(() => {
  'use strict';

  if (globalThis.__WME_STUDIO_USER_SCRIPT__) return;
  globalThis.__WME_STUDIO_USER_SCRIPT__ = true;

  // Mutation observer callbacks run as microtasks: the browser finishes all of them before it draws or answers
  // the mouse. When something else on the page keeps undoing a change Studio makes (another script, or the
  // editor re-rendering), Studio's observer and the other side can answer each other without end; the tab
  // stops responding and finally runs out of memory. That is reproducible with a test script that removes the
  // bar Studio adds next to the sidebar tabs. Every MutationObserver this script creates therefore counts how
  // often it has been called without the browser getting a turn. Past 200 calls it stops answering at once:
  // the records are kept and handled a moment later, with the wait doubling from 50 ms to 2 s while the
  // disagreement lasts (five quiet seconds reset it). Normal use never comes near the limit.
  const NativeMutationObserver = globalThis.MutationObserver;
  let observerTurn = 0, observerTurnTimer = 0, observerLoopWarned = false;
  const MutationObserver = class extends NativeMutationObserver {
    constructor(callback) {
      let turn = -1, calls = 0, held = null, trips = 0, tripAt = 0;
      super((records, observer) => {
        if (held) { held.push(...records); return; }
        if (!observerTurnTimer) observerTurnTimer = setTimeout(() => { observerTurnTimer = 0; observerTurn++; }, 0);
        if (turn !== observerTurn) { turn = observerTurn; calls = 0; }
        if (++calls <= 200) { callback(records, observer); return; }
        const now = performance.now();
        trips = now - tripAt > 5000 ? 1 : trips + 1; tripAt = now;
        if (trips >= 3 && !observerLoopWarned) {   // one long burst is not a loop; three in a row is
          observerLoopWarned = true;
          console.warn('[WME Studio] The page kept changing in answer to Studio\'s own updates (200 rounds without a pause). Studio now waits between rounds so the editor stays responsive. Another script, or the editor itself, is probably undoing one of Studio\'s changes.');
        }
        held = [...records];
        setTimeout(() => { const batch = held; held = null; callback(batch, observer); }, Math.min(2000, 50 * 2 ** Math.min(6, trips - 1)));
      });
    }
  };

  const USERSCRIPT_VERSION = '1.0.0';
  const studioResourceRecovery = (() => {
    const styles = new Map(), repairedImages = new WeakSet(), errorEvents = new WeakMap();
    function release(link,state) {
      state.observer.disconnect();link.removeEventListener('load',state.onLoad);
      state.style.remove();styles.delete(link);
    }
    function repair(element,failed = false) {
      if (repairedImages.has(element)) return true;
      if (element?.localName === 'img' && element.closest('#RAUtilWindow #header') &&
          /^https:\/\/storage\.googleapis\.com\/waze?opedia-files\/1\/1e\/RA_Util\.png(?:[?#]|$)/i.test(element.getAttribute('src') || '')) {
        const svg = element.ownerDocument.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','svg');
        svg.setAttribute('viewBox','0 0 24 24');svg.setAttribute('width','24');svg.setAttribute('height','24');
        svg.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');svg.setAttribute('focusable','false');svg.classList.add('ws-ra-util-icon');
        svg.style.cssText='float:left;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;flex-shrink:0;';
        svg.innerHTML='<g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5"/><path d="M12 2v5m0 10v5M2 12h5m10 0h5m-7-8-3 3-3-3m10 5-3 3 3 3m-10 5 3-3 3 3M4 15l3-3-3-3"/></g>';
        repairedImages.add(element);element.replaceWith(svg);return true;
      }
      if (element?.localName !== 'link' || !element.relList.contains('stylesheet') || !element.isConnected) return false;
      const href = element.getAttribute('href') || '', match = /^data:text\/css((?:;[^,]*)?),(.*)$/is.exec(href);
      if (!match || element.sheet && !failed) return false;
      if (styles.has(element)) return styles.get(element).style.sheet !== null;
      try {
        const payload = decodeURIComponent(match[2]);
        const css = /;base64(?:;|$)/i.test(match[1]) ? new TextDecoder().decode(Uint8Array.from(atob(payload),character=>character.charCodeAt(0))) : payload;
        const style = element.ownerDocument.createElement('style');
        style.dataset.wmeStudioResourceFallback='stylesheet';style.textContent=css;
        if (element.nonce) style.nonce=element.nonce;
        const sync = () => {
          for (const name of ['media','title']) {
            if (element.hasAttribute(name)) style.setAttribute(name,element.getAttribute(name));else style.removeAttribute(name);
          }
          if (style.sheet) style.sheet.disabled=element.disabled;
        };
        sync();element.before(style);
        if (!style.sheet) {style.remove();return false;}
        sync();
        const state = {style,observer:null,onLoad:null};
        state.onLoad=()=>{if(element.sheet)release(element,state);};
        state.observer=new MutationObserver(()=>{
          if (!element.isConnected || element.getAttribute('href') !== href) release(element,state);else sync();
        });
        state.observer.observe(element,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['href','media','title','disabled']});
        element.addEventListener('load',state.onLoad);styles.set(element,state);return true;
      } catch (error) {reportStudioError('Stylesheet recovery failed',error);return false;}
    }
    function inspect(node) {
      for (const image of node.querySelectorAll?.('#RAUtilWindow #header img') || []) repair(image);
      if (node.matches?.('#RAUtilWindow #header img')) repair(node);
    }
    function prune() {for (const [link,state] of styles) if (!link.isConnected) release(link,state);}
    function onError(event) {
      if (!errorEvents.has(event)) errorEvents.set(event,repair(event.target,true));
      return errorEvents.get(event);
    }
    return Object.freeze({repair,inspect,prune,onError});
  })();
  // Temporary diagnostics for this release only. Do not advance this version gate.
  const reportStudioError = (() => {
    const diagnosticVersion = '0.0.4';
    const installedVersion = typeof GM_info === 'object' && GM_info?.script?.version || USERSCRIPT_VERSION;
    if (USERSCRIPT_VERSION !== diagnosticVersion || installedVersion !== diagnosticVersion) return () => {};
    const log = console.error.bind(console), seenErrors = new WeakSet(), seenEvents = new WeakSet();
    const source = value => /^data:/i.test(String(value || '')) ? String(value).split(',',1)[0]+',…' : String(value || '').split(/[?#]/,1)[0];
    const report = (context,error,details = {}) => {
      try {
        if (error && (typeof error === 'object' || typeof error === 'function')) {
          if (seenErrors.has(error)) return;
          seenErrors.add(error);
        }
        log(`[WME Studio ${diagnosticVersion}] ${context}`,error,{
          version:diagnosticVersion,time:new Date().toISOString(),...details
        });
      } catch { /* Diagnostics must never interrupt the editor or its fallback paths. */ }
    };
    const onError = event => {
      if (seenEvents.has(event)) return;
      seenEvents.add(event);
      if (event.target?.localName && event.target !== window) {
        const element = event.target;
        const url = element.getAttribute('src') || element.getAttribute('href');
        if (studioResourceRecovery.onError(event)) {
          console.info(`[WME Studio ${diagnosticVersion}] Resource recovered locally`,{source:source(url)});return;
        }
        if (url) report('Resource load failed',new Error(`Failed to load ${element.localName}`),{source:source(url)});
      } else report('Uncaught error',event.error || event.message || 'Unknown runtime error',{
        source:source(event.filename),line:event.lineno || 0,column:event.colno || 0
      });
    };
    const onRejection = event => {
      if (seenEvents.has(event)) return;
      seenEvents.add(event);
      report('Unhandled promise rejection',event.reason);
    };
    // Observe both the userscript sandbox and WME page; leave native error reporting intact.
    for (const target of new Set([window,typeof unsafeWindow === 'undefined' ? window : unsafeWindow])) {
      target.addEventListener('error',onError,true);
      target.addEventListener('unhandledrejection',onRejection);
    }
    console.info(`[WME Studio ${diagnosticVersion}] Temporary error logging enabled for this release only.`);
    return Object.assign(report,{active:true});
  })();
  // Asset recovery remains available after the temporary diagnostic release.
  document.addEventListener('error',studioResourceRecovery.onError,true);

  // Safari compatibility: keep the native sheet on supported browsers; lower only
  // unsupported shadow-context selectors to attributes on registered UI hosts.
  globalThis.WMEStudioSafari = (() => {
    let active = false;
    try { active = !CSS.supports('selector(:host-context(html))'); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("Studio initialization",studioError); active = true; }
    const desktopViewport = '(min-width: 1180px) and (min-height: 640px)';
    if (!active) return Object.freeze({active:false,viewport:desktopViewport,page:text=>text,css:text=>text,bind:(_host,text)=>text,release:()=>{}});
    const viewport = '(min-width: 768px) and (min-height: 500px)';
    const viewportCSS = text => text.replace(/\(min-width:\s*1180px\)\s+and\s+\(min-height:\s*640px\)/g,viewport);
    const attribute = 'data-wme-studio-safari-context';
    const selectors = new Map(), compiled = new Map(), hosts = new Map(), ancestors = new Map();
    const dirty = new Set(), documents = new Map(), attributes = new Set(['class','id','slot']);
    let frame = 0, rebuild = false;
    const parent = node => node.assignedSlot || node.parentElement || node.getRootNode?.().host;
    const chain = host => {
      const nodes = [];
      for (let node = host; node?.nodeType === 1; node = parent(node)) nodes.push(node);
      return nodes;
    };
    function prepare(text) {
      if (compiled.has(text)) return compiled.get(text);
      const contexts = new Set(), parts = []; let from = 0, quote = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
        const ch = text[i];
        if (ch === '\\') { i++; continue; }
        if (quote) { if (ch === quote) quote = ''; continue; }
        if (ch === '"' || ch === "'") { quote = ch; continue; }
        if (text.startsWith('/*',i)) { const end = text.indexOf('*/',i + 2); i = end < 0 ? text.length : end + 1; continue; }
        if (!text.startsWith(':host-context(',i)) continue;
        let end = i + 14, depth = 1, innerQuote = '';
        for (; end < text.length && depth; end++) {
          const c = text[end];
          if (c === '\\') { end++; continue; }
          if (innerQuote) { if (c === innerQuote) innerQuote = ''; continue; }
          if (c === '"' || c === "'") innerQuote = c;
          else if (c === '(') depth++;
          else if (c === ')') depth--;
        }
        if (depth) continue;
        const selector = text.slice(i + 14,end - 1).trim();
        let context = selectors.get(selector);
        if (!context) {
          context = {selector,token:`s${selectors.size}`,rootOnly:/^html(?:\[[^\]]+\]|:not\(\[[^\]]+\]\))*$/.test(selector)};
          selectors.set(selector,context);
          for (const match of selector.matchAll(/\[([\w-]+)/g)) {
            if (!attributes.has(match[1])) { attributes.add(match[1]); rebuild = true; }
          }
        }
        contexts.add(context);
        parts.push(text.slice(from,i),`:host([${attribute}~="${context.token}"])`);
        from = end; i = end - 1;
      }
      parts.push(text.slice(from));
      const result = {css:viewportCSS(parts.join('')),contexts}; compiled.set(text,result); return result;
    }
    const observe = node => observer.observe(node,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:[...attributes],childList:true});
    function refreshObservers() {
      if (!rebuild) return;
      rebuild = false; observer.disconnect();
      for (const node of ancestors.keys()) observe(node);
    }
    function unlink(item) {
      for (const node of item.nodes) {
        const set = ancestors.get(node); set?.delete(item);
        if (set && !set.size) { ancestors.delete(node); rebuild = true; }
      }
    }
    function release(host) {
      const item = hosts.get(host);
      if (!item) return;
      hosts.delete(host); dirty.delete(item); unlink(item); host.removeAttribute(attribute);
      const record = documents.get(host.ownerDocument);
      if (record && --record.count === 0) {
        host.ownerDocument.removeEventListener('pointerover',record.hover,true);
        host.ownerDocument.removeEventListener('pointerout',record.hover,true);
        documents.delete(host.ownerDocument);
      }
      refreshObservers();
    }
    function sync(item, cache = new Map()) {
      const {host} = item;
      if (!host.isConnected) { release(host); return; }
      const nodes = chain(host);
      if (nodes.length !== item.nodes.length || nodes.some((node,index) => node !== item.nodes[index])) {
        unlink(item); item.nodes = nodes;
        for (const node of nodes) {
          if (!ancestors.has(node)) { ancestors.set(node,new Set()); observe(node); }
          ancestors.get(node).add(item);
        }
      }
      const matches = (node, context) => {
        if (!cache.has(node)) cache.set(node,new Map());
        const results = cache.get(node);
        if (!results.has(context)) {
          let match = false; try { match = node.matches(context.selector); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("matches",studioError);}
          results.set(context,match);
        }
        return results.get(context);
      };
      const value = [...item.contexts].filter(context => context.rootOnly
        ? matches(host.ownerDocument.documentElement,context)
        : nodes.some(node => matches(node,context))).map(context => context.token).join(' ');
      if (host.getAttribute(attribute) !== (value || null)) {
        if (value) host.setAttribute(attribute,value); else host.removeAttribute(attribute);
      }
    }
    function flush() {
      frame = 0; const pending = [...dirty], cache = new Map(); dirty.clear();
      for (const item of pending) sync(item,cache);
      refreshObservers();
    }
    function enqueue(node) {
      for (const item of ancestors.get(node) || []) dirty.add(item);
      if (dirty.size && !frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(flush);
    }
    const observer = new MutationObserver(records => {
      for (const record of records) enqueue(record.target);
    });
    function bind(host,text) {
      const result = prepare(text);
      let item = hosts.get(host);
      if (item?.text === text) return result.css;
      if (!item) {
        item = {host,nodes:[],contexts:new Set(),text:null}; hosts.set(host,item);
        const doc = host.ownerDocument;
        if (!documents.has(doc)) {
          const hover = event => {
            const current = new Set(chain(event.target)), previous = new Set(event.relatedTarget ? chain(event.relatedTarget) : []);
            for (const node of new Set([...current,...previous])) {
              if (current.has(node) === previous.has(node) || !ancestors.has(node)) continue;
              if ([...selectors.values()].some(context => context.selector.includes(':hover'))) enqueue(node);
            }
          };
          documents.set(doc,{count:0,hover});
          doc.addEventListener('pointerover',hover,true); doc.addEventListener('pointerout',hover,true);
        }
        documents.get(doc).count++;
      }
      item.text = text;
      for (const context of result.contexts) item.contexts.add(context);
      sync(item); refreshObservers(); return result.css;
    }
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-safari','on');
    const page = text => viewportCSS(text) + `
html[data-wme-studio="on"][data-wme-studio-safari="on"] { -webkit-text-size-adjust:100%; text-size-adjust:100%; }
html[data-wme-studio="on"][data-wme-studio-safari="on"] [aria-roledescription="draggable"] { touch-action:none; }
@media (hover:none) {
  html[data-wme-studio="on"][data-wme-studio-safari="on"][data-wme-studio-compact="on"] { --ws-compact-hover-opacity:var(--ws-compact-opacity,60%) !important; }
}
@media (min-width:768px) and (max-width:1179px) and (min-height:500px) {
  html[data-wme-studio="on"][data-wme-studio-safari="on"][data-wme-studio-compact="on"] { --ws-compact-header-inset:72px; }
}
`;
    return Object.freeze({active:true,viewport,page,css:text=>prepare(text).css,bind,release});
  })();
  const storageListeners = new Set();
  let refreshStudioLauncher = () => {};
  const studioRangeCSS = selector => `
${selector} {
  --ws-range-accent: var(--wme-studio-accent, var(--accent, #0099ff));
  --ws-range-rail: color-mix(in srgb, var(--wme-studio-border-strong, var(--line2, #90959c)) 50%, var(--wme-studio-surface-2, var(--surface2, #f5f7fa)));
  appearance: none !important; -webkit-appearance: none !important;

  const trackedStorageKeys = [
    'wmeStudio.workspaceProfiles.v1','wmeStudio.scriptTabPins.v1','wmeStudio.panelSizes.v1','wmeStudio.chatPanelOffset.v3','wmeStudio.streetViewWindow.v1',
    'wmeStudio.enabled','wmeStudio.theme','wmeStudio.corners','wmeStudio.accent',
    'wmeStudio.addons','wmeStudio.motion','wmeStudio.compactMode','wmeStudio.compactHeaderFullWidth','wmeStudio.compactHeaderWidth','wmeStudio.compactIslandOpacity','wmeStudio.compactSnapEdges','wmeStudio.compactSnapCenter','wmeStudio.compactIslandLayout.v1','wmeStudio.layerColumns','wmeStudio.eyeSaver','wmeStudio.satelliteBrightness','wmeStudio.viewportOverlay','wmeStudio.viewportBrightness','wmeStudio.gpsBelowRoads','wmeStudio.gpsOpacity','wmeStudio.discussionVisible','wmeStudio.compactRequests','wmeStudio.commandShortcut'
  ];
  const emitStorage = changes => {
    if (!Object.keys(changes).length) return;
    queueMicrotask(() => {
      for (const listener of [...storageListeners]) {
        try { listener(changes, 'local'); } catch (error) { if (reportStudioError.active) reportStudioError('Storage listener failed',error); else console.error('[WME Studio] storage listener failed', error); }
      }
    });
  };
  const chrome = {
    storage: {
      local: {
        async get(request) {
          const out = {};
          if (request && typeof request === 'object' && !Array.isArray(request)) {
            for (const [key, fallback] of Object.entries(request)) out[key] = await GM_getValue(key, fallback);
          } else {
            const keys = Array.isArray(request) ? request : [request];
            for (const key of keys.filter(Boolean)) out[key] = await GM_getValue(key);
          }
          return out;
        },
        async set(data) {
          const changes = {};
          for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(data || {})) {
            const oldValue = await GM_getValue(key);
            if (Object.is(oldValue, value)) continue;
            await GM_setValue(key, value);
            changes[key] = { oldValue, newValue: value };
          }
          emitStorage(changes);
        }
      },
      onChanged: {
        addListener(listener) { if (typeof listener === 'function') storageListeners.add(listener); },
        removeListener(listener) { storageListeners.delete(listener); },
        hasListener(listener) { return storageListeners.has(listener); }
      }
    },
    runtime: { getManifest: () => ({ name: 'WME Studio', version: '0.0.1' }) }
  };

  if (typeof GM_addValueChangeListener === 'function') {
    for (const key of trackedStorageKeys) {
      GM_addValueChangeListener(key, (_name, oldValue, newValue, remote) => {
        if (remote) emitStorage({ [key]: { oldValue, newValue } });
      });
    }
  }

  // "A :is(x,y,z)" as the subject of a rule is tested against every element that is styled, map features
  // included. Written once per member as "A :where(x):is(x,y,z)" the same rule is filed under that member
  // (its tag, class or attribute) and only tested against elements that have it. ":where()" adds no
  // specificity and ":is()" keeps the specificity of the whole list, so nothing else changes.
  function studioKeyedList(list, before = '', after = '') {
    const members = list.split(',').map(member => member.trim());
    const keys = [...new Set(members.map(member => /^[a-z][\w-]*/i.exec(member)?.[0] || member))];
    return keys.map(key => `${before}:where(${key}):is(${list})${after}`).join(',');
  }
  function studioButtonMotionCSS(selector, scope = ':host-context(html[data-wme-studio="on"][data-wme-studio-motion="normal"])', lift = true) {

  globalThis.WMEStudioPageStyle = GM_addStyle(globalThis.WMEStudioSafari.page(String.raw`
/* Notes on three selector forms used in this sheet (0.0.4). They change how fast rules are matched, never
   what they match or which rule wins.

   1. "@media all { ... }" blocks are state gates. Every selector inside one starts with the same root state
      (html[data-wme-studio...="..."]...), and the script switches the whole block off while that state is
      not active, so its rules take no part in matching. Rules for another state belong outside the block
      (a block that mixes states is noticed at run time and left always on). States whose attribute is not
      written through attr() - data-wme-studio-texts, -locale and the short-lived ones - are not gated.

   2. ":where(X):is(X, Y, ...)", one list member per alternative, is ":is(X, Y, ...)" spelled so that the
      browser can file each member under X instead of testing the rule against every element. ":where()"
      adds no specificity; ":is()" keeps the specificity the original list had.

   3. ":where(#id *)" or ":where(#id > *)" in front of ":has()" repeats the ancestor the selector already
      requires, so that ":has()" is only evaluated inside that container. Without it, a single evaluation
      elsewhere makes the browser restyle large parts of the page on every DOM change. */

:root {

  };
  for (const [key,translations] of Object.entries({ ...settingsStrings, ...setupStrings, ...shortcutStrings })) {
    const position = KEYS.indexOf(key);
    if (position < 0) { KEYS.push(key); for (const [language,pack] of Object.entries(PACKS)) pack.push(translations[language] || key); }
    else for (const [language,pack] of Object.entries(PACKS)) if (pack[position] === key && translations[language]) pack[position] = translations[language];
  }
  const index = new Map(KEYS.map((key, position) => [key, position]));
  const patterns = KEYS.filter(key => key.includes('{0}')).map(key => ({
    key, test: new RegExp('^' + key.replace(/[.*+?^$()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&').replace(/\{\d\}/g, '(.+?)') + '$')
  }));
  const ATTRIBUTES = ['title', 'aria-label', 'placeholder', 'aria-valuetext'];
  const roots = new Set(), texts = new WeakMap(), attributes = new WeakMap();
  let chosen = 'auto', active = 'en', used = false;
  function wmeLocale() {
    try { return String(pageWindow.I18n?.currentLocale?.() || pageWindow.I18n?.locale || document.documentElement.lang || '').toLowerCase(); }
    catch (_) { reportStudioError("wmeLocale",_); return ''; }
  }
  function supported(code) {
    code = String(code || '').toLowerCase();
    if (!code) return '';
    const base = code.split(/[-_]/)[0];
    return base === 'en' ? 'en' : PACKS[code] ? code : PACKS[base] ? base : '';
  }
  function lookup(text, language = active) {
    const pack = PACKS[language], position = index.get(text);
    return pack && position != null && pack[position] ? pack[position] : text;
  }
  function translate(text) {
    if (active === 'en' || !text) return text;
    if (index.has(text)) return lookup(text);
    for (const pattern of patterns) {
      const match = pattern.test.exec(text);
      if (!match) continue;
      let out = lookup(pattern.key);
      match.slice(1).forEach((value, position) => { out = out.replaceAll(`{${position}}`, translate(value)); });
      return out;
    }
    const point = /^(.+) · (-?\d+), (-?\d+)$/.exec(text);
    return point ? `${translate(point[1])} · ${point[2]}, ${point[3]}` : text;
  }
  function t(text, ...values) {
    let out = lookup(text);
    values.forEach((value, position) => { out = out.replaceAll(`{${position}}`, String(value)); });
    return out;
  }
  function known(text) {
    return index.has(text) || patterns.some(pattern => pattern.test.test(text)) || /^(.+) · (-?\d+), (-?\d+)$/.test(text);
  }
  function localizeText(node) {
    const record = texts.get(node);
    if (active === 'en' && !record) return;
    const source = record && node.nodeValue === record.shown ? record.source : node.nodeValue;
    const parts = /^(\s*)([\s\S]*?)(\s*)$/.exec(source), body = parts[2].replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
    const translated = body ? translate(body) : body;
    const shown = translated === body ? source : parts[1] + translated + parts[3];
    texts.set(node, { source, shown });
    if (node.nodeValue !== shown) node.nodeValue = shown;
  }
  function localizeAttributes(element) {
    let record = attributes.get(element);
    if (active === 'en' && !record) return;
    for (const name of ATTRIBUTES) {
      const value = element.getAttribute(name);
      if (value == null) continue;
      if (!record) attributes.set(element, record = {});
      const previous = record[name];
      const source = previous && value === previous.shown ? previous.source : value;
      const body = source.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' '), translated = translate(body);
      const shown = translated === body ? source : translated;
      record[name] = { source, shown };
      if (value !== shown) element.setAttribute(name, shown);
    }
  }
  function walk(node) {
    if (node.nodeType === 3) { localizeText(node); return; }
    if (node.nodeType === 1) {
      if (/^(STYLE|SCRIPT|TEXTAREA)$/.test(node.tagName) || node.hasAttribute('data-ws-keep')) return;
      localizeAttributes(node);
    } else if (node.nodeType !== 11) return;
    for (const child of node.childNodes) walk(child);
  }
  function localize(root) {
    if (!root) return;
    if (roots.has(root)) { if (used) walk(root); return; }
    roots.add(root);
    if (used) walk(root);
    new MutationObserver(records => {
      if (!used) return;
      for (const record of records) {
        if (record.type === 'characterData') localizeText(record.target);
        else if (record.type === 'attributes') localizeAttributes(record.target);
        else for (const node of record.addedNodes) walk(node);
      }
    }).observe(root, { subtree: true, childList: true, characterData: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ATTRIBUTES });
  }
  function apply() {
    const locale = wmeLocale();
    const next = chosen !== 'auto' ? supported(chosen) || 'en' : supported(locale) || 'en';
    const html = document.documentElement;
    if (html) {
      const texts = chosen !== 'auto' || !locale || !!supported(locale);
      if (texts !== (html.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-texts') === 'on')) html.toggleAttribute('data-wme-studio-texts', false), texts && html.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-texts', 'on');
      for (const [name, text] of [['--ws-t-notifications', 'Notifications'], ['--ws-t-no-notifications', 'No notifications'], ['--ws-t-new', 'new']]) {
        const value = JSON.stringify(lookup(text, next));
        if (html.style.getPropertyValue(name) !== value) html.style.setProperty(name, value);
      }
    }
    if (next === active) return;
    active = next;
    if (active !== 'en') used = true;
    if (used) for (const root of roots) walk(root);
  }
  function setLanguage(value) {
    const next = value === 'en' || PACKS[value] ? value : 'auto';
    if (next !== chosen) { chosen = next; }
    apply();
  }
  globalThis.WMEStudioI18n = Object.freeze({
    t, translate, known, localize, setLanguage, refresh: apply,
    current: () => active, selected: () => chosen, languages: () => NAMES.map(item => [...item])
  });
  apply();
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', apply, { once: true });
  window.addEventListener('load', () => { apply(); setTimeout(apply, 4000); }, { once: true });
})();

(() => {
  'use strict';
  const defaults = Object.freeze({
    enabled: true, theme: 'dark', corners: 'soft',
    accent: '#0099ff', addons: true, motion: true, compactMode: true, compactHeaderFullWidth: false, compactHeaderWidth: 100,
    compactIslandOpacity: 60, compactSnapEdges: true, compactSnapCenter: true, layerColumns: 'one',
    eyeSaver: 0, satelliteBrightness: 100, viewportBrightness: 100, hudScale: 100, panelScale: 100, fontScale: 100, gpsBelowRoads: true, gpsOpacity: 100,
    discussionVisible: 2, compactRequests: true, language: 'auto', commandShortcut: 'Shift+KeyP'
  });
  // A shortcut is stored as its modifiers plus the physical key ("Shift+KeyP"), so it is the same key on a Greek
  // or any other keyboard layout. '' means the shortcut is off. A letter, number or symbol key needs a modifier;
  // function keys can stand alone.
  const SHORTCUT_CODE = /^(?:Key[A-Z]|Digit\d|Numpad\d|F(?:[1-9]|1\d|2[0-4])|Space|Enter|Comma|Period|Slash|Semicolon|Quote|Backquote|Minus|Equal|BracketLeft|BracketRight|Backslash|IntlBackslash)$/;
  const SHORTCUT_MODIFIERS = ['Ctrl', 'Alt', 'Shift', 'Meta'];
  function normalizeShortcut(value) {
    if (value === '') return '';
    if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.length > 40) return null;
    const parts = value.split('+'), code = parts.pop(), modifiers = SHORTCUT_MODIFIERS.filter(name => parts.includes(name));
    if (!SHORTCUT_CODE.test(code) || modifiers.length !== parts.length) return null;
    if (!modifiers.length && !/^F\d/.test(code)) return null;
    if (/^(?:Space|Enter)$/.test(code) && modifiers.every(name => name === 'Shift')) return null;
    return [...modifiers, code].join('+');
  }
  function shortcutFromEvent(event) {
    if (!event.code || /^(?:Shift|Control|Alt|Meta|OS)/.test(event.code)) return undefined;   // only modifiers are down so far
    return normalizeShortcut([event.ctrlKey && 'Ctrl', event.altKey && 'Alt', event.shiftKey && 'Shift', event.metaKey && 'Meta', event.code].filter(Boolean).join('+'));
  }
  function shortcutLabel(value) {
    if (!value) return '';
    const mac = /Mac|iPhone|iPad/.test(navigator.platform || '');
    const names = { Alt: mac ? 'Option' : 'Alt', Meta: mac ? 'Cmd' : 'Win', Comma: ',', Period: '.', Slash: '/', Semicolon: ';', Quote: "'", Backquote: '`', Minus: '-', Equal: '=', BracketLeft: '[', BracketRight: ']', Backslash: '\\', IntlBackslash: '\\' };
    return value.split('+').map(part => names[part] || part.replace(/^(?:Key|Digit)/, '').replace(/^Numpad/, 'Num ')).join(' + ');
  }
  globalThis.WMEStudioShortcut = { normalize: normalizeShortcut, fromEvent: shortcutFromEvent, label: shortcutLabel, recording: false };
  const choices = { theme: ['light', 'dark', 'black'], corners: ['flat', 'soft'], layerColumns: ['one', 'two'], language: ['auto','en','el','es','pt','fr','de','it','nl','pl','ru','tr'] };
  const ranges = { compactHeaderWidth: [0, 100], compactIslandOpacity: [20, 100], eyeSaver: [0, 100], satelliteBrightness: [0, 100], viewportBrightness: [0, 100], gpsOpacity: [0, 100], hudScale: [70, 100], panelScale: [70, 100], fontScale: [85, 120], discussionVisible: [1, 10] };
  const steps = { compactHeaderWidth: 1, discussionVisible: 1 };
  const prefix = 'wmeStudio.';

  function sanitize(input = {}) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(input.viewportBrightness) && Number.isFinite(input.viewportOverlay)) input = { ...input, viewportBrightness: 100 - input.viewportOverlay };
    const out = {};
    for (const [key, fallback] of Object.entries(defaults)) {
      const value = input[key];
      if (choices[key]) out[key] = choices[key].includes(value) ? value : fallback;
      else if (ranges[key]) out[key] = Number.isFinite(value)
        ? Math.min(ranges[key][1], Math.max(ranges[key][0], Math.round(value / (steps[key] || 5)) * (steps[key] || 5)))
        : fallback;
      else if (key === 'accent') out[key] = /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(value || '') ? value.toLowerCase() : fallback;
      else if (key === 'commandShortcut') { const shortcut = normalizeShortcut(value); out[key] = shortcut === null ? fallback : shortcut; }
      else out[key] = typeof value === 'boolean' ? value : fallback;
    }
    return out;
  }

  async function read() {
    const keys = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(defaults).map(([key, value]) => [prefix + key, value]));
    keys[prefix + 'viewportBrightness'] = undefined;
    keys[prefix + 'viewportOverlay'] = undefined;
    const stored = await chrome.storage.local.get(keys);
    return sanitize({ ...Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(defaults).map(key => [key, stored[prefix + key]])), viewportOverlay: stored[prefix + 'viewportOverlay'] });
  }

  async function write(patch) {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(patch, 'viewportBrightness') && Number.isFinite(patch.viewportOverlay)) patch = { ...patch, viewportBrightness: 100 - patch.viewportOverlay };
    const clean = sanitize(patch);
    const data = Object.fromEntries(
      Object.keys(defaults)
        .filter(key => Object.hasOwn(patch, key))
        .map(key => [prefix + key, clean[key]])
    );
    await chrome.storage.local.set(data);
  }

  function changes(current, items) {
    const next = { ...current };
    for (const key of Object.keys(defaults)) {
      if (items[prefix + key]) next[key] = items[prefix + key].newValue ?? defaults[key];
    }
    return sanitize(next);
  }

  function ink(hex) {
    const rgb = hex.slice(1).match(/../g)
      .map(v => parseInt(v, 16) / 255)
      .map(v => v <= .04045 ? v / 12.92 : ((v + .055) / 1.055) ** 2.4);
    return rgb[0] * .2126 + rgb[1] * .7152 + rgb[2] * .0722 > .179 ? '#111820' : '#ffffff';
  }

  globalThis.WMEStudioSettings = Object.freeze({ defaults, sanitize, read, write, changes, ink });
})();

    const scopeCSS = (css, scope) => css.replaceAll('$root', scope);
    function selectorList(text) {
      const parts = []; let depth = 0, quote = '', start = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
        const ch = text[i];
        if (quote) { if (ch === quote && text[i - 1] !== '\\') quote = ''; continue; }
        if (ch === '"' || ch === "'") quote = ch;
        else if (ch === '(' || ch === '[') depth++;
        else if (ch === ')' || ch === ']') depth--;
        else if (ch === ',' && !depth) { parts.push(text.slice(start, i)); start = i + 1; }
      }
      parts.push(text.slice(start)); return parts;
    }
    function safeRoot(node) {
      return node?.nodeType === 1 && !node.matches(nativeRoot) && !node.localName.startsWith('wz-') && !node.matches('script,style,svg,canvas,img,iframe') && !node.querySelector('.app,#app-head,#WazeMap,#sidebar');
    }
    function attachShadow(host) {
      if (!safeRoot(host) || !host.shadowRoot || !compatibilityRoots.has(host)) return false;
      const ids = [...memberships.get(host)].filter(id => adapters.get(id)?.shadow);
      if (!ids.length) return false;
      const key = ids.sort().join(' ');
      let text = scopeCSS(genericCSS, `:host-context(${enabled}):host([data-wme-studio-compat])`);
      for (const id of ids) text += scopeCSS(adapters.get(id).shadowCSS || adapters.get(id).css, `:host-context(${enabled}):host([data-wme-studio-compat~="${id}"])`);
      text = globalThis.WMEStudioSafari.bind(host,text);
      const shadow = host.shadowRoot;
      const old = shadowStyles.get(shadow);
      if (old?.text === text && (old.sheet ? shadow.adoptedStyleSheets.includes(old.sheet) : old.style?.isConnected)) return true;
      if (old?.sheet) shadow.adoptedStyleSheets = shadow.adoptedStyleSheets.filter(s => s !== old.sheet);
      if (old?.style) old.style.remove();
      const item = { host, text, sheet: null, style: null };
      try {
        if (!shadowSheets.has(key) || shadowSheets.get(key).text !== text) {
          const sheet = new CSSStyleSheet(); sheet.replaceSync(text); shadowSheets.set(key, { sheet, text });
        }
        item.sheet = shadowSheets.get(key).sheet;
        shadow.adoptedStyleSheets = [...shadow.adoptedStyleSheets, item.sheet];
      } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("attachShadow",studioError);
        item.sheet = null; item.style = document.createElement('style');
        item.style.dataset.wmeStudioCompat = '1'; item.style.textContent = text; shadow.append(item.style);
      }
      shadowStyles.set(shadow, item);
      return true;
    }
    function registerRoot(node, id = 'opt-in') {
      if (!safeRoot(node) || (id !== 'opt-in' && !adapters.has(id))) return false;
      if (!memberships.has(node)) { memberships.set(node, new Set()); compatibilityRoots.add(node); }
      const ids = memberships.get(node);
      if (!ids.has(id)) { ids.add(id); node.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-compat', [...ids].join(' ')); }
      attachShadow(node);
      return true;
    }
    function unregisterRoot(node, id) {
      const ids = memberships.get(node);
      if (!ids) return;
      if (id && !ids.has(id)) return;
      if (id) ids.delete(id); else ids.clear();
      if (ids.size) node.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-compat', [...ids].join(' '));
      else { node.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-compat'); memberships.delete(node); compatibilityRoots.delete(node); }
      const old = shadowStyles.get(node.shadowRoot);
      if (old) {
        if (old.sheet) node.shadowRoot.adoptedStyleSheets = node.shadowRoot.adoptedStyleSheets.filter(s => s !== old.sheet);
        old.style?.remove(); shadowStyles.delete(node.shadowRoot);
      }
      if (ids.size) attachShadow(node);
      else globalThis.WMEStudioSafari.release(node);
    }
    let fumeLayoutQueued = false;
    function inspectFume(node) {
      if (node.id === '_cbShrinkTopBars' && adapters.has('wme-fume')) {
        const pane = node.parentElement;
        if (safeRoot(pane) && pane.querySelector('#_inpUICompression') && pane.querySelector('#_inpUIContrast') && pane.querySelector('#_inpASX')) {
          if (!pane.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-fume-panel')) pane.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-fume-panel', '');
          const statusButton = pane.querySelector('#_btnKillNode');
          if (statusButton && !statusButton.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-semantic')) statusButton.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-semantic', '');
          registerRoot(pane, 'wme-fume');
        }
      }
      if (node.id && node.matches(fumeAnchors + ',#abAlerts,#WMEFUzoom,#WMEFUPC')) scheduleFumeLayout();
    }
    function syncFumeLayout() {
      fumeLayoutQueued = false;
      const root = document.documentElement;
      const active = adapters.has('wme-fume');
      const style = active ? document.getElementById('WMEFUMEshrinkTopBars') : null;
      let height = '';
      if (style?.sheet && !style.disabled) {
        for (const rule of style.sheet.cssRules) if (rule.selectorText === '#app-head') { height = rule.style.height; break; }
      }
      const sizes = height === '35px' ? ['low','35px','33px','24px'] : height === '24px' ? ['high','24px','26px','18px'] : null;
      const present = active && !!(style || document.getElementById('_cbShrinkTopBars') || document.getElementById('abAlerts') || document.getElementById('WMEFUzoom'));
      const attributes = { 'data-wme-studio-fume': present ? 'on' : null, 'data-wme-studio-fume-compact': sizes?.[0] || null };
      for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(attributes)) {
        if (value === null) { if (root.hasAttribute(name)) root.removeAttribute(name); }
        else if (root.getAttribute(name) !== value) root.setAttribute(name, value);
      }
      const values = { '--wme-studio-fume-header': sizes?.[1], '--wme-studio-fume-overlay': sizes?.[2], '--wme-studio-fume-topbar': sizes?.[3] };
      for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
        if (!value) { if (root.style.getPropertyValue(name)) root.style.removeProperty(name); }
        else if (root.style.getPropertyValue(name) !== value) root.style.setProperty(name, value);
      }
    }
    function scheduleFumeLayout() { if (!fumeLayoutQueued) { fumeLayoutQueued = true; queueMicrotask(syncFumeLayout); } }
    function collect(records) {
      for (const record of records) {
        if (record.target.id === 'WMEFUMEshrinkTopBars') { scheduleFumeLayout(); return; }
        for (const nodes of [record.addedNodes, record.removedNodes]) for (const node of nodes) {
          if (node.nodeType === 1 && node.id === 'WMEFUMEshrinkTopBars') { scheduleFumeLayout(); return; }
        }
      }
    }
    function inspect(node) {
      if (node?.nodeType !== 1) return;
      inspectFume(node);
      const dialog = node.closest('.ui-dialog');
      if (dialog && !dialog.classList.contains('wme-studio-toolbox-dialog') &&
          (dialog.querySelector('[class*="WMETB_"],[id^="WMETB_"]') || /^Toolbox\s*(?:[-–—:]|$)/i.test(dialog.querySelector('.ui-dialog-title')?.textContent?.trim() || ''))) {
        dialog.classList.add('wme-studio-toolbox-dialog'); registerRoot(dialog,'toolbox');
      }
      if (node?.nodeType !== 1 || !node.matches(selector)) return;
      if (node.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-compatible')) registerRoot(node);
      for (const adapter of adapters.values()) if (node.matches(adapter.selector)) registerRoot(node, adapter.id);
    }
    function discover(start = document) {
      inspect(start);
      if (start.querySelectorAll) for (const node of start.querySelectorAll(selector)) inspect(node);
    }
    function prune() {
      let fumeRemoved = false;
      for (const node of compatibilityRoots) if (!node.isConnected) { fumeRemoved ||= memberships.get(node)?.has('wme-fume'); unregisterRoot(node); }
      if (fumeRemoved) scheduleFumeLayout();
    }
    function rebuild() {
      rebuildQueued = false;
      let text = scopeCSS(genericCSS, `${enabled} [data-wme-studio-compat]`);
      for (const adapter of adapters.values()) text += '\n' + scopeCSS(adapter.css, `${enabled} [data-wme-studio-compat~="${adapter.id}"][data-wme-studio-compat]`);
      if (!sheetNode?.isConnected) { sheetNode = document.createElement('style'); sheetNode.id = 'wme-studio-compatibility'; (document.head || document.documentElement).append(sheetNode); }
      if (sheetNode.textContent !== text) sheetNode.textContent = text;
      selector = ['[data-wme-studio-compatible]', fumeAnchors, ...[...adapters.values()].map(a => a.selector)].join(',');
      discover();
      for (const node of compatibilityRoots) attachShadow(node);
    }
    function scheduleRebuild() { if (!rebuildQueued) { rebuildQueued = true; queueMicrotask(rebuild); } }
    // `builtIn` is only passed for the adapters that ship in this file: their stylesheets are known to be
    // scoped, so they are not parsed a second time just to check that.
    function registerCompatibilityAdapter(spec, builtIn = false) {
      if (!spec || !/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/.test(spec.id) || !Array.isArray(spec.selectors) || !spec.selectors.length) throw new TypeError('Adapter needs an id and exact root selectors.');
      for (const sel of spec.selectors) {
        if (typeof sel !== 'string' || !/^(?:[.#][A-Za-z_][\w-]*(?:[.#][A-Za-z_][\w-]*)*|\[data-[\w-]+(?:=["'][\w-]+["'])?\])$/.test(sel)) throw new TypeError('Use an exact script root selector.');
        const probe = document.createElement('div');
        if (sel[0] === '#') probe.id = sel.slice(1);
        if (sel[0] === '.') probe.className = sel.slice(1).replaceAll('.', ' ');
        if (probe.matches(nativeRoot)) throw new TypeError('Native WME roots cannot be compatibility roots.');
      }
      if (adapters.has(spec.id)) return false;
      const css = String(spec.css || ''), shadowCSS = String(spec.shadowCSS || '');
      for (const source of builtIn ? [] : [css, shadowCSS]) {
        if (!source.trim()) continue;
        const sheet = new CSSStyleSheet(); sheet.replaceSync(scopeCSS(source, '.wme-studio-validation-root'));
        const validate = rules => { for (const rule of rules) {
          if (rule.selectorText) { if (selectorList(rule.selectorText).some(sel => !sel.trim().startsWith('.wme-studio-validation-root'))) throw new TypeError('Every adapter selector must start with $root.'); }
          else if (rule.cssRules && /^(?:@media|@supports)/.test(rule.cssText)) validate(rule.cssRules);
          else throw new TypeError('Only scoped style/media/supports rules are allowed.');
        } };
        validate(sheet.cssRules);
      }
      adapters.set(spec.id, { id: spec.id, selectors: [...spec.selectors], selector: spec.selectors.join(','), css, shadowCSS, shadow: spec.shadow === true });
      scheduleRebuild();
      return true;
    }
    function unregisterAdapter(id) {
      if (!adapters.delete(id)) return;
      if (id === 'wme-fume') scheduleFumeLayout();
      for (const node of compatibilityRoots) unregisterRoot(node, id);
      shadowSheets.clear(); scheduleRebuild();
    }
    const api = Object.freeze({ version: 1, registerCompatibilityAdapter: spec => registerCompatibilityAdapter(spec), unregisterAdapter, registerRoot, unregisterRoot, registerShadowRoot: attachShadow,
      refresh() { prune(); discover(); }, getRoots: () => [...compatibilityRoots], getAdapters: () => [...adapters.keys()] });
    globalThis.WMEStudioTheme = api;
    document.addEventListener('wme-studio:register-adapter', event => {
      try { registerCompatibilityAdapter(typeof event.detail === 'string' ? JSON.parse(event.detail) : event.detail); }
      catch (error) { if (reportStudioError.active) reportStudioError('Compatibility adapter rejected',error); else console.warn('[WME Studio] Compatibility adapter rejected:', error.message); }
    });
    document.addEventListener('wme-studio:refresh-compatibility', () => api.refresh());

    registerCompatibilityAdapter({
      id: 'map-pins',
      selectors: ['.wmeRcPins','.wmeRcPinsStandaloneSidebar','.wmeRcPinsTabView','.wmeRcPinsTabPanelHost','.wmeRcPinsBubble','.wmeRcPinsContextMenu','.wmeRcPinsContextSubmenu','.wmeRcPinSetDropdownMenu','.wmeRcUnifiedDropdownMenu'],
      css: String.raw`
$root {
  --wmeRcPinsBg: var(--wme-studio-surface) !important;

  --wmeRcPinsBtnHover: var(--wme-studio-hover) !important;

/* Notes on the selector forms used in this sheet (0.0.4). It is adopted by every wz-* shadow root, so what
   matters here is how much work one rule costs per component. None of these forms changes what a rule
   matches or which rule wins.

   1. "@media all { ... }" blocks are state gates: every selector inside starts with the same
      ":host-context(html[data-wme-studio...="..."]...)" and the script switches the block off while that
      state is not active. Where :host-context() is supported, the script also drops that prefix from the
      rules of a gate when the sheet is first used (the gate already guarantees it) and gives its specificity
      back with ":not(.ws-0)...:not(ws-0)", the same way the universal rules were handled before.

   2. "S:is(A B > *)" is "A B > S" with the ancestors written on the subject. A leading ":host(...)" or
      ":host-context(...)" stays in front. The browser keeps one invalidation entry per ancestor name and per
      shadow root; written this way the ancestors do not create those entries.

   3. ":where(X):is(X, Y, ...)", one list member per alternative, is ":is(X, Y, ...)" spelled so that each
      member can be filed under X. */

${studioHeaderAddonCSS(':host-context(html[data-wme-studio="on"][data-wme-studio-addons="on"]):host-context(#app-head)')}

  function sanitizeCompactIslandLayout(value) {

    return {
      left: spec.id === 'header' && compactHeaderSpansViewport(size.width, frame.width) ? (frame.width - size.width) / 2 : Math.max(horizontalInset, Math.min(Math.round(left), frame.width - horizontalInset - size.width)),
      top: Math.max(12, Math.min(Math.round(top), bottom - size.height)),
      ...size
    };
  }

  const COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP = 2;
  function compactRectClear(rect, obstacles, gap = COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP) {
    return obstacles.every(other => rect.left + rect.width + gap <= other.left ||
      other.left + other.width + gap <= rect.left ||
      rect.top + rect.height + gap <= other.top || other.top + other.height + gap <= rect.top);
  }
  function compactFreePosition(rect, obstacles, viewport = { width: innerWidth, height: innerHeight }, accept = () => true, horizontalInset = 12) {
    const inset = 12, maxLeft = Math.floor(viewport.width - rect.width - horizontalInset), maxTop = Math.floor(viewport.height - rect.height - inset);
    if (maxLeft < horizontalInset || maxTop < inset) return null;
    const clampX = x => Math.min(maxLeft, Math.max(horizontalInset, Math.round(x)));
    const clampY = y => Math.min(maxTop, Math.max(inset, Math.round(y)));
    const preferred = { ...rect, left: clampX(rect.left), top: clampY(rect.top) };
    const clear = candidate => compactRectClear(candidate, obstacles) && accept(candidate);
    if (clear(preferred)) return preferred;
    const xs = new Set([preferred.left, horizontalInset, maxLeft]), ys = new Set([preferred.top, inset, maxTop]);
    for (const other of obstacles) {
      xs.add(clampX(Math.floor(other.left - rect.width - COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP)));
      xs.add(clampX(Math.ceil(other.left + other.width + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP)));
      ys.add(clampY(Math.floor(other.top - rect.height - COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP)));
      ys.add(clampY(Math.ceil(other.top + other.height + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP)));
    }
    let best = null, distance = Infinity;
    for (const left of xs) for (const top of ys) {
      const candidate = { ...rect, left, top }, cost = (left - preferred.left) ** 2 + (top - preferred.top) ** 2;
      if (cost < distance && clear(candidate)) { best = candidate; distance = cost; }
    }
    return best;
  }
  function compactFitInPlace(rect, obstacles, viewport = { width: innerWidth, height: innerHeight }, minimum = 200) {
    const inset = 12;
    if (rect.left < inset || rect.top < inset || rect.left + rect.width > viewport.width - inset) return null;
    let high = Math.min(Math.floor(rect.height), Math.floor(viewport.height - inset - rect.top)), low = Math.min(minimum, high);
    if (high < 1 || high < low || !compactRectClear({ ...rect, height: low }, obstacles)) return null;
    let best = low;
    while (low <= high) {
      const height = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
      if (compactRectClear({ ...rect, height }, obstacles)) { best = height; low = height + 1; }
      else high = height - 1;
    }
    return { ...rect, height: best };
  }
  function compactFitPanel(rect, obstacles, viewport = { width: innerWidth, height: innerHeight }) {
    const full = compactFreePosition(rect,obstacles,viewport);
    if (full) return full;
    let low = Math.min(120,Math.floor(rect.height)), high = Math.floor(rect.height) - 1;
    let best = compactFreePosition({...rect,height:low},obstacles,viewport);
    if (!best) return null;
    while (low <= high) {
      const height = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
      const placed = compactFreePosition({...rect,height},obstacles,viewport);
      if (placed) { best = placed; low = height + 1; }
      else high = height - 1;
    }
    return best;
  }
  function compactSlidePosition(rect, previous, obstacles, viewport = { width: innerWidth, height: innerHeight }, inset = 12, horizontalInset = inset) {
    const gap = COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP;
    const clamp = (value, maximum) => Math.max(inset, Math.min(Math.round(value), maximum - inset));
    let left = Math.max(horizontalInset, Math.min(Math.round(rect.left), viewport.width - rect.width - horizontalInset));
    let top = clamp(rect.top, viewport.height - rect.height);
    for (const other of obstacles) {
      if (previous.top + rect.height + gap <= other.top || other.top + other.height + gap <= previous.top) continue;
      if (left > previous.left && previous.left + rect.width + gap <= other.left) left = Math.min(left, other.left - rect.width - gap);
      if (left < previous.left && previous.left >= other.left + other.width + gap) left = Math.max(left, other.left + other.width + gap);
    }
    for (const other of obstacles) {
      if (left + rect.width + gap <= other.left || other.left + other.width + gap <= left) continue;
      if (top > previous.top && previous.top + rect.height + gap <= other.top) top = Math.min(top, other.top - rect.height - gap);
      if (top < previous.top && previous.top >= other.top + other.height + gap) top = Math.max(top, other.top + other.height + gap);
    }
    const placed = { ...rect, left, top };
    return compactRectClear(placed, obstacles) ? placed : compactFreePosition(previous, obstacles, viewport, () => true, horizontalInset);
  }
  function compactLauncherObstacles(exclude = null) {
    return ['online','tile'].filter(id => id !== exclude).map(id => compactVisibleRect(queryCompactIsland(compactIslandSpec(id)))).filter(Boolean);
  }
  // Only a header that actually spans the viewport has no horizontal room.
  function compactHeaderPlacement(rect, previous, obstacles, viewport = { width: innerWidth, height: innerHeight }) {
    if (!compactHeaderSpansViewport(rect.width, viewport.width)) return compactSlidePosition(rect, previous, obstacles, viewport, 12, compactHeaderHorizontalInset(rect.width, viewport.width));
    const left = (viewport.width - rect.width) / 2;
    const maxTop = Math.max(12, viewport.height - rect.height - 12);
    const clamp = value => Math.max(12, Math.min(Math.round(value), maxTop));
    let top = clamp(rect.top);
    for (const other of obstacles) {
      if (left + rect.width + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP <= other.left || other.left + other.width + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP <= left) continue;
      if (top > previous.top && previous.top + rect.height + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP <= other.top) top = Math.min(top, other.top - rect.height - COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP);
      if (top < previous.top && previous.top >= other.top + other.height + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP) top = Math.max(top, other.top + other.height + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP);
    }
    const candidate = y => ({ ...rect, left, top: clamp(y) });
    if (compactRectClear(candidate(top), obstacles)) return candidate(top);
    const candidates = [...new Set([previous.top, 12, maxTop, ...obstacles.flatMap(other =>
      [other.top - rect.height - COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP, other.top + other.height + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP])])]
      .map(candidate).filter(point => compactRectClear(point, obstacles));
    candidates.sort((a, b) => Math.abs(a.top - previous.top) - Math.abs(b.top - previous.top));
    return candidates[0] || null;
  }
  function compactHeaderObstacles() {
    const elements = new Set(compactIslandSpecs.filter(spec => spec.id !== 'header').map(queryCompactIsland));
    for (const element of [document.getElementById('sidebar'), document.getElementById('filter-panel-region'),
      ...headerGuardWindows.keys(), ...[...onlineEditorsPanels.values()].map(state => state.panel)]) elements.add(element);
    return [...elements].map(compactVisibleRect).filter(Boolean);
  }
  function compactDragInProgress() {
    return !!(sidePanelResizing() || compactLayoutEditor?.dragging?.() || floatingHeader.drag || requestHeaderDrag || [...mapLayerWindows.values()].some(state => state.drag));
  }
  function compactTileExpansion(rect, obstacles, viewport = { width: innerWidth, height: innerHeight }) {
    let left = 12, right = viewport.width - 12;
    for (const other of obstacles) {
      if (rect.top + rect.height + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP <= other.top || other.top + other.height + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP <= rect.top) continue;
      if (other.left + other.width <= rect.left) left = Math.max(left, other.left + other.width + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP);
      if (other.left >= rect.left + rect.width) right = Math.min(right, other.left - COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP);
    }
    const leftWidth = Math.max(rect.width, rect.left + rect.width - left), rightWidth = Math.max(rect.width, right - rect.left);
    return { right: rightWidth > leftWidth, width: Math.min(440, Math.max(leftWidth, rightWidth)) };
  }
  function compactVisibleRect(element) {
    if (!element?.isConnected || element.hidden || element.getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true' || element.classList.contains('hide-layer-switcher')) return null;
    const style = getComputedStyle(element), rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden' || rect.width < 12 || rect.height < 12 || rect.right <= 0 || rect.bottom <= 0 || rect.left >= innerWidth || rect.top >= innerHeight) return null;
    return { left: rect.left, top: rect.top, width: rect.width, height: rect.height };
  }
  function compactOnlinePanelPlacement(anchor, size, obstacles, viewport = { width: innerWidth, height: innerHeight }) {
    const gap = COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP;
    const opensRight = anchor.left + anchor.width / 2 <= viewport.width / 2;
    const left = opensRight ? anchor.left : anchor.left + anchor.width - size.width;
    for (const height of [...new Set([size.height, Math.min(size.height, 240), Math.min(size.height, 180), Math.min(size.height, 128)])]) {
      const sides = [anchor.left + anchor.width + gap, anchor.left - gap - size.width];
      if (!opensRight) sides.reverse();
      const candidates = [
        ...sides.map(left => ({ left, top: anchor.top + anchor.height - height })),
        { left, top: anchor.top - gap - height }, { left, top: anchor.top + anchor.height + gap }
      ].map(point => ({ ...point, width: size.width, height }));
      const inBounds = rect => rect.left >= 12 && rect.top >= 12 && rect.left + rect.width <= viewport.width - 12 && rect.top + rect.height <= viewport.height - 12;
      for (const candidate of candidates) if (inBounds(candidate) && compactRectClear(candidate, obstacles)) return candidate;
      const placed = compactFreePosition(candidates[0], obstacles, viewport);
      if (placed) return placed;
    }
    return null;
  }
  let compactAuxiliaryFrame = 0;
  const compactPlacementElements = new Set();
  const compactPlacementResize = typeof ResizeObserver === 'function' ? new ResizeObserver(() => {queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();queueHeaderGuardWindows();}) : null;
  const compactPlacementObserver = new MutationObserver(records => {
    if (records.some(record => record.attributeName !== 'style' || !mapLayerWindows.get(record.target)?.drag)) {queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();queueHeaderGuardWindows();}
  });
  function observeCompactPlacement(element) {
    if (!element?.isConnected || compactPlacementElements.has(element)) return;
    compactPlacementElements.add(element);
    compactPlacementResize?.observe(element);
    compactPlacementObserver.observe(element, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style','class','hidden','aria-hidden'] });
  }
  function clearCompactTaskFilters(panel = document.getElementById('filter-panel-region')) {
    if (!panel) return;
    panel.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-filter-space');
    for (const name of ['--ws-filter-left','--ws-filter-top','--ws-filter-height']) {
      if (panel.style.getPropertyValue(name)) panel.style.removeProperty(name);
    }
  }
  function syncCompactTaskFilters(obstacles, sidebar) {
    const panel = document.getElementById('filter-panel-region');
    if (!panel) return null;
    const app = panel.closest('.app');
    observeCompactPlacement(panel); observeCompactPlacement(app);
    if (!app?.classList.contains('filter-panel-open') || app.classList.contains('sidebar-fullscreen')) {
      clearCompactTaskFilters(panel); return null;
    }
    const bounds = panel.getBoundingClientRect(), sidebarRect = compactVisibleRect(sidebar);
    const anchor = sidebarRect || compactVisibleRect(document.getElementById('drawer')) || { left: 12, width: 52 };
    const header = compactVisibleRect(document.getElementById('app-head'));
    const top = sidebarRect?.top ?? (header && header.top + header.height < innerHeight / 2 ? header.top + header.height + 24 : 100);
    const footer = compactVisibleRect(document.querySelector('.wz-map-ol-footer'));
    const bottom = Math.min(innerHeight - 24, footer ? footer.top - COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP : innerHeight - 24,
      sidebarRect ? sidebarRect.top + sidebarRect.height : innerHeight - 24);
    const width = Math.min(320, innerWidth - 24), available = Math.max(0, bottom - top);
    const height = panel.classList.contains('curated-tasks-mode') ? Math.min(available, panel.scrollHeight || bounds.height) : available;
    const sides = [anchor.left + anchor.width + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP, anchor.left - width - COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP];
    if (anchor.left + anchor.width / 2 > innerWidth / 2) sides.reverse();
    const occupied = [...obstacles];
    if (compactLayoutEditing) for (const id of ['online','tile']) {
      const rect = compactVisibleRect(queryCompactIsland(compactIslandSpec(id)));
      if (rect) occupied.push(rect);
    }
    let placed = null;
    for (const cap of [...new Set([height, Math.min(height, 560), Math.min(height, 420), Math.min(height, 320), Math.min(height, 240)])]) {
      if (cap <= 0) continue;
      for (const left of sides) {
        const candidate = { left, top, width, height: cap };
        if (left >= 12 && left + width <= innerWidth - 12 && top >= 12 && top + cap <= innerHeight - 12 && compactRectClear(candidate, occupied)) {
          placed = candidate; break;
        }
      }
      if (!placed) placed = compactFreePosition({ left: sides[0], top, width, height: cap }, occupied);
      if (placed) break;
    }
    const space = placed ? 'clear' : 'blocked';
    if (panel.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-filter-space') !== space) panel.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-filter-space', space);
    if (!placed) return null;
    for (const [name, value] of [['--ws-filter-left',placed.left], ['--ws-filter-top',placed.top], ['--ws-filter-height',placed.height]]) {
      const text = `${value}px`;
      if (panel.style.getPropertyValue(name) !== text) panel.style.setProperty(name, text);
    }
    return placed;
  }
  const toolboxLoggers = new Map();
  const toolboxDashboards = new Map();
  const toolboxDashboardProperties = ['left','top','right','bottom'];
  const toolboxDashboardResize = typeof ResizeObserver === 'function' ? new ResizeObserver(queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement) : null;
  function toolboxPlacementObstacles(exclude = null, includeLoggers = true) {
    return [...new Set([
      ...compactIslandSpecs.map(queryCompactIsland),...headerGuardWindows.keys(),
      document.getElementById('sidebar'),document.getElementById('filter-panel-region'),
      document.querySelector('.wz-map-ol-footer'),floatingHeader.locationLabel,
      document.querySelector('.wme-studio-header-location[data-placement]:not([data-placement="inline"])'),
      ...[...onlineEditorsPanels.values()].map(state=>state.panel),
      document.querySelector('.ws-street-view-toolbar'),document.getElementById('wme-studio-minimized-requests'),
      ...searchAreaButtons,
      document.getElementById('WMETB_Dashboard'),document.getElementById('WMETB_NavBar'),
      ...(includeLoggers ? toolboxLoggers.keys() : [])
    ])].filter(element=>element!==exclude).map(compactVisibleRect).filter(Boolean)
      .map(rect=>({left:rect.left-6,top:rect.top-6,width:rect.width+12,height:rect.height+12}));
  }
  function rememberToolboxDashboardStyle(state) {
    for (const name of toolboxDashboardProperties) {
      const value = state.element.style.getPropertyValue(name), priority = state.element.style.getPropertyPriority(name);
      const applied = state.applied.get(name);
      if (!applied || value!==applied.value || priority!==applied.priority) state.originals.set(name,{value,priority});
    }
  }
  function trackToolboxDashboard(element) {
    if (toolboxDashboards.has(element)) return;
    const state = {element,originals:new Map(),applied:new Map(),writtenStyle:null,dragging:false};
    rememberToolboxDashboardStyle(state);
    state.observer = new MutationObserver(records=>{
      if (records.some(record=>record.attributeName==='style') && element.style.cssText!==state.writtenStyle) rememberToolboxDashboardStyle(state);
      if (records.some(record=>record.attributeName!=='style') || element.style.cssText!==state.writtenStyle) queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();
    });
    state.observer.observe(element,{attributes:true,attributeOldValue:true,attributeFilter:['style','class','hidden']});
    state.start = event => {
      if (event.button!==0 || event.isPrimary===false || !event.target.closest?.('#WMETB_DashboardTitle,.ui-draggable-handle')) return;
      state.dragging = true;
    };
    element.addEventListener('pointerdown',state.start,{capture:true,passive:true});
    toolboxDashboards.set(element,state); toolboxDashboardResize?.observe(element);
    queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();
  }
  function finishToolboxDashboardDrag() {
    for (const state of toolboxDashboards.values()) if (state.dragging) {
      state.dragging = false; queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();
    }
  }
  window.addEventListener('pointerup',finishToolboxDashboardDrag,{capture:true,passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('pointercancel',finishToolboxDashboardDrag,{capture:true,passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('blur',finishToolboxDashboardDrag);
  function syncToolboxDashboards() {
    for (const [element,state] of toolboxDashboards) {
      if (!element.isConnected) {
        state.observer.disconnect(); toolboxDashboardResize?.unobserve(element);
        element.removeEventListener('pointerdown',state.start,true); toolboxDashboards.delete(element); continue;
      }
      if (!compactLayoutActive() || !settings.addons) {
        if (state.applied.size) {
          for (const [name,{value,priority}] of state.originals) {
            if (value) element.style.setProperty(name,value,priority); else element.style.removeProperty(name);
          }
          state.writtenStyle = element.style.cssText; state.applied.clear();
        }
        continue;
      }
      // Toolbox keeps its native drag handler; settle after its mouseup, without competing writes.
      if (state.dragging || element.classList.contains('ui-draggable-dragging') || compactDragInProgress()) continue;
      const style = getComputedStyle(element);
      if (element.hidden || element.getAttribute('aria-hidden')==='true' || style.display==='none' || style.visibility==='hidden') continue;
      if (!['absolute','fixed'].includes(style.position)) continue;
      const bounds = element.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (bounds.width<12 || bounds.height<12) continue;
      const rect = {left:bounds.left,top:bounds.top,width:bounds.width,height:bounds.height};
      const placed = compactFreePosition(rect,toolboxPlacementObstacles(element));
      if (!placed || (Math.abs(placed.left-rect.left)<.5 && Math.abs(placed.top-rect.top)<.5)) continue;
      const zoom = element.currentCSSZoom || 1;
      const left = parseFloat(style.left), top = parseFloat(style.top);
      if (!Number.isFinite(left) || !Number.isFinite(top)) continue;
      element.style.setProperty('left',`${left + (placed.left-rect.left) / zoom}px`,element.style.getPropertyPriority('left'));
      element.style.setProperty('top',`${top + (placed.top-rect.top) / zoom}px`,element.style.getPropertyPriority('top'));
      if (style.right!=='auto') element.style.setProperty('right','auto',element.style.getPropertyPriority('right'));
      if (style.bottom!=='auto') element.style.setProperty('bottom','auto',element.style.getPropertyPriority('bottom'));
      for (const name of toolboxDashboardProperties) state.applied.set(name,{value:element.style.getPropertyValue(name),priority:element.style.getPropertyPriority(name)});
      state.writtenStyle = element.style.cssText;
    }
  }
  const toolboxLoggerResize = typeof ResizeObserver === 'function' ? new ResizeObserver(queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement) : null;
  const toolboxLoggerVariables = ['--ws-toolbox-log-left','--ws-toolbox-log-top','--ws-toolbox-log-width','--ws-toolbox-log-height'];
  function trackToolboxLogger(element) {
    if (!toolboxLoggers.has(element)) {
      const nativeStyle = text => (text || '').replace(/--ws-toolbox-log-(?:left|top|width|height)\s*:[^;]*(?:;|$)/g,'').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ');
      const observer = new MutationObserver(records=>{
        if (records.some(record=>record.target!==element || record.attributeName!=='style' || nativeStyle(record.oldValue)!==nativeStyle(element.style.cssText))) queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();
      });
      observer.observe(element,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true,attributes:true,attributeOldValue:true,attributeFilter:['style','class','hidden']});
      toolboxLoggers.set(element,observer); toolboxLoggerResize?.observe(element);
    }
    queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();
  }
  function syncToolboxLoggers() {
    if (!toolboxLoggers.size) return;
    const active = compactLayoutActive() && settings.addons;
    const clear = element => {
      element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-log-space');
      for (const name of toolboxLoggerVariables) if (element.style.getPropertyValue(name)) element.style.removeProperty(name);
    };
    const obstacles = active ? toolboxPlacementObstacles(null,false) : [];
    const header = active ? compactVisibleRect(document.getElementById('app-head')) : null;
    // Show warnings first; normal messages never displace or cover them.
    const entries = [...toolboxLoggers].sort(([a],[b])=>Number(b.id==='WMETB_logger_warn')-Number(a.id==='WMETB_logger_warn'));
    for (const [element,observer] of entries) {
      if (!element.isConnected) { observer.disconnect(); toolboxLoggerResize?.unobserve(element); toolboxLoggers.delete(element); clear(element); continue; }
      if (!active || !element.textContent.trim()) { clear(element); continue; }
      const style = getComputedStyle(element);
      if (element.hidden || style.display==='none') { clear(element); continue; }
      let placed = null;
      for (const width of [...new Set([Math.min(500,innerWidth-24),Math.min(320,innerWidth-24),Math.min(180,innerWidth-24)])]) {
        setElementVariable(element,'--ws-toolbox-log-width',`${width}px`);
        setElementVariable(element,'--ws-toolbox-log-height','160px');
        if (!element.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-log-space')) element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-log-space','clear');
        const height = Math.min(160,Math.max(24,element.scrollHeight));
        for (const cap of [...new Set([height,Math.min(height,48),Math.min(height,28)])]) {
          placed = compactFreePosition({left:(innerWidth-width)/2,top:header ? header.top+header.height+10 : 70,width,height:cap},obstacles);
          if (placed) break;
        }
        if (placed) break;
      }
      const space = placed ? 'clear' : 'blocked';
      if (element.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-log-space')!==space) element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-log-space',space);
      if (!placed) continue;
      for (const [axis,value] of Object.entries(placed)) setElementVariable(element,`--ws-toolbox-log-${axis}`,`${Math.round(value)}px`);
      obstacles.push({left:placed.left-6,top:placed.top-6,width:placed.width+12,height:placed.height+12});
    }
  }
  // Set while a slider is being dragged (see WMEStudioPreview.quick); "var" because placement can be asked for
  // before this line has run.
  var quickPreviewUntil = 0;
  function queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement() {
    if (sidePanelResizing() || performance.now() < quickPreviewUntil) return;
    if (!compactAuxiliaryFrame) compactAuxiliaryFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => { compactAuxiliaryFrame = 0; syncCompactAuxiliaryPlacement(); syncSearchAreaButtons(); syncToolboxDashboards(); syncToolboxLoggers(); syncAddonToasts(); });
  }
