  function syncSearchAreaButtons() {
    if (!searchAreaButtons.size) return;
    const clear=element=>{
      element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-search-space');
      for (const axis of ['left','top']) if (element.style.getPropertyValue(`--ws-search-area-${axis}`)) element.style.removeProperty(`--ws-search-area-${axis}`);
    };
    // Use the live geometry even when devtools narrows the viewport below the desktop layout breakpoint.
    const active=ready && settings.enabled && settings.compactMode && !standaloneSignin && !editorProfile;
    if (active && compactDragInProgress()) return;
    for (const element of searchAreaButtons) {
      if (!element.isConnected) {clear(element);searchAreaButtons.delete(element);continue;}
      if (!active || element.hidden || element.getAttribute('aria-hidden')==='true') {clear(element);continue;}
      const style=getComputedStyle(element);
      if (style.display==='none' || style.visibility==='hidden') {clear(element);continue;}
      for (const obstacle of [floatingHeader.locationLabel,
        document.querySelector('.wme-studio-header-location[data-placement]:not([data-placement="inline"])'),
        ...headerGuardWindows.keys()]) observeCompactPlacement(obstacle);
      const header=compactVisibleRect(document.getElementById('app-head'));
      const bounds=element.getBoundingClientRect(),width=bounds.width,height=bounds.height;
      if (!width || !height) continue;
      const placed=compactFreePosition({left:(innerWidth-width)/2,top:header?header.top+header.height+12:80,width,height},toolboxPlacementObstacles(element));
      if (!placed) {clear(element);continue;}
      if (element.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-search-space')!=='clear') element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-search-space','clear');
      // Fixed elements can inherit a transformed or zoomed map ancestor. Correct in viewport pixels.
      const rect=element.getBoundingClientRect(),zoom=element.currentCSSZoom || 1;
      for (const [axis,value] of [['left',placed.left],['top',placed.top]]) {
        const origin=axis==='left'?rect.left:rect.top;
        if (Math.abs(value-origin)<.5) continue;
        const previous=parseFloat(element.style.getPropertyValue(`--ws-search-area-${axis}`)) || 0;
        setElementVariable(element,`--ws-search-area-${axis}`,`${Math.round((previous+(value-origin)/zoom)*100)/100}px`);
      }
    }
  }
  const addonToasts = new Map();
  const addonToastResize = typeof ResizeObserver==='function' ? new ResizeObserver(queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement) : null;
  function trackAddonToast(element) {
    // Alert history is a separate, normally hidden panel, not a live notification stack.
    if (element.id==='toast-container-history' || element.closest('.WWAlertsHistory,#WWAlertsHistory-list')) return;
    if (!addonToasts.has(element)) {
      const observer=new MutationObserver(queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement);
      observer.observe(element,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class','hidden']});
      addonToasts.set(element,observer); addonToastResize?.observe(element);
    }
    queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();
  }
  function syncAddonToasts() {
    if (!addonToasts.size) return;
    const active=compactLayoutActive() && settings.addons;
    const obstacles=active?toolboxPlacementObstacles():[];
    const placedToasts=[];
    const header=active?compactVisibleRect(document.getElementById('app-head')):null;
    const clear=element=>{
      element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-toast-space');
      for (const axis of ['left','top','width','height']) element.style.removeProperty(`--ws-toast-${axis}`);
    };
    for (const [element,observer] of addonToasts) {
      if (!element.isConnected) {observer.disconnect();addonToastResize?.unobserve(element);addonToasts.delete(element);continue;}
      if (!active || !element.textContent.trim()) {
        clear(element);
        continue;
      }
      const style=getComputedStyle(element);
      if (element.hidden || style.display==='none') continue;
      const zoom=element.currentCSSZoom || 1;
      const top=header?header.top+header.height+10:80;
      const widths=[...new Set([500,400,320,240,180].map(width=>Math.min(width,innerWidth-24)))];
      let placed=null,rect=null;
      if (element.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-toast-space')!=='clear') element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-toast-space','clear');
      const sizes=[];
      // Try a narrower stack before adding scroll; a fixed 500px stack could hide every alert.
      for (const width of widths) {
        setElementVariable(element,'--ws-toast-width',`${width/zoom}px`);
        setElementVariable(element,'--ws-toast-height',`${160/zoom}px`);
        rect=element.getBoundingClientRect();
        const height=Math.min(160,Math.max(24,rect.height));
        sizes.push({width,height});
        placed=compactFreePosition({left:(innerWidth-width)/2,top,width,height},obstacles);
        if (placed) break;
      }
      if (!placed) for (const {width,height} of sizes) {
        for (const cap of [...new Set([120,80,48].map(cap=>Math.min(cap,height)))]) {
          placed=compactFreePosition({left:(innerWidth-width)/2,top,width,height:cap},obstacles);
          if (placed) break;
        }
        if (placed) break;
      }
      if (!placed) {
        // If expanded panels cover the map, keep warnings visible while still clearing the islands.
        const islands=[...new Set([
          ...compactIslandSpecs.filter(spec=>!spec.popup).map(queryCompactIsland),
          document.querySelector('.wz-map-ol-footer'),floatingHeader.locationLabel,
          document.querySelector('.wme-studio-header-location[data-placement]:not([data-placement="inline"])'),
          document.querySelector('.ws-street-view-toolbar'),document.getElementById('WMETB_NavBar')
        ])].map(compactVisibleRect).filter(Boolean).map(rect=>({left:rect.left-6,top:rect.top-6,width:rect.width+12,height:rect.height+12}));
        islands.push(...placedToasts);
        for (const {width,height} of sizes) {
          for (const cap of [...new Set([height,120,80,48].map(cap=>Math.min(cap,height)))]) {
            placed=compactFreePosition({left:(innerWidth-width)/2,top,width,height:cap},islands);
            if (placed) break;
          }
          if (placed) break;
        }
      }
      // A fully occupied viewport must not suppress native warnings or confirmation controls.
      if (!placed) {clear(element);continue;}
      setElementVariable(element,'--ws-toast-width',`${placed.width/zoom}px`);
      setElementVariable(element,'--ws-toast-height',`${placed.height/zoom}px`);
      rect=element.getBoundingClientRect();
      for (const [axis,value] of [['left',placed.left],['top',placed.top]]) {
        const origin=axis==='left'?rect.left:rect.top;
        const previous=parseFloat(element.style.getPropertyValue(`--ws-toast-${axis}`)) || (axis==='top'?80:12);
        setElementVariable(element,`--ws-toast-${axis}`,`${Math.round((previous+(value-origin)/zoom)*100)/100}px`);
      }
      const occupied={left:placed.left-6,top:placed.top-6,width:placed.width+12,height:placed.height+12};
      obstacles.push(occupied);placedToasts.push(occupied);
    }
  }
  function syncCompactAuxiliaryPlacement(forceLaunchers = false) {
    if (!compactLayoutActive()) {
      clearCompactTaskFilters();
      for (const state of onlineEditorsPanels.values()) {
        for (const name of ['--ws-online-panel-left','--ws-online-panel-top','--ws-online-panel-height']) state.panel.style.removeProperty(name);
        state.panel.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-online-space'); state.measureHeight = true;
      }
      return;
    }
    if (!forceLaunchers && compactDragInProgress()) return;
    queueHeaderGuardWindows(); queueTaskMenus();
    if (!compactLayoutEditing) for (const frame of chatFrames.keys()) {
      const state = chatPanelStates.get(frame);
      if (state && !state.dragging && chatPanelIsVisible(state)) {
        applyChatPanelPosition(state,state.requestedOffset || state.offset,true); panelResizeHints.show(frame, 'messages', state.doc);
      } else panelResizeHints.dismiss(frame);
    }
    const obstacles = [];
    for (const spec of compactIslandSpecs) {
      if (spec.id === 'online' || spec.id === 'tile') continue;
      const element = queryCompactIsland(spec), rect = compactVisibleRect(element);
      observeCompactPlacement(element);
      if (rect) obstacles.push(rect);
    }
    const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar'), footer = document.querySelector('.wz-map-ol-footer');
    for (const element of [sidebar, footer]) {
      observeCompactPlacement(element);
      const rect = compactVisibleRect(element);
      if (rect) obstacles.push(rect);
    }
    observeCompactPlacement(sidebar?.closest('.app'));
    const filterRect = syncCompactTaskFilters(obstacles, sidebar);
    if (filterRect) obstacles.push(filterRect);
    const footerRect = compactVisibleRect(footer);
    const bottom = footerRect ? innerHeight - footerRect.top + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP : 36;
    let anchor = null, tile = null;
    for (const id of ['online','tile']) {
      const spec = compactIslandSpec(id), element = queryCompactIsland(spec);
      if (!element?.isConnected) continue;
      observeCompactPlacement(element);
      let rect = compactVisibleRect(element);
      if (!rect) continue;
      if ((!compactLayoutEditing && !floatingHeader.position) || forceLaunchers) {
        const size = compactIslandSize(spec), point = compactIslandLayout?.[id];
        const preferred = point ? compactIslandPixels(spec, point, size) : { left: id === 'online' ? 12 : innerWidth - size.width - 12, top: innerHeight - size.height - bottom, ...size };
        const placed = compactFreePosition(preferred, obstacles);
        if (placed) {
          for (const [axis, value] of [['left', placed.left], ['top', placed.top]]) {
            const name = `--ws-island-${id}-${axis}`, text = `${value}px`;
            if (root.style.getPropertyValue(name) !== text) rootStyle(name, text);
          }
          rect = placed;
        }
      }
      obstacles.push(rect);
      if (id === 'online') anchor = rect;
      else tile = { element, rect };
    }
    for (const state of onlineEditorsPanels.values()) {
      const panel = state.panel;
      if (!panel.isConnected) continue;
      if (!anchor) continue;
      const heightLimit = Math.min(320, innerHeight - 48), capacity = `${heightLimit}px`;
      const measure = state.measureHeight || state.heightLimit !== heightLimit;
      if (measure && panel.style.getPropertyValue('--ws-online-panel-height') !== capacity) panel.style.setProperty('--ws-online-panel-height', capacity);
      const bounds = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (measure) { state.naturalHeight = Math.ceil(bounds.height) || heightLimit; state.heightLimit = heightLimit; state.measureHeight = false; }
      const width = bounds.width || Math.min(280, innerWidth - 48);
      const height = Math.min(heightLimit, state.naturalHeight || Math.ceil(bounds.height) || heightLimit);
      const placed = compactOnlinePanelPlacement(anchor, { width, height }, obstacles);
      const space = placed ? 'clear' : 'blocked';
      if (panel.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-online-space') !== space) panel.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-online-space', space);
      if (!placed) continue;
      const heightCap = placed.height < height ? placed.height : heightLimit;
      for (const [name, value] of [['--ws-online-panel-left', placed.left], ['--ws-online-panel-top', placed.top], ['--ws-online-panel-height', heightCap]]) {
        const text = `${value}px`;
        if (panel.style.getPropertyValue(name) !== text) panel.style.setProperty(name, text);
      }
      obstacles.push(placed);
    }
    if (tile) {
      const expansion = compactTileExpansion(tile.rect, obstacles.filter(rect => rect !== tile.rect));
      const direction = expansion.right ? 'right' : 'left';
      if (tile.element.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-tile-expand') !== direction) tile.element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-tile-expand', direction);
      const width = `${expansion.width}px`;
      if (tile.element.style.getPropertyValue('--ws-tile-expand-width') !== width) tile.element.style.setProperty('--ws-tile-expand-width', width);
    }
  }
  function rootVariable(name, value) {
    if (value == null) root.style.removeProperty(name);
    else rootStyle(name, value);
  }
  function clearCompactLayoutVariables() {
    attr('layout', null);
    for (const name of COMPACT_LAYOUT_VARIABLES) root.style.removeProperty(name);
    clearDefaultSideIslandCenters();
    for (const spec of compactIslandSpecs.filter(spec => spec.popup)) for (const axis of ['left','top']) root.style.removeProperty(`--ws-island-${spec.id}-${axis}`);
  }
  function applyCompactChatLayout(state, constrain = true) {
    const spec = compactIslandSpec('messages');
    if (!state?.target?.isConnected || !compactIslandLayout?.messages || !settings.enabled || !settings.compactMode || !mapLayerViewport.matches) return;
    const rect = state.target.getBoundingClientRect();
    const size = { width: rect.width || spec.width(), height: rect.height || spec.height() };
    const target = compactIslandPixels(spec, compactIslandLayout.messages, size);
    const baseLeft = rect.left - state.offset.x, baseTop = rect.top - state.offset.y;
    applyChatPanelPosition(state, { x: target.left - baseLeft, y: target.top - baseTop }, constrain);
  }
  function storeCompactChatLayout(state) {
    if (!state?.target?.isConnected || !compactIslandLayout?.messages) return false;
    const rect = state.target.getBoundingClientRect();
    const point = {
      x: Math.min(1, Math.max(0, rect.left / innerWidth)),
      y: Math.min(1, Math.max(0, rect.top / innerHeight)), anchor: 'viewport'
    };
    compactIslandLayout = { ...compactIslandLayout, messages: point };
    try { Promise.resolve(GM_setValue(COMPACT_LAYOUT_KEY, compactIslandLayout)).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("storeCompactChatLayout",studioError);}); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("storeCompactChatLayout",studioError);}
    return true;
  }
  function syncCompactDocks(sizes = null) {
    if (sidePanelResizing()) return;
    const layout = compactIslandLayout || {};
    const frame = compactViewportFrame();
    const railRect = id => {
      const spec = compactIslandSpec(id);
      return compactIslandPixels(spec, layout[id], sizes?.get(id) || compactIslandSize(spec), frame);
    };
    const navigation = layout.navigation ? railRect('navigation') : null;
    const tools = layout.tools && !layout.layers ? railRect('tools') : null;
    const header = typeof floatingHeader === 'undefined' ? null : floatingHeader;
    const avoidHeader = (layout.header || layout.navigation) && header?.header?.isConnected;
    const sidebarWidth = avoidHeader ? document.getElementById('sidebar')?.getBoundingClientRect().width || 330 : 330;
    let bar = avoidHeader ? header.header.getBoundingClientRect() : null;
    if (bar && header.position) {
      const spec = compactIslandSpec('header'), size = {width:bar.width,height:bar.height};
      const saved = layout.header ? compactIslandPixels(spec, layout.header, size, frame) : {left:(frame.width - size.width) / 2,top:24,...size};
      bar = {...saved,right:saved.left + saved.width,bottom:saved.top + saved.height};
    }
    let panelLeft = null, panelRight = null;
    if (layout.navigation) {
      const rail = navigation;
      if (rail.left + rail.width / 2 > frame.width / 2) panelRight = Math.round(frame.width - rail.left + COMPACT_DOCK_GAP);
      else panelLeft = Math.round(rail.left + rail.width + COMPACT_DOCK_GAP);
    }
    rootVariable('--ws-dock-panel-left', panelLeft != null ? `${panelLeft}px` : panelRight != null ? 'auto' : null);
    rootVariable('--ws-dock-panel-right', panelRight != null ? `${panelRight}px` : null);

    const footer = frame.footer;
    let panelTop = null, panelBottom = footer ? `${Math.ceil(frame.height - footer.top + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP)}px` : null;
    if (bar) {
      const gap = 24;
      const spanLeft = panelRight != null ? frame.width - panelRight - sidebarWidth : panelLeft != null ? panelLeft : 12 + compactIslandSpec('navigation').width() + COMPACT_DOCK_GAP;
      panelTop = `${gap}px`;
      if (bar.width > 0 && bar.left < spanLeft + sidebarWidth && bar.right > spanLeft) {
        if (bar.top + bar.height / 2 <= frame.height / 2) panelTop = `${Math.round(bar.bottom + gap)}px`;
        else panelBottom = `${Math.round(frame.height - bar.top + gap)}px`;
      }
    }
    let panelHeight = null;
    const sideDrag = windowResize?.kind === 'sidePanel' ? windowResize : null;
    const sideHeight = Number(panelSizes.sidePanel?.height) || 0;
    if (layout.sidePanel || sideDrag) {
      const spec = compactIslandSpec('sidePanel'), zoom = (settings.panelScale || 100) / 100;
      const measuredWidth = document.getElementById('sidebar')?.getBoundingClientRect().width;
      const size = {width:measuredWidth > 20 ? measuredWidth : spec.width() * zoom,height:(sideHeight || spec.height()) * zoom};
      const point = sideDrag ? {x:(sideDrag.edge==='left' ? sideDrag.rect.right-size.width : sideDrag.rect.left)/frame.width,y:sideDrag.rect.top/frame.height,anchor:'viewport'} : layout.sidePanel;
      const requested = compactIslandPixels(spec,point,size,frame);
      const limits = headerPanelLimits(requested.left,size.width,12,workspacePanelBounds(),requested);
      const resizeTop = sideDrag ? Math.max(limits.top,Math.min(sideDrag.rect.top,limits.bottom-160)) : limits.top;
      const height = Math.max(160,Math.min(size.height,limits.bottom - resizeTop));
      const top = sideDrag ? resizeTop : Math.max(limits.top,Math.min(requested.top,limits.bottom - height));
      const obstacles = compactIslandSpecs.filter(item=>!item.popup).map(queryCompactIsland).map(compactVisibleRect).filter(Boolean);
      const placed = compactFreePosition({...requested,top,height},obstacles,frame) || {...requested,top,height};
      panelLeft = Math.round(placed.left); panelRight = null;
      panelTop = `${Math.round(placed.top)}px`; panelBottom = 'auto'; panelHeight = `${Math.round(height)}px`;
      rootVariable('--ws-dock-panel-left',`${panelLeft}px`); rootVariable('--ws-dock-panel-right','auto');
    } else if (sideHeight) {
      const top = parseFloat(panelTop) || document.getElementById('sidebar')?.getBoundingClientRect().top || 100;
      panelHeight = `${Math.max(1,Math.min(sideHeight*(settings.panelScale || 100)/100,(footer ? footer.top-COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP : frame.height-12)-top))}px`;
      panelBottom = 'auto';
    }
    rootVariable('--ws-dock-panel-top', panelTop);
    rootVariable('--ws-dock-panel-bottom', panelBottom);
    rootVariable('--ws-dock-panel-height',panelHeight);
    rootVariable('--ws-dock-panel-css-height',panelHeight ? `calc(${panelHeight} / var(--ws-panel-zoom, 1))` : null);

    let layersLeft = null, layersRight = null;
    if (layout.tools && !layout.layers) {
      const rail = tools;
      if (rail.left + rail.width / 2 > frame.width / 2) layersRight = Math.round(frame.width - rail.left + COMPACT_DOCK_GAP);
      else layersLeft = Math.round(rail.left + rail.width + COMPACT_DOCK_GAP);
    }
    rootVariable('--ws-dock-layers-left', layersLeft != null ? `${layersLeft}px` : null);
    rootVariable('--ws-dock-layers-right', layersRight != null ? `${layersRight}px` : layersLeft != null ? 'auto' : null);
  }
  function compactLayoutActive() {
    return ready && settings.enabled && settings.compactMode && !standaloneSignin && !editorProfile && mapLayerViewport.matches;
  }

  let defaultSideCenterFrame = 0;
  let defaultSideCenterSettle = 0;
  const defaultSideCenterObserved = new WeakSet();
  function visibleViewportBox() {
    const vv = window.visualViewport;
    return {
      top: vv?.offsetTop || 0,
      height: vv?.height || document.documentElement.clientHeight || innerHeight
    };
  }
  // The two default centring offsets are read by one rule each (#drawer and #overlay-buttons). They are kept
  // in a small sheet scoped to those islands instead of on <html>, where every change would restyle the
  // whole document.
  const defaultSideCenters = { navigation: ['--ws-default-navigation-top', '#drawer', null], tools: ['--ws-default-tools-top', '#overlay-buttons', null] };
  let defaultSideCenterSheet = null;
  function writeDefaultSideIslandCenters() {
    const css = Object.values(defaultSideCenters).map(([name, selector, value]) => value == null ? '' : `${selector}{${name}:${value}}`).join('');
    for (const [name] of Object.values(defaultSideCenters)) if (root.style.getPropertyValue(name)) root.style.removeProperty(name);
    if (!css) { defaultSideCenterSheet?.remove(); defaultSideCenterSheet = null; return; }
    if (!defaultSideCenterSheet?.isConnected) {
      defaultSideCenterSheet = document.createElement('style'); defaultSideCenterSheet.id = 'wme-studio-island-centers';
      (document.head || root).append(defaultSideCenterSheet);
    }
    if (defaultSideCenterSheet.textContent !== css) defaultSideCenterSheet.textContent = css;
  }
  function clearDefaultSideIslandCenters() {
    for (const center of Object.values(defaultSideCenters)) center[2] = null;
    writeDefaultSideIslandCenters();
  }
  function syncDefaultSideIslandCenters(force = false) {
    if (!compactLayoutActive()) {
      clearDefaultSideIslandCenters();
      defaultSideCenterSettle = 0;
      return;
    }
    if (compactLayoutEditing && !force) return;
    const layout = compactIslandLayout || {};
    const viewport = visibleViewportBox();
    let needsAnotherPass = false;
    for (const [id, center] of Object.entries(defaultSideCenters)) {
      if (layout[id] && !force) {
        center[2] = null;
        continue;
      }
      const element = queryCompactIsland(compactIslandSpec(id));
      if (!element?.isConnected) { needsAnotherPass = true; continue; }
      const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (rect.width < 12 || rect.height < 12) { needsAnotherPass = true; continue; }

      const desiredTop = viewport.top + (viewport.height - rect.height) / 2;
      const cssTop = Number.parseFloat(center[2]);
      const currentTop = Number.isFinite(cssTop) ? cssTop : 0;
      const nextTop = currentTop + desiredTop - rect.top;
      if (Math.abs(rect.top - desiredTop) > 0.5 || !Number.isFinite(cssTop)) {
        center[2] = `${Math.round(nextTop)}px`;
        needsAnotherPass = true;
      }
    }
    writeDefaultSideIslandCenters();

    if (needsAnotherPass && defaultSideCenterSettle < 6) {
      defaultSideCenterSettle += 1;
      requestAnimationFrame(() => syncDefaultSideIslandCenters(force));
    } else {
      defaultSideCenterSettle = 0;
    }
  }
  function scheduleDefaultSideIslandCenters(force = false) {
    if (force) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(defaultSideCenterFrame); defaultSideCenterFrame = 0;
      defaultSideCenterSettle = 0;
      syncDefaultSideIslandCenters(true);
      return;
    }
    if (performance.now() < quickPreviewUntil) return;
    if (!defaultSideCenterFrame) defaultSideCenterFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      defaultSideCenterFrame = 0;
      defaultSideCenterSettle = 0;
      syncDefaultSideIslandCenters(false);
    });
  }
  const defaultSideCenterResize = typeof ResizeObserver === 'function'
    ? new ResizeObserver(() => scheduleDefaultSideIslandCenters()) : null;
  function observeDefaultSideIslandCenter(element) {
    if (!element?.isConnected || defaultSideCenterObserved.has(element)) return;
    defaultSideCenterObserved.add(element);
    defaultSideCenterResize?.observe(element);
    scheduleDefaultSideIslandCenters();
  }
  window.visualViewport?.addEventListener('resize', () => scheduleDefaultSideIslandCenters());
  window.visualViewport?.addEventListener('scroll', () => scheduleDefaultSideIslandCenters());
  window.addEventListener('load', () => scheduleDefaultSideIslandCenters());


  function applyCompactLayoutVariables() {
    queueStreetViewWindow();
    if (!compactLayoutActive()) {
      clearCompactLayoutVariables();
      queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();
      syncCompactToolTooltips();
      for (const frame of chatFrames.keys()) resetChatPanel(frame);
      return;
    }
    const layout = compactIslandLayout || {};
    const placedIslands = [], writes = [];
    const sizes = new Map(compactIslandSpecs.filter(spec => spec.id !== 'messages' && layout[spec.id])
      .map(spec => [spec.id, compactIslandSize(spec)]));
    const frame = compactViewportFrame();
    for (const spec of compactIslandSpecs) {
      if (spec.id === 'messages' || spec.id === 'sidePanel') continue;
      const point = layout[spec.id];
      const baseline = compactLayoutEditing ? arrangeBaseline.get(spec.id) : null;
      const horizontal = spec.id === 'header' ? '--ws-island-header-center' : `--ws-island-${spec.id}-left`;
      if (!point && !baseline) {
        writes.push([horizontal, null], [`--ws-island-${spec.id}-top`, null]);
        continue;
      }
      if (baseline) {
        if (spec.id === 'header') writes.push([horizontal, `${Math.round(baseline.left + baseline.width / 2)}px`]);
        else writes.push([horizontal, `${Math.round(baseline.left)}px`]);
        writes.push([`--ws-island-${spec.id}-top`, `${Math.round(baseline.top)}px`]);
        placedIslands.push(spec.id);
        continue;
      }
      const size = sizes.get(spec.id);
      const placed = compactIslandPixels(spec, point, size, frame);
      if (spec.id === 'header') writes.push([horizontal, `${placed.left + size.width / 2}px`]);
      else writes.push([horizontal, `${placed.left}px`]);
      writes.push([`--ws-island-${spec.id}-top`, `${placed.top}px`]);
      placedIslands.push(spec.id);
    }
    for (const [name, value] of writes) {
      if (value == null) { if (root.style.getPropertyValue(name)) root.style.removeProperty(name); }
      else rootStyle(name, value);
    }
    attr('layout', placedIslands.length ? placedIslands.join(' ') : null);
    syncCompactDocks(sizes);
    queueHeaderLocationLayout();
    if (layout.messages) {
      for (const frame of chatFrames.keys()) {
        const state = chatPanelStates.get(frame);
        if (state?.target?.isConnected) applyCompactChatLayout(state, false);
      }
    }
    scheduleCompactDrawerTop();
    scheduleDefaultSideIslandCenters();
    syncCompactToolTooltips();
    queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement(); queueHeaderGuardWindows();
  }
  async function storeCompactIslandLayout(value) {
    compactIslandLayout = sanitizeCompactIslandLayout(value);
    await GM_setValue(COMPACT_LAYOUT_KEY, compactIslandLayout || {});
    applyCompactLayoutVariables();
  }

  const compactToolTooltips = new Map();
  const toolTooltipContents = new WeakMap();
  const toolTooltipVariables = ['--ws-tools-tooltip-left','--ws-tools-tooltip-top','--ws-tools-tooltip-width'];
  function toolTooltipLocation(instance) {
    const source = instance.source || instance.querySelector?.('wz-tooltip-source');
    let anchor = null, rich = false;
    for (let node = instance.target || source || instance; node;
      node = node.assignedSlot || node.parentElement || node.getRootNode?.().host) {
      if (node.localName === 'wz-rich-tooltip') rich = true;
      if (!anchor && node.matches?.('.overlay-button,.zoom-button,.online-editors-bubble')) anchor = node;
      if (node.id === 'overlay-buttons') return {kind:'tools',rail:node,anchor:anchor || source?.querySelector?.('.overlay-button,.zoom-button') || source,passive:!rich};
      if (node.id === 'app-head') return {kind:'header',rail:node,anchor:source?.querySelector?.('wz-button,button,a') || source || instance,passive:!rich};
      if (node.id === 'online-editors') return {kind:'online',rail:node,anchor:anchor || node.querySelector('.online-editors-bubble') || source,passive:!rich};
    }
    return null;
  }
  function rememberToolTooltipContent(content) {
    for (let node = content.parentElement; node; node = node.parentElement || node.getRootNode?.().host) {
      if (['overlay-buttons','app-head','online-editors'].includes(node.id)) break;
      if (node.matches?.('wz-tooltip,wz-basic-tooltip,wz-rich-tooltip') && toolTooltipLocation(node)) {
        toolTooltipContents.set(node, content);
      }
    }
  }
  function toolTooltipContent(instance) {
    if (instance.tooltipContent?.matches?.('wz-tooltip-content')) return instance.tooltipContent;
    for (let node = instance; node; node = node.parentElement || node.getRootNode?.().host) {
      const content = toolTooltipContents.get(node);
      if (content) return content;
      if (['overlay-buttons','app-head','online-editors'].includes(node.id)) break;
    }
    return instance.querySelector?.('wz-tooltip-content');
  }
  function clearToolTooltipPosition(state) {
    state.content.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-tools-tooltip');
    state.content.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-tooltip-passive');
    for (const name of toolTooltipVariables) {
      if (state.content.style.getPropertyValue(name)) state.content.style.removeProperty(name);
    }
  }
  function positionToolTooltip(state) {
    const location = toolTooltipLocation(state.instance);
    if (!compactLayoutActive() || compactLayoutEditing || !state.content.isConnected || !location?.anchor?.isConnected) {
      clearToolTooltipPosition(state); compactToolTooltips.delete(state.instance); return;
    }
    const surface = state.content.shadowRoot?.querySelector('.wz-tooltip-content');
    if (!surface) return;
    const rail = location.rail.getBoundingClientRect(), anchor = location.anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (location.passive && !state.content.querySelector('button,wz-button,a[href],input,select,textarea,[role="button"],[contenteditable="true"]')) state.content.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-tooltip-passive','on');
    const gap = 10, edge = 8;
    if (location.kind !== 'tools') {
      const variable = (name,number) => {
        const value = `${Math.round(number)}px`; if (state.content.style.getPropertyValue(name) !== value) state.content.style.setProperty(name,value);
      };
      variable('--ws-tools-tooltip-width',Math.min(320,innerWidth - 24));
      if (state.content.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-tools-tooltip') !== 'on') state.content.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-tools-tooltip','on');
      const rect = surface.getBoundingClientRect();
      const obstacles = compactIslandSpecs.map(spec => compactVisibleRect(queryCompactIsland(spec))).filter(Boolean);
      for (const element of [document.getElementById('sidebar'),document.querySelector('.wz-map-ol-footer')]) {
        const obstacle = compactVisibleRect(element); if (obstacle) obstacles.push(obstacle);
      }
      const reference = location.kind === 'header' ? rail : anchor;
      const x = Math.max(12,Math.min(anchor.left + (anchor.width - rect.width) / 2,innerWidth - rect.width - 12));
      const positions = [reference.top - rect.height - COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP,reference.bottom + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP];
      if (reference.top + reference.height / 2 <= innerHeight / 2) positions.reverse();
      const candidates = positions.map(top => ({left:x,top,width:rect.width,height:rect.height}));
      const placed = candidates.find(point => point.top >= 12 && point.top + point.height <= innerHeight - 12 && compactRectClear(point,obstacles,8)) || compactFreePosition(candidates[0],obstacles);
      if (placed) { variable('--ws-tools-tooltip-left',placed.left); variable('--ws-tools-tooltip-top',placed.top); }
      return;
    }
    const right = rail.left + rail.width / 2 <= innerWidth / 2;
    const available = Math.max(1, right ? innerWidth - edge - rail.right - gap : rail.left - gap - edge);
    const variable = (name, number) => {
      const value = `${Math.round(number)}px`;
      if (state.content.style.getPropertyValue(name) !== value) state.content.style.setProperty(name, value);
    };
    variable('--ws-tools-tooltip-width', available);
    if (!state.content.style.getPropertyValue('--ws-tools-tooltip-left')) variable('--ws-tools-tooltip-left', right ? rail.right + gap : rail.left - gap);
    if (!state.content.style.getPropertyValue('--ws-tools-tooltip-top')) variable('--ws-tools-tooltip-top', anchor.top);
    if (state.content.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-tools-tooltip') !== 'on') state.content.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-tools-tooltip', 'on');
    const rect = surface.getBoundingClientRect();
    variable('--ws-tools-tooltip-left', right ? rail.right + gap : rail.left - gap - rect.width);
    variable('--ws-tools-tooltip-top', Math.max(edge, Math.min(anchor.top + anchor.height / 2 - rect.height / 2,
      innerHeight - edge - rect.height)));
  }
  function syncCompactToolTooltips() {

  const mapOrderListeners = [];
  function clearMapOrder() {
    mapOrderSheet?.remove(); mapOrderSheet = null;

  function applyMapOrder() {
    mapOrderQueued = false;
    if (!mapAppearanceActive()) { clearMapOrder(); return; }
    applySatelliteLayerBrightness();
    if (!settings.gpsBelowRoads && settings.gpsOpacity===100) { mapOrderSheet?.remove();mapOrderSheet=null;return; }

    const element = gps?.getRootElement?.() || gps?.div;
    const roadZ = Number(roads?.getZIndex?.());
    const rules = [];
    if (settings.gpsBelowRoads && Number.isFinite(roadZ)) rules.push(`z-index: ${roadZ - 1} !important;`);
    if (settings.gpsOpacity!==100) rules.push('opacity: var(--ws-gps-opacity,1) !important;');
    if (!element?.id || !element.isConnected || !rules.length) { mapOrderSheet?.remove(); mapOrderSheet = null; return; }

  function scheduleMapOrder() { if (!mapOrderQueued) { mapOrderQueued = true; queueMicrotask(applyMapOrder); } }
  function subscribeMapOrder() {
    if (!mapOrderSDK || mapOrderListeners.length || !mapAppearanceActive()) return;
    for (const eventName of ['wme-map-layer-added','wme-map-layer-removed','wme-map-data-loaded','wme-map-zoom-changed']) {
      mapOrderListeners.push(mapOrderSDK.Events.on({ eventName, eventHandler: scheduleMapOrder }));
    }
  }
  function syncMapOrder() {
    if (!mapAppearanceActive()) { clearMapOrder(); return; }
    subscribeMapOrder(); scheduleMapOrder();
    if (!mapOrderInit && typeof pageWindow.getWmeSdk === 'function') {
      mapOrderInit = Promise.resolve(pageWindow.SDK_INITIALIZED).then(() => {
        mapOrderSDK = pageWindow.getWmeSdk({ scriptId: 'wme-studio', scriptName: 'WME Studio', mode: 'async' });
        return mapOrderSDK.Events.once({ eventName: 'wme-ready' });
      }).then(() => { subscribeMapOrder(); scheduleMapOrder(); }).catch(error => {
        mapOrderSDK = null; mapOrderInit = null;
        if (reportStudioError.active) reportStudioError('Map layer order could not initialize',error); else console.warn('[WME Studio] Map layer order could not initialize:', error.message);
      });
    } else if (!mapOrderInit && pageWindow.SDK_INITIALIZED?.then) {
      mapOrderInit = pageWindow.SDK_INITIALIZED.then(() => { mapOrderInit = null; syncMapOrder(); });
    }
  }

  function beginWorkspaceSwitch(next) {
    if (settings.compactMode === next.compactMode) return false;
    for (const state of mapLayerWindows.values()) if (state.drag) finishMapLayerDrag(state);
    cancelAnimationFrame(workspaceSwitchFrame);
    workspaceSwitchFrame = 0;
    attr('workspace-switching', 'on');
    return true;
  }
  function finishWorkspaceSwitch() {
    cancelAnimationFrame(workspaceSwitchFrame);
    // Apply the final layout at once; suppress native CSS transitions through its first paint.
    if (document.hidden) { workspaceSwitchFrame = 0; attr('workspace-switching', null); return; }
    workspaceSwitchFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      workspaceSwitchFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        workspaceSwitchFrame = 0;
        attr('workspace-switching', null);
      });
    });
  }
  function syncInterfaceMotion() {
    const stop = settings.enabled && (!settings.motion || reducedMotion.matches);
    const scopes = new Set([document]), animations = new Set();
    for (const frame of chatFrames.keys()) {
      try {
        const doc = frame.contentDocument;
        if (!doc?.documentElement) continue;
        if (settings.enabled) doc.documentElement.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-motion', stop ? 'reduced' : 'normal');
        else doc.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-motion');
        scopes.add(doc);
        if (stop) {
          const state = chatPanelStates.get(frame);
          if (state?.motion) animations.add(state.motion);
          state?.finishClose?.();
        }
      } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("syncInterfaceMotion",studioError); }
    }
    if (!stop) return;
    for (const scope of [...scopes, ...roots.keys()]) {
      for (const animation of scope.getAnimations?.() || []) animations.add(animation);
    }
    for (const animation of animations) {
      try { animation.finish(); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("syncInterfaceMotion",studioError); }
      animation.cancel();
    }
  }
  function mapSizeOnRecord(map) {
    try {
      const native = map?.getOLMap?.() || map?.wazeMap || map?.olMap || map;
      if (typeof native?.getSize !== 'function' || typeof native?.getCurrentSize !== 'function') return false;
      const recorded = native.getSize(), actual = native.getCurrentSize();
      return !!recorded && !!actual && actual.w > 0 && actual.h > 0 && recorded.w === actual.w && recorded.h === actual.h;
    } catch (_) { return false; }
  }
  function resizeMap(immediate = false) {
    resizeNative ||= immediate;
    if (resizeFrame) return;
    resizeFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      resizeFrame = 0;
      const preferNative = resizeNative; resizeNative = false;
      notifyingMapResize = true;
      try {
        const map = pageWindow.W?.map;
        if (preferNative && document.getElementById('WazeMap') && typeof map?.resize === 'function') {
          try { map.resize(); return; } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("resizeMap",studioError); }
        }
        // A "resize" event makes the editor and every script that listens for it measure the page again.
        // When the size OpenLayers has on record already equals the size of the map element (a floating
        // side panel opening over the map, for example) there is nothing to tell it.
        if (!preferNative && mapSizeOnRecord(map)) return;
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
      } finally { notifyingMapResize = false; }
    });
  }

  const CHAT_PANEL_POSITION_KEY = 'wmeStudio.chatPanelOffset.v3';
  const DEFAULT_CHAT_PANEL_OFFSET = Object.freeze({ x: -18, y: 72 });
  const chatPanelStates = new WeakMap();
  let chatPanelPosition = null;
  function normalizedChatPanelPosition(value) {
    const x = Number(value?.x), y = Number(value?.y);
    return Number.isFinite(x) && Number.isFinite(y) ? { x, y } : null;
  }
  function isChatEmbedFrame(frame) {
    try {
      const url = new URL(frame.getAttribute('src'), location.href);
      return url.origin === location.origin && /^\/chat\/embed\/?$/.test(url.pathname);
    } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("isChatEmbedFrame",studioError); return false; }
  }
  function clampChatPanelPosition(state, position) {
    const rect = state.target.getBoundingClientRect(), gap = 12;
    const baseLeft = rect.left - state.offset.x, baseTop = rect.top - state.offset.y;
    const view = state.target.ownerDocument.defaultView || window;
    const limits = headerPanelLimits(baseLeft + position.x,rect.width,gap,null,rect);
    const desiredHeight = Math.min(Math.max(rect.height,state.collisionNaturalHeight || rect.height),view.innerHeight - 24);
    const preferred = {
      left:Math.round(Math.min(Math.max(gap,baseLeft + position.x),view.innerWidth - gap - rect.width)),
      top:Math.round(Math.min(Math.max(limits.top,baseTop + position.y),limits.bottom - rect.height)),
      width:rect.width,height:desiredHeight
    };
    let placed = preferred;
    if (compactLayoutActive() && !compactLayoutEditing) {
      const occupied = compactPanelObstacles(state.target);
      placed = null;
      const heights = [desiredHeight];
      for (let height = Math.floor((desiredHeight - 1) / 16) * 16; height >= 160; height -= 16) heights.push(height);
      if (desiredHeight > 160 && heights.at(-1) !== 160) heights.push(160);
      for (const height of heights) {
        placed = compactFreePosition({...preferred,height},occupied,{width:view.innerWidth,height:view.innerHeight});
        if (placed) break;
      }
      if (placed) {
        state.collisionNaturalHeight = desiredHeight;
        const cap = placed.height < desiredHeight - 1 ? `${Math.round(placed.height / (state.target.currentCSSZoom || 1))}px` : null;
        for (const [name,value] of [['max-height',cap],['min-height',cap ? '0px' : null]]) {
          const [original,priority] = state.collisionHeightOriginal[name];
          const desired = value || original, desiredPriority = value ? 'important' : priority;
          if (state.target.style.getPropertyValue(name) === desired && state.target.style.getPropertyPriority(name) === desiredPriority) continue;
          if (desired) state.target.style.setProperty(name,desired,desiredPriority); else state.target.style.removeProperty(name);
        }
      }
    }
    if (!placed) return {...state.offset};
    return {x:placed.left - baseLeft,y:placed.top - baseTop};
  }

  function chatPanelIsVisible(state) {
    if (state.target.checkVisibility?.({ checkOpacity: true, checkVisibilityCSS: true }) === false) return false;
    const rect = state.target.getBoundingClientRect(), view = state.target.ownerDocument.defaultView || window;
    return rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0 && rect.right > 0 && rect.bottom > 0 && rect.left < view.innerWidth && rect.top < view.innerHeight;
  }
  function disableNativeChatSlide(frame) {
    const candidates = [];
    for (let node = frame.parentElement, depth = 0; node && depth < 4; node = node.parentElement, depth += 1) candidates.push(node);
    const rootNode = frame.getRootNode();
    if (rootNode instanceof ShadowRoot && rootNode.host) candidates.push(rootNode.host);
    const records = [];
    for (const node of new Set(candidates)) {
      const computed = getComputedStyle(node);
      const durations = computed.transitionDuration.split(',').map(value => parseFloat(value) || 0);
      const properties = computed.transitionProperty.split(',').map(value => value.trim());
      const slides = durations.some(value => value > 0) && properties.some(value => value === 'all' || /^(?:transform|translate|left|right|inset)/.test(value));
      if (!slides) continue;
      records.push({ node, transition: node.style.getPropertyValue('transition'), priority: node.style.getPropertyPriority('transition') });
      node.style.setProperty('transition', 'none', 'important');
    }
    return records;
  }
  function restoreNativeChatSlide(records) {
    for (const record of records || []) {
      if (record.transition) record.node.style.setProperty('transition', record.transition, record.priority);
      else record.node.style.removeProperty('transition');
    }
  }
  function replayChatPanelOpen(state) {
    clearTimeout(state.closeTimer); state.closeTimer = 0; state.closing = false;
    state.finishClose = null;
    state.target.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-chat-closing');
    state.motion?.cancel();
    if (reducedMotion.matches || !settings.motion) return;
    state.motion = state.target.animate(
      [{ opacity: 0, scale: '.965' }, { opacity: 1, scale: '1' }],
      { duration: 180, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)', fill: 'both' }
    );
    state.motion.finished.then(() => { state.motion = null; }).catch(() => {});
  }
  function closeChatPanelThen(state, proceed) {
    if (state.closing) return;
    if (reducedMotion.matches || !settings.motion) { proceed(); return; }
    state.closing = true;
    state.target.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-chat-closing', 'on');
    state.motion?.cancel();
    state.motion = state.target.animate(
      [{ opacity: 1, scale: '1' }, { opacity: 0, scale: '.965' }],
      { duration: 140, easing: 'ease-in', fill: 'both' }
    );
    const finishClose = () => {
      if (state.finishClose !== finishClose) return;
      state.finishClose = null;
      clearTimeout(state.closeTimer); state.closeTimer = 0;
      proceed();
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (state.target.isConnected && state.closing && chatPanelIsVisible(state)) replayChatPanelOpen(state);
      }, 260);
    };
    state.finishClose = finishClose;
    state.closeTimer = setTimeout(finishClose, 140);
  }
  function chatCloseControl(event) {
    for (const node of event.composedPath()) {
      if (node?.nodeType !== 1 || !node.matches?.('button,wz-button,[role="button"]')) continue;
      const label = [node.getAttribute('aria-label'), node.getAttribute('title'), node.getAttribute('data-testid'), node.getAttribute('name')]
        .filter(Boolean).join(' ').toLowerCase();
      if (/(?:^|[\s_-])(?:close|dismiss)(?:$|[\s_-])/.test(label)) return node;
    }
    return null;
  }
  function applyChatPanelPosition(state, position = chatPanelPosition, constrain = true) {
    const requested = normalizedChatPanelPosition(position) || DEFAULT_CHAT_PANEL_OFFSET;
    state.requestedOffset = requested;
    const next = constrain || compactLayoutActive() && !compactLayoutEditing && !state.dragging && chatPanelIsVisible(state) ? clampChatPanelPosition(state, requested) : requested;
    state.offset = next;
    const zoom = state.target.currentCSSZoom || 1;
    const translate = `${Math.round(next.x / zoom * 100) / 100}px ${Math.round(next.y / zoom * 100) / 100}px`;
    const applied = (state.target.style.getPropertyValue('translate') || '').split(' ').map(parseFloat);
    const settled = applied.length === 2 && Math.abs(applied[0] * zoom - next.x) < .5 && Math.abs(applied[1] * zoom - next.y) < .5 && state.target.style.getPropertyPriority('translate') === 'important';
    if (!settled && (state.target.style.getPropertyValue('translate') !== translate || state.target.style.getPropertyPriority('translate') !== 'important')) state.target.style.setProperty('translate', translate, 'important');
  }

  }
  function resetChatPanel(frame) {
    panelResizeHints.dismiss(frame);
    const state = chatPanelStates.get(frame);
    state?.cancelDrag?.();
    state?.observer?.disconnect();
    if (state?.closeHandler) state.doc.removeEventListener('click', state.closeHandler, true);
    clearTimeout(state?.closeTimer);
    if (state) state.finishClose = null;
    state?.motion?.cancel();
    state?.handle?.remove();
    restoreNativeChatSlide(state?.slideRecords);
    if (state?.target) {
      if (state.originalTranslate) state.target.style.setProperty('translate', state.originalTranslate, state.originalTranslatePriority);
      else state.target.style.removeProperty('translate');
    }
    if (state?.collisionHeightOriginal) for (const [name,[value,priority]] of Object.entries(state.collisionHeightOriginal)) { if (value) frame.style.setProperty(name,value,priority); else frame.style.removeProperty(name); }
    chatPanelStates.delete(frame);
    frame.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-chat-panel');
    frame.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-chat-dragging');
    frame.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-chat-closing');
    frame.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-chat-reopen');
    setElementVariable(frame, '--ws-chat-user-width', null);
    setElementVariable(frame, '--ws-chat-user-height', null);
    try {
      const doc = state?.doc || frame.contentDocument;
      chatResizeDocs.get(doc)?.cancel();
      for (const grip of doc?.querySelectorAll('[data-wme-studio-chat-resize]') || []) { grip.hidden = true; grip.style.display = 'none'; }
    } catch (_) { reportStudioError("resetChatPanel",_);}
  }
  function syncChatPanel(frame, doc) {
    if (!settings.enabled || !settings.compactMode || !mapLayerViewport.matches || standaloneSignin || editorProfile || !isChatEmbedFrame(frame)) {
      resetChatPanel(frame); return;
    }
    frame.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-chat-panel', 'on');
    bindChatResize(frame, doc);
    const previous = chatPanelStates.get(frame);
    if (previous?.doc === doc && previous.handle?.isConnected) return;
    previous?.cancelDrag?.();
    previous?.observer?.disconnect();
    if (previous?.closeHandler) previous.doc.removeEventListener('click', previous.closeHandler, true);
    clearTimeout(previous?.closeTimer);
    if (previous) previous.finishClose = null;
    previous?.motion?.cancel();
    previous?.handle?.remove();
    restoreNativeChatSlide(previous?.slideRecords);
    if (previous?.target) {
      if (previous.originalTranslate) previous.target.style.setProperty('translate', previous.originalTranslate, previous.originalTranslatePriority);
      else previous.target.style.removeProperty('translate');
    }
    if (previous?.collisionHeightOriginal) for (const [name,[value,priority]] of Object.entries(previous.collisionHeightOriginal)) { if (value) frame.style.setProperty(name,value,priority); else frame.style.removeProperty(name); }
    const target = frame;
    const state = {
      doc, target, handle: null, observer: null,
      closeHandler: null, closeTimer: 0, finishClose: null, closing: false, allowCloseClick: false, motion: null,
      slideRecords: disableNativeChatSlide(frame),
      offset: { x: 0, y: 0 },
      originalTranslate: target.style.getPropertyValue('translate'),
      originalTranslatePriority: target.style.getPropertyPriority('translate'),
      collisionNaturalHeight: 0, collisionHeightOriginal: Object.fromEntries(['max-height','min-height'].map(name => [name,[target.style.getPropertyValue(name),target.style.getPropertyPriority(name)]]))
    };
    chatPanelStates.set(frame, state);
    state.observer = new MutationObserver(queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement);
    state.observer.observe(frame,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['style','class','hidden','aria-hidden']});
    for (let node=frame.parentElement,depth=0;node && depth < 4;node=node.parentElement,depth++) state.observer.observe(node,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['style','class','hidden','aria-hidden']});
    applyChatPanelPosition(state, chatPanelPosition, false);
    applyCompactChatLayout(state, false);
    const handle = doc.createElement('button');
    handle.type = 'button';
    handle.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-chat-drag-handle', '');
    handle.setAttribute('aria-label', globalThis.WMEStudioI18n.t('Move chat panel'));
    handle.title = globalThis.WMEStudioI18n.t('Drag to move · Double-click to reset');
    (doc.querySelector('[data-testid="conversation-list"]') || doc.getElementById('root') || doc.body || doc.documentElement).append(handle);
    state.handle = handle;
    state.closeHandler = event => {
      if (state.allowCloseClick) { state.allowCloseClick = false; return; }
      const control = chatCloseControl(event);
      if (!control) return;
      event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      closeChatPanelThen(state, () => {
        state.allowCloseClick = true;
        control.click();
        queueMicrotask(() => { state.allowCloseClick = false; });
      });
    };
    doc.addEventListener('click', state.closeHandler, true);
    let drag = null, moveFrame = 0;
    function renderChatDrag() {
      moveFrame = 0;
      if (!drag?.pending) return;
      drag.pending = false;
      const position = {
        x: Math.round(Math.min(drag.maxX, Math.max(drag.minX, drag.x + drag.screenX - drag.startScreenX))),
        y: Math.round(Math.min(drag.maxY, Math.max(drag.minY, drag.y + drag.screenY - drag.startScreenY)))
      };
      const previous = drag.previous;
      const placed = compactSlidePosition({left:drag.baseLeft + position.x,top:drag.baseTop + position.y,width:drag.width,height:drag.height},previous,drag.obstacles,{width:drag.viewWidth,height:drag.viewHeight}) || previous;
      drag.previous = placed;
      applyChatPanelPosition(state,{x:placed.left - drag.baseLeft,y:placed.top - drag.baseTop},false);
    }
    handle.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
      if (event.button !== 0 || event.isPrimary === false || drag) return;
      const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect(), view = target.ownerDocument.defaultView || window;
      const baseLeft = rect.left - state.offset.x, baseTop = rect.top - state.offset.y;
      drag = { pointerId: event.pointerId, startScreenX: event.screenX, startScreenY: event.screenY, screenX: event.screenX, screenY: event.screenY,
        x: state.offset.x, y: state.offset.y, baseLeft, baseTop, width: rect.width, height: rect.height, viewWidth: view.innerWidth, viewHeight: view.innerHeight,
        minX: 12 - baseLeft, minY: 12 - baseTop,
        maxX: Math.max(12 - baseLeft, view.innerWidth - 12 - rect.width - baseLeft),
        maxY: Math.max(12 - baseTop, view.innerHeight - 12 - rect.height - baseTop), pending: false };
      drag.obstacles = compactPanelObstacles(target); drag.previous = {left:rect.left,top:rect.top,width:rect.width,height:rect.height};
      state.dragging = true;
      frame.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-chat-dragging', 'on');
      handle.classList.add('dragging');
      try { handle.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("syncChatPanel",studioError);}
      doc.defaultView?.addEventListener('blur', onChatBlur);
      event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation();
    });
    handle.addEventListener('pointermove', event => {
      if (!drag || event.pointerId !== drag.pointerId) return;
      drag.screenX = event.screenX; drag.screenY = event.screenY; drag.pending = true;
      if (!moveFrame) moveFrame = requestAnimationFrame(renderChatDrag);
      event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation();
    });
    const finishDrag = (event, persist = true) => {
      if (!drag || (event && event.pointerId !== drag.pointerId)) return;
      if (event?.type === 'pointerup') { drag.screenX = event.screenX; drag.screenY = event.screenY; drag.pending = true; }
      cancelAnimationFrame(moveFrame); moveFrame = 0;
      if (persist) renderChatDrag();
      const finished = drag;
      drag = null;
      state.dragging = false;
      frame.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-chat-dragging');
      handle.classList.remove('dragging');
      doc.defaultView?.removeEventListener('blur', onChatBlur);
      try { if (handle.hasPointerCapture?.(finished.pointerId)) handle.releasePointerCapture(finished.pointerId); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("finishDrag",studioError);}
      if (persist) { applyChatPanelPosition(state,state.offset,true); if (!storeCompactChatLayout(state)) storeChatPanelPosition(state.offset); }
      queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();
      event?.preventDefault(); event?.stopPropagation();
    };
    function onChatBlur() { finishDrag(); }
    state.finishDrag = () => finishDrag();
    state.cancelDrag = () => finishDrag(null, false);
    handle.addEventListener('pointerup', finishDrag);
    handle.addEventListener('pointercancel', finishDrag);
    handle.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', finishDrag);
    handle.addEventListener('click', event => { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); });
    handle.addEventListener('dblclick', event => {
      if (compactIslandLayout?.messages) {
        const { messages: _saved, ...rest } = compactIslandLayout;
        compactIslandLayout = sanitizeCompactIslandLayout(rest);
        try { Promise.resolve(GM_setValue(COMPACT_LAYOUT_KEY, compactIslandLayout || {})).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("syncChatPanel",studioError);}); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("syncChatPanel",studioError);}
      }
      storeChatPanelPosition(null);
      applyChatPanelPosition(state, DEFAULT_CHAT_PANEL_OFFSET);
      event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation();
    });
    if (compactLayoutEditing) compactLayoutEditor?.lockChatFrames();
  }
  let allowedChatToggle = null;
  function editorChatToggleControl(event) {
    for (const node of event.composedPath()) {
      if (node?.nodeType !== 1 || !node.matches?.('button,wz-button,[role="button"]')) continue;
      const label = [
        node.getAttribute('aria-label'), node.getAttribute('title'), node.getAttribute('data-testid'),
        node.getAttribute('name'), node.getAttribute('data-tooltip-content')
      ].filter(Boolean).join(' ').toLowerCase();
      if (/(?:^|[\s_-])(?:chat|messages?)(?:$|[\s_-])/.test(label)) return node;
    }
    return null;
  }
  function replayChatOpenWhenVisible(attempt = 0) {
    for (const frame of chatFrames.keys()) {
      const state = chatPanelStates.get(frame);
      if (frame.isConnected && state && chatPanelIsVisible(state)) { applyCompactChatLayout(state,true); applyChatPanelPosition(state,state.offset,true); replayChatPanelOpen(state); return; }
    }
    if (attempt < 12) requestAnimationFrame(() => replayChatOpenWhenVisible(attempt + 1));
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', event => {
    const control = editorChatToggleControl(event);
    if (!control) return;
    if (allowedChatToggle === control) { allowedChatToggle = null; return; }
    let visibleState = null;
    for (const frame of chatFrames.keys()) {
      const state = chatPanelStates.get(frame);
      if (frame.isConnected && state && chatPanelIsVisible(state)) { visibleState = state; break; }
    }
    if (!visibleState) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => replayChatOpenWhenVisible());
      return;
    }
    event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    closeChatPanelThen(visibleState, () => {
      allowedChatToggle = control;
      control.click();
      queueMicrotask(() => { if (allowedChatToggle === control) allowedChatToggle = null; });
    });
  }, true);
  Promise.resolve().then(() => GM_getValue(CHAT_PANEL_POSITION_KEY)).then(value => {
    chatPanelPosition = normalizedChatPanelPosition(value);
    for (const frame of chatFrames.keys()) {
      const state = chatPanelStates.get(frame);
      if (frame.isConnected && state) applyChatPanelPosition(state, chatPanelPosition, false);
    }
  }).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("Studio initialization",studioError);});
  function isThemeFrameURL(url) {
    return url.origin === location.origin && (
      /^\/chat\/embed\/?$/.test(url.pathname) ||
      (/^(?:\/[^/]+)?\/signin\/?$/.test(url.pathname) && url.searchParams.get('embed') === 'true')
    );
  }
  function isChatFrame(frame) {
    if (frame.localName !== 'iframe') return false;
    try {
      const url = new URL(frame.getAttribute('src'), location.href);
      return isThemeFrameURL(url);
    } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("isChatFrame",studioError); return false; }
  }
  const signinComponentStyle = `

  function stopSigninComponents(frame) {
    const load = chatFrames.get(frame);
    load?.signin?.stop();
    if (load) load.signin = null;
  }
  function syncSigninComponents(frame, doc) {
    const load = chatFrames.get(frame);
    if (!load || load.signin?.doc === doc) return;
    stopSigninComponents(frame);
    const view = doc.defaultView, observed = new Map(), waiting = new Set();
    let sheet = null, stopped = false, signinHydrationTimer = 0;
    const signinUpgrades = new WeakSet();
    try {
      if ('adoptedStyleSheets' in view.ShadowRoot.prototype && view.CSSStyleSheet.prototype.replaceSync) {
        sheet = new view.CSSStyleSheet(); sheet.replaceSync(globalThis.WMEStudioSafari.css(signinComponentStyle));
      }
    } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("syncSigninComponents",studioError); sheet = null; }
    function attach(shadow) {
      const signinText = globalThis.WMEStudioSafari.bind(shadow.host,signinComponentStyle);
      if (sheet) {
        try {
          const sheets = shadow.adoptedStyleSheets;
          if (sheets[sheets.length - 1] !== sheet) shadow.adoptedStyleSheets = [...sheets.filter(s => s !== sheet), sheet];
          return;
        } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("attach",studioError); }
      }
      if (!shadow.querySelector('style[data-wme-studio-signin]')) {
        const style = doc.createElement('style'); style.dataset.wmeStudioSignin = '1';
        style.textContent = signinText; shadow.append(style);
      }
    }
    function inspectSignin(host) {
      if (!host.localName?.startsWith('wz-')) return;
      if (!host.shadowRoot) {
        waiting.add(host);
        if (!signinUpgrades.has(host)) {
          signinUpgrades.add(host);
          view.customElements.whenDefined(host.localName).then(() => { if (!stopped && host.isConnected) inspectSignin(host); });
        }
        if (!signinHydrationTimer) signinHydrationTimer = view.setTimeout(() => {
          signinHydrationTimer = 0;
          for (const item of [...waiting]) { waiting.delete(item); if (!stopped && item.isConnected && item.shadowRoot) inspectSignin(item); }
        }, 1500);
        return;
      }
      waiting.delete(host);
      const shadow = host.shadowRoot;
      attach(shadow);
      if (!observed.has(shadow)) { watch(shadow); scan(shadow); }
    }
    function scan(start) {
      if (stopped) return;
      inspectSignin(start);
      const walker = doc.createTreeWalker(start, view.NodeFilter.SHOW_ELEMENT, {
        acceptNode: node => /^(script|style|svg|canvas|iframe)$/.test(node.localName) ? view.NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT : view.NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT
      });
      while (walker.nextNode()) inspectSignin(walker.currentNode);
    }
    function watch(target) {
      const observer = new view.MutationObserver(records => {
        if (target.host?.isConnected) attach(target);
        const added = new Set();
        for (const record of records) {
          for (const node of record.addedNodes) {
            if (node.nodeType === 1 && !/^(script|style|svg|canvas|iframe)$/.test(node.localName)) added.add(node);
          }
        }
        for (const node of added) if (node.isConnected) {
          let covered = false;
          for (let parent = node.parentElement; parent; parent = parent.parentElement) if (added.has(parent)) { covered = true; break; }
          if (!covered) scan(node);
        }
      });
      observer.observe(target, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      observed.set(target, observer);
    }
    load.signin = { doc, stop() {
        stopped = true;
        view.clearTimeout(signinHydrationTimer);
        for (const [target, observer] of observed) {
          observer.disconnect();
          if (target.host) {
            globalThis.WMEStudioSafari.release(target.host);
            if (sheet) target.adoptedStyleSheets = target.adoptedStyleSheets.filter(s => s !== sheet);
            target.querySelector('style[data-wme-studio-signin]')?.remove();
          }
        }
        observed.clear(); waiting.clear();
      },
      refresh() {
        for (const host of waiting) { if (!host.isConnected) waiting.delete(host); else inspectSignin(host); }
        for (const [target, observer] of observed) if (target.host) {
          if (!target.host.isConnected) { observer.disconnect(); observed.delete(target); }
          else attach(target);
        }
      }
    };
    watch(doc.documentElement); scan(doc.documentElement);
  }
  function syncChatFrame(frame) {
    try {
      if (!isChatFrame(frame)) { stopSigninComponents(frame); resetChatPanel(frame); return; }
      const doc = frame.contentDocument;
      if (!doc?.documentElement || !isThemeFrameURL(new URL(frame.contentWindow.location.href))) { stopSigninComponents(frame); resetChatPanel(frame); return; }
      if (!settings.enabled) { doc.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-chat'); doc.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-motion'); stopSigninComponents(frame); resetChatPanel(frame); return; }
      if (!ready || !chatStyleText) return;
      let style = doc.querySelector('style[data-wme-studio-chat]');
      if (!style) {
        style = doc.createElement('style'); style.dataset.wmeStudioChat = '1';
        (doc.head || doc.documentElement).append(style);
      }
      if (style.textContent !== chatStyleText) style.textContent = chatStyleText;
      if (doc.documentElement.style.zoom) doc.documentElement.style.zoom = '';
      if (doc.documentElement.style.fontSizeAdjust !== fontAdjust) doc.documentElement.style.fontSizeAdjust = fontAdjust;
      let paletteStyle = doc.querySelector('style[data-wme-studio-chat-palette]');
      if (!paletteStyle) {
        paletteStyle = doc.createElement('style'); paletteStyle.dataset.wmeStudioChatPalette = '1';
        (doc.head || doc.documentElement).append(paletteStyle);
      }
      if (paletteStyle.textContent !== chatPaletteText) paletteStyle.textContent = chatPaletteText;
      if (doc.documentElement.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-chat') !== 'on') doc.documentElement.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-chat', 'on');
      doc.documentElement.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-motion', !settings.motion || reducedMotion.matches ? 'reduced' : 'normal');
      if (/\/signin\/?$/.test(new URL(frame.contentWindow.location.href).pathname)) syncSigninComponents(frame, doc);
      else stopSigninComponents(frame);
      syncChatPanel(frame, doc);
    } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("syncChatFrame",studioError); stopSigninComponents(frame); resetChatPanel(frame); }
  }
  function trackChatFrame(frame) {
    if (!isChatFrame(frame) || chatFrames.has(frame)) return;
    const onLoad = () => syncChatFrame(frame);
    chatFrames.set(frame, onLoad); frame.addEventListener('load', onLoad);
    if (ready && !chatStyleText) syncChatTheme();
    else syncChatFrame(frame);
  }
  function syncChatTheme() {
    const paletteKey = settings.theme + ':' + settings.accent + ':' + settings.corners;
    if (!settings.enabled) { chatPaletteKey = ''; chatPaletteText = ''; }
    if (settings.enabled && (standaloneSignin || chatFrames.size) && (!chatStyleText || paletteKey !== chatPaletteKey)) {
      chatPaletteKey = paletteKey;
      const computed = getComputedStyle(root), palette = document.createElement('span').style;
      if (!standaloneSignin) {
        for (const name of chatProperties) {
          const value = computed.getPropertyValue(name);
          if (value) palette.setProperty(name, value, 'important');
        }
        palette.setProperty('color-scheme', settings.theme === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark', 'important');
      }
      chatPaletteText = standaloneSignin ? '' : `html[data-wme-studio-chat="on"], html[data-wme-studio-chat="on"] body, html[data-wme-studio-chat="on"] #root { ${palette.cssText} }`;
      chatStyleText ||= `html[data-wme-studio-chat="on"],
html[data-wme-studio-chat="on"] body,
html[data-wme-studio-chat="on"] #root,
html[data-wme-studio-chat="on"] [data-testid="conversation-list"],
html[data-wme-studio-chat="on"] [data-testid="conversation-list"] > div {
  background: var(--wme-studio-surface) !important;
  color: var(--wme-studio-text) !important;
}
html[data-wme-studio-chat="on"] body { font-family: var(--ws-font) !important; }
html[data-wme-studio-chat="on"] * {
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: var(--wme-studio-border-strong) transparent;

  function queueChatTheme() {

  let previewBase = null, previewOverride = null;
  globalThis.WMEStudioPreview = Object.freeze({
    // A moving HUD size or header width slider. The stylesheet scales and places the islands from one variable,
    // so the drag sets just that: no measuring and no re-placing, which took four layouts of the whole editor
    // per step. The full pass runs once, when the value is saved as the slider rests.
    quick(key, value) {
      if (!ready || !settings.enabled || !Number.isFinite(value)) return false;
      if (key === 'hudScale') rootStyle('--ws-hud-zoom', String(value / 100));
      else if (key === 'compactHeaderWidth') { rootStyle('--ws-header-width-extension', String(value / 100)); attr('header-width', value > 0 ? 'custom' : null); }
      else return false;
      quickPreviewUntil = performance.now() + 300;
      return true;
    },
    set(patch) {
      if (!ready) return false;
      if (settings !== previewOverride || !previewBase) previewBase = settings;
      previewOverride = settings = config.sanitize({ ...previewBase, ...patch });
      apply();
      return true;
    },
    clear() {
      const active = previewOverride && settings === previewOverride;
      if (active) settings = previewBase;
      previewBase = previewOverride = null;
      if (active) apply();
    }
  });
