  function gateComponentSheet(sheet) {
    const gated = /^:host-context\(html((?:\[data-wme-studio(?:-[a-z-]+)?="[a-z-]+"\])+)\)((?::host(?:-context)?\((?:[^()]|\([^()]*\))*\))*) (?:\*(::before|::after)?|(::before|::after))$/;
    const split = text => {
      const parts = []; let depth = 0, quote = '', from = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
        const ch = text[i];
        if (quote) { if (ch === quote && text[i - 1] !== '\\') quote = ''; continue; }
        if (ch === '"' || ch === "'") quote = ch;
        else if (ch === '(' || ch === '[') depth++;
        else if (ch === ')' || ch === ']') depth--;
        else if (ch === ',' && !depth) { parts.push(text.slice(from, i).trim()); from = i + 1; }
      }
      parts.push(text.slice(from).trim()); return parts;
    };
    const visit = owner => {
      for (let index = owner.cssRules.length - 1; index >= 0; index--) {
        const rule = owner.cssRules[index];
        if (typeof rule.selectorText !== 'string') { if (rule.cssRules && !stateGateBlocks.has(rule)) visit(rule); continue; }
        const kept = [], moved = []; let state = null, mixed = false;
        for (const selector of split(rule.selectorText)) {
          const match = gated.exec(selector);
          if (!match) { kept.push(selector); continue; }
          if (state !== null && state !== match[1]) mixed = true;
          state = match[1];
          const attributes = match[1].split('][').length;
          moved.push(`${match[2] ? match[2] + ' ' : ''}*${':not(.ws-0)'.repeat(attributes + 1)}:not(ws-0)${match[3] || match[4] || ''}`);
        }
        if (!moved.length || mixed) continue;
        try { owner.insertRule(`@media all { ${moved.join(', ')} { ${rule.style.cssText} } }`, index + 1); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("visit",studioError); continue; }
        const media = owner.cssRules[index + 1].media;
        if (kept.length) rule.selectorText = kept.join(', '); else owner.deleteRule(index);
        componentGates.push({ media, state: 'html' + state, on: true });
      }
    };
    visit(sheet);
  }
  let fontAspect = 0, fontAdjust = '';
  function uiFontAspect() {
    if (fontAspect) return fontAspect;
    const probe = document.createElement('span');
    probe.style.cssText = `position:absolute;visibility:hidden;width:1ex;height:1ex;font:100px/1 ${getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue('--ws-font') || 'sans-serif'};font-size-adjust:none`;
    (document.body || root).append(probe);
    const ex = probe.getBoundingClientRect().height;
    probe.remove();
    return fontAspect = ex > 30 && ex < 80 ? ex / 100 : 0.53;
  }
  function syncFontScale() {
    const scale = settings.fontScale || 100;
    fontAdjust = scale === 100 ? '' : String(Math.round(uiFontAspect() * scale * 100) / 10000);
    if (!fontAdjust) { if (root.style.getPropertyValue('--ws-font-adjust')) root.style.removeProperty('--ws-font-adjust'); }
    else rootStyle('--ws-font-adjust', fontAdjust);
    attr('font', fontAdjust ? 'scaled' : null);
  }
  document.fonts?.addEventListener?.('loadingdone', () => { fontAspect = 0; if (ready && settings.enabled && settings.fontScale !== 100) { syncFontScale(); for (const frame of chatFrames.keys()) syncChatFrame(frame); } });
  // State gates. In both sheets an "@media all { ... }" block is one gate when every selector in it starts
  // with the same root state (html[data-wme-studio...="..."], or that state inside :host-context() in the
  // component sheet). syncComponentGates() switches the whole block off while its state is not active, so
  // its rules take no part in selector matching. Only settings-driven states are wrapped this way, because
  // switching a gate restyles the page.
  // A block is registered from its first rule so start-up stays short. The remaining rules are checked
  // while the browser is idle; a block that mixes states is put back to always on.
  const stateGateBlocks = new WeakSet();
  function splitSelectorList(text) {
    const parts = []; let depth = 0, quote = '', from = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
      const ch = text[i];
      if (quote) { if (ch === '\\') i++; else if (ch === quote) quote = ''; continue; }
      if (ch === '"' || ch === "'") quote = ch;
      else if (ch === '\\') i++;
      else if (ch === '(' || ch === '[') depth++;
      else if (ch === ')' || ch === ']') depth--;
      else if (ch === ',' && !depth) { parts.push(text.slice(from, i).trim()); from = i + 1; }
    }
    parts.push(text.slice(from).trim()); return parts;
  }
  // The root state shared by every selector of the given rules, or null. With `lists`, the split selector
  // lists are collected for reuse.
  function sharedState(rules, prefix, lists = null) {
    let state = null;
    for (const child of rules) {
      if (typeof child.selectorText !== 'string') return null;
      const selectors = splitSelectorList(child.selectorText);
      for (const selector of selectors) {
        const match = prefix.exec(selector);
        if (!match || (state !== null && state !== match[1])) return null;
        state = match[1];
      }
      lists?.push(selectors);
    }
    return state;
  }
  function registerStateGates(sheet, prefix, finish = null) {
    const work = [];
    const visit = owner => {
      for (const rule of owner.cssRules) {
        if (!rule.cssRules) continue;
        if (!rule.media || rule.media.mediaText !== 'all') { visit(rule); continue; }
        const state = rule.cssRules.length ? sharedState([rule.cssRules[0]], prefix) : null;
        if (!state) continue;
        const gate = { media: rule.media, state: 'html' + state, on: true };
        componentGates.push(gate); stateGateBlocks.add(rule);
        work.push(() => {
          const lists = [];
          if (sharedState(rule.cssRules, prefix, lists) === state) { finish?.(rule, state, lists); return; }
          const at = componentGates.indexOf(gate);
          if (at >= 0) componentGates.splice(at, 1);
          gate.media.mediaText = 'all';
          console.warn('[WME Studio] A stylesheet gate mixes root states and was left always on:', gate.state);
        });
      }
    };
    visit(sheet);
    const run = deadline => {
      while (work.length && (!deadline || deadline.timeRemaining() > 1)) work.pop()();
      if (work.length) later();
    };
    const later = () => typeof requestIdleCallback === 'function' ? requestIdleCallback(run, { timeout: 4000 }) : setTimeout(run, 1200);
    if (work.length) later();
    return () => run(null);
  }
  // ":host-context(html[...])" makes the engine walk every ancestor of a component for every candidate rule.
  // Inside a gate the root state is already known to hold, so the prefix is dropped and its specificity is
  // given back with always-true ":not()" parts (one class-level part per attribute plus one for the
  // pseudo-class, and one type-level part for html): on the subject for rules that reach into the shadow
  // tree, inside ":host(...)" for rules about the host itself.
  const hostCompound = /^(?::host(?:-context)?\((?:[^()]|\((?:[^()]|\([^()]*\))*\))*\))* (?![>+~])/;
  function subjectEnd(selector) {
    let depth = 0, quote = '', pseudo = -1;
    for (let i = 0; i < selector.length; i++) {
      const ch = selector[i];
      if (quote) { if (ch === '\\') i++; else if (ch === quote) quote = ''; continue; }
      if (ch === '"' || ch === "'") quote = ch;
      else if (ch === '\\') i++;
      else if (ch === '(' || ch === '[') depth++;
      else if (ch === ')' || ch === ']') depth--;
      else if (depth) continue;
      else if (ch === ' ') pseudo = -1;
      else if (ch === ':' && selector[i + 1] === ':') { if (pseudo < 0) pseudo = i; i++; }
    }
    return pseudo < 0 ? selector.length : pseudo;
  }
  function constantHostContext(rule, state, lists) {
    const from = `:host-context(html${state})`.length, attributes = state.split('][').length;
    const onHost = `:host(${':not(.ws-0)'.repeat(attributes)}:not(ws-0))`;
    const onSubject = `${':not(.ws-0)'.repeat(attributes + 1)}:not(ws-0)`;
    // All the ":host(...)" and ":host-context(...)" parts in front of a host rule belong to one compound, so
    // their order does not change what it matches. ":host-context()" walks up the page from the component,
    // while ":host(wz-tab)" is one comparison that turns almost every component away, so the ":host()" parts
    // go first and the always-true specificity part last.
    const hostPart = /^:host(-context)?\((?:[^()]|\((?:[^()]|\([^()]*\))*\))*\)/;
    const hostFirst = rest => {
      const own = [], context = [];
      for (let match; (match = hostPart.exec(rest)); rest = rest.slice(match[0].length)) (match[1] ? context : own).push(match[0]);
      return own.join('') + context.join('') + onHost + rest;
    };
    const rewrite = selector => {
      let rest = selector.slice(from);
      if (!hostCompound.test(rest)) return hostFirst(rest);
      if (rest[0] === ' ') rest = rest.slice(1);
      const at = subjectEnd(rest);
      return rest.slice(0, at) + onSubject + rest.slice(at);
    };
    let index = 0;
    for (const child of rule.cssRules) child.selectorText = lists[index++].map(rewrite).join(', ');
  }
  // Rewriting a sheet that shadow roots already use would restyle each of them, so whatever is left of it is
  // finished right before the first component adopts the sheet.
  let finishComponentGates = null;
  try {
    if (componentSheet && CSS.supports('selector(:host-context(html))')) {
      finishComponentGates = registerStateGates(componentSheet, /^:host-context\(html((?:\[data-wme-studio(?:-[a-z-]+)?="[a-z-]+"\])+)\)/, constantHostContext);
      gateComponentSheet(componentSheet);
    }
  } catch (error) { if (reportStudioError.active) reportStudioError('Component sheet gating skipped',error); else console.warn('[WME Studio] Component sheet gating skipped.', error.message); }
  try {
    const pageSheet = globalThis.WMEStudioPageStyle?.sheet;
    if (pageSheet) registerStateGates(pageSheet, /^html((?:\[data-wme-studio(?:-[a-z-]+)?="[a-z-]+"\])+)/);
  } catch (error) { if (reportStudioError.active) reportStudioError('Page sheet gating skipped',error); else console.warn('[WME Studio] Page sheet gating skipped.', error.message); }
  if (componentGates.length) {
    syncComponentGates();
    const names = new Set();
    for (const gate of componentGates) for (const match of gate.state.matchAll(/\[([a-z-]+)=/g)) names.add(match[1]);
    new MutationObserver(syncComponentGates).observe(root, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: [...names] });
  }
  const USER_CONTEXT = 'wz-user-box,#notification-button,.notifications-box-container,.tippy-box[data-theme~="notifications-box"]';
  function markUserContext(host) {
    let node = host, inside = false;
    while (node && !inside) {
      if (node.closest?.(USER_CONTEXT)) inside = true;
      else { const owner = node.getRootNode?.(); node = owner instanceof ShadowRoot ? owner.host : null; }
    }
    if (inside !== host.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-user-context')) host.toggleAttribute('data-wme-studio-user-context', inside);
  }
  function markNavigationLabelText(root) {
    const mark = start => {
      const walker = document.createTreeWalker(start, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
      const nodes = [];
      while (walker.nextNode()) nodes.push(walker.currentNode);
      if (start.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) nodes.unshift(start);
      for (const node of nodes) {
        if (!node.textContent?.trim()) continue;
        const parent = node.parentElement;
        if (!parent || parent.closest('[data-wme-studio-nav-label],svg,wz-icon,.w-icon,style,script,[class*="icon" i],[slot*="icon" i]')) continue;
        const label = document.createElement('span');
        label.dataset.wmeStudioNavLabel = '1';
        label.textContent = node.textContent;
        node.replaceWith(label);
      }
    };
    mark(root);
    for (const slot of root.querySelectorAll?.('slot') || []) {
      for (const assigned of slot.assignedNodes?.({ flatten: true }) || []) {
        if (assigned.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE || assigned.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) mark(assigned);
      }
    }
  }
  function syncNavigationTooltip(item, shadow) {
    if (item.host.localName !== 'wz-navigation-item') return;
    const button = shadow.querySelector('.navigation-button');
    const content = shadow.querySelector('.item-content');
    const label = button?.getAttribute('aria-label') || item.host.getAttribute('aria-label') || content?.textContent?.trim() || item.host.textContent?.trim();
    if (!button || !label) return;
    button.title = label;
    button.setAttribute('aria-label', label);
    markNavigationLabelText(shadow.querySelector('.wz-navigation-item') || button);
    markNavigationLabelText(item.host);
  }
  function attachComponentStyle(shadow, item) {
    if (item.host) markUserContext(item.host);
    const componentText = globalThis.WMEStudioSafari.bind(item.host,globalThis.WMEStudioComponents);
    if (componentSheet && item.shared !== false) {
      try {
        if (finishComponentGates) { const finish = finishComponentGates; finishComponentGates = null; finish(); }
        const sheets = shadow.adoptedStyleSheets;
        if (sheets[sheets.length - 1] !== componentSheet) shadow.adoptedStyleSheets = [...sheets.filter(sheet => sheet !== componentSheet), componentSheet];
        item.shared = true; syncNavigationTooltip(item, shadow); return;
      } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("attachComponentStyle",studioError); item.shared = false; }
    }
    if (!item.style) {
      item.style = document.createElement('style');
      item.style.dataset.wmeStudioComponents = '1';
      item.style.textContent = componentText;
    }
    if (!item.style.isConnected && item.host.isConnected) shadow.append(item.style);
    syncNavigationTooltip(item, shadow);
  }
  const laneSidebars = new Map();
  let laneFrame = 0;
  function composedParent(element) {
    return element.assignedSlot || element.parentElement || element.getRootNode().host;
  }
  function insideSidebar(element, sidebar) {
    for (let node = element; node; node = composedParent(node)) if (node === sidebar) return true;
    return false;
  }
  function laneVisible(element) {
    for (let node = element; node; node = composedParent(node)) {
      if (node.hidden || node.getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true') return false;
      if (node.localName === 'wz-tab' && (!node.hasAttribute('is-active') || node.getAttribute('is-active') === 'false')) return false;
    }
    return element.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0 && !['hidden', 'collapse'].includes(getComputedStyle(element).visibility);
  }
  const pixels = value => Number.parseFloat(value) || 0;
  function horizontalFrame(style) {
    return pixels(style.paddingLeft) + pixels(style.paddingRight) + pixels(style.borderLeftWidth) + pixels(style.borderRightWidth);
  }
  function laneRowWidth(row, sidebar, styles) {
    const css = node => {
      if (!styles.has(node)) styles.set(node, getComputedStyle(node));
      return styles.get(node);
    };
    const inFlow = node => !node.hidden && css(node).display !== 'none' && !['absolute', 'fixed'].includes(css(node).position);
    const outerWidth = node => (node.offsetWidth || node.getBoundingClientRect().width) + pixels(css(node).marginLeft) + pixels(css(node).marginRight);
    const style = css(row);
    let content = 0, count = 0;
    for (const child of row.children) {
      if (!inFlow(child)) continue;
      content += outerWidth(child);
      count++;
    }
    if (!count) return 0;
    content += pixels(style.columnGap) * (count - 1);
    for (let node = row; node; node = composedParent(node)) {
      const box = css(node);
      if (node.localName !== 'slot' && box.display !== 'contents') {
        content += horizontalFrame(box);
        if (node.clientWidth > 0) content += Math.max(0, node.offsetWidth - node.clientWidth - pixels(box.borderLeftWidth) - pixels(box.borderRightWidth));
        if (node !== sidebar) content += pixels(box.marginLeft) + pixels(box.marginRight);
      }
      if (node === sidebar) break;
      const parent = composedParent(node);
      if (parent && node.parentElement === parent && /^(inline-)?flex$/.test(css(parent).display) && !css(parent).flexDirection.startsWith('column')) {
        const siblings = [...parent.children].filter(sibling => sibling !== node && inFlow(sibling));
        content += siblings.reduce((sum, sibling) => sum + outerWidth(sibling), 0) + pixels(css(parent).columnGap) * siblings.length;
      }
    }
    return Math.ceil(content) + 2;
  }
  function clearLaneLayout(app) {
    app?.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-lanes');
    app?.style.removeProperty('--ws-lane-width');
  }
  function clearLaneSizing() {
    cancelAnimationFrame(laneFrame); laneFrame = 0;
    for (const { app } of laneSidebars.values()) clearLaneLayout(app);
  }
  function untrackSidebar(sidebar, item) {
    item.observer.disconnect();
    sidebarObserver?.unobserve?.(sidebar); sidebarWidths.delete(sidebar); laneSidebars.delete(sidebar);
    if (![...laneSidebars].some(([node, state]) => node.isConnected && state.app === item.app)) clearLaneLayout(item.app);
  }
  function updateLaneSizing() {
    laneFrame = 0;
    if (sidePanelResizing()) return;
    if (!ready || !settings.enabled) return;
    let normalWidth = 0;
    const selector = '.direction-lanes .lane-arrows, .direction-lanes-edit .checkboxes-wrapper';
    for (const [sidebar, item] of laneSidebars) {
      if (!sidebar.isConnected) {
        untrackSidebar(sidebar, item); continue;
      }
      const app = sidebar.closest('.app');
      if (item.app !== app) { clearLaneLayout(item.app); item.app = app; }
      if (!app) continue;
      const rows = [...sidebar.querySelectorAll(selector)];
      const visible = rows.filter(laneVisible);
      if (!visible.length) { clearLaneLayout(app); continue; }
      const styles = new Map();
      normalWidth ||= pixels(getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue('--ws-sidebar')) || 330;
      const needed = Math.max(normalWidth, ...visible.map(row => laneRowWidth(row, sidebar, styles)));
      const width = needed + 'px';
      if (app.style.getPropertyValue('--ws-lane-width') !== width) app.style.setProperty('--ws-lane-width', width);
      if (app.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-lanes') !== 'on') app.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-lanes', 'on');
    }
  }
  function scheduleLaneSizing() {
    if (!ready || !settings.enabled || laneFrame || document.hidden || sidePanelResizing()) return;
    laneFrame = requestAnimationFrame(updateLaneSizing);
  }
  const sidebarWidths = new WeakMap();
  const sidebarObserver = typeof ResizeObserver === 'function' ? new ResizeObserver(entries => {
    for (const entry of entries) {
      const width = entry.contentRect.width;
      const previous = sidebarWidths.get(entry.target);
      sidebarWidths.set(entry.target, width);
      if (width !== previous) {
        if (sidePanelResizing()) continue;
        scheduleLaneSizing();
        if (previous != null && ready && settings.enabled) resizeMap();
      }
    }
  }) : null;
  let compactDrawerFrame = 0;
  const compactDrawers = new WeakSet();

  const taskMenus = new Map();
  let taskMenuFrame = 0;
  function taskMenuOwner(host) {
    for (let node = host; node; node = composedParent(node)) {
      if (node.id === 'drawer') return null;
      if (node.id === 'sidebar' || node.id === 'filter-panel-region') return node;
    }
    return null;
  }
  function syncTaskMenus() {
    taskMenuFrame = 0;
    for (const [host,state] of taskMenus) {
      if (!host.isConnected) { state.observer.disconnect(); taskMenus.delete(host); continue; }
      if (!settings.enabled) continue;
      const wrapper = state.shadow.querySelector('.options-wrapper');
      if (!wrapper || getComputedStyle(wrapper).visibility === 'hidden') continue;
      const rect = wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!rect.width || !rect.height) continue;
      const owner = compactVisibleRect(state.owner);
      const bottom = Math.min(innerHeight - 12, owner ? owner.top + owner.height - 8 : innerHeight - 12);
      const height = `${Math.max(40, Math.floor(bottom - Math.max(12, rect.top)))}px`;
      if (host.style.getPropertyValue('--ws-task-menu-height') !== height) host.style.setProperty('--ws-task-menu-height',height);
    }
  }
  function queueTaskMenus() { if (!taskMenuFrame) taskMenuFrame = requestAnimationFrame(syncTaskMenus); }
  function trackTaskMenu(host,shadow) {
    if (taskMenus.has(host)) return;
    const owner = taskMenuOwner(host);
    if (!owner) return;
    host.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-task-menu','on');
    const state = {shadow,owner,observer:new MutationObserver(queueTaskMenus)};
    state.observer.observe(host,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['expanded','open','hidden']});
    state.observer.observe(shadow,{childList:true,subtree:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class','hidden','aria-hidden']});
    taskMenus.set(host,state); observeCompactPlacement(owner); queueTaskMenus();
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize',queueTaskMenus,{passive:true});
  document.addEventListener('click',event => { if (event.composedPath().some(node => node?.id === 'sidebar' || node?.id === 'filter-panel-region')) queueTaskMenus(); },true);

  const navigationMenus = new Map();
  let navigationMenusQueued = false;
  function navigationMenuAnchor(host) {
    let anchor = null, depth = 0;
    for (let node = host; node; node = node.parentElement || node.getRootNode?.().host) {
      depth += 1;
      if (!anchor && node.matches?.('wz-menu-sub-menu,.wz-menu-sub-menu')) anchor = node;
      if (node.id === 'drawer') return { rail: node, anchor: anchor || node, depth };
    }
    return null;
  }
  function clearNavigationMenuPosition(state) {
    const positioner = state.positioner;
    if (!positioner) return;
    if (positioner.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-nav-menu')) positioner.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-nav-menu');
    for (const name of ['--ws-nav-menu-left','--ws-nav-menu-top','--ws-nav-menu-width','--ws-nav-menu-height','--ws-nav-menu-offset-x','--ws-nav-menu-offset-y']) {
      if (positioner.style.getPropertyValue(name)) positioner.style.removeProperty(name);
    }
    state.offsetX = state.offsetY = 0;
  }
  function navigationMenuPlacement(rail, anchor, menu, firstLevel, paddingTop, viewportWidth, viewportHeight) {
    const edge = 12;
    const capacity = Math.max(1, viewportHeight - 2 * edge);
    const height = Math.min(menu.height, capacity);
    const width = Math.min(menu.width, viewportWidth - 24);
    const opensLeft = rail.left + rail.width / 2 > viewportWidth / 2;
    const left = opensLeft ? anchor.left - width - (firstLevel ? 8 : 0) : anchor.right + (firstLevel ? 8 : 0);
    return {
      left: Math.max(12, Math.min(left, viewportWidth - width - 12)),
      top: Math.max(edge, Math.min(firstLevel ? Math.ceil(rail.top) : anchor.top - paddingTop, viewportHeight - edge - height)),
      width, capacity
    };
  }
  function syncNavigationMenus() {
    const ordered = [...navigationMenus.values()].map(state => ({ state, location: navigationMenuAnchor(state.host) }))
      .sort((a, b) => (a.location?.depth || 0) - (b.location?.depth || 0));
    for (const { state, location } of ordered) {
      if (!state.host.isConnected || !location) {
        clearNavigationMenuPosition(state); state.observer.disconnect(); state.resize?.disconnect();
        state.shadow.removeEventListener('scroll', queueNavigationMenus, true); navigationMenus.delete(state.host); continue;
      }
      const container = state.shadow.querySelector('.wz-menu > .options-container') || state.shadow.querySelector('.options-container');
      const positioner = container?.parentElement;
      if (state.container !== container || state.positioner !== positioner) {
        clearNavigationMenuPosition(state); state.container = container; state.positioner = positioner;
      }
      if (!container || !positioner?.matches('.wz-menu')) continue;
      const rail = location.rail.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!compactLayoutActive() || compactLayoutEditing || !rail.width || !rail.height) {
        clearNavigationMenuPosition(state); continue;
      }
      const wrapper = container.querySelector('.options-wrapper') || container;
      if (state.wrapper !== wrapper) {
        state.wrapper = wrapper; state.resize?.disconnect(); state.resize?.observe(wrapper);
      }
      const style = getComputedStyle(wrapper);
      const menu = wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden' || menu.width < 1 || menu.height < 1) {
        clearNavigationMenuPosition(state); continue;
      }
      const anchor = location.anchor === location.rail ? rail : location.anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
      const borderTop = Number.parseFloat(style.borderTopWidth) || 0;
      const zoom = positioner.currentCSSZoom || 1;
      const naturalHeight = Math.max(menu.height, (wrapper.scrollHeight + borderTop + (Number.parseFloat(style.borderBottomWidth) || 0)) * zoom);
      const naturalWidth = Math.max(menu.width, (wrapper.scrollWidth + wrapper.offsetWidth - wrapper.clientWidth) * zoom);
      const placed = navigationMenuPlacement(rail, anchor, { width: naturalWidth, height: naturalHeight },
        location.anchor === location.rail, ((Number.parseFloat(style.paddingTop) || 0) + borderTop) * zoom, innerWidth, innerHeight);
      for (const [name, value] of [['--ws-nav-menu-left',placed.left],['--ws-nav-menu-top',placed.top],['--ws-nav-menu-width',placed.width],['--ws-nav-menu-height',placed.capacity]]) {
        const pixels = `${Math.round(value / zoom * 100) / 100}px`, existing = parseFloat(positioner.style.getPropertyValue(name));
        if (!(Math.abs(existing - value / zoom) < .5)) positioner.style.setProperty(name, pixels);
      }
      const level = location.anchor === location.rail ? '1' : '2';
      if (positioner.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-nav-level') !== level) positioner.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-nav-level', level);
      if (!positioner.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-nav-menu')) positioner.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-nav-menu', 'on');
      const actual = positioner.getBoundingClientRect();
      for (const [key, name, delta] of [['offsetX','--ws-nav-menu-offset-x',placed.left - actual.left],['offsetY','--ws-nav-menu-offset-y',placed.top - actual.top]]) {
        if (Math.abs(delta) < .5) continue;
        const offset = Math.round(((state[key] || 0) + delta / zoom) * 100) / 100;
        if (state[key] !== offset) { state[key] = offset; positioner.style.setProperty(name, `${offset}px`); }
      }
    }
    queueHeaderGuardWindows(); queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();
  }
  function queueNavigationMenus() {
    if (navigationMenusQueued) return;
    navigationMenusQueued = true;
    queueMicrotask(() => { navigationMenusQueued = false; syncNavigationMenus(); });
  }
  function navigationMenusNeedSync() {
    for (const state of navigationMenus.values()) {
      if (!state.host.isConnected || state.positioner?.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-nav-menu') || !navigationMenuAnchor(state.host)) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  function trackNavigationMenu(host, shadow) {
    if (navigationMenus.has(host) || !navigationMenuAnchor(host)) return;
    const state = { host, shadow, container: null, offsetX: 0, offsetY: 0, observer: new MutationObserver(queueNavigationMenus),
      resize: typeof ResizeObserver === 'function' ? new ResizeObserver(queueNavigationMenus) : null };
    state.observer.observe(shadow, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true,
      attributeFilter: ['class','style','hidden','aria-hidden','expanded','open'] });
    state.observer.observe(host, { attributes: true });
    shadow.addEventListener('scroll', queueNavigationMenus, { capture: true, passive: true });
    navigationMenus.set(host, state); queueNavigationMenus();
  }
  // Nothing reads the old --ws-compact-drawer-* variables any more, and writing them on <html> restyled the
  // whole document on every resize, so the drawer is only watched here to keep its menus placed.
  function updateCompactDrawerGeometry() {
    for (const name of ['--ws-compact-drawer-top', '--ws-compact-drawer-height', '--ws-compact-drawer-left']) if (root.style.getPropertyValue(name)) root.style.removeProperty(name);
    if (!ready || !settings.enabled || !settings.compactMode || standaloneSignin || editorProfile) return;
    const drawer = document.getElementById('drawer');
    if (!drawer?.isConnected) return;
    if (!compactDrawers.has(drawer)) {
      compactDrawers.add(drawer);
      compactDrawerObserver?.observe(drawer);
    }
    queueNavigationMenus();
  }
  function scheduleCompactDrawerTop() {
    if (compactDrawerFrame) return;
    compactDrawerFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      compactDrawerFrame = 0;
      updateCompactDrawerGeometry();
    });
  }
  const compactDrawerObserver = typeof ResizeObserver === 'function' ? new ResizeObserver(scheduleCompactDrawerTop) : null;

  const headerGuardWindows = new Map();
  let headerGuardQueued = false, headerGuardHeader = null, headerGuardFooter = null;

  function isRequestPopup(element) {

  function requestPopupMotionEnabled() {
    return settings.enabled && settings.motion && !reducedMotion.matches && !document.hidden && !compactLayoutEditing;
  }
  function resetRequestPopupMotion(state) {
    cancelAnimationFrame(state.popupFrame); state.popupFrame = 0;
    clearTimeout(state.popupCloseTimer); state.popupCloseTimer = 0;
    state.popupMotion?.cancel(); state.popupMotion = null;
    state.popupVisible = false; state.popupClosing = false;
    state.element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-popup-enter');
    state.element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-popup-closing');
  }
  function queueRequestPopupOpen(state) {
    state.popupVisible = true;
    if (!requestPopupMotionEnabled() || typeof state.element.animate !== 'function') return;
    state.element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-popup-enter','pending');
    state.popupFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      state.popupFrame = 0;
      state.element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-popup-enter');
      if (!state.element.isConnected || !state.popupVisible || state.popupClosing || !requestPopupMotionEnabled()) return;
      const motion = state.element.animate([{opacity:0,scale:'.975'},{opacity:1,scale:'1'}],
        {duration:160,easing:'cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)'});
      state.popupMotion = motion;
      motion.finished.catch(() => {}).then(() => {
        if (state.popupMotion !== motion) return;
        state.popupMotion = null; queueHeaderGuardWindows();
      });
    });
  }
  const requestPopupCloseReplay = new WeakSet();
  window.addEventListener('click', event => {
    const path = event.composedPath();
    const control = path.find(node => node?.matches?.('wz-button[aria-label="Close"],button[aria-label="Close"],.problem-edit .actions wz-button.done,.place-update-edit wz-button.done'));
    if (!control || requestPopupCloseReplay.has(control) || !requestPopupMotionEnabled()) return;
    const element = path.find(node => headerGuardWindows.has(node));
    const state = headerGuardWindows.get(element);
    if (!state?.popupVisible || !isRequestPopup(element) || typeof element.animate !== 'function') return;
    event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    if (state.popupClosing) return;
    cancelAnimationFrame(state.popupFrame); state.popupFrame = 0;
    element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-popup-enter');
    state.popupMotion?.cancel();
    state.popupClosing = true; element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-popup-closing','on');
    state.popupMotion = element.animate([{opacity:1,scale:'1'},{opacity:0,scale:'.975'}],
      {duration:110,easing:'ease-in',fill:'forwards'});
    state.popupMotion.finished.catch(() => {});
    state.popupCloseTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      state.popupCloseTimer = 0;
      if (control.isConnected && element.isConnected) {
        requestPopupCloseReplay.add(control);
        try { control.click(); } finally { requestPopupCloseReplay.delete(control); }
      }
      resetRequestPopupMotion(state); queueHeaderGuardWindows();
    },110);
  },true);
  function lockPanelDragSize(element, rect) {
    const properties = ['height','min-height','max-height'];
    const original = properties.map(name => [name,element.style.getPropertyValue(name),element.style.getPropertyPriority(name)]);
    const style = getComputedStyle(element), zoom = element.currentCSSZoom || 1;
    const insets = style.boxSizing === 'border-box' ? 0 : ['paddingTop','paddingBottom','borderTopWidth','borderBottomWidth'].reduce((sum,key) => sum + (parseFloat(style[key]) || 0),0);
    const height = `${Math.max(0,rect.height / zoom - insets)}px`;
    for (const name of properties) element.style.setProperty(name,height,'important');
    return () => {
      for (const [name,value,priority] of original) {
        if (value) element.style.setProperty(name,value,priority);
        else element.style.removeProperty(name);
      }
    };
  }

  }
  function hoverFlowPanel(event) {

    if (grip) panel.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-flow-grip', 'on'); else panel.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-flow-grip');
  }

  }
  function ensureLiftFilters() {
    if (document.getElementById('wme-studio-filters')) return;
    const holder = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'svg');
    holder.id = 'wme-studio-filters'; holder.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); holder.setAttribute('width', '0'); holder.setAttribute('height', '0');
    holder.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;width:0;height:0;pointer-events:none';
    const matrix = amount => `1 0 ${amount} 0 0  0 1 ${amount} 0 0  0 0 ${1 + amount} 0 0  0 0 0 1 0`;
    holder.innerHTML = [['dark', .75], ['black', 1.05]].map(([name, amount]) =>
      `<filter id="wme-studio-lift-${name}" color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"><feColorMatrix type="matrix" values="${matrix(amount)}"/></filter>`).join('');
    (document.body || root).append(holder);
  }
  function syncLocaleFlag() {
    ensureLiftFilters();

    try { locale = pageWindow.I18n?.currentLocale?.() || pageWindow.I18n?.locale || ''; } catch (_) { reportStudioError("syncLocaleFlag",_);}

  function requestPopupKind(element) {
    if (!element?.matches?.(REQUEST_WINDOW_SELECTOR) && !element?.querySelector?.('.problem-edit,.place-update-edit')) return null;
    const heading = element.querySelector('[aria-roledescription="draggable"]') || element.querySelector('h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,[class*="header" i]');
    const text = (heading?.textContent || element.textContent || '').slice(0,240).replace(/\s+/g,' ');
    if (element.id==='ISSUE_WINDOW_MAP_SUGGESTION' || /map\s+suggestion/i.test(text)) return 'mapSuggestion';
    if (/map\s+update\s+request/i.test(text)) return 'mapUpdateRequest';
    if (/place\s+update/i.test(text) || element.querySelector('.place-update-edit')) return 'placeUpdateRequest';
    if (/map\s+problem/i.test(text)) return 'mapProblem';
    return 'updateRequest';
  }

    function setPillColor(value) {
      pillColor=colorValue(value);
      shadow.querySelector('[name="pill-color"]').value=pillColor;
      for(const button of shadow.querySelectorAll('[data-pill-color]'))button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(button.dataset.pillColor===pillColor));
      shadow.querySelector('[data-id="pill-picker-open"]').style.setProperty('--custom-color',pillColor);
    }
    function setupPillPicker() {
      const q=selector=>shadow.querySelector(selector);
      for(const button of shadow.querySelectorAll('[data-pill-color]'))button.addEventListener('click',()=>setPillColor(button.dataset.pillColor));
    const colorPicker = q('[data-id="color-picker"]'), colorPlane = q('[data-id="picker-plane"]');
    let pickerHSV = {h:204,s:1,v:1}, pickerHex = '', pickerDrag = null, pickerTimer = 0;
    function colorRGB(hex) { return [1,3,5].map(index => parseInt(hex.slice(index,index + 2),16)); }
    function colorHSV(hex) {
      const [r,g,b] = colorRGB(hex).map(value => value / 255), max = Math.max(r,g,b), min = Math.min(r,g,b), delta = max - min;
      const hue = delta ? (max === r ? (g - b) / delta + (g < b ? 6 : 0) : max === g ? (b - r) / delta + 2 : (r - g) / delta + 4) * 60 : pickerHSV.h;
      return {h:hue,s:max ? delta / max : 0,v:max};
    }
    function colorHex({h,s,v}) {
      const c = v * s, x = c * (1 - Math.abs((h / 60) % 2 - 1)), m = v - c;
      const parts = h < 60 ? [c,x,0] : h < 120 ? [x,c,0] : h < 180 ? [0,c,x] : h < 240 ? [0,x,c] : h < 300 ? [x,0,c] : [c,0,x];
      return '#' + parts.map(value => Math.round((value + m) * 255).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
    }
    function paintColorPicker(hex = colorHex(pickerHSV)) {
      colorPicker.style.setProperty('--picker-hue',`hsl(${pickerHSV.h} 100% 50%)`);
      colorPicker.style.setProperty('--picker-color',hex);
      colorPlane.style.setProperty('--picker-x',`${pickerHSV.s * 100}%`);
      colorPlane.style.setProperty('--picker-y',`${(1 - pickerHSV.v) * 100}%`);
      colorPlane.setAttribute('aria-valuenow',String(Math.round(pickerHSV.s * 100)));
      colorPlane.setAttribute('aria-valuetext',`Saturation ${Math.round(pickerHSV.s * 100)}%, brightness ${Math.round(pickerHSV.v * 100)}%`);
      q('[data-id="picker-hue"]').value = String(Math.round(pickerHSV.h));
      const fields = ['red','green','blue'];
      colorRGB(hex).forEach((value,index) => { const input = q(`[data-id="picker-${fields[index]}"]`); if (input !== shadow.activeElement) input.value = String(value); });
      const input = q('[data-id="picker-hex"]');
      if (input !== shadow.activeElement) input.value = hex.toUpperCase();
    }
    function syncColorPicker(hex) {
      if (hex !== pickerHex) { pickerHex = hex; pickerHSV = colorHSV(hex); }
      paintColorPicker(hex);
    }
    function commitPickerColor() {
      clearTimeout(pickerTimer); pickerTimer = 0;
      setPillColor(pickerHex);
    }
    function previewPickerColor(hex = colorHex(pickerHSV)) {
      pickerHex = hex;
      setPillColor(hex); paintColorPicker(hex);
    }
    function positionColorPicker() {
      if (!colorPicker.matches(':popover-open')) return;
      const anchor = q('[data-id="pill-picker-open"]').getBoundingClientRect(), size = colorPicker.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = Math.max(12,Math.min(anchor.right - size.width,innerWidth - size.width - 12));
      const y = anchor.bottom + 10 + size.height <= innerHeight - 12 ? anchor.bottom + 10 : anchor.top - size.height - 10;
      colorPicker.style.left = `${Math.round(x)}px`; colorPicker.style.top = `${Math.round(Math.max(12,Math.min(y,innerHeight - size.height - 12)))}px`;
    }
    function closeColorPicker(focus=true) {
      if (pickerTimer) commitPickerColor();
      pickerDrag = null;
      if (colorPicker.matches(':popover-open')) colorPicker.hidePopover();
      q('[data-id="pill-picker-open"]').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
      if(focus)q('[data-id="pill-picker-open"]').focus({preventScroll:true});
    }
    q('[data-id="pill-picker-open"]').addEventListener('click',() => {
      if (colorPicker.matches(':popover-open')) { closeColorPicker(); return; }
      syncColorPicker(pillColor); colorPicker.showPopover(); positionColorPicker();
      q('[data-id="pill-picker-open"]').setAttribute('aria-expanded','true'); colorPlane.focus({preventScroll:true});
    });
    colorPicker.addEventListener('toggle',event => {
      q('[data-id="pill-picker-open"]').setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(event.newState === 'open'));
      if (event.newState === 'closed' && pickerTimer) commitPickerColor();
    });
    const pickPlane = event => {
      if (!pickerDrag) return;
      pickerHSV.s = Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(event.clientX - pickerDrag.left) / pickerDrag.width));
      pickerHSV.v = 1 - Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(event.clientY - pickerDrag.top) / pickerDrag.height));
      previewPickerColor();
    };
    colorPlane.addEventListener('pointerdown',event => {
      if (event.button !== 0) return; event.preventDefault(); colorPlane.focus({preventScroll:true});
      pickerDrag = colorPlane.getBoundingClientRect(); colorPlane.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); pickPlane(event);
    });
    colorPlane.addEventListener('pointermove',event => { if (pickerDrag) pickPlane(event); });
    for (const type of ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture']) colorPlane.addEventListener(type,event => {
      if (!pickerDrag) return;
      if (type === 'pointerup') pickPlane(event); pickerDrag = null; commitPickerColor();
    });
    function adjustPickerPlane(event) {
      if (!['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown'].includes(event.key)) return;
      event.preventDefault(); const step = event.shiftKey ? .1 : .01;
      if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft' || event.key === 'ArrowRight') pickerHSV.s = Math.max(0,Math.min(1,pickerHSV.s + (event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? step : -step)));
      else pickerHSV.v = Math.max(0,Math.min(1,pickerHSV.v + (event.key === 'ArrowUp' ? step : -step)));
      previewPickerColor();
    }
    q('[data-id="picker-hue"]').addEventListener('input',event => { pickerHSV.h = Number(event.target.value); previewPickerColor(); });
    q('[data-id="picker-hue"]').addEventListener('change',commitPickerColor);
    const readPickerHex = () => {
      const input = q('[data-id="picker-hex"]'), value = input.value.trim().replace(/^#/,'');
      const valid = /^(?:[0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{6})$/i.test(value);
      input.setAttribute('aria-invalid',String(!valid)); if (!valid) return;
      const hex = '#' + (value.length === 3 ? [...value].map(digit => digit + digit).join('') : value).toLowerCase();
      pickerHSV = colorHSV(hex); previewPickerColor(hex); commitPickerColor(); input.value = hex.toUpperCase();
    };
    q('[data-id="picker-hex"]').addEventListener('change',readPickerHex);
    q('[data-id="picker-hex"]').addEventListener('keydown',event => { if (event.key === 'Enter') { event.preventDefault(); readPickerHex(); } });
    for (const name of ['red','green','blue']) q(`[data-id="picker-${name}"]`).addEventListener('change',() => {
      const values = ['red','green','blue'].map(channel => Number(q(`[data-id="picker-${channel}"]`).value));
      if (values.some(value => !Number.isFinite(value))) return;
      const hex = '#' + values.map(value => Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(value))).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
      pickerHSV = colorHSV(hex); previewPickerColor(hex); commitPickerColor();
    });
    q('[data-id="picker-reset"]').addEventListener('click',() => { pickerHSV = colorHSV('#0099ff'); previewPickerColor('#0099ff'); commitPickerColor(); });
    q('[data-id="picker-close"]').addEventListener('click',()=>closeColorPicker());
    q('[data-id="picker-done"]').addEventListener('click',()=>closeColorPicker());
    colorPlane.addEventListener('keydown',adjustPickerPlane);
    colorPicker.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{if(event.key==='Enter' && event.target.matches('input[type=number]')){event.preventDefault();event.target.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));}});
    window.addEventListener('resize',positionColorPicker,{passive:true});
    return {close:closeColorPicker,isOpen:()=>colorPicker.matches(':popover-open')};
    }
    function hideMinimizeTip() {
      tooltipButton?.removeAttribute('aria-describedby');tooltipButton=null;
      if(shadow)shadow.querySelector('.minimize-tip').hidden=true;
    }
    function showMinimizeTip(button) {

    }
    function updateDockVisibility() {
      const dock=shadow?.querySelector('.dock');

    function updateZoom() {
      try { const level=sdk?.Map?.getZoomLevel(); zoomLevel=Number.isFinite(level)?level:null; }
      catch (_) { reportStudioError("updateZoom",_); zoomLevel=null; }

    }
    function connectZoom() {
      if (sdk?.Map?.getZoomLevel && sdk?.Events?.on && zoomSDK!==sdk) {
        try {
          sdk.Events.on({eventName:'wme-map-zoom-changed',eventHandler:updateZoom});
          zoomSDK=sdk;
          sdk.Events.once?.({eventName:'wme-ready'})?.then(updateZoom).catch(()=>{});
        } catch (_) { reportStudioError("connectZoom",_);}
      }
      updateZoom();
    }
    function message(text) { ensureUI(); const status=shadow.querySelector('.status'); status.textContent=text; status.hidden=!text; }
    function render() {
      if (!host && !items.size && !naming) return;
      ensureUI(); const dock=shadow.querySelector('.dock'); dock.replaceChildren();
      if (items.size>1) dock.append(cycleButton(-1));
      for (const item of items.values()) {
        const pill=document.createElement('div'); pill.className='pill'; pill.style.setProperty('--ws-pill-color',colorValue(item.color));
        const button=document.createElement('button'); button.type='button'; button.className='restore';
        button.innerHTML=restoreIcon+'<span></span>'; button.querySelector('span').textContent=item.name;
        const selected=active?.id===item.id && !!currentPanel();
        pill.toggleAttribute('data-active',selected); if(selected)pill.setAttribute('data-active','on');
        button.title=selected?`${item.name} is open`:`Open ${item.name}`; button.setAttribute('aria-label',`Open Update Request: ${item.name}`); button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(selected));
        button.disabled=!!pendingRestore; button.addEventListener('click',()=>requestRestore(item));
        const remove=document.createElement('button'); remove.type='button'; remove.className='remove'; remove.title=`Remove pill: ${item.name}`; remove.setAttribute('aria-label',remove.title); remove.disabled=!!pendingRestore;
        remove.innerHTML='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7 7 10 10M17 7 7 17"/></svg>';
        remove.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(active?.id===item.id || !item.draft.trim()){items.delete(item.id);render();}else requestRestore(item,true);});
        pill.append(button,remove); dock.append(pill);
      }
      if (items.size>1) dock.append(cycleButton(1));
      updateDockVisibility();
      if (!settings.enabled || compactLayoutEditing) { hideMinimizeTip(); closeName(); shadow.querySelector('.status').hidden=true; }
      refreshButtons(); positionDock();
    }
    function cycleButton(direction) {
      const button=document.createElement('button'); button.type='button'; button.className='cycle'; button.disabled=!!pendingRestore;
      button.title=direction<0?'Previous saved request':'Next saved request'; button.setAttribute('aria-label',button.title);
      button.innerHTML=`<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="${direction<0?'m14 5-7 7 7 7':'m10 5 7 7-7 7'}"/></svg>`;
      button.addEventListener('click',()=>{const saved=[...items.values()],index=saved.findIndex(item=>item.id===active?.id);requestRestore(saved[index<0?(direction<0?saved.length-1:0):(index+direction+saved.length)%saved.length]);});
      return button;
    }
    function closeName(focus=false) {
      const previous=naming; naming=null; pillPicker?.close(false); hideMinimizeTip();
      if (shadow) shadow.querySelector('.backdrop').hidden=true;
      if (focus && previous?.button?.isConnected) previous.button.focus({preventScroll:true});
    }
    function openName(panel,target=null,forget=false) {
      if (!settings.enabled || compactLayoutEditing || pendingRestore || !active || !isUpdate(panel)) return;
      if (!target && items.size>=limit && !items.has(active.id)) { message('Four requests are saved. Remove a pill to free a slot.'); return; }
      ensureUI(); message('');
      const button=panels.get(panel)?.button;
      naming={panel,button,id:active.id,target,forget};
      const input=shadow.querySelector('[name="request-name"]'); input.value=items.get(active.id)?.name || active.name || '';
      setPillColor(colorValue(items.get(active.id)?.color || active.color));
      shadow.querySelector('h2').textContent=target?'Keep your current reply':'Name this request';
      shadow.querySelector('.description').textContent=target?'Name the current request to keep its unsent reply while you restore the other request.':'Name a pill to keep this request available. You can cycle through up to four requests.';
      const submit=shadow.querySelector('[type="submit"]'); submit.textContent=target?'Minimize & switch':'Minimize'; submit.disabled=!input.value.trim();
      shadow.querySelector('.backdrop').hidden=false; input.focus({preventScroll:true}); input.select();
    }
    function replyField(panel) {
      return panel?.querySelector('wz-textarea.new-comment-text') || panel?.querySelector('.new-comment-form textarea');
    }
    function replyValue(panel) { const field=replyField(panel); return String(field?.value ?? field?.shadowRoot?.querySelector('textarea')?.value ?? ''); }
    function snapshot(panel,name,color) {
      const element=panel.closest(REQUEST_WINDOW_SELECTOR) || panel.closest('#panel-container > *') || panel;
      const rect=element.getBoundingClientRect(), guard=headerGuardWindows.get(element);
      return {...active,name:name.trim().slice(0,48),color:colorValue(color || active.color),draft:replyValue(panel),point:guard?.requestPoint?{...guard.requestPoint}:{left:rect.left,top:rect.top}};
    }
    function nativeOpen(item) {
      try {
        if (sdk?.IssueTracker?.showPanel && Number.isFinite(item.mapIssueId)) return sdk.IssueTracker.showPanel({issueTrackerId:item.mapIssueId,type:'mapUpdateRequest'});
      } catch (error) { reportStudioError("nativeOpen",error);
        // A minimized request may have left the loaded map data after a pan.
        if (!item.model || !pageWindow.W?.reqres?.request) throw error;
      }
      if (!item.model || !pageWindow.W?.reqres?.request) throw new Error('This Update Request cannot be reopened yet.');
      return pageWindow.W.reqres.request('problems:browse',{problem:item.model,showNext:false});
    }
    async function minimize(panel,name,color) {
      if (!name.trim() || !active || pendingRestore || items.size>=limit && !items.has(active.id)) return;
      const previous=items.get(active.id),item=snapshot(panel,name,color), element=panel.closest(REQUEST_WINDOW_SELECTOR) || panel;
      items.set(item.id,item); element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-request-minimized','on');
      panelResizeHints.dismiss(element); render();
      try {
        if (sdk?.IssueTracker?.closePanel) await sdk.IssueTracker.closePanel();
        else {
          const control=element.querySelector('wz-button[aria-label="Close"],button[aria-label="Close"],.actions wz-button.done,.actions button.done,[class*="closePanel--"]');
          if (!control) throw new Error('The native request close button is not ready.');
          control.click();
        }
      } catch (_) { reportStudioError("minimize",_);
        if(previous)items.set(item.id,previous);else items.delete(item.id); element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-request-minimized'); render();
        message('Could not minimize this request. Please try again.');
      }
    }
    function currentPanel() { return [...panels.keys()].find(panel=>panel.isConnected && isUpdate(panel)); }
    function saveCurrent() {
      const item=items.get(active?.id);
      if (!item) return;
      const candidates=[...panels].filter(([panel,state])=>state.id===active.id);
      const panel=candidates.find(([panel])=>panel.isConnected)?.[0] || candidates.at(-1)?.[0];
      if (!panel) return;
      if (panel.isConnected && panel.getBoundingClientRect().width) Object.assign(item,snapshot(panel,item.name,item.color));
      else item.draft=replyValue(panel);
    }
    function requestRestore(item,forget=false) {
      if (!item || !settings.enabled || compactLayoutEditing || pendingRestore) return;
      if (active?.id===item.id && currentPanel()) { if(forget){items.delete(item.id);render();} return; }
      const panel=currentPanel();
      if (panel && replyValue(panel).trim() && !items.has(active?.id)) {
        if(items.size>=limit && !forget){message('Four requests are saved. Remove a pill before keeping another reply.');return;}
        openName(panel,item,forget); return;
      }
      restore(item,null,false,forget);
    }
    function restore(item,swap=null,rollback=false,forget=false) {
      if (pendingRestore || !item) return;
      saveCurrent(); message('');
      const operation={item,swap,rollback,forget,timer:0,previousPanel:currentPanel(),previousId:active?.id}; pendingRestore=operation; render();
      operation.timer=setTimeout(()=>failedRestore(operation),5000);
      try { Promise.resolve(nativeOpen(item)).catch((studioError)=>{ reportStudioError("restore",studioError); return failedRestore(operation); }); }
      catch (_) { reportStudioError("restore",_); failedRestore(operation); }
    }
    function failedRestore(operation) {
      if (pendingRestore!==operation) return;
      clearTimeout(operation.timer); pendingRestore=null; render();
      if (operation.swap && !operation.rollback) { restore(operation.swap,null,true); return; }
      message('Could not restore the request. Your minimized pill is still here; try again.');
    }
    function finishRestore(panel) {
      const operation=pendingRestore;
      if (!operation || active?.id !== operation.item.id || !panel.isConnected || !isUpdate(panel) ||
          operation.previousPanel===panel && operation.previousId!==operation.item.id) return;
      const field=replyField(panel), item=operation.item;
      if (item.draft && !field) return;
      if (field && item.draft) {
        // Update the live native component, allowing its normal change handler to retain the draft.
        field.value=item.draft;
        if (field.localName==='textarea') {
          const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value')?.set;
          setter?.call(field,item.draft); field.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));
        }
        field.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true,composed:true}));
      }
      const element=panel.closest(REQUEST_WINDOW_SELECTOR) || panel.closest('#panel-container > *'), guard=headerGuardWindows.get(element);
      if (guard && item.point) {
        guard.requestPoint={...item.point};
        const saved=compactIslandLayout?.[requestPopupKind(element)];
        guard.appliedPopupPoint=saved?`${saved.anchor || 'preview'},${saved.x},${saved.y}`:null;
      }
      active.name=item.name; active.color=colorValue(item.color);
      if (!operation.rollback) {
        if (operation.forget) items.delete(item.id);
        if (operation.swap && operation.swap.id!==item.id) items.set(operation.swap.id,operation.swap);
      }
      clearTimeout(operation.timer); pendingRestore=null;
      render(); queueHeaderGuardWindows();
    }
    function refreshButtons() {
      for (const [panel,state] of panels) {
        if (!panel.isConnected) { positions?.unobserve(panel); if(state.close)positions?.unobserve(state.close); state.button.remove(); panels.delete(panel); continue; }
        state.button.hidden=!settings.enabled || compactLayoutEditing || !isUpdate(panel);
        state.button.disabled=!!pendingRestore || !active || items.size>=limit && !items.has(active.id);
        state.button.minimizeTip=items.size>=limit && !items.has(active?.id)?'Four requests saved — remove a pill first':'Minimize';
      }
    }
    function positionDock() {
      if (!host) return;
      const next=document.querySelector('.wz-map-ol-footer');
      if (next!==footer) {
        if (footer) positions?.unobserve(footer);
        footerChanges.disconnect(); footer=next;
        if (footer) { positions?.observe(footer); footerChanges.observe(footer,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['style','class','hidden']}); }
      }
      const rect=footer?.getBoundingClientRect();
      const bottom=Math.max(18,rect?.height && rect.top<innerHeight ? innerHeight-rect.top+12 : 18);
      const value=`${Math.ceil(bottom)}px`;
      if (host.style.getPropertyValue('--ws-minimized-bottom')!==value) host.style.setProperty('--ws-minimized-bottom',value);
    }
    function positionButton(state) {
      if (!state.close?.isConnected || !state.button.isConnected) return;
      const close=state.close,button=state.button;
      let x=close.offsetLeft-34,y=close.offsetTop+(close.offsetHeight-28)/2;
      if (close.offsetParent!==button.offsetParent) {
        const rect=close.getBoundingClientRect(),own=button.getBoundingClientRect(),zoom=button.currentCSSZoom || 1;
        x=(parseFloat(button.style.left) || 0)+(rect.left-own.left)/zoom-34;
        y=(parseFloat(button.style.top) || 0)+(rect.top+(rect.height-own.height)/2-own.top)/zoom;
      }
      const left=`${Math.max(0,Math.round(x*100)/100)}px`,top=`${Math.round(y*100)/100}px`;
      if (state.button.style.left!==left) state.button.style.left=left;
      if (state.button.style.top!==top) state.button.style.top=top;
    }
    function queuePositions() {
      if (positionFrame) return;
      positionFrame=requestAnimationFrame(()=>{positionFrame=0;positionDock();if(tooltipButton)showMinimizeTip(tooltipButton);for(const state of panels.values())positionButton(state);});
    }
    // Measuring at once would force a style pass for every part of a request panel the discovery pass
    // reaches; afterDiscover() measures once the pass is done, still before anything is painted.
    const awaitingPosition=new Set();
    function deferPosition(state) {
      if (awaitingPosition.has(state)) return;
      awaitingPosition.add(state);
      afterDiscover(()=>{awaitingPosition.delete(state);positionButton(state);});
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize',queuePositions,{passive:true});
    function readCurrent() {
      let model;
      try { model=pageWindow.W?.problemsController?.getCurrentProblem?.(); } catch (_) { reportStudioError("readCurrent",_);}
      if (model) {
        const type=model.type || model.getType?.();
        if (type==='mapUpdateRequest') {
          const id=String(model.getID());
          active={...(active?.id===id?active:{}),type,id,mapIssueId:Number(model.getMapIssueId?.() ?? model.getID()),model};
        } else active=null;
      }
    }
    function inspect(panel) {
      if (!panel?.matches('.problem-edit')) return;
      connect(); readCurrent();
      const existing=panels.get(panel),window=panel.closest(REQUEST_WINDOW_SELECTOR);
      const close=panel.querySelector('[class*="closePanel--"]') || window?.querySelector('[aria-roledescription="draggable"] wz-button[aria-label="Close"],[aria-roledescription="draggable"] button[aria-label="Close"]');
      // Keep Minimize outside the Close tooltip's hover source.
      let anchor=close;
      for (let node=close?.parentElement;node && node!==window && node!==panel;node=node.parentElement) {
        if (node.matches('[aria-roledescription="draggable"],[class*="issuePanelHeader--"],[class*="panelHeaderActions--"]')) break;
        if (node.matches('wz-basic-tooltip,wz-rich-tooltip,wz-tooltip,wz-tooltip-source,wz-tooltip-target')) anchor=node;
      }
      const actions=anchor?.parentElement || window?.querySelector('[aria-roledescription="draggable"]') || panel.querySelector('[class*="issuePanelHeader--"]');
      if (!actions) return;
      let state=existing;
      if (!existing || !existing.button.isConnected || existing.button.parentElement!==actions || existing.close!==close) {
        existing?.button.remove(); if(existing?.close)positions?.unobserve(existing.close);
        for (const stale of actions.querySelectorAll(':scope > .ws-request-minimize')) stale.remove();
        const button=document.createElement('button'); button.type='button'; button.className='ws-request-minimize';
        button.innerHTML=icon; button.setAttribute('aria-label','Minimize Update Request');
        button.addEventListener('pointerenter',()=>showMinimizeTip(button));button.addEventListener('pointerleave',hideMinimizeTip);
        button.addEventListener('focus',()=>showMinimizeTip(button));button.addEventListener('blur',hideMinimizeTip);
        button.addEventListener('pointerdown',event=>{event.stopPropagation();hideMinimizeTip();});
        button.addEventListener('click',event=>{event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();hideMinimizeTip();readCurrent();openName(panel);});
        if (close) { button.setAttribute('data-next-to-close','on'); actions.insertBefore(button,anchor); }
        else { button.style.marginInlineStart='auto'; actions.append(button); }
        state={button,close,id:active?.id}; panels.set(panel,state); positions?.observe(panel);
        if (!existing) {
          const saveDraft=()=>{const item=items.get(panels.get(panel)?.id);if(item)item.draft=replyValue(panel);};
          panel.addEventListener('change',saveDraft); panel.addEventListener('input',saveDraft);
        }
        if (close) positions?.observe(close);
      }
      state.id=pendingRestore?.previousPanel===panel && pendingRestore.previousId!==pendingRestore.item.id ? pendingRestore.previousId : active?.id;
      deferPosition(state); finishRestore(panel); refreshButtons();
    }
    function queueRefresh() {
      if (refreshFrame) return;
      refreshFrame=requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
        refreshFrame=0;
        for (const panel of document.querySelectorAll('.problem-edit')) inspect(panel);
        render();
      });
    }
    function connect() {
      if (standaloneSignin || editorProfile) return;
      if (!sdkReadyHooked && pageWindow.SDK_INITIALIZED?.then) { sdkReadyHooked=true; Promise.resolve(pageWindow.SDK_INITIALIZED).then(connect).catch((studioError)=>{ reportStudioError("connect",studioError);}); }
      if (!sdk) try { sdk=pageWindow.getWmeSdk?.({scriptId:'wme-studio',scriptName:'WME Studio'}); } catch (_) { reportStudioError("connect",_);}
      connectZoom();
      trackStreetViewSDK(sdk);
      const app=pageWindow.W?.app;
      if (!app?.on) return;
      if (connectedApp===app) return;
      connectedApp=app; readCurrent();
      app.on('problems:shown',model=>{
        const previousPanel=currentPanel(),previousId=active?.id;
        const type=model?.type || model?.getType?.();
        active=type==='mapUpdateRequest'?{type,id:String(model.getID()),mapIssueId:Number(model.getMapIssueId?.() ?? model.getID()),model}:null;
        for (const state of requestReplyForms.values()) startRequestOpeningScroll(state);
        if (naming && naming.id!==active?.id) closeName();
        if (!pendingRestore && active && items.has(active.id)) {
          pendingRestore={item:items.get(active.id),swap:null,rollback:false,timer:0,previousPanel,previousId};
          const operation=pendingRestore; operation.timer=setTimeout(()=>failedRestore(operation),5000);
        }
        queueRefresh();
      });
      app.on('problems:closed',()=>{saveCurrent();active=null; closeName(); queueRefresh();});
      queueRefresh();
    }
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',connect,{once:true}); window.addEventListener('load',connect,{once:true});
    connect();
    return Object.freeze({inspect,refresh:()=>{connect();render();},prune:()=>{refreshButtons();if(naming && !naming.panel.isConnected)closeName();}});
  })();

  function compactPanelObstacles(exclude = null, gap = 12) {
    const elements = new Set(compactIslandSpecs.filter(spec => !spec.popup && spec.id !== 'messages').map(queryCompactIsland));
    elements.add(document.getElementById('sidebar')); elements.add(document.getElementById('filter-panel-region'));
    elements.add(document.querySelector('.wz-map-ol-footer'));
    elements.add(document.querySelector('.wme-studio-header-location[data-placement]:not([data-placement="inline"])'));
    for (const element of headerGuardWindows.keys()) elements.add(element);
    for (const frame of chatFrames.keys()) { const state = chatPanelStates.get(frame); if (state?.target) elements.add(state.target); }
    return [...elements].filter(element => element !== exclude).map(compactVisibleRect).filter(Boolean).map(rect => ({
      left:rect.left - gap, top:rect.top - gap, width:rect.width + 2 * gap, height:rect.height + 2 * gap
    }));
  }
  function writeFlowPosition(state, left, top) {
    const element = state.element;
    const write = (x, y) => {
      const values = [['--ws-flow-left', `${Math.round(x * 100) / 100}px`], ['--ws-flow-top', `${Math.round(y * 100) / 100}px`]];
      for (const [name, value] of values) if (element.style.getPropertyValue(name) !== value) element.style.setProperty(name, value);
    };
    const origin = state.flowOrigin || { x: 0, y: 0 }, zoom = element.currentCSSZoom || 1;
    write((left - origin.x) / zoom, (top - origin.y) / zoom);
    if (element.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-flow-placed') !== 'on') element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-flow-placed', 'on');
    if (!state.flowOrigin) {
      const now = element.getBoundingClientRect();
      state.flowOrigin = { x: Math.round(now.left - left), y: Math.round(now.top - top) };
      if (state.flowOrigin.x || state.flowOrigin.y) write((left - state.flowOrigin.x) / zoom, (top - state.flowOrigin.y) / zoom);
    }
    state.shiftX = 0; state.shift = 0;
  }
  function writeRequestPosition(state,rect,left,top) {
    if (isFlowPanel(state.element)) { writeFlowPosition(state, left, top); return; }
    const rawLeft = rect.left - state.shiftX, rawTop = rect.top - state.shift;
    const nextX = Math.round((left - rawLeft) * 100) / 100, nextY = Math.round((top - rawTop) * 100) / 100;
    if (Math.abs(nextX - state.shiftX) < .5 && Math.abs(nextY - state.shift) < .5 && state.element.style.getPropertyValue('translate')) return;
    state.shiftX = nextX; state.shift = nextY;
    const zoom = state.element.currentCSSZoom || 1;
    const value = `${Math.round(state.shiftX / zoom * 100) / 100}px ${Math.round(state.shift / zoom * 100) / 100}px`;
    if (state.element.style.getPropertyValue('translate') !== value || state.element.style.getPropertyPriority('translate') !== 'important') state.element.style.setProperty('translate',value,'important');
  }

  function workspacePanelBounds() {
    const header = document.getElementById('app-head');
    let bar = null;
    const rect = compactVisibleRect(header);
    if (rect) {
      bar = { left: rect.left, right: rect.left + rect.width, top: rect.top, bottom: rect.top + rect.height };
    }
    const map = !compactLayoutActive() ? compactVisibleRect(document.getElementById('WazeMap') || document.querySelector('.edit-area-main')) : null;
    return { width: innerWidth, height: innerHeight, header: bar, map, footer: compactVisibleRect(document.querySelector('.wz-map-ol-footer')) };
  }
  function standardPanelHorizontalBounds(width, geometry) {
    const gap = 12, map = geometry.map;
    let left = Math.max(gap, map ? map.left + gap : gap);
    let right = Math.min(geometry.width - gap, map ? map.left + map.width - gap : geometry.width - gap);
    if (right - left < width) { left = gap; right = geometry.width - gap; }
    return {left, right: Math.max(left, right - width)};
  }
  function headerPanelLimits(left, width, gap = 12, geometry = null, panel = null) {
    const limits = { top: gap, bottom: innerHeight - gap };
    if (!ready || !settings.enabled || standaloneSignin || editorProfile) return limits;
    const bounds = geometry || workspacePanelBounds(), footer = bounds.footer, bar = bounds.header;
    if (footer && left + width > footer.left && left < footer.left + footer.width) limits.bottom = Math.min(limits.bottom, footer.top - COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP);
    if (!bar || left + width + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP <= bar.left || left >= bar.right + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP) return limits;
    const above = floatingHeader.position && panel ? panel.top + panel.height / 2 < (bar.top + bar.bottom) / 2 : (bar.top + bar.bottom) / 2 > bounds.height / 2;
    if (above) limits.bottom = Math.min(limits.bottom, bar.top - COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP);
    else limits.top = Math.max(limits.top, bar.bottom + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP);
    return limits;
  }
  function restoreHeaderGuardProperty(state, name) {
    const [value, priority] = state.original.get(name) || ['', ''];
    const style = state.element.style;
    if (style.getPropertyValue(name) === value && style.getPropertyPriority(name) === priority) return;
    if (value) style.setProperty(name, value, priority);
    else style.removeProperty(name);
  }
  function requestWindowBody(state) {
    if (state.bodyLayout?.container.isConnected && state.bodyLayout.content.isConnected) return state.bodyLayout;
    state.bodyLayout = null;
    const mapSuggestion = state.element.id === 'ISSUE_WINDOW_MAP_SUGGESTION' || state.element.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-popup-kind') === 'mapSuggestion';
    for (const card of state.element.querySelectorAll?.('wz-card') || []) {
      // WME nests a div container inside its review form; history has no footer.
      const containers = mapSuggestion ? card.querySelectorAll('[class*="container--"]') : card.children;
      for (const container of containers) {
        if (!container.matches('[class*="container--"]')) continue;
        const children = [...container.children];
        const content = children.find(child => child.matches('[class*="content--"]'));
        const footer = children.find(child => child.matches('[class*="footer--"]'));
        const header = children.find(child => child.matches('[class*="header--"]'));
        if (!content || !(footer || mapSuggestion && header)) continue;
        container.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-request-body','on');
        content.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-request-content','on');
        return state.bodyLayout = {card,container,content};
      }
    }
    return null;
  }
  function clearHeaderGuardCap(state) {
    state.cap = null; state.element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-request-limited');
    for (const name of ['max-height','min-height','overflow-y','--ws-request-body-max-height']) restoreHeaderGuardProperty(state,name);
  }
  function applyHeaderGuardCap(state, height, style) {
    const element = state.element, number = value => parseFloat(value) || 0;
    const insets = css => number(css.borderTopWidth) + number(css.borderBottomWidth) + number(css.paddingTop) + number(css.paddingBottom);
    const write = (name,value) => {
      const existing = element.style.getPropertyValue(name);
      if (existing && element.style.getPropertyPriority(name) === 'important' && value.endsWith('px') && existing.endsWith('px') && Math.abs(parseFloat(existing) - parseFloat(value)) < .5) return;
      if (existing !== value || element.style.getPropertyPriority(name) !== 'important') element.style.setProperty(name,value,'important');
    };
    state.cap = height;
    const zoom = element.currentCSSZoom || 1;
    write('max-height',`${Math.round(Math.max(0,height / zoom - (style.boxSizing === 'border-box' ? 0 : insets(style))) * 100) / 100}px`);
    write('min-height','0px');
    const body = requestWindowBody(state);
    if (body) {
      const handle = element.querySelector('[aria-roledescription="draggable"]');
      const cardShell = body.card.shadowRoot?.querySelector('.wz-card') || body.card;
      const shellStyle = getComputedStyle(cardShell), cardStyle = getComputedStyle(body.card);
      const reserved = (handle?.getBoundingClientRect().height || 0) + zoom * (insets(style) + insets(shellStyle) + number(shellStyle.marginTop) + number(shellStyle.marginBottom) + (cardShell === body.card ? 0 : number(cardStyle.marginTop) + number(cardStyle.marginBottom)));
      write('--ws-request-body-max-height',`${Math.max(1,Math.floor(height - reserved))}px`);
      if (element.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-request-limited') !== 'on') element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-request-limited','on');
      restoreHeaderGuardProperty(state,'overflow-y');
    } else {
      element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-request-limited');
      restoreHeaderGuardProperty(state,'--ws-request-body-max-height');
      write('overflow-y','auto');
    }
  }
  function resetHeaderGuard(state) {
    panelResizeHints.dismiss(state.element);
    if (requestHeaderDrag?.element === state.element) releaseRequestHeaderDrag(requestHeaderDrag);
    resetRequestPopupMotion(state);
    state.shift = 0; state.shiftX = 0; state.cap = null; state.appliedPopupPoint = null; state.requestPoint = null;
    state.element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-request-limited');
    if (state.element.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-flow-placed')) {
      state.element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-flow-placed');
      state.element.style.removeProperty('--ws-flow-left'); state.element.style.removeProperty('--ws-flow-top');
    }
    state.flowOrigin = null;
    for (const name of headerGuardProperties) restoreHeaderGuardProperty(state, name);
  }
  function syncHeaderGuardWindows() {
    if (sidePanelResizing()) return;
    syncSidePanelSize();
    if (compactLayoutEditing || compactLayoutEditor?.dragging?.() || floatingHeader.drag) return;
    const header = document.getElementById('app-head'), footer = document.querySelector('.wz-map-ol-footer');
    if (headerGuardHeader !== header || headerGuardFooter !== footer) {
      headerGuardHeaderObserver.disconnect();
      for (const element of [headerGuardHeader, headerGuardFooter]) if (element) headerGuardResize?.unobserve(element);
      headerGuardHeader = header; headerGuardFooter = footer;
      for (const element of [header, footer]) if (element) {
        headerGuardHeaderObserver.observe(element, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style', 'class', 'hidden'] });
        headerGuardResize?.observe(element);
      }
    }
    let geometry = null;
    observeCompactPlacement(document.querySelector('.app'));
    for (const element of [document.getElementById("drawer"),document.getElementById("sidebar"),document.getElementById("filter-panel-region"),document.getElementById("WazeMap")]) {
      if (!element) continue;
      observeCompactPlacement(element); headerGuardResize?.observe(element);
    }
    for (const [element, state] of headerGuardWindows) {
      if (!element.isConnected) {
        resetHeaderGuard(state); state.observer.disconnect(); headerGuardResize?.unobserve(element);
        headerGuardWindows.delete(element); continue;
      }
      const compact = compactLayoutActive();
      if (state.compact !== compact) {
        resetHeaderGuard(state); state.compact = compact;
      }
      if (!compact && (mapLayerWindows.has(element) || isFlowPanel(element))) {
        if (state.shift || state.shiftX || state.cap != null || state.requestPoint || element.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-request-limited') || element.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-flow-placed')) resetHeaderGuard(state);
        continue;
      }
      if (isFlowPanel(element) && !state.requestPoint && flowPanelPoint) state.requestPoint = { ...flowPanelPoint };
      if (mapLayerWindows.get(element)?.drag || requestHeaderDrag?.element === element) continue;
      const style = getComputedStyle(element);
      if (!ready || !settings.enabled || standaloneSignin || editorProfile || element.hidden ||
          element.getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true' || element.getAttribute('data-window-hidden') === 'true' ||
          element.classList.contains('hide-layer-switcher') || style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden') {
        resetHeaderGuard(state); continue;
      }
      if (state.popupMotion || state.popupClosing) continue;
      const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!rect.width || !rect.height) { resetHeaderGuard(state); continue; }
      if (isRequestPopup(element) && !state.popupVisible) queueRequestPopupOpen(state);
      const popupKind = requestPopupKind(element) || (element.matches('.layer-switcher .menu') ? 'layers' : isFlowPanel(element) ? 'panel' : null);
      if (popupKind && element.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-popup-kind') !== popupKind) element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-popup-kind',popupKind);
      if (popupKind && panelSizes[popupKind] && resizableWindow(element)) applyWindowSize(element);
      panelResizeHints.show(element, resizableWindow(element));
      const savedPoint = popupKind && compact ? compactIslandLayout?.[popupKind] : null;
      const signature = savedPoint ? `${savedPoint.anchor || 'preview'},${savedPoint.x},${savedPoint.y}` : null;
      const newOpeningPoint = savedPoint && signature !== state.appliedPopupPoint;
      if (newOpeningPoint) state.requestPoint = null;
      if (state.cap == null) state.naturalHeight = rect.height;
      const suggestionBody = popupKind === 'mapSuggestion' ? requestWindowBody(state) : null;
      // Account for content arriving after the loading shell was height-limited.
      const suggestionOverflow = suggestionBody ? Math.max(0,suggestionBody.container.scrollHeight - suggestionBody.container.clientHeight) + Math.max(0,suggestionBody.content.scrollHeight - suggestionBody.content.clientHeight) : 0;
      const desiredHeight = Math.max(rect.height + suggestionOverflow * (element.currentCSSZoom || 1),state.naturalHeight || rect.height);
      const preferredHeightLimit=popupKind==='mapSuggestion' ? panelSizes.mapSuggestion?.height || 520 : Infinity;
      const preferred = newOpeningPoint
        ? compactIslandPixels(compactIslandSpec(popupKind),savedPoint,{width:rect.width,height:desiredHeight}) : {left:state.requestPoint?.left ?? rect.left,top:state.requestPoint?.top ?? rect.top,width:rect.width,height:desiredHeight};
      if (popupKind && !state.requestPoint) state.requestPoint = {left:preferred.left,top:preferred.top};
      if (popupKind && compact && !compactLayoutEditing) {
        const occupied = compactPanelObstacles(element);
        const wanted = isFlowPanel(element) ? { ...preferred, height: Math.min(preferred.height, 620) } : {...preferred,height:Math.min(preferred.height,preferredHeightLimit)};
        const placed = (state.requestPoint && compactFitInPlace(wanted,occupied)) || compactFitPanel(wanted,occupied);
        if (placed) {
          if (popupKind==='mapSuggestion' || placed.height < desiredHeight - 1) {
            applyHeaderGuardCap(state,placed.height,style);
          } else if (state.cap != null) {
            clearHeaderGuardCap(state);
          }
          writeRequestPosition(state,rect,placed.left,placed.top);
          state.appliedPopupPoint = signature;
          continue;
        }
      }
      geometry ||= workspacePanelBounds();
      const horizontal = standardPanelHorizontalBounds(rect.width, geometry);
      const left = Math.max(horizontal.left, Math.min(preferred.left, horizontal.right));
      const limits = headerPanelLimits(left, rect.width, 12, geometry, rect);
      const anchor = state.requestPoint ? Math.max(limits.top, Math.min(preferred.top, limits.bottom - 200)) : limits.top;
      const available = Math.max(1, Math.min(Math.floor(limits.bottom - anchor), preferredHeightLimit, floatingHeader.position && state.cap != null ? state.cap : Infinity));
      const border = (parseFloat(style.borderTopWidth) || 0) + (parseFloat(style.borderBottomWidth) || 0);
      const naturalHeight = Math.max(rect.height, (element.scrollHeight + border) * (element.currentCSSZoom || 1));
      const write = (name, value) => {
        if (element.style.getPropertyValue(name) !== value || element.style.getPropertyPriority(name) !== 'important') element.style.setProperty(name, value, 'important');
      };
      const fillsCap = state.cap != null && rect.height >= state.cap - 1;
      if (naturalHeight > available + 1 || fillsCap) {
        applyHeaderGuardCap(state,available,style);
      } else {
        clearHeaderGuardCap(state);
      }
      const rawTop = rect.top - state.shift, height = Math.min(naturalHeight, available);
