      const top = Math.max(limits.top, Math.min(state.requestPoint ? preferred.top : rawTop, limits.bottom - height));
      if (state.requestPoint) {
        writeRequestPosition(state,rect,left,top);
        continue;
      }
      if (Math.abs(left - rect.left) > .01 || Math.abs(top - rawTop) > .01 || state.shiftX || state.shift) writeRequestPosition(state,rect,left,top);
      else restoreHeaderGuardProperty(state, 'translate');
    }
  }
  function queueHeaderGuardWindows() {
    if (headerGuardQueued || sidePanelResizing()) return;
    headerGuardQueued = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => { headerGuardQueued = false; syncHeaderGuardWindows(); if (streetViewWindow.active && streetViewWindow.docked) queueStreetViewWindow(); });
  }
  const headerGuardHeaderObserver = new MutationObserver(queueHeaderGuardWindows);
  const headerGuardResize = typeof ResizeObserver === 'function' ? new ResizeObserver(queueHeaderGuardWindows) : null;
  const headerGuardRootObserver = new MutationObserver(queueHeaderGuardWindows);
  headerGuardRootObserver.observe(root, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style', 'data-wme-studio', 'data-wme-studio-compact', 'data-wme-studio-page'] });
  const PANEL_SIZES_KEY = 'wmeStudio.panelSizes.v1';
  let panelSizes = {}, panelSizeTimer = 0, windowResize = null;
  function sidePanelResizing() { return windowResize?.kind === 'sidePanel'; }
  try { Promise.resolve(GM_getValue(PANEL_SIZES_KEY, {})).then(value => { if (value && typeof value === 'object') { panelSizes = value; applyPanelSizes(); } }).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("Studio initialization",studioError);}); } catch (_) { reportStudioError("Studio initialization",_);}
  function storePanelSizes() {
    clearTimeout(panelSizeTimer);
    panelSizeTimer = setTimeout(() => { try { Promise.resolve(GM_setValue(PANEL_SIZES_KEY, panelSizes)).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("storePanelSizes",studioError);}); } catch (_) { reportStudioError("storePanelSizes",_);} }, 250);
  }
  function resizableWindow(element) {
    if (element?.id === 'sidebar') return settings.enabled && !standaloneSignin && !editorProfile && !!element.closest('.app.show-sidebar:not(.sidebar-fullscreen)') ? 'sidePanel' : '';
    const kind = element?.getAttribute?.('data-wme-studio-popup-kind');
    return kind && kind !== 'layers' && kind !== 'panel' && !element.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-panel-preview') ? kind : '';
  }
  function setElementVariable(element, name, value) {
    if (value == null) { if (element.style.getPropertyValue(name)) element.style.removeProperty(name); }
    else if (element.style.getPropertyValue(name) !== value) element.style.setProperty(name, value);
  }
  function syncSidePanelSize(element = document.getElementById('sidebar')) {
    if (sidePanelResizing() && windowResize.element === element) return;
    const width = Number(panelSizes.sidePanel?.width), active = ready && settings.enabled && !standaloneSignin && !editorProfile;
    const sized = active && Number.isFinite(width) && width > 0;
    attr('side-width',sized ? 'on' : null);
    rootVariable('--ws-side-width',sized ? `${Math.max(300,Math.min(640,width))}px` : null);
    if (!element) return;
    const mode = resizableWindow(element) ? compactLayoutActive() ? 'floating' : 'docked' : null;
    if (mode) {
      if (element.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-side-resizable')!==mode) element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-side-resizable',mode);
      panelResizeHints.show(element,'sidePanel');
    } else {
      element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-side-resizable');
      panelResizeHints.dismiss(element);
      if (resizeGrip?.target===element && !windowResize) hideResizeGrip();
    }
  }
  function applyWindowSize(element) {
    if (element.id==='sidebar') { syncSidePanelSize(element);if (compactLayoutActive()) syncCompactDocks();return; }
    const size = panelSizes[resizableWindow(element)] || {}, state = headerGuardWindows.get(element);
    const flag = (node, name, on) => { if (on !== node.hasAttribute(name)) { if (on) node.setAttribute(name, 'on'); else node.removeAttribute(name); } };
    setElementVariable(element, '--ws-user-width', size.width ? `${size.width}px` : null);
    setElementVariable(element, '--ws-user-height', size.height ? `${size.height}px` : null);
    flag(element, 'data-wme-studio-user-width', !!size.width); flag(element, 'data-wme-studio-user-height', !!size.height);
    const sized = !!(size.width || size.height);
    const body = state && requestWindowBody(state);
    const card = body?.card || element.querySelector('wz-card');
    const chain = new Set();
    if (card && sized) for (let node = card.parentElement; node && node !== element; node = node.parentElement) chain.add(node);
    if (body && sized) for (let node = body.container.parentElement; node && node !== card; node = node.parentElement) chain.add(node);
    for (const node of element.querySelectorAll('[data-wme-studio-size-chain],[data-wme-studio-size-card]')) {
      if (!chain.has(node)) node.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-size-chain');
      if (node !== card || !sized) node.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-size-card');
    }
    for (const node of chain) flag(node, 'data-wme-studio-size-chain', true);
    if (card) flag(card, 'data-wme-studio-size-card', sized);
  }
  function applyChatSize(frame) {
    const size = compactLayoutActive() ? panelSizes.messages || {} : {};
    setElementVariable(frame, '--ws-chat-user-width', size.width ? `${size.width}px` : null);
    setElementVariable(frame, '--ws-chat-user-height', size.height ? `${size.height}px` : null);
  }
  function applyPanelSizes() {
    syncSidePanelSize();
    if (compactLayoutActive()) syncCompactDocks();
    for (const element of headerGuardWindows.keys()) if (resizableWindow(element)) applyWindowSize(element);
    for (const frame of chatFrames.keys()) applyChatSize(frame);
  }
  const panelResizeHints = (() => {
    const key = 'wmeStudio.panelResizeHints.v1';
    const kinds = new Set(['updateRequest', 'mapUpdateRequest', 'placeUpdateRequest', 'mapProblem', 'messages', 'sidePanel']);
    const active = new Map();
    let seen = {}, loaded = false, saving = Promise.resolve();
    function dismiss(element) {
      const hint = active.get(element);
      if (!hint) return;
      clearTimeout(hint.timer);
      element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-resize-hint');
      hint.doc?.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-resize-hint');
      active.delete(element);
    }
    function visible(element) {
      if (!ready || !settings.enabled || compactLayoutEditing || document.hidden || !element?.isConnected ||
          element.hidden || element.getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true' || element.getAttribute('data-window-hidden') === 'true' ||
          element.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-panel-preview')) return false;
      if (element.checkVisibility?.({ checkOpacity: true, checkVisibilityCSS: true }) === false) return false;
      const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
      return rect.width > 80 && rect.height > 80 && rect.right > 0 && rect.bottom > 0 && rect.left < innerWidth && rect.top < innerHeight;
    }
    function show(element, kind, doc = null) {
      if (!kinds.has(kind)) { dismiss(element); return; }
      if (!active.has(element) && (!loaded || seen[kind])) return;
      if (!visible(element)) { dismiss(element); return; }
      if (active.get(element)?.kind === kind) return;
      dismiss(element);
      if (!loaded || seen[kind]) return;
      if (doc) {
        if (doc.URL === 'about:blank' || doc.readyState === 'loading' ||
            !doc.querySelector('[data-wme-studio-chat-resize]')) return;
        if (!doc.getElementById('wme-studio-resize-hint-style')) {
          const style = doc.createElement('style'); style.id = 'wme-studio-resize-hint-style';
          style.textContent = `
            @keyframes wme-studio-resize-hint { 0%,100% { opacity:1; } 50% { opacity:.35; } }
            html[data-wme-studio-resize-hint="on"] [data-wme-studio-chat-resize] > span {
              background:var(--wme-studio-accent,#0099ff)!important; opacity:1;
              animation:wme-studio-resize-hint 1.5s ease-in-out 7;
            }
            html[data-wme-studio-resize-hint="on"] [data-wme-studio-chat-resize="bottom"] > span { width:60px!important; height:5px!important; }
            html[data-wme-studio-motion="reduced"] [data-wme-studio-chat-resize] > span { animation:none!important; }
            @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { [data-wme-studio-chat-resize] > span { animation:none!important; } }
          `;
          (doc.head || doc.documentElement).append(style);
        }
        doc.documentElement.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-resize-hint', 'on');
      }
      element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-resize-hint', 'on');
      seen[kind] = true;
      const snapshot = { ...seen };
      saving = saving.then(() => GM_setValue(key, snapshot)).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("show",studioError);});
      active.set(element, { kind, doc, timer: setTimeout(() => dismiss(element), 11000) });
    }
    // prune() runs from the clean-up that follows every removal on the page. Asking whether a panel is
    // visible there made the browser lay the whole page out again in the middle of the change (measured:
    // most of the time spent rebuilding a panel while a hint was showing). What can be answered without
    // layout is answered at once; the visibility check waits for the next frame.
    let pruneFrame = 0;
    function prune() {
      if (!active.size) return;
      for (const [element, hint] of active) if (!element.isConnected || hint.doc && element.contentDocument !== hint.doc) dismiss(element);
      if (!active.size || pruneFrame) return;
      pruneFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        pruneFrame = 0;
        for (const [element, hint] of active) if (!visible(element) || hint.doc && element.contentDocument !== hint.doc) dismiss(element);
      });
    }
    try {
      Promise.resolve(GM_getValue(key, {})).then(value => {
        if (value && typeof value === 'object') for (const kind of kinds) if (value[kind] === true) seen[kind] = true;
      }).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("panelResizeHints",studioError);}).then(() => {
        loaded = true; queueHeaderGuardWindows(); queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();
      });
    } catch (_) { reportStudioError("panelResizeHints",_); loaded = true; }
    return Object.freeze({ show, dismiss, prune });
  })();
  let resizeGrip = null;
  let resizeHoverFrame = 0, resizeHoverPoint = null;
  function queueResizeHover(event) {
    if (windowResize || event.buttons) return;
    resizeHoverPoint = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY, target: event.target };
    if (!resizeHoverFrame) resizeHoverFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      resizeHoverFrame = 0;
      const point = resizeHoverPoint; resizeHoverPoint = null;
      if (!point || windowResize || requestHeaderDrag) return;
      if (point.target?.closest?.('#wme-studio-userscript-ui,#wme-studio-minimized-requests')) { hideResizeGrip(); return; }
      const hit = windowEdgeAt(point.x, point.y);
      if (hit) showResizeGrip(hit);
      else if (resizeGrip && !resizeGrip.hidden && point.target !== resizeGrip) hideResizeGrip();
    });
  }
  function windowEdgeAt(x, y) {
    if (!settings.enabled || compactLayoutEditing || requestHeaderDrag) return null;
    for (const element of [...headerGuardWindows.keys(),document.getElementById('sidebar')].filter(Boolean)) {
      if (!resizableWindow(element) || !element.isConnected) continue;
      const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (rect.width < 80 || rect.height < 80 || x < rect.left - 7 || x > rect.right + 7 || y < rect.top || y > rect.bottom + 7) continue;
      if (element.checkVisibility && !element.checkVisibility({ checkVisibilityCSS: true, checkOpacity: true })) continue;
      const inSpan = x >= rect.left + 12 && x <= rect.right - 12, inColumn = y >= rect.top + 14 && y <= rect.bottom - 12;
      const dockedSide = element.id==='sidebar' && !compactLayoutActive();
      if (!dockedSide && inSpan && y >= rect.bottom - 6 && y <= rect.bottom + 7) return { element, edge: 'bottom', rect };
      if (inColumn && x >= rect.right - 4 && x <= rect.right + 7) return { element, edge: 'right', rect };
      if (!dockedSide && inColumn && x <= rect.left + 4 && x >= rect.left - 7) return { element, edge: 'left', rect };
    }
    return null;
  }
  function hideResizeGrip() {
    if (!resizeGrip || windowResize) return;
    resizeGrip.target?.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-resize-edge');
    resizeGrip.target = null; resizeGrip.hidden = true;
  }
  function showResizeGrip(hit) {
    if (!resizeGrip) {
      resizeGrip = document.createElement('div');
      resizeGrip.id = 'wme-studio-resize-grip'; resizeGrip.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      resizeGrip.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;z-index:2147483000;background:transparent;touch-action:none';
      resizeGrip.addEventListener('pointerdown', startWindowResize);
      resizeGrip.addEventListener('pointermove', moveWindowResize);
      resizeGrip.addEventListener('pointerup', endWindowResize);
      resizeGrip.addEventListener('pointercancel', endWindowResize);
      resizeGrip.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', endWindowResize);
      resizeGrip.addEventListener('dblclick', resetWindowSize);
      resizeGrip.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => { if (!windowResize) hideResizeGrip(); });
      root.append(resizeGrip);
    }
    const { element, edge, rect } = hit;
    if (resizeGrip.target && resizeGrip.target !== element) resizeGrip.target.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-resize-edge');
    resizeGrip.target = element; resizeGrip.edge = edge; resizeGrip.hidden = false;
    if (element.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-resize-edge') !== edge) element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-resize-edge', edge);
    const box = edge === 'bottom' ? [rect.left + 12, rect.bottom - 6, rect.width - 24, 13]
      : edge === 'right' ? [rect.right - 4, rect.top + 14, 11, rect.height - 26] : [rect.left - 7, rect.top + 14, 11, rect.height - 26];
    Object.assign(resizeGrip.style, { left: `${box[0]}px`, top: `${box[1]}px`, width: `${box[2]}px`, height: `${box[3]}px`, cursor: edge === 'bottom' ? 'ns-resize' : 'ew-resize' });
  }
  document.addEventListener('pointermove', queueResizeHover, { capture: true, passive: true });
  function startWindowResize(event) {
    const element = resizeGrip?.target, edge = resizeGrip?.edge;
    if (!element || !edge || windowResize || event.button !== 0 || event.isPrimary === false) return;
    event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    cancelAnimationFrame(resizeHoverFrame); resizeHoverFrame = 0; resizeHoverPoint = null;
    panelResizeHints.dismiss(element);
    const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect(), zoom = element.currentCSSZoom || 1, kind = resizableWindow(element);
    windowResize = { element, edge, kind, zoom, pointerId: event.pointerId, startX: event.clientX, startY: event.clientY, rect, width: rect.width / zoom, height: rect.height / zoom, frame: 0, x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
    if (kind === 'sidePanel') {
      const drag = windowResize, footer = compactVisibleRect(document.querySelector('.wz-map-ol-footer'));
      drag.floating = compactLayoutActive();
      drag.size = { ...(panelSizes.sidePanel || {}) };
      drag.bottom = footer ? footer.top - COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP : innerHeight - 12;
      drag.viewportWidth = innerWidth;
      drag.viewportHeight = innerHeight;
      drag.obstacles = drag.floating ? compactIslandSpecs.filter(spec => !spec.popup).map(queryCompactIsland).filter(node => node !== element).map(compactVisibleRect).filter(Boolean) : [];
      drag.previewRect = rect;
      // Keep resize writes on the sidebar; the map and other islands settle once on release.
      drag.originalVariables = new Map(['--ws-sidebar','--ws-dock-panel-left','--ws-dock-panel-right','--ws-dock-panel-top','--ws-dock-panel-bottom','--ws-dock-panel-css-height']
        .map(name => [name,[element.style.getPropertyValue(name),element.style.getPropertyPriority(name)]]));
    }
    try { resizeGrip.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) { reportStudioError("startWindowResize",_);}
  }
  window.addEventListener('blur', () => { if (windowResize) endWindowResize(); });
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    if (sidePanelResizing() && (innerWidth !== windowResize.viewportWidth || innerHeight !== windowResize.viewportHeight)) endWindowResize();
  });
  function moveWindowResize(event) {
    const drag = windowResize;
    if (!drag) { queueResizeHover(event); return; }
    if (event.pointerId !== drag.pointerId) return;
    event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    drag.x = event.clientX; drag.y = event.clientY;
    if (!drag.frame) drag.frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      drag.frame = 0;
      if (windowResize === drag) applyWindowResize(drag);
    });
  }
  function applyWindowResize(drag) {
    if (drag.kind === 'sidePanel') {
      const size = drag.size, zoom = drag.zoom, start = drag.rect;
      let width = drag.width, height = drag.height;
      if (drag.edge === 'bottom') {
        let bottom = drag.bottom;
        for (const other of drag.obstacles) if (start.left < other.left + other.width + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP && start.right + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP > other.left && other.top >= start.bottom - .5) bottom = Math.min(bottom,other.top - COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP);
        height = Math.max(Math.min(220,drag.height),Math.min((bottom - start.top) / zoom,drag.height + (drag.y - drag.startY) / zoom));
      }
      else {
        const delta = (drag.x - drag.startX) * (drag.edge === 'left' ? -1 : 1);
        let available = drag.floating ? drag.edge === 'left' ? start.right - 12 : drag.viewportWidth - 12 - start.left : drag.viewportWidth - 24;
        for (const other of drag.obstacles) {
          if (start.top >= other.top + other.height + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP || start.bottom + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP <= other.top) continue;
          if (drag.edge === 'left' && other.left + other.width <= start.left + .5) available = Math.min(available,start.right - other.left - other.width - COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP);
          if (drag.edge === 'right' && other.left >= start.right - .5) available = Math.min(available,other.left - COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP - start.left);
        }
        available = Math.max(start.width,available);
        width = Math.min(640,available / zoom,Math.max(300,drag.width + delta / zoom));
        size.width = Math.round(width);
      }
      if (drag.floating) size.height = Math.round(height);
      const left = drag.edge === 'left' ? start.right - width * zoom : start.left;
      setElementVariable(drag.element,'--ws-sidebar',`${width}px`);
      if (drag.floating) {
        for (const [name,value] of [['--ws-dock-panel-left',`${left}px`],['--ws-dock-panel-right','auto'],['--ws-dock-panel-top',`${start.top}px`],['--ws-dock-panel-bottom','auto'],['--ws-dock-panel-css-height',`${height}px`]]) setElementVariable(drag.element,name,value);
      }
      drag.previewRect = {left,top:start.top,width:width * zoom,height:height * zoom,right:left + width * zoom,bottom:start.top + height * zoom};
      showResizeGrip({element:drag.element,edge:drag.edge,rect:drag.previewRect});
      return;
    }
    const size = panelSizes[drag.kind] = { ...(panelSizes[drag.kind] || {}) };
    delete size.extra;
    if (drag.edge === 'bottom') size.height = Math.round(Math.max(220, Math.min((innerHeight - 24) / drag.zoom, drag.height + (drag.y - drag.startY) / drag.zoom)));
    else {
      const delta = (drag.x - drag.startX) * (drag.edge === 'left' ? -1 : 1);
      size.width = Math.round(Math.min(640,Math.max(300, drag.width + delta / drag.zoom)));
      if (drag.edge === 'left') {
        const guard = headerGuardWindows.get(drag.element);
        if (guard) guard.requestPoint = { left: drag.rect.right - size.width * drag.zoom, top: drag.rect.top };
      }
    }
    applyWindowSize(drag.element); queueHeaderGuardWindows();
    const rect = drag.element.getBoundingClientRect();
    showResizeGrip({ element: drag.element, edge: drag.edge, rect });
  }
  function endWindowResize(event) {
    const drag = windowResize;
    if (!drag || (event && event.pointerId !== drag.pointerId)) return;
    if (drag.frame || event?.type === 'pointerup') {
      cancelAnimationFrame(drag.frame); drag.frame = 0;
      if (event?.type === 'pointerup') { drag.x = event.clientX; drag.y = event.clientY; }
      applyWindowResize(drag);
    }
    windowResize = null;
    if (drag.kind === 'sidePanel') {
      panelSizes.sidePanel = drag.size;
      if (drag.floating && drag.element.isConnected && drag.element.closest('.app.show-sidebar:not(.sidebar-fullscreen)')) {
        const rect = drag.previewRect;
        // Update the anchor before removing the preview so there is no snap back on release.
        void storeCompactIslandLayout({...compactIslandLayout,sidePanel:{x:rect.left/innerWidth,y:rect.top/innerHeight,anchor:'viewport'}}).catch((studioError)=>{ reportStudioError("endWindowResize",studioError);});
      }
      for (const [name,[value,priority]] of drag.originalVariables) {
        if (value) drag.element.style.setProperty(name,value,priority); else drag.element.style.removeProperty(name);
      }
      applyWindowSize(drag.element);
      scheduleLaneSizing(); queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement(); resizeMap(true);
    }
    try { if (resizeGrip.hasPointerCapture(drag.pointerId)) resizeGrip.releasePointerCapture(drag.pointerId); } catch (_) { reportStudioError("endWindowResize",_);}
    storePanelSizes(); queueHeaderGuardWindows();
    const hit = event ? windowEdgeAt(event.clientX, event.clientY) : null;
    if (hit) showResizeGrip(hit); else hideResizeGrip();
  }
  function resetWindowSize(event) {
    const element = resizeGrip?.target, kind = element && resizableWindow(element);
    if (!kind || !panelSizes[kind]) return;
    event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    delete panelSizes[kind]; applyWindowSize(element); storePanelSizes(); queueHeaderGuardWindows(); hideResizeGrip();
  }
  globalThis.WMEStudioPanelSizes = Object.freeze({
    reset() {
      panelSizes = {};
      applyPanelSizes(); storePanelSizes(); queueHeaderGuardWindows();
      for (const frame of chatFrames.keys()) { const state = chatPanelStates.get(frame); if (state) { state.collisionNaturalHeight = 0; applyChatPanelPosition(state, state.offset, true); } }
    }
  });
  const chatResizeDocs = new WeakMap();
  function bindChatResize(frame, doc) {
    applyChatSize(frame);
    for (const grip of doc.querySelectorAll('[data-wme-studio-chat-resize]')) { grip.hidden = false; grip.style.display = 'flex'; }
    for (const edge of ['bottom', 'left', 'right']) {
      if (doc.querySelector(`[data-wme-studio-chat-resize="${edge}"]`)) continue;
      const grip = doc.createElement('div'), pill = doc.createElement('span');
      grip.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-chat-resize', edge); grip.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      grip.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;z-index:2147483646;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;touch-action:none;color:var(--wme-studio-text-muted,#99a4ae);' +
        (edge === 'bottom' ? 'left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:9px;cursor:ns-resize' : `top:56px;bottom:9px;${edge}:0;width:6px;cursor:ew-resize`);
      pill.style.cssText = 'display:block;border-radius:2px;background:currentColor;opacity:.55;pointer-events:none;' + (edge === 'bottom' ? 'width:38px;height:4px' : 'width:3px;height:38px');
      grip.addEventListener('pointerenter', () => { pill.style.opacity = '1'; pill.style.background = 'var(--wme-studio-accent,#0099ff)'; });
      grip.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => { pill.style.opacity = '.55'; pill.style.background = 'currentColor'; });
      grip.append(pill); (doc.body || doc.documentElement).append(grip);
    }
    panelResizeHints.show(frame, 'messages', doc);
    if (chatResizeDocs.has(doc)) return;
    let drag = null;
    const originalCursor = [doc.documentElement.style.getPropertyValue('cursor'),doc.documentElement.style.getPropertyPriority('cursor')];
    const cancel = () => {
      const pointerId = drag?.pointerId; drag = null;
      if (pointerId != null) try { doc.documentElement.releasePointerCapture(pointerId); } catch (_) { reportStudioError("cancel",_);}
      if (originalCursor[0]) doc.documentElement.style.setProperty('cursor',...originalCursor); else doc.documentElement.style.removeProperty('cursor');
    };
    chatResizeDocs.set(doc,{cancel});
    const edgeAt = event => {
      const width = doc.documentElement.clientWidth, height = doc.documentElement.clientHeight;
      if (!frame.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-chat-panel')) return '';
      if (height - event.clientY <= 7) return 'bottom';
      if (event.clientX <= 5) return 'left';
      if (width - event.clientX <= 5) return 'right';
      return '';
    };
    const point = event => { const rect = frame.getBoundingClientRect(), zoom = frame.currentCSSZoom || 1; return { x: rect.left + event.clientX * zoom, y: rect.top + event.clientY * zoom, rect, zoom }; };
    doc.addEventListener('pointermove', event => {
      if (!frame.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-chat-panel') || !compactLayoutActive()) return;
      if (!drag) { const edge = edgeAt(event), cursor = edge === 'bottom' ? 'ns-resize' : edge ? 'ew-resize' : ''; if (doc.documentElement.style.cursor !== cursor) doc.documentElement.style.cursor = cursor; return; }
      if (event.pointerId !== drag.pointerId) return;
      event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      const now = point(event), size = panelSizes.messages = { ...(panelSizes.messages || {}) };
      if (drag.edge === 'bottom') size.height = Math.round(Math.max(280, Math.min(innerHeight - 24, now.y - drag.rect.top + drag.grab)) / now.zoom);
      else size.width = Math.round(Math.max(300, Math.min(600, drag.edge === 'right' ? now.x - drag.rect.left + drag.grab : drag.rect.right - now.x + drag.grab)) / now.zoom);
      applyChatSize(frame);
      const state = chatPanelStates.get(frame), after = frame.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (state) {
        state.collisionNaturalHeight = 0;
        const dx = drag.edge === 'left' ? drag.rect.right - after.right : drag.rect.left - after.left, dy = drag.rect.top - after.top;
        if (Math.abs(dx) > .5 || Math.abs(dy) > .5) applyChatPanelPosition(state, { x: state.offset.x + dx, y: state.offset.y + dy }, false);
      }
    }, true);
    doc.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
      const edge = event.button === 0 && event.isPrimary !== false ? edgeAt(event) : '';
      if (!edge || drag) return;
      panelResizeHints.dismiss(frame);
      event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      const now = point(event);
      drag = { edge, pointerId: event.pointerId, rect: now.rect, grab: edge === 'bottom' ? now.rect.bottom - now.y : edge === 'right' ? now.rect.right - now.x : now.x - now.rect.left };
      try { doc.documentElement.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) { reportStudioError("bindChatResize",_);}
    }, true);
    const finish = event => {
      if (!drag || event.pointerId !== drag.pointerId) return;
      try { doc.documentElement.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) { reportStudioError("finish",_);}
      drag = null; storePanelSizes();
      const state = chatPanelStates.get(frame);
      if (state) { applyChatPanelPosition(state, state.offset, true); storeChatPanelPosition(state.offset); }
    };
    doc.addEventListener('pointerup', finish, true); doc.addEventListener('pointercancel', finish, true);
    doc.addEventListener('dblclick', event => {
      if (!edgeAt(event) || !panelSizes.messages) return;
      event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      delete panelSizes.messages; applyChatSize(frame); storePanelSizes();
      const state = chatPanelStates.get(frame); if (state) { state.collisionNaturalHeight = 0; applyChatPanelPosition(state, state.offset, true); }
    }, true);
  }
  function trackHeaderGuardWindow(element) {
    if (!element || headerGuardWindows.has(element)) return;
    const state = { element, shift: 0, shiftX: 0, appliedPopupPoint: null, cap: null, compact: null, original: new Map(headerGuardProperties.map(name =>
      [name, [element.style.getPropertyValue(name), element.style.getPropertyPriority(name)]])), observer: null };
    state.observer = new MutationObserver(records => {
      if (records.every(record => record.type === 'attributes' && record.attributeName === 'style')) {
        if (mapLayerWindows.get(element)?.drag) return;
        if (requestHeaderDrag?.element === element) return;
      }
      queueHeaderGuardWindows();
    });
    state.observer.observe(element, { childList: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style', 'class', 'hidden', 'aria-hidden', 'data-window-hidden'] });
    headerGuardWindows.set(element, state); headerGuardResize?.observe(element);
    const kind = requestPopupKind(element);
    if (kind) element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-popup-kind',kind);
    queueHeaderGuardWindows();
  }
  function trackRequestHeaderGuard(panel) {
    const nativeWindow = panel.closest('[data-issues-tracker-window],[id^="ISSUE_WINDOW"],[data-testid="floating-window"]');
    if (nativeWindow) trackHeaderGuardWindow(nativeWindow);
    else if (panel.previousElementSibling?.matches('[aria-roledescription="draggable"]')) trackHeaderGuardWindow(panel.parentElement);
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', queueHeaderGuardWindows, { passive: true });
  let requestHeaderDrag = null;
  function queueRequestHeaderDrag() {
    const drag = requestHeaderDrag;
    if (drag && !drag.frame) drag.frame = requestAnimationFrame(renderRequestHeaderDrag);
  }
  function releaseRequestHeaderDrag(drag) {
    if (requestHeaderDrag !== drag) return;
    cancelAnimationFrame(drag.frame); drag.frame = 0;
    if (drag.active) drag.state.requestPoint = {...drag.previous};
    if (drag.active && isFlowPanel(drag.element)) flowPanelPoint = {...drag.previous};
    if (drag.active && !drag.cancelled && compactLayoutActive()) {
      const kind=requestPopupKind(drag.element);
      if (compactIslandSpec(kind)?.popup) {
        const point={x:Math.min(1,Math.max(0,drag.previous.left/innerWidth)),y:Math.min(1,Math.max(0,drag.previous.top/innerHeight)),anchor:'viewport'};
        compactIslandLayout={...compactIslandLayout,[kind]:point};
        try { Promise.resolve(GM_setValue(COMPACT_LAYOUT_KEY,compactIslandLayout)).catch((studioError)=>{ reportStudioError("releaseRequestHeaderDrag",studioError);}); } catch (_) { reportStudioError("releaseRequestHeaderDrag",_);}
      }
    }
    requestHeaderDrag = null;
    drag.unlockSize?.();
    drag.element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-panel-dragging');
    drag.handle.removeEventListener('lostpointercapture',finishRequestHeaderDrag);
    try { if (drag.handle.hasPointerCapture?.(drag.pointerId)) drag.handle.releasePointerCapture(drag.pointerId); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("releaseRequestHeaderDrag",studioError);}
    queueHeaderGuardWindows(); queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();
  }
  function renderRequestHeaderDrag() {
    const drag = requestHeaderDrag;
    if (!drag) return;
    drag.frame = 0;
    if (!drag.element.isConnected || !settings.enabled) { releaseRequestHeaderDrag(drag); return; }
    if (!drag.active && Math.hypot(drag.clientX - drag.startX,drag.clientY - drag.startY) > 5) drag.active = true;
    if (drag.active) {
      const rect = {...drag.rect,left:drag.baseLeft + drag.state.shiftX,top:drag.baseTop + drag.state.shift};
      const {width,height} = drag.rect;
      const horizontal = standardPanelHorizontalBounds(width, drag.geometry);
      const left = Math.max(horizontal.left,Math.min(drag.left + drag.clientX - drag.startX,horizontal.right));
      const limits = headerPanelLimits(left,width,12,drag.geometry,{...drag.previous,height});
      const top = Math.max(limits.top,Math.min(drag.top + drag.clientY - drag.startY,limits.bottom - height));
      const previous = {...drag.previous,width,height};
      const viewport = {width:drag.geometry.width,height:limits.bottom + 12};
      const origin = compactRectClear(previous,drag.obstacles) ? previous : compactFreePosition(previous,drag.obstacles,viewport);
      const placed = origin && compactSlidePosition({left,top,width,height},origin,drag.obstacles,viewport);
      if (placed) {
        writeRequestPosition(drag.state,rect,placed.left,placed.top);
        drag.previous = {left:placed.left,top:placed.top};
      }
    }
    if (drag.finishing) releaseRequestHeaderDrag(drag);
  }
  function startRequestHeaderDrag(event) {
    if (!ready || !settings.enabled || compactLayoutEditing || event.button !== 0 || event.isPrimary === false) return;
    const path = event.composedPath();
    let handle = path.find(node => node?.matches?.('[aria-roledescription="draggable"]'));
    let element = handle?.parentElement;
    if (!handle && compactLayoutActive()) {
      const panel = path.find(isFlowPanel);
      if (panel && flowPanelGrip(panel, event, path)) { handle = panel; element = panel; }
    }
    if (!handle || path.some(node => node !== handle && node?.matches?.('button,a,input,select,textarea,wz-button,[contenteditable="true"]'))) return;
    const state = headerGuardWindows.get(element);
    if (!state || !isFlowPanel(element) && !element.matches(REQUEST_WINDOW_SELECTOR) && !element.querySelector('.problem-edit,.place-update-edit')) return;
    event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    if (requestHeaderDrag) {
      if (!requestHeaderDrag.finishing) return;
      cancelAnimationFrame(requestHeaderDrag.frame); renderRequestHeaderDrag();
    }
    cancelAnimationFrame(state.popupFrame); state.popupFrame = 0;
    element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-popup-enter');
    state.popupMotion?.cancel(); state.popupMotion = null;
    if (state.popupClosing) return;
    const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect(), geometry = workspacePanelBounds();
    const obstacles = compactLayoutActive() ? compactPanelObstacles(element) : [
      geometry.header && {left:geometry.header.left,top:geometry.header.top,width:geometry.header.right - geometry.header.left,height:geometry.header.bottom - geometry.header.top},
      geometry.footer
    ].filter(Boolean);
    requestHeaderDrag = {element,state,handle,rect:{left:rect.left,top:rect.top,width:rect.width,height:rect.height},
      baseLeft:rect.left - state.shiftX,baseTop:rect.top - state.shift,unlockSize:lockPanelDragSize(element,rect),
      pointerId:event.pointerId,startX:event.clientX,startY:event.clientY,
      clientX:event.clientX,clientY:event.clientY,left:rect.left,top:rect.top,geometry,obstacles,
      previous:{left:rect.left,top:rect.top},active:false,finishing:false,frame:0};
    element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-panel-dragging','on');
    handle.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',finishRequestHeaderDrag);
    try { handle.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("startRequestHeaderDrag",studioError);}
  }
  function moveRequestHeaderDrag(event) {
    const drag = requestHeaderDrag;
    if (!drag || drag.finishing || event.pointerId !== drag.pointerId) return;
    event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    drag.clientX = event.clientX; drag.clientY = event.clientY;
    queueRequestHeaderDrag();
  }
  function finishRequestHeaderDrag(event) {
    const drag = requestHeaderDrag;
    if (!drag || (event?.pointerId != null && event.pointerId !== drag.pointerId)) return;
    if (event?.type?.startsWith('pointer')) { event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation(); }
    if (event?.type === 'pointerup') { drag.clientX=event.clientX; drag.clientY=event.clientY; }
    if (event?.type === 'pointercancel' || event?.key === 'Escape') {
      drag.cancelled = true;
      drag.clientX=drag.startX; drag.clientY=drag.startY;
    }
    drag.finishing = true; cancelAnimationFrame(drag.frame); renderRequestHeaderDrag();
  }
  window.addEventListener('pointerdown',startRequestHeaderDrag,true);
  window.addEventListener('pointermove',moveRequestHeaderDrag,true);
  window.addEventListener('pointerup',finishRequestHeaderDrag,true);
  window.addEventListener('pointercancel',finishRequestHeaderDrag,true);
  window.addEventListener('blur',finishRequestHeaderDrag);
  window.addEventListener('keydown',event => { if (event.key === 'Escape') finishRequestHeaderDrag(event); },true);

  const mapLayerViewport = matchMedia(globalThis.WMEStudioSafari.viewport);
  const floatingHeader = { header: null, handle: null, locationLabel: null, locationSource: null,
    locationObserver: null, locationResize: null, locationLayoutObserver: null, locationLayoutHeader: null,
    locationResizeTargets: new Set(), locationLayoutFrame: 0, locationBottom: 0,
    originalTitle: null, position: null, drag: null, frame: 0, suppressUntil: 0, active: false, refreshTimer: 0 };
  const rightClickHeaderSlots = new Map();
  let rightClickHeaderQueued = false;
  function queueRightClickHeaderLaunchers() {
    if (rightClickHeaderQueued) return;
    rightClickHeaderQueued = true;
    queueMicrotask(() => { rightClickHeaderQueued = false; syncRightClickHeaderLaunchers(); });
  }
  function syncRightClickHeaderLaunchers() {
    if (!ready) return;
    const header = document.getElementById('app-head');
    const toolbar = header?.querySelector('.secondary-toolbar');
    for (const [slot, state] of rightClickHeaderSlots) {
      if (!slot.isConnected) { rightClickHeaderSlots.delete(slot); continue; }
      if (!settings.enabled || !settings.addons) {
        if (state.moved && slot.parentElement === state.toolbar && state.parent?.isConnected) {
          state.parent.insertBefore(slot, state.next?.parentNode === state.parent ? state.next : null);
        }
        state.moved = false; state.toolbar = null;
        continue;
      }
      if (!toolbar || slot.parentElement === toolbar) continue;
      if (!state.moved) { state.parent = slot.parentNode; state.next = slot.nextSibling; }
      state.moved = true; state.toolbar = toolbar;
      toolbar.insertBefore(slot, toolbar.querySelector(':scope > .secondary-toolbar-actions'));
    }
  }
  function trackRightClickHeaderSlot(slot) {
    if (!rightClickHeaderSlots.has(slot)) rightClickHeaderSlots.set(slot, {moved: false, parent: null, next: null, toolbar: null});
    queueRightClickHeaderLaunchers();
  }
  function compactHeaderActive() {
    return ready && settings.enabled && settings.compactMode && mapLayerViewport.matches &&
      !standaloneSignin && !editorProfile && floatingHeader.header?.isConnected &&
      !floatingHeader.header.closest('.sidebar-fullscreen');
  }
  function canMoveHeader() {
    return compactHeaderActive() && !compactLayoutEditing;
  }
  function finishHeaderDrag() {
    const drag = floatingHeader.drag;
    floatingHeader.drag = null;
    cancelAnimationFrame(floatingHeader.frame); floatingHeader.frame = 0;
    if (drag?.compositor && floatingHeader.header) {
      const style = floatingHeader.header.style;
      if (drag.translated && floatingHeader.position) writeHeaderPosition(drag.width);
      style.removeProperty('translate');
      const [value, priority] = drag.originalTransition;
      if (value) style.setProperty('transition', value, priority); else style.removeProperty('transition');
    }
    floatingHeader.header?.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-header-dragging');
    window.removeEventListener('pointermove', moveHeader, true);
    window.removeEventListener('pointerup', endHeaderDrag, true);
    window.removeEventListener('pointercancel', endHeaderDrag, true);
    queueHeaderGuardWindows(); queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();
    if (drag && floatingHeader.handle?.hasPointerCapture?.(drag.pointerId)) {
      try { floatingHeader.handle.releasePointerCapture(drag.pointerId); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("finishHeaderDrag",studioError);}
    }
  }
  function resetHeaderPosition() {
    finishHeaderDrag();
    const moved = !!floatingHeader.position;
    floatingHeader.position = null;
    floatingHeader.header?.style.removeProperty('--ws-header-center');
    floatingHeader.header?.style.removeProperty('--ws-header-top');
    queueHeaderLocationLayout();
    if (moved && compactLayoutActive()) syncCompactDocks();
  }
  function writeHeaderPosition(width) {
    const { header, position } = floatingHeader;
    header.style.setProperty('--ws-header-center', `${position.x + width / 2}px`);
    header.style.setProperty('--ws-header-top', `${position.y}px`);
  }
  function positionHeader(x, y, bounds) {
    const gap = 12;
    const horizontalInset = compactHeaderHorizontalInset(bounds.width);
    const left = compactHeaderSpansViewport(bounds.width) ? (innerWidth - bounds.width) / 2 : Math.round(Math.max(horizontalInset, Math.min(x, innerWidth - bounds.width - horizontalInset)));
    const geometry = bounds.geometry || workspacePanelBounds();
    const bottom = Math.min(geometry.height - gap, geometry.footer ? geometry.footer.top - COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP : geometry.height - gap);
    const top = Math.round(Math.max(gap, Math.min(y, bottom - bounds.height)));
    const previous = floatingHeader.position ? {left:floatingHeader.position.x,top:floatingHeader.position.y} : {left:bounds.left ?? left,top:bounds.top ?? top};
    const placed = compactHeaderPlacement({left,top,width:bounds.width,height:bounds.height}, previous, bounds.obstacles || compactHeaderObstacles(), {width:geometry.width,height:bottom + gap});
    if (!placed) return;
    floatingHeader.position = { x: placed.left, y: placed.top };
    const drag = floatingHeader.drag;
    if (drag && bounds === drag && drag.compositor) {
      const hudZoom = (settings.hudScale || 100) / 100;
      const translate = `${(placed.left - drag.left) / hudZoom}px ${(placed.top - drag.top) / hudZoom}px`;
      if (floatingHeader.header.style.getPropertyValue('translate') !== translate) floatingHeader.header.style.setProperty('translate', translate, 'important');
      drag.translated = true;
    } else writeHeaderPosition(bounds.width);
    placeHeaderLocationPill(placed, bottom);
    queueProfileMenus(); queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();
  }
  function placeHeaderLocationPill(rect, bottom = floatingHeader.locationBottom || innerHeight - 12) {
    const label = floatingHeader.locationLabel;
    if (!label?.dataset.placement || label.dataset.placement === 'inline') return;
    const placement = rect.top + rect.height + 8 + 32 <= bottom ? 'below' : 'above';
    if (label.dataset.placement !== placement) label.dataset.placement = placement;
  }
  function headerLocationSnapshot(header) {
    const controls = new Set(), trees = [header], visited = new Set();
    for (let index = 0; index < trees.length; index++) {
      const tree = trees[index];
      if (visited.has(tree)) continue;
      visited.add(tree);
      for (const element of tree.querySelectorAll('*')) {
        if (floatingHeader.locationLabel?.contains(element) || element.matches('script,style,link,meta,template')) continue;
        if (element.shadowRoot) trees.push(element.shadowRoot);
        if (element.matches('button,wz-button,input,select,textarea,a[href],[role="button"],#search-autocomplete,img,svg') ||
            !element.childElementCount && element.textContent?.trim()) controls.add(element);
      }
    }
    return {controls,trees};
  }
  function headerLocationFits(rect, width, controls) {
    const left = rect.left + (rect.width - width) / 2, top = rect.top + (rect.height - 20) / 2;
    const candidate = {left,top,width,height:20};
    return controls.every(other => candidate.left + candidate.width + 8 <= other.left ||
      other.left + other.width + 8 <= candidate.left || candidate.top + candidate.height + 4 <= other.top ||
      other.top + other.height + 4 <= candidate.top);
  }
  function layoutHeaderLocation() {
    if (!compactHeaderActive()) return;
    const label = floatingHeader.locationLabel, text = label?.firstElementChild;
    if (!label?.isConnected || !text) return;
    const header = floatingHeader.header.getBoundingClientRect();
    const naturalWidth = Math.ceil(text.getBoundingClientRect().width + 16);
    const width = Math.min(naturalWidth, header.width * .3, 260);
    const controls = [];
    for (const element of floatingHeader.locationControls || []) {
      if (!element.isConnected || element.hidden || element.getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true' ||
          element.checkVisibility?.({checkOpacity:true,checkVisibilityCSS:true}) === false) continue;
      const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0) controls.push({left:rect.left,top:rect.top,width:rect.width,height:rect.height});
    }
    const overlaps = naturalWidth > width + 1 || !headerLocationFits(header,width,controls);
    const footer = compactVisibleRect(document.querySelector('.wz-map-ol-footer'));
    floatingHeader.locationBottom = footer ? Math.min(innerHeight - 12, footer.top - COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP) : innerHeight - 12;
    const placement = overlaps ? header.bottom + 8 + 32 <= floatingHeader.locationBottom ? 'below' : 'above' : 'inline';
    if (label.dataset.placement !== placement) label.dataset.placement = placement;
  }
  function queueHeaderLocationLayout() {
    if (!floatingHeader.locationLayoutFrame) floatingHeader.locationLayoutFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      floatingHeader.locationLayoutFrame = 0; layoutHeaderLocation();
    });
  }
  function watchHeaderLocationLayout() {
    const header = compactHeaderActive() && floatingHeader.locationLabel ? floatingHeader.header : null;
    if (header !== floatingHeader.locationLayoutHeader) {
      floatingHeader.locationResize?.disconnect();
      floatingHeader.locationResizeTargets.clear();
      floatingHeader.locationLayoutObserver?.disconnect();
      floatingHeader.locationLayoutObserver = null;
      floatingHeader.locationLayoutHeader = header;
      floatingHeader.locationControls = new Set();
      cancelAnimationFrame(floatingHeader.locationLayoutFrame); floatingHeader.locationLayoutFrame = 0;
      if (header) {
        floatingHeader.locationResize ||= typeof ResizeObserver === 'function' ? new ResizeObserver(queueHeaderLocationLayout) : null;
        floatingHeader.locationLayoutObserver = new MutationObserver(records => {
          if (records.some(record => !floatingHeader.locationLabel?.contains(record.target) &&
              !(record.target === header && record.type === 'attributes' && record.attributeName === 'style'))) {
            watchHeaderLocationLayout(); queueHeaderLocationLayout();
          }
        });
        floatingHeader.locationLayoutObserver.observe(header, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true,
          attributeFilter: ['class','style','hidden','slot'] });
      }
    }
    if (!header) return;
    const snapshot = headerLocationSnapshot(header);
    floatingHeader.locationControls = snapshot.controls;
    floatingHeader.locationLayoutObserver?.disconnect();
    for (const tree of snapshot.trees) floatingHeader.locationLayoutObserver?.observe(tree,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class','style','hidden','slot','aria-hidden']});
    const targets = new Set([header, floatingHeader.locationLabel.firstElementChild,...snapshot.controls].filter(Boolean));
    for (const element of floatingHeader.locationResizeTargets) if (!targets.has(element)) floatingHeader.locationResize?.unobserve(element);
    for (const element of targets) if (!floatingHeader.locationResizeTargets.has(element)) floatingHeader.locationResize?.observe(element);
    floatingHeader.locationResizeTargets = targets;
    queueHeaderLocationLayout();
  }
  function updateHeaderLocation() {
    const text = (floatingHeader.locationSource?.querySelector('.location-info')?.textContent || '')
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (!compactHeaderActive() || !text) {
      floatingHeader.locationLabel?.remove();
      floatingHeader.locationLabel = null;
      watchHeaderLocationLayout();
      return;
    }
    let label = floatingHeader.locationLabel;
    if (!label?.isConnected || label.parentElement !== floatingHeader.header) {
      label?.remove();
      label = document.createElement('div');
      label.className = 'wme-studio-header-location';
      label.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      label.append(document.createElement('span'));
      floatingHeader.header.append(label);
      floatingHeader.locationLabel = label;
    }
    if (label.firstElementChild.textContent !== text) label.firstElementChild.textContent = text;
    watchHeaderLocationLayout();
  }
  function watchHeaderLocation() {
    const source = document.getElementById('topbar-container');
    if (source !== floatingHeader.locationSource) {
      floatingHeader.locationObserver?.disconnect();
      floatingHeader.locationSource = source;
      floatingHeader.locationObserver = source ? new MutationObserver(updateHeaderLocation) : null;
      floatingHeader.locationObserver?.observe(source, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true });
    }
    updateHeaderLocation();
  }
  function syncFloatingHeader(constrain = false) {
    const header = document.getElementById('app-head');
    const handle = document.getElementById('product-icon');
    if (header !== floatingHeader.header || handle !== floatingHeader.handle) {
      resetHeaderPosition();
      floatingHeader.locationLabel?.remove();
      floatingHeader.locationLabel = null;
      if (floatingHeader.handle) {
        if (floatingHeader.originalTitle == null) floatingHeader.handle.removeAttribute('title');
        else floatingHeader.handle.setAttribute('title', floatingHeader.originalTitle);
      }
      floatingHeader.header = header;
      floatingHeader.handle = handle;
      floatingHeader.originalTitle = handle?.getAttribute('title') ?? null;
      floatingHeader.suppressUntil = 0;
    }
    floatingHeader.active = compactHeaderActive();
    if (!floatingHeader.active) {
      resetHeaderPosition();
      if (handle) {
        if (floatingHeader.originalTitle == null) handle.removeAttribute('title');
        else handle.setAttribute('title', floatingHeader.originalTitle);
      }
      watchHeaderLocation();
      return;
    }
    const headerTip = globalThis.WMEStudioI18n.t('Drag to move header · Click to reset position');
    if (handle && handle.getAttribute('title') !== headerTip) handle.setAttribute('title', headerTip);
    if (constrain && floatingHeader.position) {
      if (floatingHeader.drag) finishHeaderDrag();
      const bounds = header.getBoundingClientRect();
      positionHeader(bounds.left, floatingHeader.position.y, bounds);
      if (floatingHeader.drag) Object.assign(floatingHeader.drag, { width: bounds.width, height: bounds.height });
    }
    watchHeaderLocation();
  }
  function refreshFloatingHeader() {
    const stale = document.getElementById('app-head') !== floatingHeader.header ||
      document.getElementById('product-icon') !== floatingHeader.handle ||
      document.getElementById('topbar-container') !== floatingHeader.locationSource ||
      (floatingHeader.locationLabel && !floatingHeader.locationLabel.isConnected) ||
      compactHeaderActive() !== floatingHeader.active;
    if (stale) {
      clearTimeout(floatingHeader.refreshTimer); floatingHeader.refreshTimer = 0;
      syncFloatingHeader(); return;
    }
    if (!floatingHeader.refreshTimer) floatingHeader.refreshTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      floatingHeader.refreshTimer = 0; syncFloatingHeader();
    }, 250);
  }
  function isHeaderHandle(event) {
    return event.composedPath().some(node => node?.id === 'product-icon') && canMoveHeader();
  }
  function moveHeader(event) {
    const drag = floatingHeader.drag;
    if (!drag || event.pointerId !== drag.pointerId) return;
    event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    const dx = event.clientX - drag.startX, dy = event.clientY - drag.startY;
    if (!drag.moved && Math.hypot(dx, dy) < 4) return;
    drag.moved = true; drag.clientX = event.clientX; drag.clientY = event.clientY;
    if (!floatingHeader.frame) floatingHeader.frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      floatingHeader.frame = 0;
      if (floatingHeader.drag === drag) positionHeader(drag.left + drag.clientX - drag.startX,drag.top + drag.clientY - drag.startY,drag);
    });
  }
  function endHeaderDrag(event) {
    const drag = floatingHeader.drag;
    if (!drag || event.pointerId !== drag.pointerId) return;
    event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    if (drag.moved && event.type === 'pointerup') positionHeader(drag.left + event.clientX - drag.startX,drag.top + event.clientY - drag.startY,drag);
    const reset = event.type === 'pointerup' && !drag.moved;
    floatingHeader.suppressUntil = performance.now() + 500;
    finishHeaderDrag();
    if (reset) resetHeaderPosition();
    else if (compactLayoutActive()) syncCompactDocks();
  }
  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
    if (!isHeaderHandle(event) || event.button !== 0 || event.isPrimary === false || floatingHeader.drag) return;
    const rect = floatingHeader.header.getBoundingClientRect();
    const headerStyle = floatingHeader.header.style;
    floatingHeader.drag = { pointerId: event.pointerId, startX: event.clientX, startY: event.clientY,
      left: rect.left, top: rect.top, width: rect.width, height: rect.height, moved: false,
      geometry: workspacePanelBounds(), obstacles: compactHeaderObstacles(),
      compositor: getComputedStyle(floatingHeader.header).translate === 'none', translated: false,
      originalTransition: [headerStyle.getPropertyValue('transition'), headerStyle.getPropertyPriority('transition')] };
    if (floatingHeader.drag.compositor) headerStyle.setProperty('transition', 'none', 'important');
    floatingHeader.header.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-header-dragging', 'on');
    event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    try { floatingHeader.handle?.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("Studio initialization",studioError);}
    window.addEventListener('pointermove', moveHeader, true);
    window.addEventListener('pointerup', endHeaderDrag, true);
    window.addEventListener('pointercancel', endHeaderDrag, true);
  }, true);
  window.addEventListener('click', event => {
    if (!isHeaderHandle(event)) return;
    event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    if (event.detail === 0 || performance.now() > floatingHeader.suppressUntil) resetHeaderPosition();
  }, true);
  window.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', event => {
    if (floatingHeader.drag?.pointerId === event.pointerId) {
      floatingHeader.suppressUntil = performance.now() + 500;
      finishHeaderDrag();
    }
  }, true);
  mapLayerViewport.addEventListener('change', () => syncFloatingHeader(true));
  window.addEventListener('blur', finishHeaderDrag);
  const mapLayerWindows = new Map();
  // Beta uses CSS-module class names. Alias only its stable test-id roots, never hashed suffixes.
  const betaMapLayers = (() => {
    const menus = new Set(), aliases = new Map();
    function alias(element,name) {
      if (!element || element.classList.contains(name)) return;
      if (!aliases.has(element)) aliases.set(element,new Set());
      aliases.get(element).add(name); element.classList.add(name);
    }
    function sync(menu) {
      if (!menu?.isConnected || !ready || !settings.enabled) return;
      const wrapper = menu.closest('[data-testid="layer-switcher"]');
      if (!wrapper) return;
      alias(wrapper,'layer-switcher'); alias(menu,'menu');
      if (menu.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-beta-layers') !== 'on') menu.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-beta-layers','on');
      for (const child of menu.children) {
        if ([...child.classList].some(name => name.startsWith('title--'))) alias(child,'title');
        if ([...child.classList].some(name => name.startsWith('scrollable--'))) alias(child,'scrollable');
      }
      for (const list of menu.querySelectorAll('ul[class*="togglers--"]')) alias(list,'togglers');
      const hidden = [...menu.classList].some(name => /^(?:hideLayerSwitcher|hide-layer-switcher|hidden)--/.test(name));
      const added = aliases.get(menu);
      if (hidden) alias(menu,'hide-layer-switcher');
      else if (added?.has('hide-layer-switcher')) { menu.classList.remove('hide-layer-switcher'); added.delete('hide-layer-switcher'); }
      trackMapLayerWindow(menu);
    }
    function inspect(node) {
      let menu = node.closest('[data-testid="layer-switcher-menu"]');
      if (!menu && node.getAttribute('data-testid') === 'layer-switcher') menu = node.querySelector('[data-testid="layer-switcher-menu"]');
      if (!menu) return;
      menus.add(menu); sync(menu);
    }
    function refresh() {
      if (!settings.enabled) {
        for (const [element,names] of aliases) for (const name of names) element.classList.remove(name);
        aliases.clear(); for (const menu of menus) menu.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-beta-layers'); return;
      }
      for (const menu of menus) { if (menu.isConnected) sync(menu); else menus.delete(menu); }
    }
    function prune() {
      for (const menu of menus) if (!menu.isConnected) menus.delete(menu);
      for (const element of aliases.keys()) if (!element.isConnected) aliases.delete(element);
    }
    return {inspect,sync,refresh,prune};
  })();
  function canMoveMapLayer(menu) {
    return ready && settings.enabled && settings.compactMode && mapLayerViewport.matches &&
      !standaloneSignin && !editorProfile && mapLayerIsOpen(menu);
  }
  function finishMapLayerDrag(state) {
    const drag = state.drag;
    cancelAnimationFrame(state.frame); state.frame = 0;
    if (drag) {
      writeMapLayerPosition(state);
      const [value, priority] = drag.originalTransform;
      if (value) state.menu.style.setProperty('transform', value, priority);
      else state.menu.style.removeProperty('transform');
    }
    state.drag = null;
    drag?.unlockSize?.();
    const guard = headerGuardWindows.get(state.menu);
    if (drag && guard && state.position) guard.requestPoint = {left:state.position.x,top:state.position.y};
    if (drag && !compactLayoutEditing) storeMapLayerPosition(state,drag);
    state.menu.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-layer-dragging');
    queueHeaderGuardWindows(); queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();
    window.removeEventListener('pointermove', state.onMove, true);
    window.removeEventListener('pointerup', state.onEnd, true);
    window.removeEventListener('pointercancel', state.onEnd, true);
    if (drag && state.title?.hasPointerCapture?.(drag.pointerId)) {
      try { state.title.releasePointerCapture(drag.pointerId); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("finishMapLayerDrag",studioError);}
    }
  }
  function storeMapLayerPosition(state, bounds) {
    if (!state.position || !bounds || compactLayoutEditing) return;
    const gap = 12;
    const point = {
      x: Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(state.position.x - gap) / Math.max(1,innerWidth - 2 * gap - bounds.width))),
      y: Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(state.position.y - gap) / Math.max(1,innerHeight - 2 * gap - bounds.height)))
    };
    compactIslandLayout = {...compactIslandLayout,layers:point};
    applyCompactLayoutVariables();
    try { Promise.resolve(GM_setValue(COMPACT_LAYOUT_KEY,compactIslandLayout)).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("storeMapLayerPosition",studioError);}); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("storeMapLayerPosition",studioError);}
  }
  function resetMapLayerPosition(state) {
    finishMapLayerDrag(state);
    state.position = null;
    state.menu.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-layer-placed');
    state.menu.style.removeProperty('--ws-layer-top');
    state.menu.style.removeProperty('--ws-layer-left');
  }
  function positionMapLayer(state, x, y, bounds) {
    const gap = bounds.gap ?? 24;
    const left = Math.round(Math.max(gap, Math.min(x, innerWidth - bounds.width - gap)));
    const geometry = bounds.geometry || workspacePanelBounds();
    const previous = state.position ? {left:state.position.x, top:state.position.y} : {left:bounds.left ?? left,top:bounds.top ?? y};
    const limits = headerPanelLimits(left, bounds.width, gap, geometry, {...previous,height:bounds.height});
    const top = Math.round(Math.max(limits.top, Math.min(y, limits.bottom - bounds.height)));
    const placed = compactSlidePosition({left,top,width:bounds.width,height:bounds.height}, previous, bounds.obstacles || compactLauncherObstacles(), {width:geometry.width,height:limits.bottom + gap}, gap);
    if (!placed) return;
    state.position = { x: placed.left, y: placed.top };
    if (state.drag) {
      const transform = `translate3d(${(placed.left - state.drag.left) / state.drag.zoom}px,${(placed.top - state.drag.top) / state.drag.zoom}px,0px)`;
      if (state.menu.style.getPropertyValue('transform') !== transform) state.menu.style.setProperty('transform', transform, 'important');
    } else writeMapLayerPosition(state);
  }
  function writeMapLayerPosition(state) {
    if (!state.position) return;
    for (const [name, value] of [['--ws-layer-top',state.position.y],['--ws-layer-left',state.position.x]]) {
      const text = `${value}px`; if (state.menu.style.getPropertyValue(name) !== text) state.menu.style.setProperty(name, text);
    }
    if (state.menu.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-layer-placed') !== 'on') state.menu.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-layer-placed', 'on');
  }
  function mapLayerDragInsets() {
    return { gap: parseFloat(getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue('--ws-compact-gap')) || 24 };
  }
  function mapLayerIsOpen(menu) {
    return menu.isConnected && !menu.classList.contains('hide-layer-switcher') && !menu.hidden && menu.getAttribute('aria-hidden') !== 'true' &&
      menu.checkVisibility?.({checkVisibilityCSS:true}) !== false;
  }
  function syncMapLayerRail() {
    const rail = queryCompactIsland(compactIslandSpec('tools'));
    if (!rail) return;
    let open = false;
    for (const menu of mapLayerWindows.keys()) if (mapLayerIsOpen(menu)) { open = true; break; }
    if (open) { if (rail.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-layers-open') !== 'on') rail.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-layers-open', 'on'); }
    else if (rail.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-layers-open')) rail.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-layers-open');
  }
  function syncMapLayerWindow(state, constrain = false) {
    syncMapLayerRail();
    if (!state.menu.isConnected) return;
    const title = state.menu.querySelector(':scope > .title');
    if (state.title !== title) {
      finishMapLayerDrag(state);
      state.title?.removeEventListener('pointerdown', state.onDown);
      state.title?.removeEventListener('lostpointercapture', state.onEnd);
      state.title = title;
      title?.addEventListener('pointerdown', state.onDown);
      title?.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', state.onEnd);
    }
    if (!canMoveMapLayer(state.menu)) resetMapLayerPosition(state);
    else if (constrain && state.position && !compactLayoutEditing && !state.drag) {
      const rect = state.menu.getBoundingClientRect();
      const bounds = { ...mapLayerDragInsets(), width: rect.width, height: rect.height };
      positionMapLayer(state, state.position.x, state.position.y, bounds);
    }
  }
  function trackMapLayerWindow(menu) {
    trackHeaderGuardWindow(menu);
    if (mapLayerWindows.has(menu)) return;
    const state = { menu, title: null, position: null, drag: null, frame: 0, observer: null, resizeObserver: null };
    state.onDown = event => {
      if (event.button !== 0 || event.isPrimary === false || state.drag || compactLayoutEditing || !canMoveMapLayer(menu)) return;
      const interactive = 'button,a,input,select,textarea,wz-button,wz-checkbox,wz-toggle-switch,wz-rich-tooltip,[role="button"],[contenteditable="true"]';
      if (event.composedPath().some(node => node?.matches?.(interactive))) return;
      const bounds = menu.getBoundingClientRect();
      state.drag = { pointerId: event.pointerId, startX: event.clientX, startY: event.clientY,
        left: bounds.left, top: bounds.top, width: bounds.width, height: bounds.height, ...mapLayerDragInsets(),
        geometry: workspacePanelBounds(), obstacles: compactPanelObstacles(menu), clientX:event.clientX,clientY:event.clientY,
        zoom:menu.currentCSSZoom || 1,unlockSize:lockPanelDragSize(menu,bounds),
        originalTransform: [menu.style.getPropertyValue('transform'), menu.style.getPropertyPriority('transform')] };
      const guard = headerGuardWindows.get(menu);
      if (guard && (guard.shift || guard.shiftX)) { guard.shift = 0; guard.shiftX = 0; restoreHeaderGuardProperty(guard, 'translate'); }
      state.position = { x: bounds.left, y: bounds.top };
      writeMapLayerPosition(state);
      menu.style.setProperty('transform', 'translate3d(0px,0px,0px)', 'important');
      menu.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-layer-dragging', 'on');
      event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation();
      try { state.title.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("trackMapLayerWindow",studioError);}
      window.addEventListener('pointermove', state.onMove, true);
      window.addEventListener('pointerup', state.onEnd, true);
      window.addEventListener('pointercancel', state.onEnd, true);
    };
    state.onMove = event => {
      const drag = state.drag;
      if (!drag || drag.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
      event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation();
      drag.clientX = event.clientX; drag.clientY = event.clientY;
      if (!state.frame) state.frame = requestAnimationFrame(state.renderDrag);
    };
    state.renderDrag = () => {
      state.frame = 0; const drag = state.drag;
      if (drag) positionMapLayer(state, drag.left + drag.clientX - drag.startX, drag.top + drag.clientY - drag.startY, drag);
    };
    state.onEnd = event => {
      if (!state.drag || event.pointerId !== state.drag.pointerId) return;
      if (event.type === 'pointerup') { state.drag.clientX = event.clientX; state.drag.clientY = event.clientY; }
      if (event.type === 'pointercancel') { state.drag.clientX = state.drag.startX; state.drag.clientY = state.drag.startY; }
      cancelAnimationFrame(state.frame); state.renderDrag(); finishMapLayerDrag(state);
    };
    state.observer = new MutationObserver(() => { if (menu.matches('[data-testid="layer-switcher-menu"]')) betaMapLayers.sync(menu); syncMapLayerWindow(state); });
    state.observer.observe(menu, { childList: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class', 'hidden', 'aria-hidden'] });
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') {
      state.resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => syncMapLayerWindow(state, true));
      state.resizeObserver.observe(menu);
    }
    mapLayerWindows.set(menu, state);
    syncMapLayerWindow(state);
  }
  function syncMapLayerWindows(constrain = false) {
    for (const [menu, state] of mapLayerWindows) {
      if (!menu.isConnected) {
        resetMapLayerPosition(state); state.observer.disconnect(); state.resizeObserver?.disconnect();
        state.title?.removeEventListener('pointerdown', state.onDown);
        state.title?.removeEventListener('lostpointercapture', state.onEnd);
        mapLayerWindows.delete(menu);
      } else syncMapLayerWindow(state, constrain);
    }
    syncMapLayerRail();
  }
  mapLayerViewport.addEventListener('change', syncMapLayerWindows);
  mapLayerViewport.addEventListener('change', () => {
    for (const frame of chatFrames.keys()) syncChatFrame(frame);
    queueHeaderGuardWindows(); queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();
  });
  window.addEventListener('blur', () => { for (const state of mapLayerWindows.values()) finishMapLayerDrag(state); });

    function popupSpecs() { return compactIslandSpecs.filter(spec => spec.popup && spec.id !== 'layers'); }
    function editorControlRects() {
      return [q('.dock')].map(element => element.getBoundingClientRect());
    }
    function invalidateLabels() {
      for (const item of targets) item.labelAnchor = null;
      scheduleLabels();
    }
    function placeDock(point = dockPoint, settle = !dockDrag) {
      if (!point || !open) return;
      const rect = dockDrag?.size || dock.getBoundingClientRect();
      const bar = dockDrag?.barSize || toolbar.getBoundingClientRect();
      const lead = Math.max(0,rect.height - bar.height), offset = (rect.width - bar.width) / 2;
      // Store the toolbar's position, so flipping or hiding its hint never moves the grab point.
      const below = point.top < Math.max(80,12 + lead);
      dock.setAttribute('data-hint-placement',below ? 'below' : 'above');
      let left = Math.max(12,Math.min(innerWidth - rect.width - 12,point.left - offset));
      let top = Math.max(12,Math.min(innerHeight - rect.height - 12,point.top - (below ? 0 : lead)));
      if (settle) {
        const footer = compactVisibleRect(document.querySelector('.wz-map-ol-footer'));
        const viewport = {width:innerWidth,height:footer ? Math.min(innerHeight,footer.top + 4) : innerHeight};
        const box = {left,top,width:rect.width,height:rect.height};
        const islands = targets.map(item => compactVisibleRect(item.element)).filter(Boolean);
        const placed = compactFreePosition(box,islands,viewport);
        if (placed) { left = placed.left; top = placed.top; }
        else top = Math.max(12,Math.min(top,viewport.height - rect.height - 12));
      }
      dockPoint = {left:left + offset,top:top + (below ? 0 : lead)};
      for (const [name,value] of [['left',`${left}px`],['top',`${top}px`],['bottom','auto'],['transform','none']]) {
        if (dock.style[name] !== value) dock.style[name] = value;
      }
      invalidateLabels();
    }
    let dockMoved = false;
    function autoPlaceDock() {
      for (const name of ['left','top','bottom','transform']) dock.style[name] = '';
      dockPoint = null;
      dock.setAttribute('data-hint-placement','above');
      const rect = toolbar.getBoundingClientRect();
      placeDock({left:rect.left,top:rect.top},true);
    }
    function finishDockDrag(event) {
      if (!dockDrag || (event && event.pointerId !== dockDrag.pointerId)) return;
      dockMoved = true;
      const finished = dockDrag; dockDrag = null;
      dock.removeAttribute('data-dragging');
      placeDock(dockPoint,true);
      try { if (toolbar.hasPointerCapture(finished.pointerId)) toolbar.releasePointerCapture(finished.pointerId); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("finishDockDrag",studioError);}
    }
    function placePanelPicker() {
      if (panelPicker.hidden) return;
      const button = panelPickerToggle.getBoundingClientRect(), rect = panelPicker.getBoundingClientRect();
      const left = Math.max(12,Math.min(innerWidth - rect.width - 12,button.left + button.width / 2 - rect.width / 2));
      const above = button.top - rect.height - 10;
      const top = above >= 12 ? above : Math.max(12,Math.min(innerHeight - rect.height - 12,button.bottom + 10));
      for (const [name,value] of [['left',`${Math.round(left)}px`],['right','auto'],['top',`${Math.round(top)}px`]]) {
        if (panelPicker.style[name] !== value) panelPicker.style[name] = value;
      }
      invalidateLabels();
    }
    function finishPickerDrag(event) {
      if (!pickerDrag || (event && event.pointerId !== pickerDrag.pointerId)) return;
      const finished = pickerDrag; pickerDrag = null;
      panelPicker.removeAttribute('data-dragging');
      try { if (panelPickerHandle.hasPointerCapture(finished.pointerId)) panelPickerHandle.releasePointerCapture(finished.pointerId); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("finishPickerDrag",studioError);}
    }
    function setPanelPickerOpen(visible) {
      finishPickerDrag(); panelPicker.hidden = !visible;
      panelPickerToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(visible));
      if (visible) placePanelPicker();
      else invalidateLabels();
    }
    function releasePanelPreviews() {
      for (const restore of previewRestores.values()) restore();
      previewRestores.clear();
      for (const element of panelPreviews.values()) element.remove();
      panelPreviews.clear(); selectedPanels.clear();
    }
    function renderPanelList() {
      const list = q('[data-id="panel-list"]');
      for (const spec of popupSpecs()) {
        let controls = panelRows.get(spec.id);
        if (!controls) {
          const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className = 'panel-row';
          const title = document.createElement('strong'); title.textContent = spec.label;
          const detail = document.createElement('small');
          const choice = document.createElement('button'); choice.className = 'choice'; choice.type = 'button'; choice.setAttribute('role','menuitemradio');
          choice.addEventListener('click',() => choosePanel(spec));
          const reset = document.createElement('button'); reset.className = 'action'; reset.type = 'button'; reset.textContent = 'Reset';
          reset.addEventListener('click',() => { finishDrag(); delete draft[spec.id]; compactIslandLayout = draft;
            const element = queryCompactIsland(spec); if (panelPreviews.has(spec.id)) placePanelPreview(spec,panelPreviews.get(spec.id));
            else if (spec.id === 'layers' && element) {
              arrangeBaseline.delete(spec.id);
              const state = mapLayerWindows.get(element); if (state) resetMapLayerPosition(state);
              const guard = headerGuardWindows.get(element); if (guard) { guard.shiftX=0; guard.shift=0; restoreHeaderGuardProperty(guard,'translate'); }
            } else if (spec.id === 'messages') {
              const state = element && chatPanelStates.get(element); if (state) applyChatPanelPosition(state,DEFAULT_CHAT_PANEL_OFFSET,false);
            } else previewRestores.get(spec.id)?.();
            applyCompactLayoutVariables(); collectTargets(); renderPanelList(); q('[data-id="status"]').textContent = `${spec.label}: automatic opening position`; });
          choice.append(title,detail);
          const actions = document.createElement('div'); actions.className = 'panel-actions'; actions.append(reset);
          row.append(choice,actions); list.append(row);
          controls = {detail,choice,reset}; panelRows.set(spec.id,controls);
        }
        const detail = draft[spec.id] ? 'Custom opening position' : 'Automatic opening position';
        const shown = selectedPanels.has(spec.id);
        if (controls.detail.textContent !== detail) controls.detail.textContent = detail;
        if (controls.choice.getAttribute('aria-checked') !== String(shown)) controls.choice.setAttribute('aria-checked',String(shown));
        if (controls.reset.hidden !== !draft[spec.id]) controls.reset.hidden = !draft[spec.id];
      }
      placePanelPicker();
    }
    function choosePanel(spec) {
      const shown = selectedPanels.has(spec.id);
      for (const other of popupSpecs()) if (other.id !== spec.id && selectedPanels.has(other.id)) togglePanel(other,false);
      togglePanel(spec);
      setPanelPickerOpen(false);
      if (!shown) q('[data-id="status"]').textContent = 'Drag this preview to where the panel should open, then Save layout.';
    }
    function placePanelPreview(spec,element) {
      const zoom = element.currentCSSZoom || parseFloat(getComputedStyle(element).zoom) || 1;
      const size = {width:Math.min(spec.width(),innerWidth - 48) * zoom,height:Math.min(spec.height(),innerHeight - 200) * zoom};
      const point = draft[spec.id] || {x:.55,y:.45};
      const preferred = compactIslandPixels(spec,point,size);
      const obstacles = targets.filter(item => item.element !== element).map(item => compactVisibleRect(item.element)).filter(Boolean);
      const footer = compactVisibleRect(document.querySelector('.wz-map-ol-footer'));
      const viewport = {width:innerWidth,height:footer ? Math.min(innerHeight,footer.top + 4) : innerHeight};
      const placed = compactFreePosition(preferred,obstacles,viewport) || {...preferred,top:Math.max(12,Math.min(preferred.top,viewport.height - size.height - 12))};
      Object.assign(element.style,{left:`${placed.left / zoom}px`,top:`${placed.top / zoom}px`,width:`${size.width / zoom}px`,height:`${size.height / zoom}px`});
    }
    function togglePanel(spec, refresh = true) {
      finishDrag();
      if (selectedPanels.has(spec.id)) {
        selectedPanels.delete(spec.id); arrangeBaseline.delete(spec.id);
        if (panelPreviews.has(spec.id)) { panelPreviews.get(spec.id).remove(); panelPreviews.delete(spec.id); }
        else { previewRestores.get(spec.id)?.(); previewRestores.delete(spec.id); }
      } else {
        const element = document.createElement('section'); element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-popup-kind',spec.id);
        element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-panel-preview','on');
        element.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;z-index:510;box-sizing:border-box;border:1px solid var(--wme-studio-border);border-radius:20px;background:var(--wme-studio-surface);color:var(--wme-studio-text);box-shadow:0 18px 52px #0005;overflow:hidden;font:13px/1.4 var(--ws-font,system-ui,sans-serif)';
        const heading = document.createElement('div'); heading.textContent = globalThis.WMEStudioI18n.translate(spec.label); heading.style.cssText = 'padding:16px;font-weight:700;border-bottom:1px solid var(--wme-studio-border)';
        const copy = document.createElement('p'); copy.textContent = globalThis.WMEStudioI18n.translate('Drag this preview to where the panel should open, then Save layout.'); copy.style.cssText = 'margin:0;padding:16px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--wme-studio-text-secondary)';
        element.append(heading,copy); (document.querySelector('.edit-area-main') || document.body).append(element);
        panelPreviews.set(spec.id,element); placePanelPreview(spec,element);
        selectedPanels.add(spec.id);
      }
      if (refresh) {
        compactIslandLayout=draft; applyCompactLayoutVariables();
        collectTargets(); renderPanelList(); queueHeaderGuardWindows();
      }
    }

    const blockedEvents = ['mousedown','mouseup','mousemove','click','dblclick','auxclick','contextmenu','dragstart','selectstart','wheel','touchstart','touchmove','keyup','keypress'];

    function elementVisible(element) {
      if (!element?.isConnected || element.hidden || element.getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true' || element.classList.contains('hide-layer-switcher')) return false;
      if (element.checkVisibility?.({ checkOpacity: true, checkVisibilityCSS: true }) === false) return false;
      const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect(), style = getComputedStyle(element);
      return rect.width > 20 && rect.height > 20 && style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden' && Number(style.opacity || 1) > .01 && rect.right > 0 && rect.bottom > 0 && rect.left < innerWidth && rect.top < innerHeight;
    }
    function panelGeometry() {
      return compactIslandSpecs.filter(spec => spec.arrange === false && !selectedPanels.has(spec.id)).flatMap(spec => {
        const element = (spec.popup && panelPreviews.get(spec.id)) || queryCompactIsland(spec), rect = compactVisibleRect(element);
        return rect ? [{ spec, element, rect }] : [];
      });
    }
    const opacityPreview = new Set();
    function clearOpacityPreview() {
