      for (const element of opacityPreview) { element.style.removeProperty('--ws-compact-opacity'); element.style.removeProperty('--ws-compact-hover-opacity'); }
      opacityPreview.clear();
    }
    function setOpacity(value, commit = true) {
      opacity = Math.min(100, Math.max(20, Math.round(Number(value) / 5) * 5));
      const input = q('[data-id="opacity"]');
      input.value = String(opacity); input.style.setProperty('--range-fill', `${(opacity - 20) / .8}%`);
      q('[data-id="opacity-value"]').textContent = `${opacity}%`;
      const base = `${opacity}%`, hover = `${Math.min(100, opacity + 48)}%`;
      if (!commit && open) {
        const elements = new Set(targets.map(item => item.element));
        for (const pill of document.querySelectorAll('.wme-studio-header-location')) elements.add(pill);
        for (const element of elements) {
          if (!element.isConnected) continue;
          element.style.setProperty('--ws-compact-opacity', base); element.style.setProperty('--ws-compact-hover-opacity', hover);
          opacityPreview.add(element);
        }
        return;
      }
      clearOpacityPreview();
      rootStyle('--ws-compact-opacity', base);
      rootStyle('--ws-compact-hover-opacity', hover);
      syncCompactGlassAppearance(opacity);
      syncArrangeChatAppearance();
    }
    function syncArrangeChatAppearance() {
      if (!open) return;
      for (const state of chatStates()) {
        const html = state.doc.documentElement;
        if (!chatAppearance.has(html)) chatAppearance.set(html, html.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-layout-editing'));
        if (html.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-layout-editing') !== 'on') html.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-layout-editing', 'on');
      }
    }
    function restoreChatAppearance() {
      for (const [html, attribute] of chatAppearance) {
        if (attribute == null) html.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-layout-editing');
        else html.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-layout-editing', attribute);
      }
      chatAppearance.clear();
    }
    function clearTargetMarks() {
      for (const item of targets) {
        item.element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-layout-target');
        item.element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-layout-dragging');
      }
      targets = []; labels.replaceChildren(); shields.replaceChildren();
    }
    function positionLabel(item, rect, geometry) {
      const anchor = [rect.left, rect.top, rect.width, rect.height, geometry.width, geometry.height];
      if (!item.labelAnchor || anchor.some((value, index) => value !== item.labelAnchor[index])) {
        const {width,height} = item.labelSize, gap = COMPACT_DOCK_GAP;
        const x = rect.left + (rect.width - width) / 2, y = rect.top + (rect.height - height) / 2;
        const obstacles = [...geometry.rects.values(), ...geometry.obstacles,
          ...targets.filter(target => target !== item && target.labelRect).map(target => target.labelRect)];
        const candidates = [
          {left:x,top:rect.top - height - gap}, {left:x,top:rect.top + rect.height + gap},
          {left:rect.left + rect.width + gap,top:y}, {left:rect.left - width - gap,top:y}
        ].map(point => ({...point,width,height}));
        const inBounds = point => point.left >= 8 && point.top >= 8 && point.left + width <= geometry.width - 8 && point.top + height <= geometry.height - 8;
        const placed = candidates.find(point => inBounds(point) && compactRectClear(point, obstacles, 8)) || compactFreePosition(candidates[0], obstacles, geometry);
        item.label.hidden = !placed;
        if (placed) {
          item.labelRect = placed;
          item.label.style.left = `${Math.round(placed.left)}px`; item.label.style.top = `${Math.round(placed.top)}px`;
        }
        item.labelAnchor = anchor;
      }
      item.shield.style.left = `${rect.left}px`; item.shield.style.top = `${rect.top}px`;
      item.shield.style.width = `${rect.width}px`; item.shield.style.height = `${rect.height}px`;
    }
    function updateLabels() {
      const positions = [];
      for (const item of targets) {
        if (!item.label.isConnected || !item.element.isConnected) continue;
        positions.push([item, item.element.getBoundingClientRect()]);
      }
      const geometry = {rects:new Map(positions.map(([item,rect]) => [item.spec.id,rect])),width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight,obstacles:[]};
      for (const { spec, rect } of panelGeometry()) geometry.rects.set(spec.id, rect);
      for (const element of [q('.dock'),q('.panel-picker'),document.querySelector('.wz-map-ol-footer'),document.getElementById('sidebar')]) {
        if (element?.hidden) continue;
        const rect = element === q('.dock') || element === q('.panel-picker') ? element.getBoundingClientRect() : compactVisibleRect(element);
        if (rect) geometry.obstacles.push(rect);
      }
      for (const [item, rect] of positions) positionLabel(item, rect, geometry);
    }
    function scheduleLabels() {
      if (!labelFrame && open) labelFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => { labelFrame = 0; if (!drag) updateLabels(); });
    }
    function previewVariable(element, name, value) {
      if (!element?.isConnected) return;
      let originals = previewVariables.get(element);
      if (!originals) previewVariables.set(element, originals = new Map());
      if (!originals.has(name)) originals.set(name, { value: element.style.getPropertyValue(name), priority: element.style.getPropertyPriority(name) });
      if (element.style.getPropertyValue(name) !== value) element.style.setProperty(name, value);
    }
    let dockSlide = null;
    function previewOffset(element, value) {
      if (!element?.isConnected) return;
      let originals = previewVariables.get(element);
      if (!originals) previewVariables.set(element, originals = new Map());
      for (const name of ['translate', 'transition']) {
        if (!originals.has(name)) originals.set(name, { value: element.style.getPropertyValue(name), priority: element.style.getPropertyPriority(name) });
      }
      if (element.style.getPropertyValue('transition') !== 'none') element.style.setProperty('transition', 'none', 'important');
      if (element.style.getPropertyValue('translate') !== value) element.style.setProperty('translate', value, 'important');
    }
    function clearPreviewVariables() {
      for (const [element, originals] of previewVariables) for (const [name, original] of originals) {
        if (original.value) element.style.setProperty(name, original.value, original.priority);
        else element.style.removeProperty(name);
      }
      previewVariables.clear(); dockSlide = null;
    }
    function dragGeometry(item) {
      const rects = new Map(targets.map(target => {
        const rect = target.element.getBoundingClientRect();
        return [target.spec.id, { left: rect.left, top: rect.top, width: rect.width, height: rect.height }];
      }));
      const panels = panelGeometry();
      for (const { spec, rect } of panels) rects.set(spec.id, rect);
      const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
      const geometry = { rects, width: innerWidth, height: innerHeight, sidebar, sidebarRect: compactVisibleRect(sidebar), sidebarWidth: sidebar?.getBoundingClientRect().width || 330, layers: queryCompactIsland(compactIslandSpec('layers')), obstacles: [], onlinePanels: [] };
      geometry.labelObstacles = editorControlRects();
      geometry.obstacles.push(...geometry.labelObstacles);
      const footer = compactVisibleRect(document.querySelector('.wz-map-ol-footer'));
      geometry.footer = footer;
      geometry.footerBottom = footer ? Math.max(24, innerHeight - footer.top + COMPACT_ISLAND_GAP) : 24;
      for (const element of [sidebar, document.querySelector('.wz-map-ol-footer'), document.getElementById('filter-panel-region')]) {
        const rect = element === sidebar ? geometry.sidebarRect : compactVisibleRect(element);
        if (rect) geometry.obstacles.push(rect);
      }
      for (const state of onlineEditorsPanels.values()) {
        const rect = compactVisibleRect(state.panel);
        if (!rect) continue;
        geometry.onlinePanels.push({panel:state.panel,rect});
        if (item.spec.id !== 'online') geometry.obstacles.push(rect);
      }
      return geometry;
    }
    function previewDocks(item, geometry) {
      const id = item.spec.id;
      if (!draft.sidePanel && (id === 'navigation' || id === 'header') && geometry.sidebar && geometry.sidebarRect) {
        const rail = geometry.rects.get('navigation'), bar = geometry.rects.get('header');
        let left = 12 + compactIslandSpec('navigation').width() + COMPACT_DOCK_GAP, right = null;
        if (draft.navigation && rail) {
          if (rail.left + rail.width / 2 > geometry.width / 2) { right = Math.round(geometry.width - rail.left + COMPACT_DOCK_GAP); left = null; }
          else left = Math.round(rail.left + rail.width + COMPACT_DOCK_GAP);
        }
        const spanLeft = right != null ? geometry.width - right - geometry.sidebarWidth : left;
        let top = 24, bottom = geometry.footerBottom;
        if (bar && bar.width > 0 && bar.left < spanLeft + geometry.sidebarWidth && bar.left + bar.width > spanLeft) {
          if (bar.top + bar.height / 2 <= geometry.height / 2) top = Math.round(bar.top + bar.height + 24);
          else bottom = Math.round(geometry.height - bar.top + 24);
        }
        const edges = `${top}px ${bottom}px`, panel = geometry.sidebar;
        if (!dockSlide || dockSlide.element !== panel || dockSlide.edges !== edges || !dockSlide.compositor) {
          const compositor = dockSlide?.element === panel ? dockSlide.compositor : getComputedStyle(panel).translate === 'none';
          previewVariable(panel, '--ws-dock-panel-left', left != null ? `${left}px` : 'auto');
          previewVariable(panel, '--ws-dock-panel-right', right != null ? `${right}px` : 'auto');
          previewVariable(panel, '--ws-dock-panel-top', `${top}px`);
          previewVariable(panel, '--ws-dock-panel-bottom', `${bottom}px`);
          if (compositor) previewOffset(panel, '0px 0px');
          dockSlide = { element: panel, edges, left: spanLeft, compositor };
        } else previewOffset(panel, `${spanLeft - dockSlide.left}px 0px`);
      }
      if (id === 'tools' && !draft.layers) {
        const layers = geometry.layers;
        if (!layers) return;
        const rail = geometry.rects.get(id), rect = geometry.rects.get('layers');
        if (!rail || !rect) return;
        const onRight = rail.left + rail.width / 2 > geometry.width / 2;
        const right = Math.round(geometry.width - rail.left + COMPACT_DOCK_GAP), left = Math.round(rail.left + rail.width + COMPACT_DOCK_GAP);
        previewVariable(layers, '--ws-dock-layers-left', onRight ? 'auto' : `${left}px`);
        previewVariable(layers, '--ws-dock-layers-right', onRight ? `${right}px` : 'auto');
        const placed = { ...rect, left: onRight ? geometry.width - right - rect.width : left };
        geometry.rects.set('layers', placed);
      }
    }
    function collectTargets() {
      const previous = new Map(targets.map(item => [item.spec.id,item]));
      const visible = compactIslandSpecs.filter(spec => spec.arrange !== false || selectedPanels.has(spec.id)).flatMap(spec => {
        const element = (spec.popup && panelPreviews.get(spec.id)) || queryCompactIsland(spec);
        return elementVisible(element) ? [{spec,element,radius:getComputedStyle(element).borderRadius}] : [];
      });
      const next = [], created = [];
      for (const {spec,element,radius} of visible) {
        let item = previous.get(spec.id);
        if (item?.element === element) previous.delete(spec.id);
        else {
          const label = document.createElement('div');
          label.className = 'target-label'; label.dataset.id = spec.id; label.textContent = spec.label;
          const shield = document.createElement('div');
          shield.className = 'drag-shield'; shield.setAttribute('data-island',spec.id);
          shield.setAttribute('aria-label',`Move ${spec.label}`); shield.style.borderRadius = radius;
          shield.tabIndex = 0; shield.setAttribute('role','button');
          labels.append(label); shields.append(shield);
          element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-layout-target',spec.id);
          item = {spec,element,label,shield,labelSize:null,labelRect:null}; created.push(item);
        }
        item.labelAnchor = null; next.push(item);
      }
      for (const item of previous.values()) {
        item.element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-layout-target');
        item.element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-layout-dragging');
        item.label.remove(); item.shield.remove();
      }
      targets = next;
      for (const item of created) {
        const size = item.label.getBoundingClientRect();
        item.labelSize = {width:Math.ceil(size.width),height:Math.ceil(size.height)};
      }
      scheduleLabels();
    }
    function alignToIslands(item, geometry, value, size, start, extent, edges, centers) {
      let best = null;
      for (const [id, other] of geometry.rects) {
        if (id === item.spec.id) continue;
        const options = [];
        if (edges) options.push([other[start], other[start]], [other[start] + other[extent] - size, other[start] + other[extent]]);
        if (centers) options.push([other[start] + (other[extent] - size) / 2, other[start] + other[extent] / 2]);
        for (const [candidate, line] of options) {
          const distance = Math.abs(candidate - value);
          if (distance <= 8 && (!best || distance < best.distance)) best = { value: candidate, line, distance };
        }
      }
      return best;
    }
    function settleArrangePoint(item, desired, geometry) {
      const id = item.spec.id;
      const obstacles = [...geometry.rects].filter(([other]) => other !== id).map(([,rect]) => rect);
      for (const obstacle of geometry.obstacles) {
        // The temporary Arrange controls must not displace a panel's saved opening position.
        if (geometry.labelObstacles.includes(obstacle)) continue;
        if (obstacle === geometry.sidebarRect && ['header','navigation','sidePanel'].includes(id)) continue;
        obstacles.push(obstacle);
      }
      const launchers = [...geometry.rects].filter(([other]) => other !== id && ['online','tile'].includes(other)).map(([,rect]) => rect);
      const expandedHeader = id === 'header' && compactHeaderSpansViewport(desired.width,geometry.width);
      const inset = id === 'header' ? compactHeaderHorizontalInset(desired.width,geometry.width) : 12;
      const accepts = candidate => {
        if (expandedHeader && Math.abs(candidate.left - (geometry.width - candidate.width) / 2) > .5) return false;
        if (!draft.sidePanel && ['navigation','header'].includes(id) && geometry.sidebarRect) {
          const rail = id === 'navigation' ? candidate : geometry.rects.get('navigation');
          const bar = id === 'header' ? candidate : geometry.rects.get('header');
          let left = 12 + compactIslandSpec('navigation').width() + COMPACT_DOCK_GAP;
          if (rail && (draft.navigation || id === 'navigation')) left = rail.left + rail.width / 2 > geometry.width / 2 ? rail.left - COMPACT_DOCK_GAP - geometry.sidebarWidth : rail.left + rail.width + COMPACT_DOCK_GAP;
          let top = 24, bottom = geometry.footerBottom;
          if (bar && bar.left < left + geometry.sidebarWidth && bar.left + bar.width > left) {
            if (bar.top + bar.height / 2 <= geometry.height / 2) top = bar.top + bar.height + 24;
            else bottom = geometry.height - bar.top + 24;
          }
          if (!compactRectClear({left,top,width:geometry.sidebarWidth,height:Math.max(0,geometry.height - top - bottom)},launchers)) return false;
        }
        if (id === 'tools' && !draft.layers && geometry.rects.has('layers')) {
          const layers = geometry.rects.get('layers');
          const left = candidate.left + candidate.width / 2 > geometry.width / 2 ? candidate.left - COMPACT_DOCK_GAP - layers.width : candidate.left + candidate.width + COMPACT_DOCK_GAP;
          if (!compactRectClear({...layers,left},launchers)) return false;
        }
        return true;
      };
      const footer = geometry.footer;
      const viewport = {width:geometry.width,height:footer ? Math.min(geometry.height,footer.top + 4) : geometry.height};
      return compactFreePosition(desired,obstacles,viewport,accepts,inset) || {
        ...desired,
        left:Math.max(inset,Math.min(desired.left,viewport.width - desired.width - inset)),
        top:Math.max(12,Math.min(desired.top,viewport.height - desired.height - 12))
      };
    }
    function previewPoint(item, left, top, geometry, settle = false) {
      const rect = geometry.rects.get(item.spec.id), gap = 12;
      const expandedHeader = item.spec.id === 'header' && compactHeaderSpansViewport(rect.width, geometry.width);
      const horizontalInset = item.spec.id === 'header' ? compactHeaderHorizontalInset(rect.width, geometry.width) : gap;
      const maxLeft = Math.max(horizontalInset, geometry.width - rect.width - horizontalInset), maxTop = Math.max(gap, geometry.height - rect.height - gap);
      let nextLeft = Math.min(maxLeft, Math.max(horizontalInset, left)), nextTop = Math.min(maxTop, Math.max(gap, top));
      let centerX = false, centerY = false, guideX = null, guideY = null;
      const free = !!(settle || drag?.free || drag?.keyboard), edges = snapEdges && !free, centers = snapCenter && !free;
      const threshold = 22, horizontalCenter = (geometry.width - rect.width) / 2, verticalCenter = (geometry.height - rect.height) / 2;
      if (expandedHeader) { nextLeft = horizontalCenter; centerX = true; }
      else if (edges && Math.abs(nextLeft - horizontalInset) <= threshold) nextLeft = horizontalInset;
      else if (edges && Math.abs(nextLeft - maxLeft) <= threshold) nextLeft = maxLeft;
      else if (centers && Math.abs(nextLeft - horizontalCenter) <= threshold) { nextLeft = horizontalCenter; centerX = true; }
      else if (edges || centers) {
        const snap = alignToIslands(item, geometry, nextLeft, rect.width, 'left', 'width', edges, centers);
        if (snap) { nextLeft = snap.value; guideX = snap.line; }
      }
      if (edges && Math.abs(nextTop - gap) <= threshold) nextTop = gap;
      else if (edges && Math.abs(nextTop - maxTop) <= threshold) nextTop = maxTop;
      else if (centers && Math.abs(nextTop - verticalCenter) <= threshold) { nextTop = verticalCenter; centerY = true; }
      else if (edges || centers) {
        const snap = alignToIslands(item, geometry, nextTop, rect.height, 'top', 'height', edges, centers);
        if (snap) { nextTop = snap.value; guideY = snap.line; }
      }
      nextLeft = Math.round(nextLeft); nextTop = Math.round(nextTop);
      const desired = { left: nextLeft, top: nextTop, width: rect.width, height: rect.height };
      // Follow the pointer across other islands; find the nearest clear location only on release.
      const placed = settle ? settleArrangePoint(item,desired,geometry) : desired;
      centerX = centerX && placed.left === nextLeft; centerY = centerY && placed.top === nextTop;
      if (placed.left !== nextLeft) guideX = null;
      if (placed.top !== nextTop) guideY = null;
      nextLeft = placed.left; nextTop = placed.top;
      verticalGuide.style.left = guideX != null ? `${Math.round(guideX)}px` : '';
      horizontalGuide.style.top = guideY != null ? `${Math.round(guideY)}px` : '';
      verticalGuide.classList.toggle('show', centerX || guideX != null); horizontalGuide.classList.toggle('show', centerY || guideY != null);
      arrangeBaseline.delete(item.spec.id);
      draft[item.spec.id] = item.spec.popup ? {
        x: nextLeft / geometry.width, y: nextTop / geometry.height, anchor: 'viewport'
      } : {
        x: expandedHeader ? (draft.header?.x ?? .5) : maxLeft === horizontalInset ? 0 : (nextLeft - horizontalInset) / (maxLeft - horizontalInset),
        y: maxTop === gap ? 0 : (nextTop - gap) / (maxTop - gap)
      };
      const horizontal = item.spec.id === 'header' ? '--ws-island-header-center' : `--ws-island-${item.spec.id}-left`;
      if (panelPreviews.has(item.spec.id)) {
        const zoom = item.element.currentCSSZoom || parseFloat(getComputedStyle(item.element).zoom) || 1;
        item.element.style.left = `${nextLeft / zoom}px`; item.element.style.top = `${nextTop / zoom}px`;
      } else if (item.spec.id === 'layers') {
        previewVariable(item.element,'--ws-layer-left',`${nextLeft}px`);
        previewVariable(item.element,'--ws-layer-top',`${nextTop}px`);
      } else if (item.spec.id === 'messages') {
        const state = chatPanelStates.get(item.element), current = item.element.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (state) applyChatPanelPosition(state,{x:state.offset.x + nextLeft - current.left,y:state.offset.y + nextTop - current.top},false);
      } else if (item.spec.popup && item.spec.id !== 'layers') {
        const guard = headerGuardWindows.get(item.element);
        if (guard) writeRequestPosition(guard,item.element.getBoundingClientRect(),nextLeft,nextTop);
        else { item.element.style.left = `${nextLeft}px`; item.element.style.top = `${nextTop}px`; }
      }
      previewVariable(item.element, horizontal, `${nextLeft + (item.spec.id === 'header' ? rect.width / 2 : 0)}px`);
      previewVariable(item.element, `--ws-island-${item.spec.id}-top`, `${nextTop}px`);
      geometry.rects.set(item.spec.id, placed);
      if (item.spec.id === 'header') placeHeaderLocationPill(placed, geometry.height - geometry.footerBottom);
      if (!drag.active) {
        drag.active = true; compactIslandLayout = draft;
        attr('layout', compactIslandSpecs.filter(spec => spec.id !== 'messages' && draft[spec.id]).map(spec => spec.id).join(' '));
        const bar = toolbar.getBoundingClientRect();
        dock.setAttribute('data-used', 'on');
        placeDock({left:bar.left,top:bar.top},false);
      }
      statusLine.textContent = `${item.spec.label} · ${nextLeft}, ${nextTop}`;
      if (settle) previewDocks(item, geometry);
      if (settle && item.spec.id === 'online') for (const popup of geometry.onlinePanels) {
        const occupied = [...geometry.rects.values(),...geometry.obstacles];
        const position = compactOnlinePanelPlacement(placed, popup.rect, occupied, geometry);
        if (position) for (const [name,value] of [['--ws-online-panel-left',position.left],['--ws-online-panel-top',position.top],['--ws-online-panel-height',position.height]]) previewVariable(popup.panel,name,`${value}px`);
      }
      positionLabel(item, placed, {...geometry,obstacles:[...geometry.obstacles,...geometry.labelObstacles]});
    }
    function targetFromEvent(event) {
      const path = event.composedPath();
      return targets.find(item => path.includes(item.shield));
    }
    let nudgeTimer = 0;
    function nudgeIsland(item, dx, dy) {
      if (drag && !(drag.keyboard && drag.item === item)) finishDrag();
      if (!drag) {
        const geometry = dragGeometry(item), rect = geometry.rects.get(item.spec.id);
        if (!rect) return;
        drag = { item, geometry, pointerId: -1, startX: 0, startY: 0, clientX: 0, clientY: 0, left: rect.left, top: rect.top, pending: false, active: false, keyboard: true };
        item.element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-layout-dragging', 'on');
      }
      const current = drag.geometry.rects.get(item.spec.id);
      previewPoint(item, current.left + dx, current.top + dy, drag.geometry);
      clearTimeout(nudgeTimer);
      nudgeTimer = setTimeout(() => { if (drag?.keyboard) finishDrag(); }, 350);
    }
    function resetIsland(item) {
      finishDrag();
      const id = item.spec.id;
      if (item.spec.popup) { statusLine.textContent = `${item.spec.label}: use Reset to restore panel positions`; return; }
      if (!draft[id]) { statusLine.textContent = `${item.spec.label} is already at its default position`; return; }
      delete draft[id]; arrangeBaseline.delete(id);
      compactIslandLayout = draft;
      if (id === 'header') resetHeaderPosition();
      scheduleDefaultSideIslandCenters(true);
      applyCompactLayoutVariables();
      syncCompactAuxiliaryPlacement(true);
      collectTargets(); renderPanelList(); invalidateLabels();
      statusLine.textContent = `${item.spec.label} restored to its default position`;
    }
    function fromToolbar(event) { const path=event.composedPath(); return path.includes(toolbar) || path.includes(q('.panel-picker')); }
    function lockWorkspace() {
      const body = document.body;
      if (!body) return;
      lockedWorkspace = { element: body, attribute: body.getAttribute('inert') };
      body.setAttribute('inert', '');
    }
    function unlockWorkspace() {
      if (!lockedWorkspace) return;
      const { element, attribute } = lockedWorkspace;
      if (attribute == null) element.removeAttribute('inert'); else element.setAttribute('inert', attribute);
      lockedWorkspace = null;
    }
    function onPointerDown(event) {
      if (!open) return;
      if (saving) { event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation(); return; }
      const path = event.composedPath();
      if (!panelPicker.hidden && !path.includes(panelPicker) && !path.includes(panelPickerToggle)) setPanelPickerOpen(false);
      if (path.includes(toolbar) && !path.some(node => ['BUTTON','INPUT','SELECT','TEXTAREA','LABEL','A','OUTPUT'].includes(node?.tagName))) {
        event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
        if (event.button !== 0 || event.isPrimary === false || drag || pickerDrag || dockDrag) return;
        const rect = toolbar.getBoundingClientRect(), size = dock.getBoundingClientRect();
        dockDrag = {pointerId:event.pointerId,startX:event.clientX,startY:event.clientY,left:rect.left,top:rect.top,size,barSize:rect};
        dock.setAttribute('data-dragging','on');
        try { toolbar.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("onPointerDown",studioError);}
        return;
      }
      if (path.includes(panelPickerHandle) && !path.some(node => node?.tagName === 'BUTTON')) {
        event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
        if (event.button !== 0 || event.isPrimary === false || drag || pickerDrag || dockDrag) return;
        const rect = panelPicker.getBoundingClientRect();
        pickerDrag = {pointerId:event.pointerId,startX:event.clientX,startY:event.clientY,left:rect.left,top:rect.top};
        panelPicker.setAttribute('data-dragging','on');
        try { panelPickerHandle.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("onPointerDown",studioError);}
        return;
      }
      if (fromToolbar(event)) return;
      event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      if (drag?.keyboard) finishDrag();
      if (event.button !== 0 || event.isPrimary === false || drag || pickerDrag || dockDrag) return;
      const item = targetFromEvent(event);
      if (!item) return;
      item.shield.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      const geometry = dragGeometry(item), rect = geometry.rects.get(item.spec.id);
      drag = { item, geometry, pointerId: event.pointerId, startX: event.clientX, startY: event.clientY, clientX: event.clientX, clientY: event.clientY, left: rect.left, top: rect.top, pending: false, active: false };
      if (item.spec.id === 'layers') drag.unlockSize = lockPanelDragSize(item.element,rect);
      item.element.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-layout-dragging', 'on');
      item.shield.setAttribute('data-dragging', 'on');
      try { item.shield.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("onPointerDown",studioError);}
    }
    function renderDrag() {
      dragFrame = 0;
      if (!drag?.pending || !drag.item.element.isConnected) return;
      drag.pending = false;
      if (!drag.active && Math.hypot(drag.clientX - drag.startX, drag.clientY - drag.startY) < 4) return;
      previewPoint(drag.item, drag.left + drag.clientX - drag.startX, drag.top + drag.clientY - drag.startY, drag.geometry);
    }
    function onPointerMove(event) {
      if (open && dockDrag) {
        event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
        if (event.pointerId === dockDrag.pointerId) placeDock({left:dockDrag.left + event.clientX - dockDrag.startX,top:dockDrag.top + event.clientY - dockDrag.startY});
        return;
      }
      if (open && pickerDrag) {
        event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
        if (event.pointerId === pickerDrag.pointerId) placePanelPicker({left:pickerDrag.left + event.clientX - pickerDrag.startX,top:pickerDrag.top + event.clientY - pickerDrag.startY});
        return;
      }
      if (!open || (!drag && fromToolbar(event))) return;
      event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      if (!drag || event.pointerId !== drag.pointerId) return;
      drag.clientX = event.clientX; drag.clientY = event.clientY; drag.free = event.altKey; drag.pending = true;
      if (!dragFrame) dragFrame = requestAnimationFrame(renderDrag);
    }
    function finishDrag(event) {
      if (!drag || (event && event.pointerId !== drag.pointerId)) return;
      if (event?.type === 'pointerup') { drag.clientX = event.clientX; drag.clientY = event.clientY; drag.pending = true; }
      cancelAnimationFrame(dragFrame); dragFrame = 0; renderDrag();
      clearTimeout(nudgeTimer);
      const finished = drag;
      if (finished.active) {
        const point = finished.geometry.rects.get(finished.item.spec.id);
        previewPoint(finished.item,point.left,point.top,dragGeometry(finished.item),true);
        compactIslandLayout = draft; applyCompactLayoutVariables();
        statusLine.textContent = `${finished.item.spec.label} moved · Save layout to keep it`;
      }
      clearPreviewVariables();
      drag = null; finished.unlockSize?.(); finished.item.element.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-layout-dragging');
      finished.item.shield.removeAttribute('data-dragging');
      try { if (finished.item.shield.hasPointerCapture(finished.pointerId)) finished.item.shield.releasePointerCapture(finished.pointerId); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("finishDrag",studioError);}
      verticalGuide.classList.remove('show'); horizontalGuide.classList.remove('show');
      renderPanelList(); scheduleLabels(); queueHeaderGuardWindows(); queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();
    }
    function onPointerEnd(event) {
      if (open && dockDrag) {
        event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
        if (event.type === 'pointerup' && event.pointerId === dockDrag.pointerId) placeDock({left:dockDrag.left + event.clientX - dockDrag.startX,top:dockDrag.top + event.clientY - dockDrag.startY});
        finishDockDrag(event); return;
      }
      if (open && pickerDrag) {
        event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
        if (event.type === 'pointerup' && event.pointerId === pickerDrag.pointerId) placePanelPicker({left:pickerDrag.left + event.clientX - pickerDrag.startX,top:pickerDrag.top + event.clientY - pickerDrag.startY});
        finishPickerDrag(event); return;
      }
      if (!open || (!drag && fromToolbar(event))) return;
      event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation(); finishDrag(event);
    }
    function onLostCapture(event) {
      if (dockDrag?.pointerId === event.pointerId) finishDockDrag();
      if (pickerDrag?.pointerId === event.pointerId) finishPickerDrag();
      if (drag?.pointerId === event.pointerId) finishDrag();
    }
    function blockControlEvent(event) {
      if (!open || fromToolbar(event)) return;
      if (event.type === 'dblclick') { const item = targetFromEvent(event); if (item) resetIsland(item); }
      event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    }
    function onBlur() { finishDrag(); finishPickerDrag(); finishDockDrag(); }
    function onResize() { finishDrag(); finishPickerDrag(); finishDockDrag(); placeDock(dockPoint,true); placePanelPicker(); invalidateLabels(); }
    function onVisibilityChange() { if (document.hidden) { finishDrag(); finishPickerDrag(); finishDockDrag(); } }
    function lockChatFrames() {
      for (const state of chatStates()) {
        const view = state.doc.defaultView;
        if (!view || lockedChatDocuments.has(state.doc)) continue;
        lockedChatDocuments.add(state.doc);
        const guard = event => {
          if (!open) return;
          if (event.type === 'keydown' && event.key === 'Escape') { event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation(); if (!panelPicker.hidden) { setPanelPickerOpen(false); panelPickerToggle.focus({preventScroll:true}); } else close(false); return; }
          if (/^key/.test(event.type) && (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.altKey)) return;
          event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
        };
        const events = ['pointerdown','pointerup','pointercancel',...blockedEvents,'keydown'];
        for (const type of events) view.addEventListener(type, guard, { capture: true, passive: false });
        frameLocks.push(() => { for (const type of events) view.removeEventListener(type, guard, true); });
      }
    }
    function onKeydown(event) {
      if (!open) return;
      if (saving) { if (!event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey) { event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation(); } return; }
      if (event.key === 'Escape') { event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation(); if (!panelPicker.hidden) { setPanelPickerOpen(false); panelPickerToggle.focus({preventScroll:true}); } else close(false); return; }
      const focused = targets.find(item => item.shield === shadow.activeElement);
      const step = { ArrowLeft: [-1, 0], ArrowRight: [1, 0], ArrowUp: [0, -1], ArrowDown: [0, 1] }[event.key];
      if (focused && step && !event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey) {
        event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
        const size = event.shiftKey ? 10 : 1;
        nudgeIsland(focused, step[0] * size, step[1] * size); return;
      }
      if (focused && (event.key === 'Delete' || event.key === 'Backspace')) {
        event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation(); resetIsland(focused); return;
      }
      if (event.key === 'Tab') {
        const controls = [...shadow.querySelectorAll('.drag-shield,.toolbar input,.toolbar button,.panel-picker button')].filter(control => !control.disabled && !control.closest('[hidden]'));
        const current = controls.indexOf(shadow.activeElement);
        const next = current < 0 ? (event.shiftKey ? controls.length - 1 : 0) : (current + (event.shiftKey ? -1 : 1) + controls.length) % controls.length;
        event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation(); controls[next]?.focus({ preventScroll: true }); return;
      }
      if (!fromToolbar(event) && !event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey && !event.altKey) {
        event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      }
    }
    function bindEditorEvents() {
      window.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown, true); window.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove, true);
      window.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerEnd, true); window.addEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerEnd, true);
      window.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', onLostCapture, true);
      for (const type of blockedEvents) window.addEventListener(type, blockControlEvent, { capture: true, passive: false });
      window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeydown, true); window.addEventListener('blur', onBlur);
      window.addEventListener('resize', onResize); document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibilityChange);
      lockChatFrames();
    }
    function unbindEditorEvents() {
      window.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown, true); window.removeEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove, true);
      window.removeEventListener('pointerup', onPointerEnd, true); window.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerEnd, true);
      window.removeEventListener('lostpointercapture', onLostCapture, true);
      for (const type of blockedEvents) window.removeEventListener(type, blockControlEvent, true);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeydown, true); window.removeEventListener('blur', onBlur);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize); document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibilityChange);
      for (const unlock of frameLocks.splice(0)) unlock();
      lockedChatDocuments.clear();
      cancelAnimationFrame(labelFrame); labelFrame = 0;
    }
    function chatStates() {
      const states = [];
      for (const frame of chatFrames.keys()) {
        const state = chatPanelStates.get(frame);
        if (state?.target?.isConnected) states.push(state);
      }
      return states;
    }
    async function save() {
      if (saving) return;
      for (const state of chatStates()) state.finishDrag?.();
      finishDrag();
      const button = q('[data-id="save"]'); button.disabled = true;
      const patch = { compactIslandOpacity: opacity, compactSnapEdges: snapEdges, compactSnapCenter: snapCenter };
      for (const [id, element] of panelPreviews) {
        if (!draft[id]) continue; // Keep Reset / automatic opening positions automatic.
        const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
        draft[id] = { x: rect.left / innerWidth, y: rect.top / innerHeight, anchor: 'viewport' };
      }
      const savedLayout = sanitizeCompactIslandLayout(draft);
      saving = true; statusLine.textContent = 'Saving layout…';
      try {
        await GM_setValue(COMPACT_LAYOUT_KEY, savedLayout || {});
        await config.write(patch);
        settings = {...settings,...patch}; compactIslandLayout = savedLayout;
        close(true);
      } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("save",studioError);
        q('[data-id="status"]').textContent = 'Could not save the layout. Save again to retry.';
      } finally { saving = false; button.disabled = false; }
    }
    function syncGridVisibility() { grid.hidden = !open || (snapEdges && snapCenter); }
    function closeArrangeSidebar() {
      if (!document.querySelector('.app.show-sidebar')) return;
      const drawer = document.getElementById('drawer');
      const selected = [...(drawer?.querySelectorAll('wz-navigation-item') || [])].find(item =>
        item.selected === true || item.matches('[selected]:not([selected="false"]),[active]:not([active="false"])') ||
        item.shadowRoot?.querySelector('.navigation-button.selected'));
      if (selected) {
        const toggle = document.querySelector('#product-icon .w-icon-hamburger-menu')?.closest('wz-button,button');
        (toggle || selected).click();
      }
      pageWindow.W?.app?.closeSidePanel?.();
    }
    function closeArrangePanels() {
      const windows = document.querySelectorAll('[data-issues-tracker-window],[id^="ISSUE_WINDOW"],[data-testid="floating-window"]');
      for (const panel of windows) if (compactVisibleRect(panel) && !requestPopupKind(panel)) {
        panel.querySelector('[aria-roledescription="draggable"] wz-button[aria-label="Close"],[aria-roledescription="draggable"] button[aria-label="Close"],wz-button:has(.w-icon-x)')?.click();
      }
      const layers = document.querySelector('.layer-switcher .menu');
      for (const card of document.querySelectorAll('.tile-build-status-card')) if (compactVisibleRect(card)) card.querySelector('wz-button:has(.w-icon-x),wz-button[aria-label="Close"],.close-button')?.click();
      closeArrangeSidebar();
    }
    function show() {
      if (open) return;
      for (const state of chatStates()) state.finishDrag?.();
      arrangeBaseline.clear();
      for (const spec of compactIslandSpecs.filter(spec=>spec.arrange!==false && !spec.popup)) {
        const id=spec.id, element = queryCompactIsland(spec);
        const rect = elementVisible(element) ? element.getBoundingClientRect() : null;
        if (rect) arrangeBaseline.set(id, { left: rect.left, top: rect.top, width: rect.width, height: rect.height });
      }
      closeArrangePanels();
      open = true; compactLayoutEditing = true; requestMinimizer.refresh();
      setPanelPickerOpen(false);
      hideBetaVersionTooltip();
      previousLayout = compactIslandLayout ? structuredClone(compactIslandLayout) : null;
      draft = previousLayout ? structuredClone(previousLayout) : {};
      previousHeaderPosition=floatingHeader.position ? {...floatingHeader.position} : null;
      previousHeaderStyles=['--ws-header-center','--ws-header-top'].map(name=>[name,floatingHeader.header?.style.getPropertyValue(name) || '',floatingHeader.header?.style.getPropertyPriority(name) || '']);
      const liveHeader=arrangeBaseline.get('header');
      if (liveHeader && previousHeaderStyles.some(([,value])=>value)) {
        const inset=compactHeaderHorizontalInset(liveHeader.width);
        draft.header={x:(liveHeader.left-inset)/Math.max(1,innerWidth-2*inset-liveHeader.width),y:(liveHeader.top-12)/Math.max(1,innerHeight-24-liveHeader.height)};
      }
      resetHeaderPosition();
      snapEdges = settings.compactSnapEdges; snapCenter = settings.compactSnapCenter;
      q('[data-id="snap-edges"]').checked = snapEdges;
      q('[data-id="snap-center"]').checked = snapCenter;
      setOpacity(settings.compactIslandOpacity);
      const workspace = document.querySelector('.app:not(.sidebar-fullscreen) .edit-area-main') || document.querySelector('.app') || root;
      if (grid.parentElement !== workspace) workspace.append(grid);
      syncGridVisibility();
      compactIslandLayout = draft;
      applyCompactLayoutVariables();
      host.hidden = false; lockWorkspace(); root.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-layout-editing', 'on');
      syncCompactAuxiliaryPlacement(true);
      selectedPanels.clear();
      for (const spec of popupSpecs()) if (elementVisible(queryCompactIsland(spec))) {
        togglePanel(spec,false);
      }
      applyCompactLayoutVariables();
      collectTargets(); renderPanelList(); scheduleLabels();
      statusLine.textContent = `${targets.length} island${targets.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} · drag one to move it`;
      dock.removeAttribute('data-used');
      if (dockMoved) placeDock(); else autoPlaceDock();
      bindEditorEvents(); q('[data-id="cancel"]').focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
    function close(saved = false) {
      if (!open || saving && !saved) return;
      for (const state of chatStates()) state.finishDrag?.();
      finishDrag(); finishDockDrag(); open = false; compactLayoutEditing = false; requestMinimizer.refresh();
      setPanelPickerOpen(false);
      arrangeBaseline.clear();
      unbindEditorEvents(); root.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-layout-editing');
      clearOpacityPreview();
      restoreChatAppearance();
      if (!saved) {
        compactIslandLayout = previousLayout;
        floatingHeader.position=previousHeaderPosition;
        for (const [name,value,priority] of previousHeaderStyles || []) {
          if (value) floatingHeader.header?.style.setProperty(name,value,priority);
          else floatingHeader.header?.style.removeProperty(name);
        }
      }
      previousHeaderPosition=previousHeaderStyles=null;
      host.hidden = true; grid.hidden = true;
      clearTargetMarks(); releasePanelPreviews(); unlockWorkspace();
      if (saved) for (const state of mapLayerWindows.values()) {
        resetMapLayerPosition(state);
        const guard = headerGuardWindows.get(state.menu); if (guard) resetHeaderGuard(guard);
      }
      rootStyle('--ws-compact-opacity', `${settings.compactIslandOpacity}%`);
      rootStyle('--ws-compact-hover-opacity', `${Math.min(100, settings.compactIslandOpacity + 48)}%`);
      syncCompactGlassAppearance();
      applyCompactLayoutVariables();
    }
    panelPickerToggle.addEventListener('click', () => setPanelPickerOpen(panelPicker.hidden));
    q('[data-id="panel-picker-close"]').addEventListener('click', () => { setPanelPickerOpen(false); panelPickerToggle.focus({preventScroll:true}); });
    q('[data-id="snap-edges"]').addEventListener('change', event => { snapEdges = event.target.checked; syncGridVisibility(); });
    q('[data-id="snap-center"]').addEventListener('change', event => { snapCenter = event.target.checked; syncGridVisibility(); });
    q('[data-id="opacity"]').addEventListener('input', event => setOpacity(event.target.value, false));
    q('[data-id="opacity"]').addEventListener('change', event => setOpacity(event.target.value, true));
    q('[data-id="reset"]').addEventListener('click', () => {
      finishDrag(); releasePanelPreviews(); clearTargetMarks();
      for (const spec of compactIslandSpecs) if (spec.arrange !== false || spec.popup) delete draft[spec.id];
      arrangeBaseline.clear();
      for (const state of mapLayerWindows.values()) resetMapLayerPosition(state);
      compactIslandLayout = draft;
      scheduleDefaultSideIslandCenters(true);
      applyCompactLayoutVariables();
      syncCompactAuxiliaryPlacement(true);
      collectTargets(); renderPanelList(); scheduleLabels(); q('[data-id="status"]').textContent = 'Default positions restored in preview';
    });
    q('[data-id="cancel"]').addEventListener('click', () => close(false)); q('[data-id="save"]').addEventListener('click', save);
    compactLayoutEditor = { host, shadow, open: show, close, dragging: () => !!(drag || dockDrag || pickerDrag), lockChatFrames, reset: () => storeCompactIslandLayout(null) };
    return compactLayoutEditor;
  }

  const layoutPresets = Object.freeze([
    { id:'balanced', name:'Balanced', description:'Centered header and side rails, with plenty of room for the map.', width:0, layout:null },
    { id:'left-handed', name:'Left-handed', description:'Map tools on the left and navigation on the right.', width:0,
      layout:{header:{x:.5,y:0},navigation:{x:1,y:.5},tools:{x:0,y:.5},online:{x:1,y:.10},tile:{x:1,y:.17}} },
    { id:'review', name:'Review desk', description:'Requests open on the right, with Messages on the left.', width:0,
      layout:{header:{x:.5,y:0},navigation:{x:0,y:.5},tools:{x:1,y:.5},online:{x:1,y:.10},tile:{x:1,y:.17},
        updateRequest:{x:.86,y:.24},mapUpdateRequest:{x:.86,y:.24},placeUpdateRequest:{x:.86,y:.24},mapProblem:{x:.86,y:.24},messages:{x:.08,y:.16,anchor:'viewport'}} },
    { id:'wide', name:'Wide header', description:'A full-width header with controls along both sides.', width:100, layout:null }
  ].map(preset => Object.freeze({...preset,layout:preset.layout ? Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(preset.layout).map(([key,point])=>[key,Object.freeze(point)]))) : null})));
  const layoutSignature = value => JSON.stringify(Object.entries(sanitizeCompactIslandLayout(value) || {}).sort(([a],[b])=>a.localeCompare(b)));
  function currentLayoutPreset() {
    if (!settings.compactMode) return '';
    const width = settings.compactHeaderFullWidth ? settings.compactHeaderWidth : 0;
    const signature = layoutSignature(compactIslandLayout);
    return layoutPresets.find(preset=>preset.width === width && layoutSignature(preset.layout) === signature)?.id || '';
  }
  async function captureLayoutSettings() {
    const preferences = await config.read();
    const stored = await chrome.storage.local.get(COMPACT_LAYOUT_KEY);
    return { compactMode:preferences.compactMode,compactHeaderFullWidth:preferences.compactHeaderFullWidth,
      compactHeaderWidth:preferences.compactHeaderWidth,layout:sanitizeCompactIslandLayout(stored[COMPACT_LAYOUT_KEY]),
      chatPosition:chatPanelPosition ? {...chatPanelPosition} : null };
  }
  async function writeLayoutSettings(snapshot) {
    const clean = config.sanitize(snapshot);
    const layout = sanitizeCompactIslandLayout(snapshot.layout);
    await chrome.storage.local.set({
      'wmeStudio.compactMode':clean.compactMode,
      'wmeStudio.compactHeaderFullWidth':clean.compactHeaderFullWidth,
      'wmeStudio.compactHeaderWidth':clean.compactHeaderWidth,
      [COMPACT_LAYOUT_KEY]:layout || {}, [CHAT_PANEL_POSITION_KEY]:normalizedChatPanelPosition(snapshot.chatPosition)
    });
    applyLayoutSettings(snapshot);
  }
  function applyLayoutSettings(snapshot) {
    compactIslandLayout = sanitizeCompactIslandLayout(snapshot.layout);
    resetHeaderPosition();
    for (const state of headerGuardWindows.values()) {
      state.requestPoint = null; state.appliedPopupPoint = null; state.shift = 0; state.shiftX = 0;
      restoreHeaderGuardProperty(state,'translate');
    }
    for (const state of mapLayerWindows.values()) resetMapLayerPosition(state);
    chatPanelPosition = normalizedChatPanelPosition(snapshot.chatPosition);
    for (const frame of chatFrames.keys()) {
      const state = chatPanelStates.get(frame);
      if (state?.target?.isConnected) applyChatPanelPosition(state,chatPanelPosition,false);
    }
    applyCompactLayoutVariables(); syncMapLayerWindows(true); queueHeaderGuardWindows();
  }
  globalThis.WMEStudioCompactLayout = Object.freeze({
    open() { buildCompactLayoutEditor().open(); },
    reset() { return storeCompactIslandLayout(null); },
    hasCustomLayout() { return !!compactIslandLayout; },
    presets:layoutPresets, currentPreset:currentLayoutPreset,
    async applyPreset(id) {
      const preset = layoutPresets.find(item=>item.id === id);
      if (!preset || compactLayoutEditing || !settings.enabled) throw new Error('Layout preset unavailable');
      const previous = await captureLayoutSettings();
      try { await writeLayoutSettings({compactMode:true,compactHeaderFullWidth:preset.width > 0,compactHeaderWidth:preset.width,layout:preset.layout,chatPosition:null}); }
      catch (error) { reportStudioError("applyPreset",error); await writeLayoutSettings(previous).catch((studioError)=>{ reportStudioError("applyPreset",studioError);}); throw error; }
      return previous;
    },
    restorePreset(snapshot) { return writeLayoutSettings(snapshot); }
  });

  let scanQueued = false;
  let upgradeTimer = 0;
  function watchUpgrades() {
    if (upgradeTimer || document.hidden || !pending.size) return;
    upgradeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      upgradeTimer = 0;
      for (const host of [...pending.keys()]) {
        if (host.isConnected && host.shadowRoot) inspect(host);
        pending.delete(host);
      }
    }, 1500);
  }
  const upgradeNotifications = new WeakSet();
  function excluded(node) { return node.nodeType !== 1 || node.matches(ignored) || !!node.closest('.olMapViewport, .olLayerDiv, #render-root,.ws-restriction-select,.ws-restriction-select-menu,#wme-studio-command-palette,.ws-script-tabs'); }
  // Layout-reading work that inspect() triggers is postponed until the discovery pass that triggered it has
  // finished, so styles are resolved once for everything the pass touched instead of once per element (a
  // read in the middle of a pass also styles components before their sheet is attached, and again after).
  // Outside a pass the work runs at once.
  let discoverDepth = 0;
  const afterDiscoverQueue = [];
  function afterDiscover(task) {
    if (discoverDepth) afterDiscoverQueue.push(task);
    else task();
  }
  function leaveDiscover() {
    if (--discoverDepth) return;
    while (afterDiscoverQueue.length) {
      const task = afterDiscoverQueue.shift();
      try { task(); } catch (error) { if (reportStudioError.active) reportStudioError('Deferred layout work failed',error); else console.error('[WME Studio] Deferred layout work failed.', error); }
    }
  }
  function discover(start) {
    if (start.nodeType === 1 && excluded(start)) return;
    const outerScanning = onlineEditorsScanning, outerBarren = onlineEditorsBarren;
    onlineEditorsScanning = true; onlineEditorsBarren = null;
    discoverDepth++;
    try {
      if (start.nodeType === 1) inspect(start);
      const walker = document.createTreeWalker(start, NodeFilter.SHOW_ELEMENT, {
        acceptNode: node => {
          if (node.localName === 'iframe') trackChatFrame(node);
          return node.matches(ignored) ? NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT : NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
        }
      });
      while (walker.nextNode()) inspect(walker.currentNode);
    } finally {
      onlineEditorsScanning = outerScanning; onlineEditorsBarren = outerBarren;
      leaveDiscover();
    }
  }
  const onlineEditorsPanels = new Map();
  function onlineEditorsVisual(source, kind, parts) {
    const parent = source.parentElement;
    let visual = [...parent.children].find(child => child.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-online-ui') === kind);
    if (!visual) {
      visual = source.ownerDocument.createElement('span');
      visual.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-online-ui', kind);
      visual.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      visual.style.display = 'none';
      if (source.hasAttribute('slot')) visual.setAttribute('slot', source.getAttribute('slot'));
      for (const part of parts) {
        const node = source.ownerDocument.createElement('span');
        node.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-online-part', part);
        visual.append(node);
      }
      parent.append(visual);
    }
    if (source.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-online-source') !== kind) source.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-online-source', kind);
    return visual;
  }
  function paintOnlineEditorsPanel(state) {
    state.queued = false;
    const panel = state.panel;
    state.measureHeight = true;
    if (onlineEditorsPanels.get(panel) !== state) return;
    if (!panel.isConnected) { releaseOnlineEditorsPanel(state); return; }
    const write = (visual, part, text, hidden = false) => {
      const node = visual.querySelector(`[data-wme-studio-online-part="${part}"]`);
      if (node.textContent !== text) node.textContent = text;
      if (node.hidden !== hidden) node.hidden = hidden;
    };
    const header = panel.querySelector('.list-header');
    if (header) {
      const text = onlineEditorsText(header);
      const count = text.match(/\s*\((\d[\d\s,.]*)\)\s*$/u);
      const visual = onlineEditorsVisual(header, 'header', ['label', 'count']);
      write(visual, 'label', count ? text.slice(0, count.index).trim() : text);
      write(visual, 'count', count ? count[1].trim() : '', !count);
    }
    const banner = panel.querySelector('.list-banner [slot="item-key"]');
    const message = banner && [...banner.children].find(node => !node.matches('wz-icon,svg,img,[data-wme-studio-online-ui]'));
    if (message) {
      const text = onlineEditorsText(message);
      const split = text.match(/^(.+?[?？;;])\s*(.+)$/u);
      const visual = onlineEditorsVisual(message, 'banner', ['question', 'action']);
      write(visual, 'question', split ? split[1].trim() : '', !split);
      write(visual, 'action', split ? split[2].trim() : text);
    }
    const list = panel.querySelector('.online-editors-list');
    if (state.list !== list) {
      state.list?.removeEventListener('scroll', state.onScroll);
      state.list = list;
      list?.addEventListener('scroll', state.onScroll, { passive: true });
      afterDiscover(state.onScroll);
    }
    queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();
  }
  function releaseOnlineEditorsPanel(state) {
    state.observer.disconnect(); state.resize?.disconnect();
    state.list?.removeEventListener('scroll', state.onScroll);
    if (onlineEditorsPanels.get(state.panel) === state) onlineEditorsPanels.delete(state.panel);
  }
  function trackOnlineEditorsPanel(panel) {
    if (panel.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-online-editors-panel') !== 'on') panel.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-online-editors-panel', 'on');
    if (onlineEditorsPanels.has(panel)) return;
    const state = { panel, queued: false, list: null, observer: null, onScroll: null, resize: null, measureHeight:true, naturalHeight:0, heightLimit:0, width:0 };
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') {
      state.resize = new ResizeObserver(entries => {
        const width = entries[0]?.contentRect.width || 0;
        if (width !== state.width) { state.width = width; state.measureHeight = true; }
        queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();
      }); state.resize.observe(panel);
    }
    state.onScroll = () => {
      if (!state.list) return;
      const scrolled = state.list.scrollTop > 0 ? 'on' : 'off';
      if (state.list.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-online-scrolled') !== scrolled) state.list.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-online-scrolled', scrolled);
    };
    state.observer = new MutationObserver(records => {
      const nativeChange = records.some(record => {
        const target = record.target.nodeType === 1 ? record.target : record.target.parentElement;
        if (target?.closest('[data-wme-studio-online-ui]')) return false;
        return record.type === 'characterData' || [...record.addedNodes, ...record.removedNodes].some(node => node.nodeType !== 1 || !node.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-online-ui'));
      });
      if (!nativeChange || state.queued) return;
      state.queued = true;
      queueMicrotask(() => paintOnlineEditorsPanel(state));
    });
    onlineEditorsPanels.set(panel, state);
    paintOnlineEditorsPanel(state);
    state.observer.observe(panel, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });
    queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();
  }
  const onlineEditorsTriggers = new WeakMap();
  function paintOnlineEditorsTrigger(bubble) {
    const label = bubble.querySelector('.text') || bubble;
    const match = (label.textContent || '').match(/\d[\d\s.,]*/);
    const count = match ? Number(match[0].replace(/\D/g, '')) : NaN;
    const shown = !Number.isFinite(count) ? null : count > 99 ? '99+' : String(count);
    const state = !Number.isFinite(count) ? null : count > 0 ? 'some' : 'none';
    for (const [name, value] of [['data-wme-studio-online-count', shown], ['data-wme-studio-online-state', state]]) {
      if (value == null) { if (bubble.hasAttribute(name)) bubble.removeAttribute(name); }
      else if (bubble.getAttribute(name) !== value) bubble.setAttribute(name, value);
    }
  }
  function trackOnlineEditorsTrigger(bubble) {
    if (onlineEditorsTriggers.has(bubble)) return;
    const observer = new MutationObserver(() => paintOnlineEditorsTrigger(bubble));
    onlineEditorsTriggers.set(bubble, observer);
    queueCompactAuxiliaryPlacement();
    observer.observe(bubble, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });
    paintOnlineEditorsTrigger(bubble);
  }
  const userBoxes = new WeakSet();
  function syncUserBoxEmail(host) {
    const email = (host.getAttribute('user-email') || '').trim();
    const at = email.lastIndexOf('@');
    if (at < 1) {
      host.style.removeProperty('--ws-user-email-mask');
      if (host.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-email')) host.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-email');
      return;
    }
    host.style.setProperty('--ws-user-email-mask', JSON.stringify(`${email[0]}${'\u2022'.repeat(7)}${email.slice(at)}`));
    if (host.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-email') !== 'masked') host.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-email', 'masked');
  }
  function trackUserBox(host) {
    if (userBoxes.has(host)) return;
    userBoxes.add(host);
    new MutationObserver(() => syncUserBoxEmail(host)).observe(host, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['user-email'] });
    syncUserBoxEmail(host);
  }
  const profileMenus = new Map();
  let profileMenuFrame = 0;
  function clearProfileMenuOffset(state) {
    state.container?.style.removeProperty('--ws-user-menu-offset');
    state.container?.style.removeProperty('--ws-user-menu-height');
  }
  function syncProfileMenus() {
    profileMenuFrame = 0;
    const header = document.getElementById('app-head');
    for (const state of profileMenus.values()) {
      if (!state.host.isConnected || !settings.enabled || !header?.isConnected || !state.host.hasAttribute('expanded')) {
        clearProfileMenuOffset(state); continue;
      }
      const container = state.shadow.querySelector('.wz-menu > .options-container');
      const panel = container?.querySelector('.options-wrapper');
      if (!container || !panel) continue;
      if (state.container !== container) {
        clearProfileMenuOffset(state); state.container = container;
        state.resize?.disconnect(); state.resize?.observe(panel); state.resize?.observe(header);
      }
      const style = getComputedStyle(container), rect = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden' || rect.width < 1 || rect.height < 1) continue;
      const shift = Number.parseFloat(style.translate.split(/\s+/)[1]) || 0;
      const nativeTop = rect.top - shift;
      const gap = Number.parseFloat(getComputedStyle(panel).marginTop) || 15;
      const limits = headerPanelLimits(rect.left,rect.width,gap);
      const capacity = Math.max(1,limits.bottom - limits.top), height = Math.min(rect.height,capacity);
      const cap = `${Math.floor(capacity)}px`;
      if (container.style.getPropertyValue('--ws-user-menu-height') !== cap) container.style.setProperty('--ws-user-menu-height',cap);
      const top = Math.max(limits.top,Math.min(header.getBoundingClientRect().bottom + gap,limits.bottom - height));
      const offset = Math.round((top - nativeTop) * 100) / 100 + 'px';
      if (container.style.getPropertyValue('--ws-user-menu-offset') !== offset) container.style.setProperty('--ws-user-menu-offset', offset);
    }
  }
  function queueProfileMenus() {
    if (!profileMenuFrame) profileMenuFrame = requestAnimationFrame(syncProfileMenus);
  }
  function trackProfileMenu(host, shadow) {
    if (profileMenus.has(host)) return;
    let owner = composedParent(host);
    while (owner && owner.localName !== 'wz-user-box') owner = composedParent(owner);
    if (!owner) return;
    const state = { host, shadow, container: null, observer: new MutationObserver(queueProfileMenus), resize: null };
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') state.resize = new ResizeObserver(queueProfileMenus);
    state.observer.observe(host, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['expanded'] });
    state.observer.observe(shadow, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    profileMenus.set(host, state); queueProfileMenus();
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => { if (!notifyingMapResize) queueProfileMenus(); }, { passive: true });

  const requestReplyForms = new Map();
  const replyTextMeasure = document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d');
  let requestReplyCaretMeasure=null;
  function stopRequestOpeningScroll(state) {
    const opening=state.opening;
    if (!opening) return;
    state.opening=null;
    cancelAnimationFrame(opening.frame); clearTimeout(opening.timer);
    opening.observer.disconnect(); opening.resize?.disconnect();
    opening.boundary.removeEventListener('load',opening.schedule,true);
    opening.boundary.removeEventListener('scroll',opening.onScroll,true);
    for (const type of ['wheel','touchstart','pointerdown','keydown','focusin']) opening.boundary.removeEventListener(type,opening.stop,true);
  }
  function startRequestOpeningScroll(state) {
    stopRequestOpeningScroll(state);
    const form=state.form,panel=form.closest('.problem-edit');
    if (!settings.enabled || !form.isConnected || !panel) return;
    const boundary=panel.closest(REQUEST_WINDOW_SELECTOR) || panel.closest('#panel-container > *') || panel;
    if (!['updateRequest','mapUpdateRequest'].includes(requestPopupKind(boundary))) return;
    // Follow the initial discussion/layout only. User interaction immediately takes over.
    const opening=state.opening={boundary,frame:0,timer:0,observer:null,resize:null,observed:new Set(),positions:new Map(),schedule:null,stop:null,onScroll:null};
    opening.stop=()=>stopRequestOpeningScroll(state);
    opening.schedule=()=>{
      if (state.opening!==opening || opening.frame) return;
      opening.frame=requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
        opening.frame=0;
        if (!settings.enabled || !form.isConnected) { opening.stop(); return; }
        if (!boundary.getBoundingClientRect().height) return;
        const nodes=new Set(panel.querySelectorAll('.conversation-view .comment-list'));
        for (let node=form.parentElement;node;node=node.assignedSlot || node.parentElement || node.getRootNode()?.host) {
          nodes.add(node); if (node===boundary) break;
        }
        nodes.add(form); nodes.add(panel);
        for (const node of nodes) {
          if (opening.resize && !opening.observed.has(node)) { opening.observed.add(node); opening.resize.observe(node); }
          if (!node.clientHeight || node.scrollHeight<=node.clientHeight+1 || !/^(auto|scroll)$/.test(getComputedStyle(node).overflowY)) continue;
          const bottom=node.scrollHeight-node.clientHeight;
          if (Math.abs(node.scrollTop-bottom)>1) node.scrollTo({top:bottom,behavior:'instant'});
          opening.positions.set(node,node.scrollTop);
        }
      });
    };
    opening.onScroll=event=>{
      const expected=opening.positions.get(event.target);
      if (expected!==undefined && event.target.scrollTop<expected-1) opening.stop();
    };
    opening.observer=new MutationObserver(opening.schedule);
    opening.observer.observe(panel,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});
    opening.resize=typeof ResizeObserver==='function' ? new ResizeObserver(opening.schedule) : null;
    boundary.addEventListener('load',opening.schedule,true);
    boundary.addEventListener('scroll',opening.onScroll,{capture:true,passive:true});
    for (const type of ['wheel','touchstart','pointerdown','keydown','focusin']) boundary.addEventListener(type,opening.stop,{capture:true,passive:true});
    // No idle polling or ongoing scroll lock after the opening window.
    opening.timer=setTimeout(opening.stop,5000);
    opening.schedule();
  }
  function revealRequestReply(field, form) {
    if (!settings.enabled || field.getRootNode().activeElement!==field) return;
    const panel=form.closest('.problem-edit,.place-update-edit');
    if (!panel) return;
    const send=form.querySelector('.send-button');
    let caretOffset=null;
    const caret=style=>{
      if (caretOffset!==null) return caretOffset;
      if (!requestReplyCaretMeasure) {
        const host=document.createElement('div'),mirror=document.createElement('div'),marker=document.createElement('span');
        host.id='wme-studio-reply-caret-measure';host.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');host.inert=true;
        host.style.cssText='position:fixed;width:0;height:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;';
        host.attachShadow({mode:'closed'}).append(mirror);document.body.append(host);
        requestReplyCaretMeasure={mirror,marker};
      }
      const {mirror,marker}=requestReplyCaretMeasure;
      mirror.style.cssText='position:fixed;left:0;top:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:break-word;box-sizing:border-box;border:0;';
      for (const name of ['fontFamily','fontSize','fontStyle','fontWeight','fontVariant','lineHeight','letterSpacing','wordSpacing','textIndent','textAlign','direction','tabSize','paddingTop','paddingRight','paddingBottom','paddingLeft']) mirror.style[name]=style[name];
      mirror.style.width=`${field.clientWidth}px`;
      const index=field.selectionEnd ?? field.value.length;
      mirror.textContent=field.value.slice(0,index);marker.textContent=field.value.slice(index,index+1) || '\u200b';mirror.append(marker);
      caretOffset=marker.getBoundingClientRect().top-mirror.getBoundingClientRect().top;
      mirror.textContent='';marker.textContent='';return caretOffset;
    };
    // Scroll only the request's own containers. Never scroll the page or reposition the panel.
    for (let node=field.parentElement;node;node=node.assignedSlot || node.parentElement || node.getRootNode()?.host) {
      const style=getComputedStyle(node);
      if (node.scrollHeight>node.clientHeight+1 && /^(auto|scroll)$/.test(style.overflowY) && node.clientHeight) {
        const bounds=node.getBoundingClientRect(),zoom=node.currentCSSZoom || 1;
        const top=bounds.top+node.clientTop*zoom+4,bottom=bounds.top+(node.clientTop+node.clientHeight)*zoom-4;
        const rect=field.getBoundingClientRect();let targetTop=rect.top,targetBottom=rect.bottom;
        const sendRect=send && node.contains(send) ? send.getBoundingClientRect() : null;
        if (sendRect?.height && sendRect.width) targetBottom=Math.max(targetBottom,sendRect.bottom);
        if (targetBottom-targetTop>bottom-top) {
          const fieldStyle=getComputedStyle(field),fieldZoom=field.currentCSSZoom || 1;
          targetTop=rect.top+(field.clientTop+caret(fieldStyle)-field.scrollTop)*fieldZoom;
          targetBottom=targetTop+(parseFloat(fieldStyle.lineHeight) || 20)*fieldZoom;
          // Keep Send beneath the current line when both fit in a short panel.
          if (sendRect?.height && sendRect.width && sendRect.bottom-targetTop<=bottom-top) targetBottom=Math.max(targetBottom,sendRect.bottom);
        }
        const delta=targetBottom>bottom ? targetBottom-bottom : targetTop<top ? targetTop-top : 0;
        if (Math.abs(delta)>.5) node.scrollTop+=delta/zoom;
      }
      if (node===panel) break;
    }
  }
  function trackRequestReply(form) {
    if (!form?.matches('.new-comment-form') || !form.closest('.problem-edit,.place-update-edit')) return;
    let state = requestReplyForms.get(form);
    if (!state) {
      state = {form,field:null,frame:0,resize:null,observer:null,schedule:null,opening:null};
      state.schedule = () => {
        if (state.frame) return;
        state.frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          state.frame = 0;
          const field = form.querySelector('wz-textarea')?.shadowRoot?.querySelector('textarea');
          if (field !== state.field) {
            state.resize?.disconnect(); state.field?.removeEventListener('select',state.schedule); state.field = field;
            if (field) {state.resize?.observe(field);field.addEventListener('select',state.schedule,{passive:true});}
          }
          if (!field || !form.isConnected) return;
          const style = getComputedStyle(field);
          const single = (parseFloat(style.lineHeight) || 20) + (parseFloat(style.paddingTop) || 0) + (parseFloat(style.paddingBottom) || 0);
          const compact = settings.enabled && settings.compactRequests;
          const formStyle = getComputedStyle(form);
          const available = form.clientWidth - (parseFloat(formStyle.paddingLeft) || 0) - (parseFloat(formStyle.paddingRight) || 0) - 38 - (parseFloat(style.paddingLeft) || 0) - (parseFloat(style.paddingRight) || 0) - 2;
          if (replyTextMeasure) replyTextMeasure.font = `${style.fontStyle} ${style.fontWeight} ${style.fontSize} ${style.fontFamily}`;
          const textWidth = (replyTextMeasure?.measureText(field.value).width || 0) + (parseFloat(style.letterSpacing) || 0) * Math.max(0,field.value.length - 1);
          const multiline = field.value.includes('\n') || (compact ? textWidth > Math.max(1,available) : field.clientHeight > single + 1);
          if (form.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-reply-multiline') !== multiline) {
            if (multiline) form.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-reply-multiline','on');
            else form.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-reply-multiline');
          }
          revealRequestReply(field,form);
        });
      };
      state.resize = typeof ResizeObserver === 'function' ? new ResizeObserver(state.schedule) : null;
      state.observer = new MutationObserver(state.schedule);
      state.observer.observe(form,{childList:true,subtree:true});
      form.addEventListener('input',state.schedule,{passive:true});
      form.addEventListener('change',state.schedule,{passive:true});
      form.addEventListener('focusin',state.schedule,{passive:true});
      form.addEventListener('keyup',state.schedule,{passive:true});
      form.addEventListener('compositionend',state.schedule,{passive:true});
      requestReplyForms.set(form,state);
      startRequestOpeningScroll(state);
    }
    state.schedule();
  }
  function cleanupRequestReplies() {
    for (const [form,state] of requestReplyForms) if (!form.isConnected) {
      stopRequestOpeningScroll(state);
      cancelAnimationFrame(state.frame); state.resize?.disconnect(); state.observer.disconnect();
      form.removeEventListener('input',state.schedule); form.removeEventListener('change',state.schedule);
      form.removeEventListener('focusin',state.schedule); form.removeEventListener('keyup',state.schedule); form.removeEventListener('compositionend',state.schedule);
      state.field?.removeEventListener('select',state.schedule);
      requestReplyForms.delete(form);
    }
  }
  const betaVersionTooltip = {scope:null,header:null,badge:null,originalTitle:null,originalTabIndex:null,
    observer:null,geometry:null,resize:null,queued:false,element:null,hovered:false,focused:false,frame:0};
  function hideBetaVersionTooltip() {
    const state = betaVersionTooltip;
    if (state.element) state.element.hidden = true;
    if (state.badge) {
      const ids = (state.badge.getAttribute('aria-describedby') || '').split(/\s+/).filter(id => id && id !== 'wme-studio-beta-tooltip');
      if (ids.length) state.badge.setAttribute('aria-describedby',ids.join(' '));
      else state.badge.removeAttribute('aria-describedby');
    }
    cancelAnimationFrame(state.frame); state.frame = 0;
  }
  function positionBetaVersionTooltip() {
    const state = betaVersionTooltip, tip = state.element, badge = state.badge, header = state.header;
    state.frame = 0;
    if (!tip || tip.hidden) return;
    if (!settings.enabled || compactLayoutEditing || !badge?.isConnected || !header?.isConnected) {
      hideBetaVersionTooltip(); return;
    }
    const anchor = badge.getBoundingClientRect(), rail = header.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!anchor.width || !anchor.height) { hideBetaVersionTooltip(); return; }
    const palette = getComputedStyle(header);
    const surface = palette.getPropertyValue('--ws-header-surface').trim() || palette.backgroundColor;
    if (tip.style.getPropertyValue('--ws-beta-tooltip-surface') !== surface) tip.style.setProperty('--ws-beta-tooltip-surface',surface);
    const rect = tip.getBoundingClientRect(), edge = 12, gap = 8;
    const left = Math.max(edge,Math.min(anchor.left + (anchor.width - rect.width) / 2,innerWidth - rect.width - edge));
    const tops = [rail.bottom + gap,rail.top - gap - rect.height];
    if (rail.top + rail.height / 2 > innerHeight / 2) tops.reverse();
    const candidates = tops.map(top => ({left,top,width:rect.width,height:rect.height}));
    let placed;
    if (compactLayoutActive()) {
      const obstacles = compactIslandSpecs.map(spec => compactVisibleRect(queryCompactIsland(spec))).filter(Boolean);
      for (const element of [document.getElementById('sidebar'),document.querySelector('.wz-map-ol-footer')]) {
        const obstacle = compactVisibleRect(element); if (obstacle) obstacles.push(obstacle);
      }
      placed = candidates.find(point => point.top >= edge && point.top + point.height <= innerHeight - edge && compactRectClear(point,obstacles,gap)) || compactFreePosition(candidates[0],obstacles);
    } else placed = candidates.find(point => point.top >= edge && point.top + point.height <= innerHeight - edge);
    if (!placed) { hideBetaVersionTooltip(); return; }
    for (const [name,value] of [['left',placed.left],['top',placed.top]]) {
      const pixels = `${Math.round(value)}px`; if (tip.style[name] !== pixels) tip.style[name] = pixels;
    }
  }
  function queueBetaTooltipPosition() {
    const state = betaVersionTooltip;
    if (state.element && !state.element.hidden && !state.frame) state.frame = requestAnimationFrame(positionBetaVersionTooltip);
  }
  function showBetaVersionTooltip() {
    const state = betaVersionTooltip;
    if (!settings.enabled || compactLayoutEditing || !state.badge || !(state.hovered || state.focused)) {
      hideBetaVersionTooltip(); return;
    }
    if (!state.element) {
      state.element = document.createElement('div'); state.element.id = 'wme-studio-beta-tooltip';
      state.element.setAttribute('role','tooltip'); state.element.hidden = true;
      document.body.append(state.element);
    }
    const version = document.querySelector('#app-head #version-info')?.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
    const text = version ? `Beta · ${version}` : state.originalTitle || 'Beta';
    if (state.element.textContent !== text) state.element.textContent = text;
    const ids = (state.badge.getAttribute('aria-describedby') || '').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (!ids.includes(state.element.id)) state.badge.setAttribute('aria-describedby',[...ids,state.element.id].join(' '));
    state.element.hidden = false; positionBetaVersionTooltip();
  }
  function onBetaPointerEnter(event) {
    if (event.pointerType === 'touch' || betaVersionTooltip.hovered) return;
    betaVersionTooltip.hovered = true; showBetaVersionTooltip();
  }
  function onBetaPointerLeave() { betaVersionTooltip.hovered = false; showBetaVersionTooltip(); }
  function onBetaFocusIn() { betaVersionTooltip.focused = true; showBetaVersionTooltip(); }
  function onBetaFocusOut() { betaVersionTooltip.focused = false; showBetaVersionTooltip(); }
  function onBetaKeyDown(event) {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      betaVersionTooltip.hovered = false; betaVersionTooltip.focused = false; hideBetaVersionTooltip();
    }
  }
  const betaTooltipEvents = [['pointerenter',onBetaPointerEnter],['pointerleave',onBetaPointerLeave],
    ['mouseenter',onBetaPointerEnter],['mouseleave',onBetaPointerLeave],['focusin',onBetaFocusIn],['focusout',onBetaFocusOut],['keydown',onBetaKeyDown]];
  function releaseBetaTooltipBadge() {
    const state = betaVersionTooltip; hideBetaVersionTooltip();
    if (state.badge) {
      for (const [type,listener] of betaTooltipEvents) state.badge.removeEventListener(type,listener);
      if (state.originalTitle == null) state.badge.removeAttribute('title');
      else state.badge.setAttribute('title',state.originalTitle);
      if (state.originalTabIndex == null && state.badge.getAttribute('tabindex') === '0') state.badge.removeAttribute('tabindex');
    }
    state.resize?.disconnect(); state.geometry?.disconnect();
    state.badge = null; state.header = null; state.hovered = false; state.focused = false;
  }
  function syncBetaVersionTooltip() {
    const state = betaVersionTooltip; state.queued = false;
    const badge = settings.enabled ? document.querySelector('#app-head #env-badge.beta') : null;
    if (badge !== state.badge) {
      releaseBetaTooltipBadge(); state.badge = badge;
      if (badge) {
        state.header = document.getElementById('app-head');
        state.originalTitle = badge.getAttribute('title'); state.originalTabIndex = badge.getAttribute('tabindex');
        badge.removeAttribute('title'); if (state.originalTabIndex == null) badge.setAttribute('tabindex','0');
        for (const [type,listener] of betaTooltipEvents) badge.addEventListener(type,listener);
        state.hovered = badge.matches(':hover'); state.focused = badge.matches(':focus-within');
        state.geometry ||= new MutationObserver(queueBetaTooltipPosition);
        state.geometry.observe(state.header,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['style','class']});
        if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') {
          state.resize ||= new ResizeObserver(queueBetaTooltipPosition);
          state.resize.observe(state.header); state.resize.observe(badge);
        }
      }
    }
    const scope = document.querySelector('#app-head #left-app-head') || document.querySelector('#app-head');
    if (scope !== state.scope) {
      state.observer?.disconnect(); state.scope = scope;
      if (scope) {
        state.observer ||= new MutationObserver(queueBetaVersionTooltip);
