        state.observer.observe(scope,{childList:true,characterData:true,subtree:true});
      }
    }
    if (badge) badge.removeAttribute('title');
    showBetaVersionTooltip();
  }
  function queueBetaVersionTooltip() {
    if (!betaVersionTooltip.queued) {
      betaVersionTooltip.queued = true; queueMicrotask(syncBetaVersionTooltip);
    }
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize',queueBetaTooltipPosition,{passive:true});

  const tileBuildStates = new Map();
  const tileBuildCards = new Map();
  const TILE_PROGRESS_SELECTOR = 'wz-progressbar,wz-progress-bar,progress,[role="progressbar"],.wz-progressbar';
  const TILE_PROGRESS_ATTRIBUTES = ['class','style','progress','value','max','min','percentage','percent','status','aria-valuenow','aria-valuemin','aria-valuemax','aria-valuetext'];
  const TILE_BUILD_FEEDS = Object.freeze({
    row: 'https://storage.googleapis.com/waze-tile-build-public/current-build/intl-status.json',
    usa: 'https://storage.googleapis.com/waze-tile-build-public/current-build/na-status.json',
    il: 'https://storage.googleapis.com/waze-tile-build-public/current-build/il-status.json'
  });
  const TILE_BUILD_REFRESH_MS = 60000;
  const tileBuildFeed = { region: null, snapshot: null, nextAt: 0, failures: 0, timer: 0, controller: null, generation: 0, readyHooked: false };
  function tileBuildRegion() {
    try {
      const region = pageWindow.W?.app?.getAppRegionCode?.();
      return Object.hasOwn(TILE_BUILD_FEEDS, region) ? region : null;
    } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("tileBuildRegion",studioError); return null; }
  }
  function tileBuildSnapshot(data) {
    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data)) return null;
    if (!Object.hasOwn(data,'current_build')) {
      // Waze omits current_build between builds and publishes the previous/next build instead.
      const keys=['previous_build','next_build'];
      if (!keys.some(key=>Object.hasOwn(data,key)) || keys.some(key=>Object.hasOwn(data,key) &&
          data[key] !== null && (typeof data[key] !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data[key])))) return null;
      return {percent:null,starting:false,status:'idle'};
    }
    const current = data.current_build;
    if (current === null) return { percent: null, starting: false, status: 'idle' };
    if (!current || typeof current !== 'object' || typeof current.build_status !== 'string') return null;
    const starting = current.build_status === 'STARTING';
    const running = current.build_status === 'RUNNING' || current.build_status === 'UNDER_INVESTIGATION';
    const raw = current.progress_percent;
    const value = (typeof raw === 'number' || typeof raw === 'string' && raw.trim() !== '') ? Number(raw) : NaN;
    const percent = running && Number.isFinite(value) ? Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, value)) * 100) / 100 : null;
    const status = current.build_status === 'UNDER_INVESTIGATION' ? 'error' : Number(current.delay_minutes) > 0 ? 'warning' : running || starting ? 'running' : 'idle';
    return { percent, starting, status };
  }
  function tileBuildFeedActive() {
    return compactLayoutActive() && !document.hidden && [...tileBuildStates.keys()].some(host => host.isConnected);
  }
  function stopTileBuildFeed() {
    clearTimeout(tileBuildFeed.timer); tileBuildFeed.timer = 0;
    tileBuildFeed.generation++;
    tileBuildFeed.controller?.abort(); tileBuildFeed.controller = null;
  }
  async function syncTileBuildFeed() {
    const region = tileBuildRegion();
    if (!tileBuildFeedActive() || !region) { stopTileBuildFeed(); return; }
    if (region !== tileBuildFeed.region) {
      stopTileBuildFeed();
      tileBuildFeed.region = region; tileBuildFeed.snapshot = null;
      tileBuildFeed.nextAt = 0; tileBuildFeed.failures = 0;
      for (const state of tileBuildStates.values()) state.percent = null;
      scheduleTileBuildStates();
    }
    if (tileBuildFeed.controller) return;
    clearTimeout(tileBuildFeed.timer); tileBuildFeed.timer = 0;
    const wait = tileBuildFeed.nextAt - Date.now();
    if (wait > 0) { tileBuildFeed.timer = setTimeout(syncTileBuildFeed, wait); return; }
    const controller = new AbortController(), generation = tileBuildFeed.generation;
    tileBuildFeed.controller = controller;
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 15000);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(TILE_BUILD_FEEDS[region], { signal: controller.signal, credentials: 'omit', cache: 'no-cache' });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Tile build status unavailable');
      const snapshot = tileBuildSnapshot(await response.json());
      if (!snapshot) throw new Error('Invalid tile build status');
      if (generation !== tileBuildFeed.generation || tileBuildFeed.controller !== controller) return;
      tileBuildFeed.snapshot = snapshot;
      tileBuildFeed.failures = 0; tileBuildFeed.nextAt = Date.now() + TILE_BUILD_REFRESH_MS;
      scheduleTileBuildStates();
    } catch (studioError) {
      // Hiding the page or changing regions intentionally cancels the previous request.
      if (generation !== tileBuildFeed.generation || tileBuildFeed.controller !== controller) return;
      reportStudioError("syncTileBuildFeed",studioError);
      if (generation === tileBuildFeed.generation && tileBuildFeed.controller === controller) {
        tileBuildFeed.failures++;
        tileBuildFeed.nextAt = Date.now() + Math.min(300000, TILE_BUILD_REFRESH_MS * 2 ** Math.min(tileBuildFeed.failures, 3));
      }
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      if (generation === tileBuildFeed.generation && tileBuildFeed.controller === controller) {
        tileBuildFeed.controller = null;
        if (tileBuildFeedActive()) tileBuildFeed.timer = setTimeout(syncTileBuildFeed, Math.max(0, tileBuildFeed.nextAt - Date.now()));
      }
    }
  }
  function initTileBuildFeed() {
    syncTileBuildFeed();
    if (!tileBuildFeed.readyHooked && pageWindow.SDK_INITIALIZED?.then) {
      tileBuildFeed.readyHooked = true;
      Promise.resolve(pageWindow.SDK_INITIALIZED).then(syncTileBuildFeed).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("initTileBuildFeed",studioError);});
    }
  }
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', syncTileBuildFeed);
  window.addEventListener('load', initTileBuildFeed, { once: true });
  window.addEventListener('pageshow', initTileBuildFeed);
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', stopTileBuildFeed);


  function tileBuildPercent(node) {
    const number = raw => raw != null && String(raw).trim() !== '' && Number.isFinite(Number(raw)) ? Number(raw) : null;
    const scaled = (raw, min = 0, max = 100) => {
      const value = number(raw);
      if (value == null || !(max > min)) return null;
      return Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (value - min) / (max - min) * 100)) * 100) / 100;
    };
    const fill = node.shadowRoot?.querySelector('.wz-progress-value,.progress-bar') || node.querySelector('.wz-progress-value,.progress-bar');
    if (fill) {
      const width = (fill.style.width || '').match(/^\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%\s*$/);
      if (width) return scaled(width[1]);
    }
    const aria = node.getAttribute('aria-valuenow');
    if (aria != null) {
      const percent = scaled(aria, number(node.getAttribute('aria-valuemin')) ?? 0, number(node.getAttribute('aria-valuemax')) ?? 100);
      if (percent != null) return percent;
    }
    for (const name of ['progress','percentage','percent','value']) {
      const raw = node.getAttribute(name);
      if (raw == null) continue;
      const max = number(node.getAttribute('max')) ?? (node.localName === 'progress' ? 1 : 100);
      const percent = scaled(raw, number(node.getAttribute('min')) ?? 0, max);
      if (percent != null) return percent;
    }
    const labelNode = node.shadowRoot?.querySelector('.wz-progress-message,[aria-valuetext]') || node;
    const label = (labelNode.getAttribute?.('aria-valuetext') || labelNode.textContent || '').match(/(?:^|\s)(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s*%/);
    if (label) return scaled(label[1].replace(',', '.'));
    for (const name of ['progress','percentage','percent','value']) {
      const percent = scaled(node[name], 0, number(node.getAttribute('max')) ?? (node.localName === 'progress' ? 1 : 100));
      if (percent != null) return percent;
    }
    if (fill?.parentElement) {
      const width = fill.getBoundingClientRect().width, track = fill.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect().width;
      if (track > 0) return scaled(width, 0, track);
    }
    return null;
  }
  function scheduleTileBuildStates() {
    for (const state of tileBuildStates.values()) state.schedule();
  }
  function tileBuildRingMask(percent) {
    const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, percent));
    if (!(progress > 0)) return 'linear-gradient(transparent, transparent)';
    const circumference = Math.PI * 58;
    const dash = progress < 100 ? ` stroke-dasharray='${(circumference * progress / 100).toFixed(3)} ${circumference.toFixed(3)}'` : '';
    const svg = `<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 64 64' width='64' height='64'><circle cx='32' cy='32' r='29' fill='none' stroke='white' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'${dash} transform='rotate(-90 32 32)'/></svg>`;
    return `url("data:image/svg+xml,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}")`;
  }
  function releaseTileBuildState(state) {
    state.observer.disconnect();
    for (const observer of state.shadows.values()) observer.disconnect();
    state.host.style.removeProperty('--ws-tile-build-progress');
    state.host.style.removeProperty('--ws-tile-build-ring-mask');
    state.bar?.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-tile-progress');
    state.bar?.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-tile-starting');
    state.bar?.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-tile-status');
    tileBuildStates.delete(state.host);
    if (!tileBuildStates.size) stopTileBuildFeed();
  }
  function paintTileBuildState(state) {
    state.queued = false;
    const host = state.host;
    if (!host.isConnected) { releaseTileBuildState(state); return; }
    const bar = host.querySelector(':scope > .tile-build-status');
    if (state.bar !== bar) {
      state.bar?.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-tile-progress');
      state.bar?.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-tile-starting'); state.bar?.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-tile-status'); state.bar = bar;
    }
    const feed = tileBuildFeed.region === tileBuildRegion() ? tileBuildFeed.snapshot : null;
    const starting = feed ? feed.starting : !!bar?.querySelector('.starting-status');
    if (starting && !state.starting) state.percent = null;
    const cards = new Set([...host.querySelectorAll('.tile-build-status-card'), ...tileBuildCards.keys()].filter(card => card.isConnected));
    for (const card of cards) trackTileBuildCard(card);
    const blocks = [...cards].map(card => card.querySelector('.tile-build-status-card-block:has(.on-progress)') || card.querySelector('.tile-build-status-card-block') || card);
    const progressScopes = [...cards].map(card => card.querySelector('.tile-build-status-card-block:has(.tile-build-status-card-block__current)') || card);
    const complete = blocks.length > 0 && blocks.every(block => {
      const title = block.querySelector('.tile-build-status-card-block__title');
      return title && !title.classList.contains('on-progress');
    });
    if (!starting && state.starting && !blocks.length) state.percent = null;
    state.starting = starting;
    const keep = new Set();
    let foundProgress = false;
    for (const scope of progressScopes) {
      for (const progress of scope.querySelectorAll(TILE_PROGRESS_SELECTOR)) {
        if (progress.shadowRoot) {
          keep.add(progress.shadowRoot);
          if (!state.shadows.has(progress.shadowRoot)) {
            const observer = new MutationObserver(state.schedule);
            observer.observe(progress.shadowRoot, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: TILE_PROGRESS_ATTRIBUTES });
            state.shadows.set(progress.shadowRoot, observer);
          }
        }
        const percent = tileBuildPercent(progress);
        if (percent != null && !foundProgress) { state.percent = percent; foundProgress = true; }
      }
    }
    if (!foundProgress && !starting && complete) state.percent = null;
    if (feed && !foundProgress) state.percent = feed.percent;
    for (const [shadow, observer] of state.shadows) if (!keep.has(shadow)) { observer.disconnect(); state.shadows.delete(shadow); }
    if (!bar) return;
    const progress = progressScopes.map(scope => scope.querySelector(TILE_PROGRESS_SELECTOR)).find(Boolean);
    const nativeStatus = progress?.getAttribute('status') || (progress?.shadowRoot?.querySelector('.error') ? 'error' : progress?.shadowRoot?.querySelector('.warning') ? 'warning' : progress ? 'running' : null);
    const status = nativeStatus || feed?.status || (state.percent != null || starting ? 'running' : 'idle');
    if (bar.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-tile-status') !== status) bar.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-tile-status', status);
    if (starting) {
      if (!bar.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-tile-starting')) bar.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-tile-starting', 'on');
    } else bar.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-tile-starting');
    if (state.percent == null) {
      host.style.removeProperty('--ws-tile-build-progress');
      host.style.removeProperty('--ws-tile-build-ring-mask');
      bar.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-tile-progress');
    } else {
      const percent = String(state.percent), value = percent + '%';
      if (host.style.getPropertyValue('--ws-tile-build-progress') !== value || !host.style.getPropertyValue('--ws-tile-build-ring-mask')) {
        host.style.setProperty('--ws-tile-build-progress', value);
        host.style.setProperty('--ws-tile-build-ring-mask', tileBuildRingMask(state.percent));
      }
      if (bar.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-tile-progress') !== percent) bar.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-tile-progress', percent);
    }
  }
  function trackTileBuildStatus(host) {
    if (!host || tileBuildStates.has(host)) return;
    const state = { host, bar: null, percent: null, starting: false, queued: false, observer: null, shadows: new Map(), schedule: null };
    state.schedule = () => { if (!state.queued) { state.queued = true; requestAnimationFrame(() => paintTileBuildState(state)); } };
    state.observer = new MutationObserver(records => {
      if (records.some(record => record.type !== 'attributes' || record.target !== host || record.attributeName !== 'style')) state.schedule();
    });
    tileBuildStates.set(host, state);
    state.observer.observe(host, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: TILE_PROGRESS_ATTRIBUTES });
    state.schedule(); initTileBuildFeed();
  }
  function trackTileBuildCard(card) {
    trackHeaderGuardWindow(card);
    if (tileBuildCards.has(card)) return;
    const discoverProgress = () => {
      for (const progress of card.querySelectorAll('wz-progressbar,wz-progress-bar')) {
        if (!roots.has(progress.shadowRoot) && !pending.has(progress)) inspect(progress);
      }
      scheduleTileBuildStates();
    };
    const observer = new MutationObserver(discoverProgress);
    tileBuildCards.set(card, observer);
    observer.observe(card, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: TILE_PROGRESS_ATTRIBUTES });
    trackTileBuildStatus(document.getElementById('tile-build-status'));
    discoverProgress();
  }
  const notificationsBoxes = new Map();
  let notificationsUnreadSnapshot = 0;
  const NOTIFICATION_ICON = 'svg,img,i,wz-icon,wz-image,[class*="icon" i]';
  const NOTIFICATION_UNREAD = /(?:^|[\s_-])(?:unread|un-read|not-?read|unseen|new)(?:[\s_-]|$)/i;
  const notificationText = node => (node.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  function notificationsUnreadCount() {
    const value = Number.parseInt(document.querySelector('#notification-button wz-notification-indicator')?.getAttribute('value') || '', 10);
    return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : 0;
  }
  function notificationRows(region) {
    const rows = new Map();
    for (const icon of region.querySelectorAll(NOTIFICATION_ICON)) {
      if (notificationText(icon) || [...rows.keys()].some(row => row.contains(icon))) continue;
      let holder = icon;
      while (holder.parentElement && holder.parentElement !== region && !notificationText(holder.parentElement)) holder = holder.parentElement;
      let row = holder.parentElement;
      if (!row || row === region) continue;
      for (let parent = row.parentElement; parent && parent !== region; parent = row.parentElement) {
        if (notificationText(parent) === notificationText(row)) break;
        if ([...parent.querySelectorAll(NOTIFICATION_ICON)].some(other => !notificationText(other) && !row.contains(other))) break;
        row = parent;
      }
      const height = row.getBoundingClientRect().height;
      if (height > 0 && height < 40) continue;
      rows.set(row, holder);
    }
    return rows;
  }
  function paintNotificationsBox(state) {
    state.queued = false;
    const box = state.box;
    if (notificationsBoxes.get(box) !== state) return;
    if (!box.isConnected) { releaseNotificationsBox(state); return; }
    const mark = (node, name, value) => {
      if (value == null) { if (node.hasAttribute(name)) node.removeAttribute(name); }
      else if (node.getAttribute(name) !== value) node.setAttribute(name, value);
    };
    const region = box.querySelector('.notifications-collection-region');
    const rows = region && !box.classList.contains('empty') ? notificationRows(region) : new Map();
    const unread = Math.max(notificationsUnreadCount(), notificationsUnreadSnapshot);
    const flagged = new Set([...rows.keys()].filter(row => NOTIFICATION_UNREAD.test(
      [row, ...row.querySelectorAll('[class]')].map(node => node.getAttribute('class') || '').join(' '))));
    const allUnread = !flagged.size && unread > 0 && unread >= rows.size;
    const keep = new Set();
    for (const [row, holder] of rows) {
      keep.add(row); keep.add(holder);
      mark(row, 'data-wme-studio-notification', 'row');
      mark(holder, 'data-wme-studio-notification', 'icon');
      mark(holder, 'data-wme-studio-notification-spaced', Number.parseFloat(getComputedStyle(holder.parentElement).columnGap) > 0 ? 'on' : null);
      mark(row, 'data-wme-studio-notification-unread', flagged.has(row) || allUnread ? 'on' : null);
    }
    for (const node of box.querySelectorAll('[data-wme-studio-notification]')) {
      if (keep.has(node)) continue;
      for (const name of ['data-wme-studio-notification', 'data-wme-studio-notification-unread', 'data-wme-studio-notification-spaced']) node.removeAttribute(name);
    }
    mark(box, 'data-wme-studio-notifications-unread', unread > 0 ? (unread > 99 ? '99+' : String(unread)) : null);
  }
  function releaseNotificationsBox(state) {
    state.observer.disconnect();
    if (notificationsBoxes.get(state.box) === state) notificationsBoxes.delete(state.box);
  }
  function trackNotificationsBox(box) {
    trackHeaderGuardWindow(box);
    if (notificationsBoxes.has(box)) return;
    const state = { box, queued: false, observer: null, schedule: null };
    state.schedule = () => {
      if (state.queued) return;
      state.queued = true;
      requestAnimationFrame(() => paintNotificationsBox(state));
    };
    state.observer = new MutationObserver(state.schedule);
    notificationsBoxes.set(box, state);
    state.observer.observe(box, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
    state.schedule();
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', event => {
    if (!event.composedPath().some(node => node?.nodeType === 1 && node.id === 'notification-button')) return;
    notificationsUnreadSnapshot = notificationsUnreadCount();
    for (const state of notificationsBoxes.values()) state.schedule();
  }, true);
  const onlineEditorsTagQueue = new WeakSet();
  const onlineEditorsText = node => (node?.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  const ONLINE_EDITORS_HINT = /online\s+editors/i;
  const ONLINE_EDITORS_SCOPE = '[data-wme-studio-online-ui],.online-editors-list-wrapper,#online-editors';
  let onlineEditorsScanning = false, onlineEditorsBarren = null;
  function isSmallOnlineEditorsSurface(node) {
    if (!node?.isConnected || node.matches('html,body,.app,#drawer,#sidebar,#editor-container')) return false;
    const rect = node.getBoundingClientRect();
    return rect.width >= 180 && rect.width <= 440 && rect.height >= 60 && rect.height <= 320;
  }
  function resolveOnlineEditorsPanel(titleNode) {
    if (!titleNode.isConnected) return;
    const nativePanel = titleNode.closest('.online-editors-list-wrapper');
    if (nativePanel) {
      trackOnlineEditorsPanel(nativePanel);
      const status = nativePanel.closest('#online-editors')?.querySelector('.online-editors-bubble');
      if (status && status.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-online-editors-status') !== 'on') status.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-online-editors-status', 'on');
      return;
    }
    let main = null;
    for (let current = titleNode, depth = 0; current?.parentElement && depth < 7; depth += 1) {
      current = current.parentElement;
      const text = onlineEditorsText(current);
      if (/ask another editor/i.test(text) && /\bYou\b/i.test(text) && isSmallOnlineEditorsSurface(current)) {
        main = current; break;
      }
    }
    if (!main) return;

    let wrapper = main;
    for (let current = main.parentElement, depth = 0; current && depth < 3; current = current.parentElement, depth += 1) {
      const text = onlineEditorsText(current);
      if (!isSmallOnlineEditorsSurface(current)) break;
      if (/ask another editor/i.test(text) && /\d+\s+online editors?/i.test(text)) wrapper = current;
    }
    trackOnlineEditorsPanel(main);

    for (const candidate of wrapper.querySelectorAll('*')) {
      if (candidate.childElementCount > 2 || !/^\d+\s+online editors?$/i.test(onlineEditorsText(candidate))) continue;
      let status = candidate;
      for (let depth = 0; status.parentElement && status.parentElement !== wrapper && depth < 3; depth += 1) {
        const parent = status.parentElement;
        const rect = parent.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (!/^\d+\s+online editors?$/i.test(onlineEditorsText(parent)) || rect.width > 220 || rect.height > 80) break;
        status = parent;
      }
      status.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-online-editors-status', 'on');
      break;
    }
  }
  function tagOnlineEditorsPanel(node) {
    if (node.nodeType !== 1) return;
    const launcher = node.classList.contains('online-editors-bubble'), list = !launcher && node.classList.contains('online-editors-list-wrapper');
    if (!launcher && !list) {
      if (node.childElementCount > 4 || onlineEditorsBarren?.contains(node)) return;
      const raw = node.textContent || '';
      if (!ONLINE_EDITORS_HINT.test(raw)) { if (onlineEditorsScanning) onlineEditorsBarren = node; return; }
      if (!/^Online editors(?:\s*\(\d+\))?$/i.test(raw.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()) || onlineEditorsTagQueue.has(node)) return;
    }
    if (node.closest('[data-wme-studio-online-ui]')) return;
    if (launcher) {
      if (node.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-online-editors-status') !== 'on') node.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-online-editors-status', 'on');
      if (node.localName === 'wz-button') trackOnlineEditorsTrigger(node);
      return;
    }
    if (list) { resolveOnlineEditorsPanel(node); return; }
    onlineEditorsTagQueue.add(node);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      onlineEditorsTagQueue.delete(node);
      resolveOnlineEditorsPanel(node);
    });
  }
  function discoverOnlineEditorsPanel(start) {
    if (!start || ![Node.ELEMENT_NODE, Node.DOCUMENT_FRAGMENT_NODE].includes(start.nodeType)) return;
    if (start.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE && start.closest(ONLINE_EDITORS_SCOPE)) {
      if (start.closest('[data-wme-studio-online-ui]')) return;
      const panel = start.closest('.online-editors-list-wrapper');
      if (panel) { resolveOnlineEditorsPanel(panel); return; }
      const nativeContainer = start.closest('#online-editors');
      if (nativeContainer) {
        const launcher = nativeContainer.querySelector('.online-editors-bubble');
        if (launcher) tagOnlineEditorsPanel(launcher);
        for (const panel of nativeContainer.querySelectorAll('.online-editors-list-wrapper')) resolveOnlineEditorsPanel(panel);
        return;
      }
    }
    if (!/Online editors/i.test(start.textContent || '')) return;
    if (start.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) tagOnlineEditorsPanel(start);
    const walker = document.createTreeWalker(start, NodeFilter.SHOW_ELEMENT, {
      acceptNode: node => {
        if (node.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-online-ui')) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
        const text = onlineEditorsText(node);
        if (!/Online editors/i.test(text)) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
        return node.childElementCount <= 4 && /^Online editors(?:\s*\(\d+\))?$/i.test(text)
          ? NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT : NodeFilter.FILTER_SKIP;
      }
    });
    while (walker.nextNode()) tagOnlineEditorsPanel(walker.currentNode);
  }
  function boundedText(node, limit) {
    const walker = document.createTreeWalker(node, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
    let text = '';
    while (walker.nextNode()) {
      text += walker.currentNode.nodeValue;
      if (text.length > limit * 4) return null;
    }
    return text.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', event => {
    let onlineEditorsControl = false, checked = 0;
    for (const node of event.composedPath()) {
      if (node?.nodeType !== 1) continue;
      if (++checked > 14) break;
      const text = boundedText(node, 80);
      if (text != null && text.length <= 80 && /online editors/i.test(text)) { onlineEditorsControl = true; break; }
    }
    if (!onlineEditorsControl) return;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const mapRoot = document.getElementById('WazeMap') || document.getElementById('map') || root;
      discoverOnlineEditorsPanel(mapRoot);
      for (const shadow of roots.keys()) discoverOnlineEditorsPanel(shadow);
    }));
  }, true);
  const STREET_VIEW_WINDOW_KEY = 'wmeStudio.streetViewWindow.v1';
  const streetViewWindow = { container: null, map: null, toolbar: null, dockButton: null, observer: null, resize: null,
    active: false, docked: false, size: {width: 560, height: 360}, rect: null, drag: null, frame: 0, dragFrame: 0, resizeTimer: 0, lastResize: 0, popup: null, sdk: null, sdkStop: null };
  function trackStreetViewSDK(sdk) {
    if (!sdk || (typeof sdk.StreetView?.isActive !== 'function' && typeof sdk.Map?.getLonLatFromPixel !== 'function')) return;
    queueMicrotask(() => {
      const state = streetViewWindow;
      if (state.sdk === sdk) return;
      if (typeof state.sdkStop === 'function') { try { state.sdkStop(); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("trackStreetViewSDK",studioError);} }
      state.sdk = sdk;
      try { state.sdkStop = sdk.Events.on({eventName:'wme-street-view-panel-visibility-changed',eventHandler:queueStreetViewWindow}); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("trackStreetViewSDK",studioError);}
      queueStreetViewWindow();
    });
  }
  function resizeStreetViewWindow(immediate = false) {
    const state = streetViewWindow;
    if (immediate || !state.drag || performance.now() - state.lastResize >= 80) {
      clearTimeout(state.resizeTimer); state.resizeTimer = 0; state.lastResize = performance.now(); resizeMap(true);
    } else if (!state.resizeTimer) state.resizeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      state.resizeTimer = 0; state.lastResize = performance.now(); if (state.active) resizeMap(true);
    },80 - (performance.now() - state.lastResize));
  }
  function streetViewWindowLimits() {
    const gap = 12, footer = compactVisibleRect(document.querySelector('.wz-map-ol-footer'));
    const map = document.getElementById('WazeMap')?.getBoundingClientRect();
    const header = compactVisibleRect(document.getElementById('app-head'));
    const aboveHeader = header && header.top + header.height / 2 > innerHeight / 2;
    return { left: settings.compactMode ? gap : Math.max(gap, map?.left || gap), right: innerWidth - gap,
      top: Math.max(gap, header && !aboveHeader ? header.top + header.height + gap : gap),
      bottom: Math.min(innerHeight - gap,footer ? footer.top - gap : innerHeight - gap,aboveHeader ? header.top - gap : innerHeight - gap) };
  }
  function fitStreetViewWindow(rect, limits = streetViewWindowLimits()) {
    const width = Math.min(Math.max(280,rect.width),Math.max(1,limits.right - limits.left));
    const height = Math.min(Math.max(220,rect.height),Math.max(1,limits.bottom - limits.top));
    return {width,height,left:Math.max(limits.left,Math.min(rect.left,limits.right - width)),top:Math.max(limits.top,Math.min(rect.top,limits.bottom - height))};
  }
  function writeStreetViewWindow(rect) {
    const state = streetViewWindow, previous = state.rect;
    state.rect = rect;
    for (const axis of ['left','top','width','height']) {
      const name = `--ws-street-view-${axis}`, value = `${Math.round(rect[axis])}px`;
      if (state.container.style.getPropertyValue(name) !== value) state.container.style.setProperty(name,value);
    }
    if (!previous || Math.abs(previous.width - rect.width) > .5 || Math.abs(previous.height - rect.height) > .5) resizeStreetViewWindow();
  }
  function saveStreetViewWindow(position = false) {
    const state = streetViewWindow;
    if (position && state.rect) {
      const {left,top,width,height} = state.rect;
      const point = {x:Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(left - 12) / Math.max(1,innerWidth - width - 24))),y:Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(top - 12) / Math.max(1,innerHeight - height - 24)))};
      compactIslandLayout = {...compactIslandLayout,streetView:point};
      try { Promise.resolve(GM_setValue(COMPACT_LAYOUT_KEY,compactIslandLayout)).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("saveStreetViewWindow",studioError);}); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("saveStreetViewWindow",studioError);}
      applyCompactLayoutVariables();
    }
    try { Promise.resolve(GM_setValue(STREET_VIEW_WINDOW_KEY,{...state.size,docked:state.docked})).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("saveStreetViewWindow",studioError);}); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("saveStreetViewWindow",studioError);}
  }
  function renderStreetViewDrag() {
    const state = streetViewWindow, drag = state.drag; state.dragFrame = 0;
    if (!drag) return;
    const dx = drag.x - drag.startX, dy = drag.y - drag.startY, rect = {...drag.rect};
    if (drag.edge === 'move') { rect.left += dx; rect.top += dy; }
    else {
      const minWidth = Math.min(280,drag.limits.right - drag.limits.left), minHeight = Math.min(220,drag.limits.bottom - drag.limits.top);
      if (drag.edge.includes('e')) rect.width = Math.max(minWidth,Math.min(drag.rect.width + dx,drag.limits.right - rect.left));
      if (drag.edge.includes('s')) rect.height = Math.max(minHeight,Math.min(drag.rect.height + dy,drag.limits.bottom - rect.top));
      if (drag.edge.includes('w')) { rect.left = Math.max(drag.limits.left,Math.min(drag.rect.left + dx,drag.rect.left + drag.rect.width - minWidth)); rect.width = drag.rect.left + drag.rect.width - rect.left; }
      if (drag.edge.includes('n')) { rect.top = Math.max(drag.limits.top,Math.min(drag.rect.top + dy,drag.rect.top + drag.rect.height - minHeight)); rect.height = drag.rect.top + drag.rect.height - rect.top; }
    }
    writeStreetViewWindow(fitStreetViewWindow(rect,drag.limits));
  }
  function finishStreetViewDrag(event, commit = true) {
    const state = streetViewWindow, drag = state.drag;
    if (!drag || (event && event.pointerId !== drag.pointerId)) return;
    if (event?.type === 'pointerup') { drag.x = event.clientX; drag.y = event.clientY; }
    cancelAnimationFrame(state.dragFrame); state.dragFrame = 0;
    if (event?.type === 'pointercancel' || !commit) writeStreetViewWindow(drag.rect);
    else renderStreetViewDrag();
    state.drag = null; state.container?.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-street-view-dragging');
    try { if (drag.handle.hasPointerCapture(drag.pointerId)) drag.handle.releasePointerCapture(drag.pointerId); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("finishStreetViewDrag",studioError);}
    window.removeEventListener('pointermove',moveStreetViewDrag,true);
    window.removeEventListener('pointerup',finishStreetViewDrag,true);
    window.removeEventListener('pointercancel',finishStreetViewDrag,true);
    if (commit && event?.type !== 'pointercancel') {
      if (drag.edge !== 'move') state.size = {width:state.rect.width,height:state.rect.height};
      saveStreetViewWindow(true);
    }
    resizeStreetViewWindow(true);
  }
  function moveStreetViewDrag(event) {
    const state = streetViewWindow, drag = state.drag;
    if (!drag || event.pointerId !== drag.pointerId) return;
    event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); drag.x = event.clientX; drag.y = event.clientY;
    if (!state.dragFrame) state.dragFrame = requestAnimationFrame(renderStreetViewDrag);
  }
  function startStreetViewDrag(event) {
    const state = streetViewWindow;
    if (event.button !== 0 || event.isPrimary === false || state.docked || !state.active || state.drag || compactLayoutEditing) return;
    if (event.target.closest('button,a,input,select')) return;
    const handle = event.currentTarget;
    state.drag = {handle,pointerId:event.pointerId,edge:handle.dataset.edge || 'move',rect:{...state.rect},limits:streetViewWindowLimits(),startX:event.clientX,startY:event.clientY,x:event.clientX,y:event.clientY};
    state.container.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-street-view-dragging',state.drag.edge === 'move' ? 'move' : 'resize');
    event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation();
    try { handle.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("startStreetViewDrag",studioError);}
    window.addEventListener('pointermove',moveStreetViewDrag,{capture:true,passive:false});
    window.addEventListener('pointerup',finishStreetViewDrag,true);
    window.addEventListener('pointercancel',finishStreetViewDrag,true);
  }
  function streetViewMarkerLink() {
    const sdk = streetViewWindow.sdk;
    if (!streetViewWindow.active || typeof sdk?.Map?.getLonLatFromPixel !== 'function') return null;
    const pin = document.querySelector('.street-view-layer .pin.pano-available:not(.dragging)');
    if (!pin?.isConnected || pin.hidden || pin.getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true' || pin.checkVisibility?.({checkVisibilityCSS:true}) === false) return null;
    // WME's zero-size pin is anchored at the live camera location, not the map center.
    // Google's address control is disabled by WME, so a Maps link need not exist in the panorama DOM.
    try {
      const style = getComputedStyle(pin);
      if (style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden' || Number(style.opacity) === 0) return null;
      const pixel = pin.getBoundingClientRect(), position = sdk.Map.getLonLatFromPixel({x:pixel.left,y:pixel.top});
      if (!position || !Number.isFinite(position.lat) || !Number.isFinite(position.lon) || Math.abs(position.lat) > 90 || Math.abs(position.lon) > 180) return null;
      const url = new URL('https://www.google.com/maps/@');
      url.search = new URLSearchParams({api:'1',map_action:'pano',viewpoint:`${position.lat},${position.lon}`}).toString();
      const direction = pin.querySelector('.crosshair > [style*="rotate"]')?.style.transform;
      const rotation = /rotate\(\s*([+-]?(?:\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)(?:e[+-]?\d+)?)deg\s*\)/i.exec(direction || '');
      if (rotation && Number.isFinite(Number(rotation[1]))) url.searchParams.set('heading',String((Number(rotation[1]) % 360 + 360) % 360));
      return url.href;
    } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("streetViewMarkerLink",studioError); return null; }
  }
  function openStreetViewWindow() {
    const state = streetViewWindow, links = state.container?.querySelectorAll('.panorama a[href]') || [];
    let url = null;
    // Google's own live Maps link contains the panorama/viewpoint, including historical imagery.
    for (const link of links) {
      try {
        const candidate = new URL(link.href);
        if (candidate.protocol !== 'https:' || !['google.com','www.google.com','maps.google.com'].includes(candidate.hostname) || !/^\/maps(?:\/|$)/.test(candidate.pathname)) continue;
        if (candidate.searchParams.get('map_action') === 'pano' || candidate.searchParams.get('layer') === 'c' || candidate.searchParams.has('cbll') || /,3a(?:,|\/|$)/.test(candidate.pathname)) { url = candidate.href; break; }
        const coordinates = (candidate.searchParams.get('ll') || '').split(',').map(Number);
        if (coordinates.length === 2 && coordinates.every(Number.isFinite) && Math.abs(coordinates[0]) <= 90 && Math.abs(coordinates[1]) <= 180) {
          const pano = new URL('https://www.google.com/maps/@');
          pano.search = new URLSearchParams({api:'1',map_action:'pano',viewpoint:coordinates.join(',')}).toString(); url ||= pano.href;
        }
      } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("openStreetViewWindow",studioError);}
    }
    url ||= streetViewMarkerLink();
    const notice = state.container?.querySelector('.ws-street-view-notice');
    const message = text => { if (notice) { notice.textContent = globalThis.WMEStudioI18n.translate(text); notice.hidden = false; } };
    if (!url) { message('Street View location is unavailable. Close and reopen Street View, then try again.'); return; }
    try {
      let popup = state.popup;
      const opening = !popup || popup.closed;
      if (opening) popup = window.open('about:blank','WMEStudioStreetView','popup=yes,width=1000,height=700,resizable=yes,scrollbars=yes');
      if (!popup) { message('Allow pop-ups for WME to open Street View in a separate window.'); return; }
      // Sever opener before navigating; never copy the editor session or reconstruct a Google API key.
      state.popup = popup;
      if (opening) { try { popup.opener = null; } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("openStreetViewWindow",studioError);} }
      popup.location.href = url; popup.focus(); state.popup = popup;
      if (notice) notice.hidden = true;
    } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("openStreetViewWindow",studioError);
      // A previously opened cross-origin window can still be navigated without reading its location.
      try { state.popup.location.href = url; state.popup.focus(); if (notice) notice.hidden = true; }
      catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("openStreetViewWindow",studioError); message('Allow pop-ups for WME to open Street View in a separate window.'); }
    }
  }
  function buildStreetViewToolbar(container) {
    const state = streetViewWindow, toolbar = document.createElement('div'); toolbar.className = 'ws-street-view-toolbar';
    toolbar.setAttribute('aria-label','Move Street View');
    toolbar.innerHTML = '<strong>Street View</strong><button type="button" class="ws-street-view-dock">Dock</button><button type="button" class="ws-street-view-popout" aria-label="Open Street View in a separate window" title="Open Street View in a separate window (Google Maps)"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M14 3h7v7M21 3l-10 10M10 5H5a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v12a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>';
    toolbar.addEventListener('pointerdown',startStreetViewDrag);
    toolbar.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',event => { if (state.drag) finishStreetViewDrag(event); });
    state.dockButton = toolbar.querySelector('.ws-street-view-dock');
    state.dockButton.addEventListener('click',() => { finishStreetViewDrag(); state.docked = !state.docked; saveStreetViewWindow(); queueStreetViewWindow(); resizeMap(true); });
    toolbar.querySelector('.ws-street-view-popout').addEventListener('click',openStreetViewWindow);
    const notice = document.createElement('div'); notice.className = 'ws-street-view-notice'; notice.hidden = true; notice.setAttribute('role','status');
    container.append(toolbar,notice); state.toolbar = toolbar;
    for (const edge of ['n','e','s','w','nw','ne','sw','se']) {
      const grip = document.createElement('div'); grip.className = 'ws-street-view-grip'; grip.dataset.edge = edge;
      grip.setAttribute('aria-label','Resize Street View'); grip.setAttribute('role','button'); grip.title = 'Resize Street View (arrow keys)'; grip.tabIndex = edge === 'se' ? 0 : -1;
      grip.addEventListener('pointerdown',startStreetViewDrag);
      grip.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',event => { if (state.drag) finishStreetViewDrag(event); });
      grip.addEventListener('keydown',event => {
        if (state.docked || !state.active || !['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown'].includes(event.key)) return;
        event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation();
        const amount = event.shiftKey ? 40 : 10, rect = {...state.rect};
        if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') rect.width -= amount;
        if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') rect.width += amount;
        if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') rect.height -= amount;
        if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') rect.height += amount;
        writeStreetViewWindow(fitStreetViewWindow(rect)); state.size = {width:state.rect.width,height:state.rect.height}; saveStreetViewWindow(true);
      });
      container.append(grip);
    }
    globalThis.WMEStudioI18n.localize(toolbar);
  }
  function clearDockedStreetViewTools() {
    const tools = streetViewWindow.dockTools?.element;
    if (tools) {
      tools.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-street-tools');
      for (const axis of ['left','top','height']) tools.style.removeProperty(`--ws-street-tools-${axis}`);
    }
    streetViewWindow.dockTools = null;
  }
  function placeDockedStreetViewToolbar() {
    const state = streetViewWindow, toolbar = state.toolbar, pane = state.container.getBoundingClientRect(), limits = streetViewWindowLimits();
    // Studio controls take the viewport's right rail; map tools stay left of the split.
    // Neither the Google panorama nor WME's native chevron/splitter is reparented.
    const tools = document.getElementById('overlay-buttons');
    if (state.dockTools?.element !== tools) clearDockedStreetViewTools();
    const toolRect = tools?.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (tools && !state.dockTools) state.dockTools = {element:tools,center:(toolRect.top+toolRect.height/2)/innerHeight};
    const width = 52, height = 84, left = innerWidth-width-12;
    const center = (state.dockTools?.center ?? .5)*innerHeight;
    const top = Math.max(limits.top,Math.min(center-height/2,limits.bottom-height));
    for (const [axis,value] of Object.entries({left,top,width})) {
      const name = `--ws-street-dock-${axis}`, pixel = `${Math.round(value)}px`;
      if (toolbar.style.getPropertyValue(name) !== pixel) toolbar.style.setProperty(name,pixel);
    }
    if (!tools || compactLayoutEditing) {
      if (compactLayoutEditing) clearDockedStreetViewTools();
      return;
    }
    const zoom = tools.currentCSSZoom || 1, railHeight = Math.min(toolRect.height,Math.max(1,limits.bottom-limits.top));
    const preferred = {left:pane.left-toolRect.width-20,top:Math.max(limits.top,Math.min(center-railHeight/2,limits.bottom-railHeight)),width:toolRect.width,height:railHeight};
    const obstacles = [document.getElementById('app-head'),document.getElementById('drawer'),document.getElementById('sidebar'),floatingHeader.locationLabel,
      ...compactLauncherObstacles(),...headerGuardWindows.keys()].filter(e=>e!==tools&&e!==state.container).map(compactVisibleRect).filter(Boolean);
    const placed = compactFreePosition(preferred,obstacles,{width:pane.left-8,height:limits.bottom+12},rect=>rect.left>=limits.left&&rect.top>=limits.top) || preferred;
    for (const [axis,value] of Object.entries({left:placed.left,top:placed.top,height:railHeight})) setElementVariable(tools,`--ws-street-tools-${axis}`,`${Math.round(value/zoom*100)/100}px`);
    if (!tools.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-street-tools')) tools.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-street-tools','on');
    observeCompactPlacement(tools);
  }
  function syncStreetViewWindow() {
    const state = streetViewWindow; state.frame = 0;
    const container = document.getElementById('street-view-container'), map = container?.closest('#map') || container?.parentElement;
    if (container !== state.container || map !== state.map) {
      finishStreetViewDrag(null,false); state.observer?.disconnect(); state.resize?.disconnect();
      clearDockedStreetViewTools();
      state.toolbar?.remove();
      if (state.container) {
        state.container.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-street-view');
        for (const element of state.container.querySelectorAll(':scope > .ws-street-view-toolbar,:scope > .ws-street-view-grip,:scope > .ws-street-view-notice')) element.remove();
        for (const axis of ['left','top','width','height']) state.container.style.removeProperty(`--ws-street-view-${axis}`);
      }
      state.container = container; state.map = map; state.toolbar = null; state.active = false; state.rect = null;
      if (container && map) {
        state.observer ||= new MutationObserver(queueStreetViewWindow);
        state.observer.observe(map,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class','hidden']});
        state.observer.observe(container,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['style','class','hidden','aria-hidden'],childList:true});
        if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') { state.resize ||= new ResizeObserver(() => { if (state.active) { resizeStreetViewWindow(); if (state.docked) queueStreetViewWindow(); } }); state.resize.observe(container); }
      }
    }
    let nativeActive = map?.id === 'map' ? map.classList.contains('street-view-mode') : !!container && getComputedStyle(container).display !== 'none';
    if (state.sdk) { try { const value = state.sdk.StreetView.isActive(); if (typeof value === 'boolean') nativeActive = value; } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("syncStreetViewWindow",studioError);} }
    const active = !!(container && map && ready && settings.enabled && !standaloneSignin && !editorProfile && !container.hidden && container.getAttribute('aria-hidden') !== 'true' && nativeActive);
    if (!active) {
      const wasActive = state.active; state.active = false; finishStreetViewDrag(null,false);
      clearTimeout(state.resizeTimer); state.resizeTimer = 0;
      state.toolbar?.remove();
      clearDockedStreetViewTools();
      root.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-street-view'); container?.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-street-view');
      if (container) {
        for (const element of container.querySelectorAll(':scope > .ws-street-view-toolbar,:scope > .ws-street-view-grip,:scope > .ws-street-view-notice')) element.remove();
        for (const axis of ['left','top','width','height']) container.style.removeProperty(`--ws-street-view-${axis}`);
      }
      state.toolbar = null; state.rect = null; if (wasActive) resizeMap(true); return;
    }
    const newlyActive = !state.active; state.active = true;
    if (!state.toolbar?.isConnected) buildStreetViewToolbar(container);
    const mode = state.docked ? 'docked' : 'floating';
    if (root.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-street-view') !== mode) root.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-street-view',mode);
    if (container.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-street-view') !== mode) container.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-street-view',mode);
    if (state.toolbar.dataset.mode !== mode) state.toolbar.dataset.mode = mode;
    const toolbarHost = state.docked ? document.body || root : container;
    if (state.toolbar.parentElement !== toolbarHost) toolbarHost.append(state.toolbar);
    state.toolbar.setAttribute('aria-label',globalThis.WMEStudioI18n.translate(state.docked ? 'Street View' : 'Move Street View'));
    if (state.docked) placeDockedStreetViewToolbar();
    else clearDockedStreetViewTools();
    const label = globalThis.WMEStudioI18n.translate(state.docked ? 'Float' : 'Dock');
    if (state.dockButton.textContent !== label) state.dockButton.textContent = label;
    state.dockButton.title = globalThis.WMEStudioI18n.translate(state.docked ? 'Float Street View' : 'Return to split view');
    if (!state.docked && !state.drag && !compactLayoutEditing) {
      const point = compactIslandLayout?.streetView || {x:.55,y:.5}, size = state.size;
      writeStreetViewWindow(fitStreetViewWindow({left:point.anchor === 'viewport' ? point.x * innerWidth : 12 + point.x * Math.max(0,innerWidth - size.width - 24),top:point.anchor === 'viewport' ? point.y * innerHeight : 12 + point.y * Math.max(0,innerHeight - size.height - 24),...size}));
    }
    if (newlyActive) resizeMap(true);
  }
  function queueStreetViewWindow() { if (!streetViewWindow.frame) streetViewWindow.frame = requestAnimationFrame(syncStreetViewWindow); }
  window.addEventListener('resize',() => { if (!notifyingMapResize) queueStreetViewWindow(); },{passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('blur',() => finishStreetViewDrag());
  Promise.resolve(GM_getValue(STREET_VIEW_WINDOW_KEY,null)).then(value => {
    if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
      streetViewWindow.docked = value.docked === true;
      if (Number.isFinite(value.width) && Number.isFinite(value.height)) streetViewWindow.size = {width:Math.max(280,Math.min(2400,value.width)),height:Math.max(220,Math.min(1600,value.height))};
    }
    queueStreetViewWindow();
  }).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("Studio initialization",studioError);});
  const STREET_VIEW_SPLIT_KEY = 'wmeStudio.streetViewSplit.v1';
  const streetViewSplit = { position: null, press: null, open: false, restores: 0, frame: 0, replaying: false, container: null, resize: null, observer: null };
  function streetViewSplitGeometry() {
    if (streetViewWindow.active && !streetViewWindow.docked) return null;
    const container = document.getElementById('street-view-container'), handle = document.getElementById('street-view-drag-handle');
    const parent = container?.parentElement;
    if (!container || !handle || !parent || !container.isConnected || !container.offsetWidth) return null;
    const frame = parent.getBoundingClientRect(), grip = handle.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (frame.width < 1 || grip.width < 1 || grip.height < 1) return null;
    const x = grip.left + grip.width / 2;
    return { handle, frame, x, y: grip.top + grip.height / 2, position: (x - frame.left) / frame.width };
  }
  function sendStreetViewDrag(target, type, x, y, buttons) {
    const init = { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, composed: true, clientX: x, clientY: y, screenX: x, screenY: y, button: 0, buttons };
    target.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointer' + type, { ...init, pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', isPrimary: true }));
    target.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouse' + type, init));
  }
  function replayStreetViewSplit(geometry, position) {
    const { handle, frame, x, y } = geometry, goal = frame.left + position * frame.width;
    streetViewSplit.replaying = true;
    try {
      sendStreetViewDrag(handle, 'down', x, y, 1);
      for (const part of [.25, .5, .75, 1]) {
        const at = x + (goal - x) * part;
        sendStreetViewDrag(document.elementFromPoint(at, y) || handle, 'move', at, y, 1);
      }
      sendStreetViewDrag(document.elementFromPoint(goal, y) || handle, 'up', goal, y, 0);
    } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("replayStreetViewSplit",studioError);} finally { streetViewSplit.replaying = false; }
    resizeMap();
  }
  function applyStreetViewSplit() {
    streetViewSplit.frame = 0;
    const position = streetViewSplit.position;
    if (position === null) return;
    const geometry = streetViewSplitGeometry();
    if (!geometry) { streetViewSplit.open = false; return; }
    if (!streetViewSplit.open) { streetViewSplit.open = true; streetViewSplit.restores = 0; }
    if (!ready || !settings.enabled || streetViewSplit.press || streetViewSplit.replaying || streetViewSplit.restores >= 2) return;
    if (Math.abs(geometry.position - position) * geometry.frame.width <= 2) return;
    streetViewSplit.restores += 1;
    replayStreetViewSplit(geometry, position);
  }
  function queueStreetViewSplit() {
    if (!streetViewSplit.frame) streetViewSplit.frame = requestAnimationFrame(applyStreetViewSplit);
  }
  function trackStreetViewSplit() {
    const container = document.getElementById('street-view-container');
    if (container === streetViewSplit.container) return;
    streetViewSplit.resize?.disconnect(); streetViewSplit.observer?.disconnect();
    streetViewSplit.container = container; streetViewSplit.open = false;
    if (!container) return;
    const queue = () => { if (streetViewSplit.position !== null && !streetViewSplit.press && !streetViewSplit.replaying) queueStreetViewSplit(); };
    streetViewSplit.observer ||= new MutationObserver(queue);
    streetViewSplit.observer.observe(container, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style', 'class', 'hidden'] });
    if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'function') return;
    streetViewSplit.resize ||= new ResizeObserver(queue);
    streetViewSplit.resize.observe(container);
  }
  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
    if (!event.isTrusted) return;
    streetViewSplit.press = null;
    if (event.button !== 0 || !ready || !settings.enabled) return;
    const handle = document.getElementById('street-view-drag-handle');
    if (!handle || !event.composedPath().includes(handle)) return;
    const geometry = streetViewSplitGeometry();
    if (geometry) streetViewSplit.press = { position: geometry.position, releasing: false };
  }, true);
  function releaseStreetViewSplit(event) {
    const press = streetViewSplit.press;
    if (!event.isTrusted || !press || press.releasing) return;
    press.releasing = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (streetViewSplit.press === press) streetViewSplit.press = null;
      const geometry = streetViewSplitGeometry();
      if (!geometry || !(geometry.position > 0 && geometry.position < 1) || Math.abs(geometry.position - press.position) * geometry.frame.width < 1) return;
      streetViewSplit.position = geometry.position; streetViewSplit.open = true;
      try { Promise.resolve(GM_setValue(STREET_VIEW_SPLIT_KEY, { position: geometry.position })).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("releaseStreetViewSplit",studioError);}); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("releaseStreetViewSplit",studioError);}
    }));
  }
  for (const type of ['pointerup','mouseup','dragend']) window.addEventListener(type, releaseStreetViewSplit, true);
  window.addEventListener('blur', () => { streetViewSplit.press = null; });
  const streetViewCloseButtons = new WeakSet();
  function enhanceStreetViewClose(button) {
    if (streetViewCloseButtons.has(button)) return;
    streetViewCloseButtons.add(button);
    if (!button.hasAttribute('aria-label')) button.setAttribute('aria-label', globalThis.WMEStudioI18n.t('Close Street View'));
    if (!button.hasAttribute('title')) button.setAttribute('title', globalThis.WMEStudioI18n.t('Close Street View'));
    if (button.localName === 'a' && !button.hasAttribute('href')) {
      if (!button.hasAttribute('role')) button.setAttribute('role', 'button');
      if (!button.hasAttribute('tabindex')) button.tabIndex = 0;
      button.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
        if (event.key !== 'Enter' && event.key !== ' ') return;
        event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation();
        if (!event.repeat) button.click();
      });
    }
  }
  const studioRanges = new WeakSet();
  function enhanceStudioRange(input) {
    if (studioRanges.has(input)) return;
    studioRanges.add(input);
    const update = () => {
      const min = Number(input.min || 0), max = Number(input.max || 100);
      const progress = max > min ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (input.valueAsNumber - min) * 100 / (max - min))) : 0;
      const fill = `${Number.isFinite(progress) ? progress.toFixed(3) : 0}%`;
      if (input.style.getPropertyValue('--ws-range-progress') !== fill) input.style.setProperty('--ws-range-progress', fill);
    };
    update();
    for (const type of ['input','change','focus','pointerdown']) input.addEventListener(type, update, { passive: true });
  }
  // Enhance only the legacy selects in Restrictions; the native field remains WME's source of truth.
  const restrictionSelects = (() => {
    const states = new Map(); let popup = null, sequence = 0, frame = 0;
    const enabled = () => ready && settings.enabled;
    const available = option => !!option && !option.hidden && !option.disabled && !option.parentElement?.disabled && !option.parentElement?.hidden;
    const eligible = select => !select.multiple && select.size <= 1;
    function restoreField(state) {
      state.select.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-restriction-native');
      for (const [name,value] of state.original) {
        if (value == null) state.select.removeAttribute(name); else state.select.setAttribute(name,value);
      }
    }
    function close(focus = false) {
      if (!popup) return;
      const state = popup; popup = null; cancelAnimationFrame(frame); frame = 0;
      state.button.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false'); state.button.removeAttribute('aria-activedescendant');
      try { if (state.menu.matches(':popover-open')) state.menu.hidePopover(); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("close",studioError);}
      state.menu.hidden = true; state.menu.remove(); state.resize?.disconnect();
      if (focus && state.button.isConnected && !state.button.disabled) state.button.focus({preventScroll:true});
    }
    function labelFor(select) {
      const explicit = select.getAttribute('aria-label'); if (explicit) return explicit;
      const references = (select.getAttribute('aria-labelledby') || '').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
      const named = references.map(id => select.ownerDocument.getElementById(id)?.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).join(' ');
      if (named) return named;
      const labels = [...select.labels || []].map(label => label.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).join(' ');
      return labels || select.closest('.restriction-editing-container')?.querySelector('.restriction-section-title')?.textContent.trim() || select.name || 'Restriction option';
    }
    function sync(state) {
      const {select,button,wrapper} = state;
      if (!select.isConnected) { release(state); return; }
      if (wrapper.parentElement !== select.parentElement) select.after(wrapper);
      const active = enabled() && eligible(select);
      wrapper.hidden = !active || select.hidden || select.style.display === 'none';
      if (!active) { if (popup === state) close(); restoreField(state); return; }
      select.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-restriction-native','');
      select.setAttribute('tabindex','-1'); select.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
      state.label.textContent = select.selectedOptions[0]?.label || '';
      button.disabled = select.matches(':disabled');
      button.tabIndex = select.hasAttribute('tabindex') && state.original.get('tabindex') != null ? Number(state.original.get('tabindex')) : 0;
      button.setAttribute('aria-label',labelFor(select));
      if (select.hasAttribute('aria-invalid')) button.setAttribute('aria-invalid',select.getAttribute('aria-invalid')); else button.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
      if (popup === state) { if (button.disabled || wrapper.hidden) close(); else render(state); }
    }
    function activate(state,index) {
      state.active = index;
      for (const node of state.menu.querySelectorAll('[role="option"]')) {
        const active = Number(node.dataset.index) === index;
        if (active) node.setAttribute('data-active','on'); else node.removeAttribute('data-active');
      }
      const item = state.menu.querySelector(`[data-index="${index}"]`);
      if (item) {
        state.button.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant',item.id);
        if (item.offsetTop < state.menu.scrollTop) state.menu.scrollTop = item.offsetTop;
        else if (item.offsetTop + item.offsetHeight > state.menu.scrollTop + state.menu.clientHeight) state.menu.scrollTop = item.offsetTop + item.offsetHeight - state.menu.clientHeight;
      }
      else state.button.removeAttribute('aria-activedescendant');
    }
    function render(state) {
      const selected = state.select.selectedIndex, previous = state.active;
      state.menu.replaceChildren(); let group = null;
      for (const [index,option] of [...state.select.options].entries()) {
        if (option.hidden || option.parentElement?.hidden) continue;
        const parent = option.parentElement;
        if (parent.localName === 'optgroup' && parent !== group) {
          const heading = document.createElement('div'); heading.className='ws-restriction-select-group'; heading.textContent=parent.label;
          state.menu.append(heading); group = parent;
        }
        const item = document.createElement('div'); item.className='ws-restriction-select-option'; item.dataset.index=String(index);
        item.id=`${state.id}-option-${index}`; item.setAttribute('role','option'); item.textContent=option.label;
        item.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(index === selected)); item.setAttribute('aria-disabled',String(!available(option)));
        state.menu.append(item);
      }
      const options = [...state.select.options];
      const active = available(options[previous]) ? previous : available(options[selected]) ? selected : options.findIndex(available);
      activate(state,active); queuePosition();
    }
    function position() {
      frame = 0; const state = popup; if (!state) return;
      if (!state.select.isConnected || !enabled()) { close(); return; }
      const rect = state.button.getBoundingClientRect(); if (!rect.width || !rect.height) { close(); return; }
      const vv = window.visualViewport, left = vv?.offsetLeft || 0, top = vv?.offsetTop || 0;
      const right = left + (vv?.width || innerWidth), bottom = top + (vv?.height || innerHeight), gap = 6;
      const below = Math.max(0,bottom - rect.bottom - gap - 8), above = Math.max(0,rect.top - top - gap - 8);
      const down = below >= Math.min(180,state.menu.scrollHeight || 180) || below >= above;
      const height = Math.max(0,Math.min(320,down ? below : above));
      if (height < 32) { close(); return; }
      const width = Math.max(0,Math.min(Math.max(rect.width,180),right - left - 16));
      state.menu.style.width=`${width}px`; state.menu.style.maxHeight=`${height}px`;
      state.menu.style.left=`${Math.max(left + 8,Math.min(rect.left,right - width - 8))}px`;
      state.menu.style.top=`${down ? rect.bottom + gap : Math.max(top + 8,rect.top - gap - Math.min(state.menu.scrollHeight || height,height))}px`;
    }
    function queuePosition() { if (popup && !frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(position); }
    function open(state) {
      sync(state); if (!enabled() || state.button.disabled || state.wrapper.hidden) return;
      if (popup === state) { close(); return; }
      close(); popup = state; state.active = state.select.selectedIndex;
      state.menu.hidden = false; (document.body || root).append(state.menu);
      if (typeof state.menu.showPopover === 'function') {
        state.menu.setAttribute('popover','manual'); try { state.menu.showPopover(); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("open",studioError); state.menu.removeAttribute('popover'); }
      }
      state.button.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true'); render(state); position();
      state.resize?.observe(state.button);
    }
    function choose(state,index) {
      const option = state.select.options[index];
      if (!enabled() || state.select.matches(':disabled') || !option || !available(option)) return;
      const changed = state.select.selectedIndex !== index;
      state.select.selectedIndex = index; close(true);
      if (changed) {
        state.select.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));
        state.select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));
      }
      queueMicrotask(() => { if (states.has(state.select)) sync(state); });
    }
    function key(state,event) {
      if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.altKey || !enabled() || state.button.disabled) return;
      const options = [...state.select.options], indices = options.map((option,index)=>available(option) && !option.hidden ? index : -1).filter(index=>index>=0);
      if (event.key === 'ArrowDown' || event.key === 'ArrowUp' || event.key === 'Home' || event.key === 'End') {

    function matchRange(label,query) {
      if (!query) return null;
      let flat='';const map=[];
      for (let index=0;index<label.length;index++) {
        const part=label[index].normalize('NFKD').replace(/\p{M}/gu,'').toLocaleLowerCase();

      }

      return at<0 ? null : [map[at],map[at+query.length-1]+1];
    }
    function paintName(node,label,range) {

        const from=cuts[index], to=cuts[index+1], muted=to<=pre, hit=!!range && from>=range[0] && to<=range[1];

      }
      node.replaceChildren(...parts);
    }

    function records(source) {

      for (const row of source.children) {
        const anchor=row.querySelector(':scope > a[data-toggle="tab"],:scope > a[role="tab"],:scope > button[role="tab"]');
