        const href=anchor.getAttribute('href') || '', key=href.startsWith('#') ? href.slice(1) : anchor.getAttribute('aria-controls') || anchor.id;
        if (!key || seen.has(key)) continue;
        const short=tabText(anchor), named=scriptLabel(anchor,row,key,short), label=knownName(named.label) || named.label, {pane,pending}=named;
        const nativeIconURL=tabIconURL(anchor,row), sourceURL=iconSourceFor(anchor,row,pane,key,label,short);
        const iconURL=nativeIconURL || iconCache.get(sourceURL)?.iconURL || '';
        const active=row.classList.contains('active') || anchor.classList.contains('active') || anchor.getAttribute('aria-selected')==='true';
        const disabled=row.classList.contains('disabled') || anchor.matches(':disabled,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"],.disabled');
        out.push({key,anchor,short,label,iconURL,nativeIconURL,sourceURL,pane,pending,active,disabled,search:searchText(`${short} ${label} ${key}`)});seen.add(key);
      }
      return out;
    }
    function close(state=popup,focus=false) {
      if (!state) return;
      state.open=false;if (popup===state) popup=null;
      if (typeof state.menu.hidePopover==='function' && state.menu.matches(':popover-open')) state.menu.hidePopover();
      state.menu.classList.remove('open');state.more.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
      state.more.removeAttribute('data-active');
      for (const row of state.menu.querySelectorAll('[data-drop],[data-dragging]')) {row.removeAttribute('data-drop');row.removeAttribute('data-dragging');}
      cancelAnimationFrame(positionFrame);positionFrame=0;
      if (focus && state.host.isConnected && !state.host.hidden) state.more.focus({preventScroll:true});
    }
    function position() {
      positionFrame=0;const state=popup;if (!state) return;
      if (!enabled() || compactLayoutEditing || !state.source.isConnected || state.host.hidden) { close();return; }
      const rect=state.host.getBoundingClientRect();if (!rect.width || !rect.height) { close();return; }
      const viewport=window.visualViewport, start=viewport?.offsetLeft || 0, right=start+(viewport?.width || innerWidth);
      const width=Math.min(rect.width,520,right-start-16), left=Math.max(start+8,Math.min(rect.left,right-width-8));
      const limits=headerPanelLimits(left,width,8), top=Math.max(limits.top,(viewport?.offsetTop || 0)+8);
      const footer=document.querySelector('.wz-map-ol-footer')?.getBoundingClientRect();
      const footerLimit=footer?.height && footer.width && footer.top>top ? footer.top-8 : limits.bottom;
      const bottom=Math.min(limits.bottom,footerLimit,(viewport?.offsetTop || 0)+(viewport?.height || innerHeight)-8);
      const below=Math.max(0,bottom-rect.bottom-6), above=Math.max(0,rect.top-top-6);
      const down=below>=Math.min(300,state.menu.scrollHeight) || below>=above, capacity=Math.min(620,down ? below : above);
      if (width<100 || capacity<100) { close();return; }
      const zoom=state.menu.currentCSSZoom || 1;
      state.menu.style.width=`${width/zoom}px`;state.menu.style.maxHeight=`${capacity/zoom}px`;
      state.menu.dataset.narrow=width/zoom<300 ? 'on' : 'off';
      const height=state.menu.getBoundingClientRect().height;
      state.menu.style.left=`${left/zoom}px`;state.menu.style.top=`${(down ? rect.bottom+6 : Math.max(top,rect.top-6-height))/zoom}px`;
    }
    function queuePosition() { if (popup && !positionFrame) positionFrame=requestAnimationFrame(position); }
    function open(state) {
      reconcile();sync(state);
      if (popup===state) { close(state,true);return; }
      close();if (!enabled() || state.host.hidden) return;
      state.hideTip();
      popup=state;state.open=true;state.search.value='';filter(state);state.results.scrollTop=0;
      state.menu.classList.add('open');
      if (typeof state.menu.showPopover==='function') {
        try { state.menu.showPopover(); }
        catch (error) { reportStudioError('Opening script picker',error);state.menu.removeAttribute('popover'); }
      }
      state.more.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');state.more.dataset.active='on';position();
      if (popup===state) {
        const rows=visibleRows(state), start=rows.find(row=>row.dataset.active==='on' && !row.querySelector('.choose').disabled) || rows.find(row=>!row.querySelector('.choose').disabled);
        if (start) {start.querySelector('.choose').focus();start.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});}
        else state.search.focus({preventScroll:true});
      }
    }
    function select(state,key) {
      const item=state.items.find(item=>item.key===key);
      if (!item || item.disabled || !item.anchor.isConnected) return;
      close(state);item.anchor.click();queue(state);
    }
    function togglePin(key) {
      if (!loaded || !preferences) return;
      const pins=preferences.pins, index=pins.indexOf(key);
      if (index>=0) save(pins.filter(pin=>pin!==key));
      else save([...pins,key]);
    }
    function reorder(key,target) {
      const pins=preferences?.pins || [], from=pins.indexOf(key), to=pins.indexOf(target);
      if (from<0 || to<0 || from===to) return;
      const next=[...pins];next.splice(from,1);next.splice(to,0,key);save(next);
    }
    function movePin(key,target,after) {
      if (!loaded || !preferences || key===target) return;
      const pins=preferences.pins.filter(pin=>pin!==key);let at=pins.indexOf(target);
      if (at<0) return;
      pins.splice(after ? at+1 : at,0,key);
      if (pins.join('\n')!==preferences.pins.join('\n')) save(pins);
    }
    const visibleRows=state=>[...state.pinnedList.children,...state.otherList.children].filter(row=>!row.hidden);
    function filter(state) {
      const query=searchText(state.search.value), pins=new Set(preferences?.pins || []);let count=0, pinned=0, others=0;
      for (const item of state.items) {
        const entry=state.entries.get(item.key);if (!entry) continue;
        const show=!query || item.search.includes(query);entry.row.hidden=!show;
        if (pins.has(item.key)) pinned++; else others++;
        if (show) count++;
        const paint=`${item.label}\n${show ? query : ''}`;
        if (entry.painted!==paint) {paintName(entry.label,item.label,show ? matchRange(item.label,query) : null);entry.painted=paint;}
        entry.row.draggable=!query && pins.has(item.key);
      }
      const total=state.items.length;let first=query ? visibleRows(state).find(row=>!row.querySelector('.choose').disabled) : null;
      for (const entry of state.entries.values()) {
        if (entry.row===first) entry.row.dataset.first='on'; else entry.row.removeAttribute('data-first');
      }
      state.menu.dataset.query=query ? 'on' : 'off';
      state.pinnedHead.hidden=state.otherHead.hidden=!!query;
      if (!query) state.otherHead.hidden=!others;
      state.pinnedCount.textContent=String(pinned);state.otherCount.textContent=String(others);
      state.unpin.hidden=!pinned;
      state.hint.hidden=!!query || pinned>0;
      const tuckedAway=state.items.hidden || 0;state.missing.hidden=!!query || !tuckedAway;
      if (tuckedAway) state.missingText.textContent=`${tuckedAway} more ${tuckedAway===1 ? 'tab is' : 'tabs are'} in the editor’s list but hidden there, so ${tuckedAway===1 ? 'it is' : 'they are'} not shown.`;
      state.empty.hidden=count>0;
      if (!count) state.emptyTitle.textContent=`No script matches “${text(state.search.value)}”`;
      state.count.textContent=query ? `${count} of ${total}` : `${total} installed`;
      state.wipe.hidden=!state.search.value;
      if (state.open) queuePosition();
    }
    function clearSearch(state) {
      state.search.value='';filter(state);state.search.focus({preventScroll:true});
    }
    // Prefer an explicitly exposed iconURL; otherwise read the public userscript's header.
    function tabIconURL(anchor,row) {
      for (const node of [anchor,row,...anchor.querySelectorAll('[data-icon-url],[data-iconurl],[iconurl]')]) {
        let value;
        try { value=node.iconURL || node.getAttribute('data-icon-url') || node.getAttribute('data-iconurl') || node.getAttribute('iconurl'); }
        catch (_) { continue; }
        const url=safeIconURL(value);if(url)return url;
      }
      return '';
    }
    function initials(label,short) {
      if (/^[A-Z]{2,3}$/.test(text(short))) return text(short);
      const name=text(label).replace(/^WME(?:\s*[-–—:]\s*|\s+)/i,'').replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g,'$1 $2'), words=name.match(/\p{L}[\p{L}\p{M}]*/gu) || [];
      if (/^[A-Z]{2,3}$/.test(words[0] || '')) return words[0];
      const letters=words.length>1 ? words.slice(0,2).map(word=>Array.from(word)[0]).join('') : Array.from(words[0] || '').slice(0,2).join('');
      return letters.toLocaleUpperCase() || 'SC';
    }
    function makeIcon(item) {
      const wrapper=document.createElement('span');wrapper.className='glyph';wrapper.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
      const fallback=()=>{wrapper.classList.add('initials');wrapper.dataset.logo='initials';wrapper.textContent=initials(item.label,item.short);};
      if (!item.iconURL || brokenIconURLs.has(item.iconURL)) {fallback();return wrapper;}
      wrapper.dataset.logo='iconURL';
      const image=document.createElement('img');image.src=item.iconURL;image.alt='';image.draggable=false;image.decoding='async';image.referrerPolicy='no-referrer';
      image.addEventListener('error',()=>{brokenIconURLs.add(item.iconURL);fallback();},{once:true});wrapper.append(image);
      return wrapper;
    }
    function sync(state) {
      if (!state.source.isConnected) { release(state);return; }
      if (state.host.nextElementSibling!==state.source) state.source.before(state.host);
      state.items=records(state.source);state.mark=fingerprint(state.source);
      const pendingPanes=new Set(state.items.filter(item=>item.pending && item.pane).map(item=>item.pane));
      for (const [pane,observer] of state.pendingPanes) if(!pendingPanes.has(pane)) {observer.disconnect();state.pendingPanes.delete(pane);}
      for (const pane of pendingPanes) if(!state.pendingPanes.has(pane)) {
        const observer=new MutationObserver(()=>queue(state));observer.observe(pane,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['title','aria-label','data-script-name','data-script-id','data-scriptid','class','href']});state.pendingPanes.set(pane,observer);
      }
      state.host.hidden=!enabled() || !loaded || !state.items.length;
      if (state.host.hidden) { state.source.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-script-tabs');close(state);return; }
      for (const item of state.items) if(!item.nativeIconURL)ensureIcon(item.sourceURL);
      state.source.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-script-tabs','on');
      if (!preferences) save(state.items.filter(item=>!item.disabled).slice(0,DEFAULT_PINS).map(item=>item.key));
      const selected=state.items.find(item=>item.active) || state.items.find(item=>!item.disabled) || state.items[0];
      const pinSet=new Set(preferences.pins);
      const pinned=preferences.pins.map(key=>state.items.find(item=>item.key===key)).filter(Boolean);
      const shown=[...pinned];
      if (!shown.some(item=>item.key===selected.key)) shown.push(selected);
      // Every pinned script stays visible: tabs that do not fit on the first row continue on the next one.
      if (!state.width) state.width=state.host.clientWidth;
      const tucked=[], visible=shown;
      const wide=!pinned.length && !(state.width>0 && state.width<WIDE_MIN);
      const signature=JSON.stringify([selected.key,wide,state.items.length,tucked.map(item=>item.label),visible.map(item=>[item.key,item.label,item.short,item.iconURL,item.disabled,pinSet.has(item.key)])]);
      if (signature!==state.signature) {
        state.signature=signature;state.hideTip();
        const focused=state.shadow.activeElement, focusKey=focused?.classList.contains('tab') ? focused.dataset.key : null;
        const buttons=visible.map(item=>{
          const button=document.createElement('button'), open=item.key===selected.key;
          button.type='button';button.className='tab';button.dataset.key=item.key;button.setAttribute('role','tab');
          button.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(open));button.setAttribute('aria-controls',item.key);
          button.tabIndex=open ? 0 : -1;button.disabled=item.disabled;
          button.draggable=pinSet.has(item.key);button.dataset.tip=item.label;
          button.setAttribute('aria-label',item.label);button.append(makeIcon(item));
          if (open) {const label=document.createElement('span');label.className='label';label.textContent=shortName(item.label);button.append(label);}
          return button;
        });
        state.tabs.replaceChildren(...buttons);
        if (focusKey) buttons.find(button=>button.dataset.key===focusKey)?.focus({preventScroll:true});
        state.chip.hidden=!tucked.length;state.chip.textContent=`+${tucked.length}`;
        if (tucked.length) {
          state.chip.dataset.tip=tucked.map(item=>shortName(item.label)).join(', ');
          state.chip.setAttribute('aria-label',`${tucked.length} more pinned ${tucked.length===1 ? 'script' : 'scripts'}`);
        }
        state.bar.dataset.pins=wide ? 'none' : 'some';
        state.moreCount.textContent=String(state.items.length);
      }
      const present=new Set(), pinnedRows=[], otherRows=[];
      for (const item of [...pinned,...state.items.filter(item=>!pinSet.has(item.key))]) {
        present.add(item.key);let entry=state.entries.get(item.key);
        if (!entry) {
          const row=document.createElement('div'),grip=document.createElement('span'),choose=document.createElement('button'),tile=document.createElement('span'),label=document.createElement('span'),
            badge=document.createElement('span'),enter=document.createElement('kbd'),pin=document.createElement('button');
          row.className='entry';grip.className='grip';grip.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');grip.innerHTML=gripIcon;
          choose.type=pin.type='button';choose.className='choose';pin.className='pin';tile.className='tile';label.className='name';
          badge.className='badge';badge.textContent='Open';enter.className='enter';enter.textContent='Enter';enter.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
          row.dataset.key=choose.dataset.key=pin.dataset.key=item.key;choose.dataset.action='choose';pin.dataset.action='pin';pin.innerHTML=pinIcon;
          choose.append(tile,label);row.append(grip,choose,badge,enter,pin);
          entry={row,choose,pin,tile,label,labelText:null,iconURL:null,short:null,painted:null};state.entries.set(item.key,entry);
        }
        if (item.label!==entry.labelText || item.iconURL!==entry.iconURL || item.short!==entry.short) {
          entry.tile.replaceChildren(makeIcon(item));entry.painted=null;
          entry.labelText=item.label;entry.iconURL=item.iconURL;entry.short=item.short;
        }
        entry.choose.title=item.label;entry.choose.disabled=item.disabled;entry.choose.setAttribute('aria-current',item.active ? 'true' : 'false');
        entry.row.dataset.active=item.active ? 'on' : 'off';
        const isPinned=pinSet.has(item.key);
        entry.row.dataset.pinned=isPinned ? 'on' : 'off';
        entry.pin.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(isPinned));entry.pin.disabled=false;
        entry.pin.title=isPinned ? `Unpin ${item.label}` : `Pin ${item.label} to the bar`;
        entry.pin.setAttribute('aria-label',entry.pin.title);
        (isPinned ? pinnedRows : otherRows).push(entry.row);
      }
      for (const [key,entry] of state.entries) if (!present.has(key)) { entry.row.remove();state.entries.delete(key); }
      const place=(list,rows)=>rows.forEach((row,index)=>{if (list.children[index]!==row) list.insertBefore(row,list.children[index] || null);});
      place(state.pinnedList,pinnedRows);place(state.otherList,otherRows);
      filter(state);
      if (state.refocus) {
        // Moving a row between the two lists drops its focus; hand it back to the same control.
        const entry=state.entries.get(state.refocus.key), part=state.refocus.part;state.refocus=null;
        if (state.open && entry && !entry.row.hidden) (part==='pin' ? entry.pin : entry.choose).focus();
      }
      if (state.open) queuePosition();
    }
    function release(state) {

      state.source.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-script-tabs');state.host.remove();states.delete(state.source);
    }

  function inspect(host) {

    }

    const shadow = host.shadowRoot;

        upgradeNotifications.add(host);

        });
      }

    if (host.localName === 'wz-menu') { trackProfileMenu(host, shadow); trackTaskMenu(host, shadow); }
    if (roots.has(shadow)) return;
    const item = { host, style: null, shared: null, observer: null };
    attachComponentStyle(shadow, item);
    if (host.localName === 'wz-card' && headerGuardWindows.has(host.closest(REQUEST_WINDOW_SELECTOR))) queueHeaderGuardWindows();
    const observer = new MutationObserver(records => {
      if (host.isConnected) {
        attachComponentStyle(shadow, item);
        if (host.localName === 'wz-card' && headerGuardWindows.has(host.closest(REQUEST_WINDOW_SELECTOR))) queueHeaderGuardWindows();
      }
      collect(records);
    });
    item.observer = observer;
    roots.set(shadow, item);
    observer.observe(shadow, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    discover(shadow);
  }

  const SVG_NAMESPACE = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  const mapVectorRecord = record => record.target.namespaceURI === SVG_NAMESPACE &&
    !!record.target.closest('.olMapViewport, .olLayerDiv, #render-root');
  function collect(records) {
    let kept = records;
    for (let index = 0; index < records.length; index++) {
      if (mapVectorRecord(records[index])) { if (kept === records) kept = records.slice(0, index); }
      else if (kept !== records) kept.push(records[index]);
    }
    if (kept !== records) {
      records = kept;
      if (!records.length) {
        if (!tileBuildStates.size) trackTileBuildStatus(document.getElementById('tile-build-status'));
        return;
      }
    }
    if (compactLayoutEditor) records = records.filter(record => {
      const target = record.target.nodeType === 1 ? record.target : record.target.host || record.target.parentElement;
      if (target?.closest?.(arrangeOwned)) return false;
      const nodes = [...record.addedNodes,...record.removedNodes];
      return !nodes.length || !nodes.every(node => node.nodeType === 1 && node.matches(arrangeOwned));
    });
    if (!records.length) return;
    compatibility.collect(records);
    if (!tileBuildStates.size) trackTileBuildStatus(document.getElementById('tile-build-status'));
    for (const record of records) {
      for (const node of record.addedNodes) {
        if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE && /Online editors/i.test(node.textContent || '') && record.target.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
          discoverOnlineEditorsPanel(record.target);
        } else if (node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE && !/^(?:img|svg|path|canvas|script|style)$/.test(node.localName)) {
          compatibility.inspect(node);
          if (node.id === 'tile-build-status') trackTileBuildStatus(node);
          if (node.matches('.tile-build-status-card')) trackTileBuildCard(node);
          if (node.matches('wz-progressbar,wz-progress-bar')) {
            const card = node.closest('.tile-build-status-card');
            if (card) trackTileBuildCard(card);
          }
          discoverOnlineEditorsPanel(node);
        }
      }
    }
    if (!cleanupQueued && records.some(record => record.removedNodes.length && [...record.removedNodes].some(n => n.nodeType === 1 && !/^(?:img|svg|path|canvas)$/.test(n.localName) && (record.target.nodeType !== 1 || !excluded(record.target) || n.matches('[data-wme-studio-compat]'))))) {
      cleanupQueued = true; queueMicrotask(cleanupDetached);
    }
    records = records.filter(record => record.target.nodeType !== 1 || !excluded(record.target));
    if (laneSidebars.size && ready && settings.enabled && !laneFrame && !document.hidden && records.some(record => {
      const target = record.target.nodeType === 1 ? record.target : record.target.host || record.target.parentElement;
      return target && (target === root || target === document.body || target.matches('.app') || [...laneSidebars.keys()].some(sidebar => insideSidebar(target, sidebar)));
    })) scheduleLaneSizing();
    for (const record of records) {
      for (const node of record.addedNodes) if (node.nodeType === 1) {
        if (!studioUpdateReported && !studioUpdateTimer && (node.id==='WazeMap' || node.id==='WWSU-Container' || node.matches('.app') && node.querySelector('#WazeMap'))) showStudioUpdateNotes();
        if (node.localName === 'iframe') trackChatFrame(node);
        if (!excluded(node)) queue.add(node);
      }
    }
    if (queue.size && !scanQueued) {
      scanQueued = true;
      queueMicrotask(() => {
        scanQueued = false;
        const added = new Set(queue); queue.clear();
        discoverDepth++;
        try {
          for (const node of added) if (node.isConnected) {
            let covered = false;
            for (let parent = node.parentElement; parent; parent = parent.parentElement) {
              if (added.has(parent)) { covered = true; break; }
            }
            if (!covered) discover(node);
          }
        } finally { leaveDiscover(); }
        if (chatFrames.size && ready && !chatStyleText) syncChatTheme();
        refreshStudioLauncher();
        if (ready && settings.enabled && settings.viewportBrightness < 100 && !viewportOverlay?.isConnected) syncViewportOverlay();
      });
    }
  }
  // The map redraws its vector layers by replacing thousands of <svg> children at a time. The two
  // document-wide observers used to be handed a record for each of them, only to discard it. They now watch
  // the document *around* those <svg> roots: every ancestor of a vector root is watched for its own children,
  // every other branch as a whole. Records from outside a vector root arrive exactly as before; a vector root
  // that appears, moves or goes away re-plans the watch. With no vector root the whole document is watched.
  const studioVectorWatch = (() => {
    const SVG = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', VECTORS = '.olMapViewport svg,.olLayerDiv svg,#render-root svg';
    const clients = [], seen = new WeakSet();
    let path = new Set(), vectors = new Set(), whole = true;
    const outermost = svg => { for (let node = svg.parentNode; node; node = node.parentNode) if (node.localName === 'svg') return false; return true; };
    function attach(client) {
      const late = client.observer.takeRecords();
      client.observer.disconnect();
      if (whole) client.observer.observe(document.documentElement, client.options);
      else for (const node of path) {
        client.observer.observe(node, { childList: true });
        for (let child = node.firstElementChild; child; child = child.nextElementSibling) if (!path.has(child) && !vectors.has(child)) client.observer.observe(child, client.options);
      }
      if (late.length) queueMicrotask(() => client.handler(late));
    }
    function plan() {
      const nextPath = new Set(), nextVectors = new Set();
      try {
        for (const svg of document.querySelectorAll(VECTORS)) {
          if (!outermost(svg) || svg.querySelector('foreignObject')) continue;
          nextVectors.add(svg);
          for (let node = svg.parentNode; node && node.nodeType === 1; node = node.parentNode) nextPath.add(node);
        }
      } catch (_) { nextPath.clear(); nextVectors.clear(); }
      if (!nextPath.has(document.documentElement)) { nextPath.clear(); nextVectors.clear(); }
      path = nextPath; vectors = nextVectors; whole = !nextVectors.size;
      for (const client of clients) {
        try { attach(client); }
        catch (_) { whole = true; path = new Set(); vectors = new Set(); client.observer.disconnect(); client.observer.observe(document.documentElement, client.options); }
      }
    }
    function scan(records) {
      let replan = false; const grown = [];
      for (const record of records) {
        if (record.type !== 'childList' || seen.has(record)) continue;
        seen.add(record);
        const beside = path.has(record.target);
        for (const node of record.removedNodes) if (path.has(node) || vectors.has(node)) replan = true;
        for (const node of record.addedNodes) {
          if (node.nodeType !== 1) continue;
          if (node.localName === 'svg' ? node.matches(VECTORS) && outermost(node) : node.namespaceURI !== SVG && !!node.firstElementChild && !!node.querySelector(VECTORS)) replan = true;
          else if (beside && node.parentNode === record.target && !path.has(node) && !vectors.has(node)) grown.push(node);
        }
      }
      if (replan) plan();
      else for (const node of grown) for (const client of clients) client.observer.observe(node, client.options);
    }
    return Object.freeze({
      watch(handler, options) {
        const client = { handler, options, observer: null };
        client.observer = new MutationObserver(records => { try { scan(records); } catch (_) { whole = false; plan(); } handler(records); });
        clients.push(client);
        if (clients.length === 1) plan(); else attach(client);
        return client.observer;
      },
      refresh: plan
    });
  })();
  globalThis.WMEStudioVectorWatch = studioVectorWatch;
  const observer = studioVectorWatch.watch(collect, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  // Use WazeWrap's shared update window and per-version history.

<p>Studio restyles the Waze Map Editor: Light, Dark and Full black themes, your own accent colour, and a Floating layout whose islands you can arrange.</p>
<ul>
<li>Press Shift+P to search every setting and command.</li>

<li>Your scripts are on the script bar in the side panel. Pin the ones you use most.</li>
<li>Script authors: Settings &gt; Developers shows how to give your tab a name and an icon.</li>
</ul>
<p>Thank you for trying it.</p>`;
  let studioUpdateReported=false, studioUpdateTimer=0, studioUpdateAttempts=0;

  Promise.all([

  }).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("Studio initialization",studioError);});
  // On-demand workspace tools: no editor scans, timers or background profile polling.
  globalThis.WMEStudioWorkspaces = (() => {
    const KEY = 'wmeStudio.workspaceProfiles.v1', MAX = 12, LIMIT = 262144;
    const layoutKeys = ['hudScale','panelScale','compactSnapEdges','compactSnapCenter','layerColumns'];
    const sizeKinds = new Set(['updateRequest','mapUpdateRequest','placeUpdateRequest','mapProblem','mapSuggestion','messages','sidePanel','streetView']);
    let busy = false, profileUndo = null;
    const copy = value => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
    const record = value => value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
    const error = text => { throw new Error(text); };
    function bounded(value, low, high) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < low || value > high) error('Backup contains an invalid size or position.');
      return value;
    }
    function preferences(value, keys) {
      if (!record(value)) error('Backup settings are missing.');
      const clean = config.sanitize(value), out = {};
      for (const key of keys) {
        if (!Object.hasOwn(value,key) || value[key] !== clean[key]) error('Backup contains an invalid setting.');
        out[key] = clean[key];
      }
      return out;
    }
    function sizes(value) {
      if (!record(value)) error('Backup panel sizes are invalid.');
      const out = {};
      for (const [kind,size] of Object.entries(value)) {
        if (!sizeKinds.has(kind) || !record(size)) error('Backup panel sizes are invalid.');
        const point = {};
        for (const axis of ['width','height']) if (Object.hasOwn(size,axis)) point[axis] = bounded(size[axis],80,4000);
        if (Object.keys(point).length) out[kind] = point;
      }
      return out;
    }
    function validateSnapshot(value) {
      if (!record(value) || !record(value.workspace)) error('Backup layout is missing.');
      const source = value.workspace, workspace = preferences(source,['compactMode','compactHeaderFullWidth','compactHeaderWidth']);
      if (source.layout !== null) {
        if (!record(source.layout)) error('Backup island positions are invalid.');
        const ids = new Set(compactIslandSpecs.map(spec=>spec.id));
        for (const [id,point] of Object.entries(source.layout)) {
          if (!ids.has(id) || !record(point)) error('Backup island positions are invalid.');
          bounded(point.x,0,1); bounded(point.y,0,1);
          if (Object.hasOwn(point,'anchor') && point.anchor !== 'viewport') error('Backup island positions are invalid.');
        }
      }
      workspace.layout = sanitizeCompactIslandLayout(source.layout);
      if (source.chatPosition !== null && !record(source.chatPosition)) error('Backup Messages position is invalid.');
      workspace.chatPosition = source.chatPosition === null ? null : {x:bounded(source.chatPosition.x,-10000,10000),y:bounded(source.chatPosition.y,-10000,10000)};
      const view = value.streetView;
      if (!record(view) || typeof view.docked !== 'boolean') error('Backup Street View layout is invalid.');
      return {workspace,layoutSettings:preferences(value.layoutSettings,layoutKeys),panelSizes:sizes(value.panelSizes),
        streetView:{width:bounded(view.width,280,2400),height:bounded(view.height,220,1600),docked:view.docked}};
    }
    function profile(value) {
      if (!record(value) || typeof value.id !== 'string' || !/^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,80}$/.test(value.id)) error('Backup profile is invalid.');
      const name = String(value.name || '').trim();
      if (!name || name.length > 48 || typeof value.name !== 'string') error('Enter a workspace name (up to 48 characters).');
      return {id:value.id,name,snapshot:validateSnapshot(value.snapshot)};
    }
    async function list() {
      const value = await GM_getValue(KEY,[]), out = [], ids = new Set();
      if (!Array.isArray(value)) return out;
      for (const item of value.slice(0,MAX)) try {const clean = profile(item);if (!ids.has(clean.id)) {out.push(clean);ids.add(clean.id);}} catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("list",studioError);}
      return out;
    }
    async function snapshot() {
      const prefs = await config.read();
      return validateSnapshot({workspace:await captureLayoutSettings(),layoutSettings:Object.fromEntries(layoutKeys.map(key=>[key,prefs[key]])),
        panelSizes:copy(panelSizes),streetView:{...streetViewWindow.size,docked:streetViewWindow.docked}});
    }
    function available() {
      if (compactLayoutEditing || windowResize || streetViewWindow.drag) error('Finish arranging or resizing first.');
    }
    async function exclusive(task) {
      if (busy) error('A workspace change is already saving.');
      available();busy = true;
      try {return await task();} finally {busy = false;}
    }
    async function storeProfiles(next) {
      profileUndo = await list();
      try {await chrome.storage.local.set({[KEY]:next});} catch (err) { reportStudioError("storeProfiles",err);profileUndo = null;throw err;}
    }
    function syncSizes(items) {
      if (items[PANEL_SIZES_KEY]) {clearTimeout(panelSizeTimer);panelSizes = sizes(items[PANEL_SIZES_KEY].newValue || {});applyPanelSizes();}
      if (items[CHAT_PANEL_POSITION_KEY]) chatPanelPosition = normalizedChatPanelPosition(items[CHAT_PANEL_POSITION_KEY].newValue);
      if (items[STREET_VIEW_WINDOW_KEY]) {
        const value = items[STREET_VIEW_WINDOW_KEY].newValue;
        if (record(value) && Number.isFinite(value.width) && Number.isFinite(value.height)) {
          streetViewWindow.size = {width:Math.max(280,Math.min(2400,value.width)),height:Math.max(220,Math.min(1600,value.height))};
          streetViewWindow.docked = value.docked === true;queueStreetViewWindow();
        }
      }
    }
    async function commit(value, prefs = {}, profiles, scriptTabs) {
      available();const clean = validateSnapshot(value), workspace = clean.workspace;
      const patch = {...clean.layoutSettings,...prefs,compactMode:workspace.compactMode,compactHeaderFullWidth:workspace.compactHeaderFullWidth,compactHeaderWidth:workspace.compactHeaderWidth};
      const data = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(patch).map(([key,val])=>['wmeStudio.'+key,val]));
      Object.assign(data,{[COMPACT_LAYOUT_KEY]:workspace.layout || {},[CHAT_PANEL_POSITION_KEY]:workspace.chatPosition,[PANEL_SIZES_KEY]:clean.panelSizes,[STREET_VIEW_WINDOW_KEY]:clean.streetView});
      if (profiles) data[KEY] = profiles;
      if (scriptTabs) data[scriptTabPicker.key] = scriptTabPicker.validate(scriptTabs);
      clearTimeout(panelSizeTimer);
      await chrome.storage.local.set(data);
      applyLayoutSettings(workspace);queueStreetViewWindow();
    }
    async function backup() {
      available();return {format:'wme-studio-backup',formatVersion:1,scriptVersion:'1.0.0',createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),
        settings:await config.read(),layout:await snapshot(),profiles:await list(),scriptTabs:await scriptTabPicker.snapshot()};
    }
    function parseBackup(text) {
      if (typeof text !== 'string' || new Blob([text]).size > LIMIT) error('Choose a Studio backup smaller than 256 KB.');
      let value;
      try {value = JSON.parse(text,(key,item)=>{if (['__proto__','constructor','prototype'].includes(key)) throw new Error();return item;});}
      catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("parseBackup",studioError);error('This file is not a valid Studio JSON backup.');}
      if (!record(value) || value.format !== 'wme-studio-backup' || value.formatVersion !== 1) error('This backup format is not supported.');
      if (!Array.isArray(value.profiles) || value.profiles.length > MAX) error('A backup can contain up to 12 workspaces.');
      const profiles = value.profiles.map(profile);
      if (new Set(profiles.map(item=>item.id)).size !== profiles.length) error('Backup workspace IDs must be unique.');
      const prefs = preferences(value.settings,Object.keys(config.defaults)), layout = validateSnapshot(value.layout);
      for (const key of layoutKeys) if (prefs[key] !== layout.layoutSettings[key]) error('Backup settings and layout do not match.');
      for (const key of ['compactMode','compactHeaderFullWidth','compactHeaderWidth']) if (prefs[key] !== layout.workspace[key]) error('Backup settings and layout do not match.');
      const scriptTabs=Object.hasOwn(value,'scriptTabs') ? scriptTabPicker.validate(value.scriptTabs) : null;
      return {format:'wme-studio-backup',formatVersion:1,settings:prefs,layout,profiles,scriptTabs};
    }
    const api = {key:KEY,max:MAX,limit:LIMIT,list,snapshot,backup,parseBackup,syncSizes,
      async save(name,id = null) {return exclusive(async()=>{
        const items = await list(), index = items.findIndex(item=>item.id === id);
        if (id && index < 0) error('Workspace not found.');
        if (!id && items.length >= MAX) error('You can save up to 12 workspaces.');
        const item = profile({id:id || (globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.() || `ws-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,9)}`),name,snapshot:await snapshot()});
        if (items.some(existing=>existing.id !== item.id && existing.name.toLowerCase() === item.name.toLowerCase())) error('A workspace with that name already exists.');
        if (index >= 0) items[index] = item;else items.push(item);
        await storeProfiles(items);return copy(item);
      });},
      async rename(id,name) {return exclusive(async()=>{
        const items = await list(), index = items.findIndex(item=>item.id === id);if (index < 0) error('Workspace not found.');
        const next = profile({...items[index],name});
        if (items.some(item=>item.id !== id && item.name.toLowerCase() === next.name.toLowerCase())) error('A workspace with that name already exists.');
        items[index] = next;await storeProfiles(items);
      });},
      async remove(id) {return exclusive(async()=>{const items = await list();if (!items.some(item=>item.id === id)) error('Workspace not found.');await storeProfiles(items.filter(item=>item.id !== id));});},
      canUndoProfiles:()=>profileUndo !== null,
      async undoProfiles() {return exclusive(async()=>{if (profileUndo === null) return;const previous = profileUndo;await chrome.storage.local.set({[KEY]:previous});profileUndo = null;});},
      async apply(id) {return exclusive(async()=>{
        if (!settings.enabled) error('Enable Studio to apply a workspace.');
        const item = (await list()).find(item=>item.id === id);if (!item) error('Workspace not found.');
        const before = await snapshot();
        try {await commit(item.snapshot);} catch (err) { reportStudioError("apply",err);await commit(before).catch((studioError)=>{ reportStudioError("apply",studioError);});throw err;}
        return before;
      });},
      async restoreLayout(value) {return exclusive(async()=>{const before = await snapshot();try {await commit(value);} catch(err) { reportStudioError("restoreLayout",err);await commit(before).catch((studioError)=>{ reportStudioError("restoreLayout",studioError);});throw err;}});},
      async importBackup(text) {const value = parseBackup(text);return exclusive(async()=>{
        const before = await backup();
        try {await commit(value.layout,value.settings,value.profiles,value.scriptTabs);} catch(err) { reportStudioError("importBackup",err);await commit(before.layout,before.settings,before.profiles,before.scriptTabs).catch((studioError)=>{ reportStudioError("importBackup",studioError);});throw err;}
        profileUndo = null;return JSON.stringify(before);
      });},
      async download() {
        const value = await backup(), blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(value,null,2)],{type:'application/json'}), url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const link = document.createElement('a');link.href = url;link.download = `WME-Studio-backup-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.json`;
        link.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);
      }
    };
    return Object.freeze(api);
  })();
  config.read().then(value => { settings = value; ready = true; apply(); }).catch(error => {
    if (reportStudioError.active) reportStudioError('Appearance settings could not be loaded',error); else console.warn('[WME Studio] Appearance settings could not be loaded.', error.message);
  });
})();

        <div class="group"><h3 class="section-label">For script authors</h3><div class="card doc">
          <p>Scripts run with WME Studio without any changes. The hooks on this page are optional: they let your script show its own name and icon on Studio’s script bar, follow the theme, and stay clear of the floating layout. All of it is plain DOM and CSS, so it does nothing when Studio is not installed.</p>
        </div></div>
        <div class="group"><h3 class="section-label">Name and icon on the script bar</h3><div class="card doc" data-row="dev-tabs">
          <p>Studio replaces the editor’s row of script tabs with a bar of icons and a searchable list. It reads the name and the icon from your tab. Without them it uses the tab’s text and two initials. Studio cannot read another script’s <code data-ws-keep>@icon</code> header, so the icon has to be on the tab.</p>
          <dl>
            <dt><code data-ws-keep>data-script-name</code></dt><dd>The full name, shown in the list and on the bar.</dd>
            <dt><code data-ws-keep>data-icon-url</code></dt><dd>The icon: an <code data-ws-keep>https:</code>, <code data-ws-keep>data:image/…</code> or <code data-ws-keep>blob:</code> URL. Square, 32 px or larger.</dd>
            <dt><code data-ws-keep>data-userscript-url</code></dt><dd>Your Greasy Fork page. With no <code data-ws-keep>data-icon-url</code>, Studio reads <code data-ws-keep>@icon</code> from the public script header there.</dd>
          </dl>
          <p>Set them on the tab label, at any time. Studio picks up later changes.</p>
          <div class="code"><button class="code-copy" type="button">Copy</button><pre data-ws-keep><code>// With W.userscripts
const { tabLabel, tabPane } = W.userscripts.registerSidebarTab('my-script');
tabLabel.textContent = 'MS';   // short text for the editor's own tab
tabLabel.title = 'My Script';
tabLabel.dataset.scriptName = GM_info.script.name;   // data-script-name
tabLabel.dataset.iconUrl = GM_info.script.icon;      // data-icon-url, from your @icon
await W.userscripts.waitForElementConnected(tabPane);</code></pre></div>
          <div class="code"><button class="code-copy" type="button">Copy</button><pre data-ws-keep><code>// With the WME SDK
const { tabLabel, tabPane } = await sdk.Sidebar.registerScriptTab();
tabLabel.innerText = 'MS';
tabLabel.dataset.scriptName = 'My Script';
tabLabel.dataset.iconUrl = 'https://example.com/my-script/icon-64.png';</code></pre></div>
          <div class="code"><button class="code-copy" type="button">Copy</button><pre data-ws-keep><code>&lt;!-- A tab you add to the list yourself --&gt;
&lt;li&gt;
  &lt;a data-toggle="tab" href="#my-script-pane"
     data-script-name="My Script"
     data-icon-url="https://example.com/my-script/icon-64.png"&gt;MS&lt;/a&gt;
&lt;/li&gt;</code></pre></div>
          <p class="note">To check the result, open the command palette and run “Script tabs report”. It lists every tab Studio found, the name it uses, and the reason when a tab is left out.</p>
        </div></div>
        <div class="group"><h3 class="section-label">Detect Studio</h3><div class="card doc">
          <p>Studio describes its state with attributes on the page’s <code data-ws-keep>&lt;html&gt;</code> element. Read them in CSS or in script.</p>
          <dl>
            <dt><code data-ws-keep>data-wme-studio="on"</code></dt><dd>Studio is running. The attribute is removed while Studio is paused.</dd>
            <dt><code data-ws-keep>data-wme-studio-theme</code></dt><dd><code data-ws-keep>light</code>, <code data-ws-keep>dark</code> or <code data-ws-keep>black</code>.</dd>
            <dt><code data-ws-keep>data-wme-studio-compact="on"</code></dt><dd>Floating mode. Absent in the Standard layout.</dd>
            <dt><code data-ws-keep>data-wme-studio-corners</code></dt><dd><code data-ws-keep>soft</code> or <code data-ws-keep>flat</code>.</dd>
            <dt><code data-ws-keep>data-wme-studio-motion</code></dt><dd><code data-ws-keep>normal</code> or <code data-ws-keep>reduced</code>. Skip your own animations when it is reduced.</dd>
            <dt><code data-ws-keep>data-wme-studio-addons</code></dt><dd><code data-ws-keep>on</code> while “Match supported add-ons” is switched on, otherwise <code data-ws-keep>off</code>.</dd>
          </dl>
          <div class="code"><button class="code-copy" type="button">Copy</button><pre data-ws-keep><code>const root = document.documentElement;

function studioState() {
  return {
    on: root.dataset.wmeStudio === 'on',
    theme: root.dataset.wmeStudioTheme || null,   // 'light', 'dark' or 'black'
    floating: root.dataset.wmeStudioCompact === 'on'
  };
}

// Studio can be paused, and the user can change theme or layout at any time.
new MutationObserver(() =&gt; applyMyLook(studioState())).observe(root, {
  attributes: true,
  attributeFilter: [
    'data-wme-studio', 'data-wme-studio-theme', 'data-wme-studio-compact'
  ]
});
applyMyLook(studioState());</code></pre></div>
          <div class="code"><button class="code-copy" type="button">Copy</button><pre data-ws-keep><code>/* The same in CSS */
html[data-wme-studio-theme="dark"] .my-panel,
html[data-wme-studio-theme="black"] .my-panel {
  color-scheme: dark;
}
html[data-wme-studio-motion="reduced"] .my-panel {
  transition: none;
}</code></pre></div>
        </div></div>
        <div class="group"><h3 class="section-label">Match the theme</h3><div class="card doc">
          <p>While Studio is on, these CSS variables hold the user’s current colours and corner sizes. They are set on <code data-ws-keep>&lt;html&gt;</code> and are inherited into shadow roots. Give each one a fallback so your script looks right without Studio.</p>
          <dl>
            <dt><code data-ws-keep>--wme-studio-accent</code></dt><dd>Accent colour. <code data-ws-keep>--wme-studio-on-accent</code> is the text colour to put on it.</dd>
            <dt><code data-ws-keep>--wme-studio-surface</code></dt><dd>Panel background. <code data-ws-keep>--wme-studio-bg</code> is the page behind panels.</dd>
            <dt><code data-ws-keep>--wme-studio-input</code></dt><dd>Fields and raised rows. <code data-ws-keep>--wme-studio-hover</code> is their hover colour.</dd>
            <dt><code data-ws-keep>--wme-studio-text</code></dt><dd>Text. Also <code data-ws-keep>--wme-studio-text-secondary</code> and <code data-ws-keep>--wme-studio-text-muted</code>.</dd>
            <dt><code data-ws-keep>--wme-studio-border</code></dt><dd>Lines. <code data-ws-keep>--wme-studio-border-strong</code> for a stronger line.</dd>
            <dt><code data-ws-keep>--wme-studio-button-radius</code></dt><dd>Corner size of buttons. <code data-ws-keep>--wme-studio-panel-radius</code> for panels, <code data-ws-keep>--wme-studio-radius</code> for small parts.</dd>
            <dt><code data-ws-keep>--ws-font</code></dt><dd>The font family Studio uses.</dd>
          </dl>
          <div class="code"><button class="code-copy" type="button">Copy</button><pre data-ws-keep><code>.my-panel {
  background: var(--wme-studio-surface, #ffffff);
  color: var(--wme-studio-text, #202124);
  border: 1px solid var(--wme-studio-border, #dadce0);
  border-radius: var(--wme-studio-panel-radius, 8px);
  font-family: var(--ws-font, inherit);
}
.my-panel input {
  background: var(--wme-studio-input, #f1f3f4);
  color: inherit;
  border: 1px solid var(--wme-studio-border, #dadce0);
  border-radius: var(--wme-studio-radius, 4px);

.my-panel .primary {
  background: var(--wme-studio-accent, #0099ff);
  color: var(--wme-studio-on-accent, #ffffff);
  border-radius: var(--wme-studio-button-radius, 6px);

.my-panel .hint { color: var(--wme-studio-text-muted, #5f6368); }</code></pre></div>
          <p class="note">With “Match supported add-ons” on, Studio already restyles ordinary buttons and fields inside script tabs. Use the variables for what it cannot reach: your own widgets, drawings and floating windows.</p>
        </div></div>
        <div class="group"><h3 class="section-label">Floating mode</h3><div class="card doc">
          <p>In Floating mode the header, the side panel and the tool rails are separate islands, and the user can move every one of them. Do not assume that the header is at the top of the window or that the side panel touches the left edge. Measure the element you want to sit next to, and measure again when the window is resized.</p>
          <div class="code"><button class="code-copy" type="button">Copy</button><pre data-ws-keep><code>// Put your own floating window just below the header, wherever it is.
function placeBelowHeader(box) {
  const head = document.querySelector('#app-head').getBoundingClientRect();
  const floating = document.documentElement.dataset.wmeStudioCompact === 'on';
  box.style.position = 'fixed';
  box.style.top = Math.round(head.bottom + (floating ? 8 : 0)) + 'px';
  box.style.left = Math.round(Math.max(8, head.left)) + 'px';
}
window.addEventListener('resize', () =&gt; placeBelowHeader(myBox));</code></pre></div>
          <p class="note">Add dialogs to <code data-ws-keep>document.body</code>, not to the map element, and keep them shorter than the window so they are not covered by the floating header.</p>

    const shortcutButton = q('[data-id="shortcut"]'), shortcutDefault = q('[data-id="shortcut-default"]'), shortcutHint = q('[data-id="shortcut-hint"]');
    let shortcutRecording = false;
    function paintShortcut(note) {
      const label = globalThis.WMEStudioShortcut.label(current.commandShortcut), text = shortcutRecording ? 'Press keys…' : label || 'Off';
      shortcutButton.toggleAttribute('data-ws-keep', !shortcutRecording && !!label);
      if (shortcutButton.dataset.shown !== text) { shortcutButton.dataset.shown = text; shortcutButton.textContent = text; }
      shortcutButton.toggleAttribute('data-recording', shortcutRecording);
      shortcutDefault.hidden = shortcutRecording || current.commandShortcut === config.defaults.commandShortcut;
      const hint = note || (shortcutRecording ? 'Press the new shortcut. Esc cancels, Backspace turns it off.' : 'Opens the search for settings and commands from anywhere in the editor.');
      if (shortcutHint.dataset.shown !== hint) { shortcutHint.dataset.shown = hint; shortcutHint.textContent = hint; }
      commandButton.title = label;
    }
    function setShortcutRecording(on) { shortcutRecording = on; globalThis.WMEStudioShortcut.recording = on; paintShortcut(); }
    function recordShortcut(event) {
      if (event.key === 'Tab') { setShortcutRecording(false); return; }
      event.preventDefault();
      if (event.key === 'Escape') { setShortcutRecording(false); return; }
      if ((event.key === 'Backspace' || event.key === 'Delete') && !event.ctrlKey && !event.altKey && !event.metaKey && !event.shiftKey) { setShortcutRecording(false); change({ commandShortcut: '' }); return; }
      const shortcut = globalThis.WMEStudioShortcut.fromEvent(event);
      if (shortcut === undefined) return;
      if (shortcut === null) { paintShortcut('Add Ctrl, Alt or Shift to that key.'); return; }
      setShortcutRecording(false); change({ commandShortcut: shortcut });
    }
    shortcutButton.addEventListener('click', () => setShortcutRecording(!shortcutRecording));
    shortcutButton.addEventListener('blur', () => { if (shortcutRecording) setShortcutRecording(false); });
    shortcutDefault.addEventListener('click', () => change({ commandShortcut: config.defaults.commandShortcut }));

    // Earlier page names, so older callers still land on the right section.
    const pageAliases = { workspace: 'layout', presets: 'layout', appearance: 'look', addons: 'look', requests: 'panels', help: 'studio' };

    function selectPage(name) {
      name = pageAliases[name] || name;
      if (!Object.hasOwn(pages, name)) return;
      if (activePage !== name) { if (q('[data-id="color-picker"]').matches(':popover-open')) closeColorPicker(); q('.body').scrollTop = 0; }
      activePage = name;
      qa('[data-page-target]').forEach(button => {
        const selected = button.dataset.pageTarget === name;
        button.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(selected));
        button.tabIndex = selected ? 0 : -1;
      });
      qa('[data-page]').forEach(page => { page.hidden = page.dataset.page !== name; });

    async function refreshProfiles() {try {profiles = await workspaces.list();renderProfileList();} catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("refreshProfiles",studioError);featureStatus('profile','Could not load workspaces.',true);}}
    async function workspaceTask(kind,task,success) {
      if (profilesBusy || presetBusy) return;
      profilesBusy = true;render();
      try {await flushSliderChanges();await task();current = await config.read();render();await refreshProfiles();featureStatus(kind,success);}
      catch(err) { reportStudioError("workspaceTask",err);featureStatus(kind,err.message || 'Could not save preferences.',true);}
      finally {profilesBusy = false;render();}
    }

    async function flushSliderChanges() {
      const patch = {};
      for (const [key,timer] of sliderTimers) {clearTimeout(timer);Object.assign(patch,rangePatch(key,current[key]));}
      sliderTimers.clear();
      if (Object.keys(patch).length) await config.write(patch);
      await workspaceModeSave.catch((studioError)=>{ reportStudioError("flushSliderChanges",studioError);});
    }
    async function usePreset(id) {
      if (presetBusy || profilesBusy || !current.enabled) return;
      presetBusy = true; render();setStatus('Saving…','saving');
      try {
        await flushSliderChanges();
        presetUndo = await globalThis.WMEStudioCompactLayout.applyPreset(id);
        current = await config.read();q('[data-id="preset-feedback"]').textContent = 'Layout applied.';savedStatus();
      } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("usePreset",studioError);q('[data-id="preset-feedback"]').textContent = 'Could not save the layout. Save again to retry.';setStatus('Could not save preferences.','error');}
      finally {presetBusy = false;render();}
    }
    async function undoPreset() {
      if (!presetUndo || presetBusy || profilesBusy || !current.enabled) return;
      presetBusy = true;render();
      try {await flushSliderChanges();await globalThis.WMEStudioCompactLayout.restorePreset(presetUndo);presetUndo = null;current = await config.read();q('[data-id="preset-feedback"]').textContent = 'Previous layout restored.';savedStatus();}
      catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("undoPreset",studioError);setStatus('Could not save preferences.','error');}
      finally {presetBusy = false;render();}
    }
    function focusedElement() {
      let element = document.activeElement;
      while (element?.shadowRoot?.activeElement) element = element.shadowRoot.activeElement;
      return element;
    }
    const languageControl = q('[data-id="language-control"]'), languageButton = q('[data-id="language"]'), languageMenu = q('[data-id="language-menu"]'), languageValue = q('[data-id="language-value"]');
    function setLanguageMenu(open) {
      languageMenu.hidden = !open; languageButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
      if (!open) return;
      languageMenu.removeAttribute('data-side');
      if (languageMenu.getBoundingClientRect().bottom > innerHeight - 10) languageMenu.setAttribute('data-side', 'up');
      const selected = languageMenu.querySelector('[aria-selected="true"]') || languageMenu.firstElementChild;
      selected?.focus({ preventScroll: true }); selected?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
    }
    function languageKeydown(event) {
      const options = [...languageMenu.children], index = options.indexOf(shadow.activeElement);
      if (event.key === 'Escape' && !languageMenu.hidden) { event.preventDefault(); setLanguageMenu(false); languageButton.focus({ preventScroll: true }); return true; }
      if (event.key === 'Tab') { if (!languageMenu.hidden) setLanguageMenu(false); return false; }
      const target = event.key === 'ArrowDown' ? Math.min(options.length - 1, index + 1) : event.key === 'ArrowUp' ? Math.max(0, index - 1)
        : event.key === 'Home' ? 0 : event.key === 'End' ? options.length - 1 : -1;
      if (target < 0) return false;
      event.preventDefault();
      if (languageMenu.hidden) { setLanguageMenu(true); return true; }
      options[target]?.focus({ preventScroll: true }); options[target]?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
      return true;
    }
    function modalKeydown(event) {
      if (!studioPanelOpen) return;
      event.stopPropagation();
      if (shortcutRecording) { recordShortcut(event); return; }
      if (event.composedPath().includes(languageControl) && languageKeydown(event)) return;
      if (event.key === 'Escape' && !languageMenu.hidden) setLanguageMenu(false);
      if (event.composedPath().includes(colorPlane) && ['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown'].includes(event.key)) { adjustPickerPlane(event); return; }
      if (event.key === 'Enter' && event.composedPath().includes(q('[data-id="picker-hex"]'))) { event.preventDefault(); readPickerHex(); return; }
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (q('[data-id="color-picker"]').matches(':popover-open')) closeColorPicker(); else close();
        return;
      }
      const tab = event.composedPath().find(node => node?.dataset?.pageTarget);
      if (tab && ['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Home','End'].includes(event.key)) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const tabs = qa('[data-page-target]');
        const index = tabs.indexOf(tab);
        const next = event.key === 'Home' ? 0 : event.key === 'End' ? tabs.length - 1 :
          (index + (['ArrowUp','ArrowLeft'].includes(event.key) ? -1 : 1) + tabs.length) % tabs.length;
        selectPage(tabs[next].dataset.pageTarget);
        tabs[next].focus({ preventScroll: true });
        return;
      }
      if (event.key === 'Tab') {
        const controls = qa('button,input,select,textarea,a[href],[tabindex]').filter(element =>
          element.tabIndex >= 0 && element.getClientRects().length > 0 && !element.closest('[hidden]') && !element.matches(':disabled'));
        const index = controls.indexOf(focusedElement());
        if (index === -1 || (event.shiftKey ? index === 0 : index === controls.length - 1)) {
          event.preventDefault();
          (event.shiftKey ? controls.at(-1) : controls[0])?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        }
      }
    }

    function render() {

          if (keep) option.setAttribute('data-ws-keep', '');

        };
        add('auto', 'Automatic (same as WME)', false);
        for (const [code, name] of globalThis.WMEStudioI18n.languages()) add(code, name, true);
      }
      for (const option of languageMenu.children) {
        const selected = option.dataset.value === current.language;
        if (option.getAttribute('aria-selected') !== String(selected)) option.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(selected));
        if (!selected || languageValue.dataset.value === option.dataset.value) continue;
        languageValue.dataset.value = option.dataset.value;
        languageValue.toggleAttribute('data-ws-keep', option.dataset.value !== 'auto');
        languageValue.textContent = option.dataset.label;
      }
      globalThis.WMEStudioI18n.setLanguage(current.language);
      paintShortcut();

      fieldsets.forEach(fieldset => { fieldset.disabled = !current.enabled || profilesBusy; });
      qa('input[name="workspace-mode"]').forEach(input => { input.checked = (input.value === 'compact') === current.compactMode; });
      qa('[data-compact-preferences]').forEach(fieldset=>{fieldset.disabled = !current.enabled || !current.compactMode;});
      qa('[data-action="arrange"]').forEach(button=>{button.disabled = !current.enabled || !arrangeViewport.matches || presetBusy || profilesBusy;});
      qa('[data-arrange-label]').forEach(label=>{label.textContent = current.compactMode ? 'Arrange' : 'Floating & arrange';});
      renderPresets();
      syncWorkspaceControls();
      q('[data-id="compactModeHint"]').textContent = !current.enabled ? 'Enable Studio to adjust workspace settings.' :
        current.compactMode ? 'Applies to floating islands on desktop. Your arrangement is saved separately.' :
        'Select Floating compact to adjust these settings. Your saved values are kept.';
      q('[data-id="layerColumnsToggle"]').checked = current.layerColumns === 'two';
      panel.dataset.motion = current.motion ? 'full' : 'reduced';

      q('.colorshell').style.setProperty('--custom-color', current.accent);
