      for (const key of ['compactHeaderWidth','compactIslandOpacity','eyeSaver','satelliteBrightness','viewportBrightness','gpsOpacity','hudScale','panelScale','fontScale']) {
        const value = key === 'compactHeaderWidth' && !current.compactHeaderFullWidth ? 0 : current[key];
        const input = q(`[data-id="${key}"]`);
        if (Number(input.value) !== value) input.value = value;
        q(`[data-id="${key}-value"]`).textContent = value === 0 && key === 'compactHeaderWidth' ? 'Default' : key === 'eyeSaver' && value === 0 ? 'Off' : `${value}%`;
      }
      q('[data-id="discussionVisible"]').value = current.discussionVisible;
      q('[data-id="discussionVisible-value"]').textContent = String(current.discussionVisible);
      qa('input[type="range"]').forEach(input => {
        const min = Number(input.min) || 0, max = Number(input.max) || 100, value = Number(input.value) || 0;
        input.style.setProperty('--range-fill', `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (value - min) * 100 / Math.max(1, max - min)))}%`);
      });
      qa('[data-setting]').forEach(button => button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(current[button.dataset.setting] === button.dataset.value)));
    }
    const colorPicker = q('[data-id="color-picker"]'), colorPlane = q('[data-id="picker-plane"]');
    let pickerHSV = {h:204,s:1,v:1}, pickerHex = '', pickerDrag = null, pickerTimer = 0;
    function colorRGB(hex) { return [1,3,5].map(index => parseInt(hex.slice(index,index + 2),16)); }
    function colorHSV(hex) {
      const [r,g,b] = colorRGB(hex).map(value => value / 255), max = Math.max(r,g,b), min = Math.min(r,g,b), delta = max - min;
      const hue = delta ? (max === r ? (g - b) / delta + (g < b ? 6 : 0) : max === g ? (b - r) / delta + 2 : (r - g) / delta + 4) * 60 : pickerHSV.h;
      return {h:hue,s:max ? delta / max : 0,v:max};
    }
    function colorHex({h,s,v}) {
      const c = v * s, x = c * (1 - Math.abs((h / 60) % 2 - 1)), m = v - c;
      const parts = h < 60 ? [c,x,0] : h < 120 ? [x,c,0] : h < 180 ? [0,c,x] : h < 240 ? [0,x,c] : h < 300 ? [x,0,c] : [c,0,x];
      return '#' + parts.map(value => Math.round((value + m) * 255).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
    }
    function paintColorPicker(hex = colorHex(pickerHSV)) {
      colorPicker.style.setProperty('--picker-hue',`hsl(${pickerHSV.h} 100% 50%)`);
      colorPicker.style.setProperty('--picker-color',hex);
      colorPlane.style.setProperty('--picker-x',`${pickerHSV.s * 100}%`);
      colorPlane.style.setProperty('--picker-y',`${(1 - pickerHSV.v) * 100}%`);
      colorPlane.setAttribute('aria-valuenow',String(Math.round(pickerHSV.s * 100)));
      colorPlane.setAttribute('aria-valuetext',`Saturation ${Math.round(pickerHSV.s * 100)}%, brightness ${Math.round(pickerHSV.v * 100)}%`);
      q('[data-id="picker-hue"]').value = String(Math.round(pickerHSV.h));
      const fields = ['red','green','blue'];
      colorRGB(hex).forEach((value,index) => { const input = q(`[data-id="picker-${fields[index]}"]`); if (input !== shadow.activeElement) input.value = String(value); });
      const input = q('[data-id="picker-hex"]');
      if (input !== shadow.activeElement) input.value = hex.toUpperCase();
    }
    function syncColorPicker(hex) {
      if (hex !== pickerHex) { pickerHex = hex; pickerHSV = colorHSV(hex); }
      paintColorPicker(hex);
    }
    function commitPickerColor() {
      clearTimeout(pickerTimer); pickerTimer = 0;
      if (current.accent === pickerHex) change({accent:pickerHex});
    }
    function previewPickerColor(hex = colorHex(pickerHSV)) {
      pickerHex = hex;
      current = config.sanitize({...current,accent:hex}); render();
      clearTimeout(pickerTimer); pickerTimer = setTimeout(commitPickerColor,100);
    }
    function positionColorPicker() {
      if (!colorPicker.matches(':popover-open')) return;
      const anchor = q('[data-id="accent-picker-open"]').getBoundingClientRect(), size = colorPicker.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = Math.max(12,Math.min(anchor.right - size.width,innerWidth - size.width - 12));
      const y = anchor.bottom + 10 + size.height <= innerHeight - 12 ? anchor.bottom + 10 : anchor.top - size.height - 10;
      colorPicker.style.left = `${Math.round(x)}px`; colorPicker.style.top = `${Math.round(Math.max(12,Math.min(y,innerHeight - size.height - 12)))}px`;
    }
    function closeColorPicker() {
      if (pickerTimer) commitPickerColor();
      pickerDrag = null;
      if (colorPicker.matches(':popover-open')) colorPicker.hidePopover();
      q('[data-id="accent-picker-open"]').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
      q('[data-id="accent-picker-open"]').focus({preventScroll:true});
    }
    q('[data-id="accent-picker-open"]').addEventListener('click',() => {
      if (colorPicker.matches(':popover-open')) { closeColorPicker(); return; }
      syncColorPicker(current.accent); colorPicker.showPopover(); positionColorPicker();
      q('[data-id="accent-picker-open"]').setAttribute('aria-expanded','true'); colorPlane.focus({preventScroll:true});
    });
    colorPicker.addEventListener('toggle',event => {
      q('[data-id="accent-picker-open"]').setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(event.newState === 'open'));
      if (event.newState === 'closed' && pickerTimer) commitPickerColor();
    });
    const pickPlane = event => {
      if (!pickerDrag) return;
      pickerHSV.s = Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(event.clientX - pickerDrag.left) / pickerDrag.width));
      pickerHSV.v = 1 - Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(event.clientY - pickerDrag.top) / pickerDrag.height));
      previewPickerColor();
    };
    colorPlane.addEventListener('pointerdown',event => {
      if (event.button !== 0) return; event.preventDefault(); colorPlane.focus({preventScroll:true});
      pickerDrag = colorPlane.getBoundingClientRect(); colorPlane.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); pickPlane(event);
    });
    colorPlane.addEventListener('pointermove',event => { if (pickerDrag) pickPlane(event); });
    for (const type of ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture']) colorPlane.addEventListener(type,event => {
      if (!pickerDrag) return;
      if (type === 'pointerup') pickPlane(event); pickerDrag = null; commitPickerColor();
    });
    function adjustPickerPlane(event) {
      if (!['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown'].includes(event.key)) return;
      event.preventDefault(); const step = event.shiftKey ? .1 : .01;
      if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft' || event.key === 'ArrowRight') pickerHSV.s = Math.max(0,Math.min(1,pickerHSV.s + (event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? step : -step)));
      else pickerHSV.v = Math.max(0,Math.min(1,pickerHSV.v + (event.key === 'ArrowUp' ? step : -step)));
      previewPickerColor();
    }
    q('[data-id="picker-hue"]').addEventListener('input',event => { pickerHSV.h = Number(event.target.value); previewPickerColor(); });
    q('[data-id="picker-hue"]').addEventListener('change',commitPickerColor);
    const readPickerHex = () => {
      const input = q('[data-id="picker-hex"]'), value = input.value.trim().replace(/^#/,'');
      const valid = /^(?:[0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{6})$/i.test(value);
      input.setAttribute('aria-invalid',String(!valid)); if (!valid) return;
      const hex = '#' + (value.length === 3 ? [...value].map(digit => digit + digit).join('') : value).toLowerCase();
      pickerHSV = colorHSV(hex); previewPickerColor(hex); commitPickerColor(); input.value = hex.toUpperCase();
    };
    q('[data-id="picker-hex"]').addEventListener('change',readPickerHex);
    q('[data-id="picker-hex"]').addEventListener('keydown',event => { if (event.key === 'Enter') { event.preventDefault(); readPickerHex(); } });
    for (const name of ['red','green','blue']) q(`[data-id="picker-${name}"]`).addEventListener('change',() => {
      const values = ['red','green','blue'].map(channel => Number(q(`[data-id="picker-${channel}"]`).value));
      if (values.some(value => !Number.isFinite(value))) return;
      const hex = '#' + values.map(value => Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(value))).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
      pickerHSV = colorHSV(hex); previewPickerColor(hex); commitPickerColor();
    });
    q('[data-id="picker-reset"]').addEventListener('click',() => { pickerHSV = colorHSV('#0099ff'); previewPickerColor('#0099ff'); commitPickerColor(); });
    q('[data-id="picker-close"]').addEventListener('click',closeColorPicker);
    q('[data-id="picker-done"]').addEventListener('click',closeColorPicker);
    window.addEventListener('resize',positionColorPicker,{passive:true});
    function setStatus(text, state = 'saved') {
      status.textContent = text;
      q('.notice').dataset.state = state;
      q('.save-indicator').textContent = state === 'saving' ? '…' : state === 'error' ? '!' : '✓';
    }
    function savedStatus() { setStatus(current.enabled ? 'Changes save automatically' : 'Studio is paused'); }
    let workspaceModeChange = 0, pendingWorkspaceMode = null;
    let workspaceModeSave = Promise.resolve();
    const painted = () => document.hidden ? Promise.resolve() : new Promise(resolve => {
      const timer = setTimeout(resolve, 150);
      requestAnimationFrame(() => setTimeout(() => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(); }, 0));
    });
    async function change(patch, feedback = false) {
      const modeChange = Object.hasOwn(patch, 'compactMode') ? ++workspaceModeChange : 0;
      if (modeChange) pendingWorkspaceMode = patch.compactMode;
      current = config.sanitize({ ...current, ...patch });
      render();
      setStatus('Saving…', 'saving');
      if (!modeChange && feedback) await painted();
      try {
        if (modeChange) {
          await (workspaceModeSave = workspaceModeSave.catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("change",studioError);}).then(() => {
            if (modeChange === workspaceModeChange) return config.write(patch);
          }));
          if (modeChange === workspaceModeChange) pendingWorkspaceMode = null;
        } else await config.write(patch);
        if (pendingWorkspaceMode === null) savedStatus();
      } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("change",studioError);
        if (!modeChange || modeChange === workspaceModeChange) {
          pendingWorkspaceMode = null;
          setStatus('Could not save preferences.', 'error');
        }
      }
    }
    function rangePatch(key, value) {
      return key === 'compactHeaderWidth' ? { compactHeaderWidth:value, compactHeaderFullWidth:value > 0 } : { [key]:value };
    }
    function previewRange(key, value) {
      current = config.sanitize({ ...current, ...rangePatch(key,value) });
      const input = q(`[data-id="${key}"]`), output = q(`[data-id="${key}-value"]`);
      output.textContent = key === 'compactHeaderWidth' && value === 0 ? 'Default' : key === 'eyeSaver' && value === 0 ? 'Off' : key === 'discussionVisible' ? String(value) : `${value}%`;
      input.style.setProperty('--range-fill',`${(value - Number(input.min)) * 100 / (Number(input.max) - Number(input.min))}%`);
      if (!(quickRangeKeys.has(key) && globalThis.WMEStudioPreview?.quick(key,value))) writeRange(key,value);
      clearTimeout(sliderTimers.get(key));
      sliderTimers.set(key,setTimeout(()=>{sliderTimers.delete(key);change(rangePatch(key,current[key]));},100));
    }
    // A moving slider used to reach the editor only once it had rested for 100 ms. Its value is now written
    // straight away, at most once per frame and never while the previous write is still on its way; the 100 ms
    // timer above only finishes the job (status line, full re-render) once the slider rests.
    const quickRangeKeys = new Set(['hudScale','compactHeaderWidth']);
    const sliderWrites = new Map();
    function writeRange(key,value) {
      let state = sliderWrites.get(key);
      if (!state) sliderWrites.set(key,state = {busy:false,dirty:false,value});
      state.value = value;
      if (state.busy) { state.dirty = true; return; }
      state.busy = true;
      const send = () => {
        state.dirty = false;const started = performance.now();
        return Promise.resolve(config.write(rangePatch(key,state.value))).catch(error => reportStudioError('writeRange',error))
          .then(() => new Promise(resolve => { const timer = setTimeout(resolve,60); requestAnimationFrame(() => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(); }); }))
          // Scaling the interface re-lays-out the whole editor. When one update takes longer than two frames, the
          // slider gets the same time to itself before the next one, so its handle keeps following the pointer.
          .then(() => { const cost = performance.now() - started; if (cost > 32) return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve,Math.min(120,cost))); })
          .then(() => { if (state.dirty) return send(); state.busy = false; });
      };
      send();
    }
    const liveRangeKeys = () => { const keys = new Set(); for (const [key,state] of sliderWrites) if (state.busy || sliderTimers.has(key)) for (const name of Object.keys(rangePatch(key,state.value))) keys.add(name); return keys; };
    // Sliders whose effect shows in the editor behind the window; dragging one hides everything but its own row.
    const peekKeys = new Set(['compactHeaderWidth','compactIslandOpacity','eyeSaver','satelliteBrightness','viewportBrightness','gpsOpacity','hudScale','panelScale','fontScale']);
    function setPeek(input) {
      qa('[data-peek-row]').forEach(node=>node.removeAttribute('data-peek-row'));
      const row = input?.closest('.srow');
      if (row) row.setAttribute('data-peek-row','');
      panel.toggleAttribute('data-peek',!!row);backdrop.toggleAttribute('data-peek',!!row);
    }
    function bindRangeDrag(input,key) {
      const update = event => {
        const drag = rangeDrag;
        if (!drag || drag.input !== input || event.pointerId !== drag.pointerId) return;
        const min = Number(input.min),max = Number(input.max),step = Number(input.step) || 1;
        const value = Math.min(max,Math.max(min,min + Math.round((event.clientX - drag.left) / drag.width * (max - min) / step) * step));
        if (Number(input.value) !== value) {input.value = String(value);input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));}
      };
      const finish = event => {
        const drag = rangeDrag;
        if (!drag || drag.input !== input || event.pointerId !== drag.pointerId) return;
        if (event.type === 'pointerup') update(event);
        rangeDrag = null;setPeek(null);
        try {if (input.hasPointerCapture(drag.pointerId)) input.releasePointerCapture(drag.pointerId);} catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("finish",studioError);}
        input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));
      };
      input.addEventListener('pointerdown',event=>{
        if (event.button !== 0 || event.isPrimary === false || input.matches(':disabled')) return;
        const rect = input.getBoundingClientRect();
        rangeDrag = {input,key,pointerId:event.pointerId,left:rect.left + 10,width:Math.max(1,rect.width - 20),startX:event.clientX,peek:false};
        input.focus({preventScroll:true});event.preventDefault();
        try {input.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);} catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("bindRangeDrag",studioError);}
        update(event);
      });
      input.addEventListener('pointermove',event=>{
        const drag = rangeDrag;
        if (drag && drag.input === input && event.pointerId === drag.pointerId && !drag.peek && peekKeys.has(key) && Math.abs(event.clientX - drag.startX) > 3) {drag.peek = true;setPeek(input);}
        update(event);
      });
      for (const type of ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture']) input.addEventListener(type,finish);
    }
    function open(page) {
      if (typeof page === 'string') selectPage(page);
      if (!studioPanelOpen) returnFocus = focusedElement();
      studioPanelOpen = true;
      backdrop.hidden = false;
      panel.classList.add('open');
      document.addEventListener('keydown', modalKeydown, true);
      setLauncherActive(true);
      panel.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      config.read().then(v => { current = v; render(); savedStatus(); }).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("open",studioError); return setStatus('Could not load preferences.', 'error'); });
      refreshProfiles();
    }
    function close() {
      if (shortcutRecording) setShortcutRecording(false);
      if (colorPicker.matches(':popover-open')) closeColorPicker();
      rangeDrag = null;setPeek(null);
      studioPanelOpen = false;
      backdrop.hidden = true;
      panel.classList.remove('open');
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', modalKeydown, true);
      setLauncherActive(false);
      if (returnFocus?.isConnected) returnFocus.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      returnFocus = null;
    }
    q('.close').addEventListener('click', close);
    backdrop.addEventListener('click', close);
    qa('[data-page-target]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => selectPage(button.dataset.pageTarget)));
    q('[data-page="developers"]').addEventListener('click', async event => {
      const button = event.target.closest('.code-copy'); if (!button) return;
      const text = button.parentElement.querySelector('pre').textContent;
      try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); }
      catch (_) {
        const range = document.createRange(); range.selectNodeContents(button.parentElement.querySelector('pre'));
        const selection = shadow.getSelection ? shadow.getSelection() : getSelection(); selection?.removeAllRanges(); selection?.addRange(range);
        try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (__) { /* the code stays selected for a manual copy */ }
      }
      button.textContent = 'Copied'; setTimeout(() => { button.textContent = 'Copy'; }, 1400);
    });
    qa('[data-preset]').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>usePreset(button.dataset.preset)));
    q('[data-id="preset-undo"]').addEventListener('click',undoPreset);
    arrangeViewport.addEventListener('change',()=>{if(studioPanelOpen)render();});
    qa('[data-setting]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => change({ [button.dataset.setting]: button.dataset.value }, true)));
    for (const key of ['enabled','addons','motion','gpsBelowRoads','compactRequests']) q(`[data-id="${key}"]`).addEventListener('change', e => change({ [key]: e.target.checked }, true));
    qa('input[name="workspace-mode"]').forEach(input => input.addEventListener('change', e => {
      if (e.target.checked) change({ compactMode: e.target.value === 'compact' });
    }));
    q('[data-id="layerColumnsToggle"]').addEventListener('change', e => change({ layerColumns: e.target.checked ? 'two' : 'one' }, true));
    q('[data-id="accent"]').addEventListener('change', e => change({ accent: e.target.value }));
    for (const key of ['compactHeaderWidth','compactIslandOpacity','eyeSaver','satelliteBrightness','viewportBrightness','gpsOpacity','hudScale','panelScale','fontScale','discussionVisible']) {
      bindRangeDrag(q(`[data-id="${key}"]`),key);
      q(`[data-id="${key}"]`).addEventListener('input', e => previewRange(key, Number(e.target.value)));
      q(`[data-id="${key}"]`).addEventListener('change', e => { clearTimeout(sliderTimers.get(key)); sliderTimers.delete(key); change(rangePatch(key,Number(e.target.value))); });
    }
    qa('[data-action="arrange"]').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',async()=>{
      if (!current.enabled || !arrangeViewport.matches || presetBusy || profilesBusy) return;
      try {
        await flushSliderChanges();
        if (!current.compactMode) {await config.write({compactMode:true});current.compactMode = true;}
        close();requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>globalThis.WMEStudioCompactLayout.open()));
      } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("buildStudioUI",studioError);setStatus('Could not save preferences.','error');}
    }));
    q('[data-id="reset"]').addEventListener('click', () => {
      Promise.resolve(globalThis.WMEStudioCompactLayout?.reset?.()).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("buildStudioUI",studioError);});
      change({ ...config.defaults });
    });
    q('[data-id="resetPanelSizes"]').addEventListener('click', () => globalThis.WMEStudioPanelSizes?.reset());
    languageButton.addEventListener('click', () => setLanguageMenu(languageMenu.hidden));
    languageMenu.addEventListener('click', event => {
      const option = event.target.closest('.language-option');
      if (!option) return;
      setLanguageMenu(false); languageButton.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      if (option.dataset.value !== current.language) change({ language: option.dataset.value });
    });
    shadow.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
      if (!languageMenu.hidden && !event.composedPath().includes(languageControl)) setLanguageMenu(false);
    });
    selectPage(activePage);
    render();

    chrome.storage.onChanged.addListener((changes, area) => {
      if (area !== 'local' || !Object.keys(changes).some(key => key.startsWith('wmeStudio.'))) return;
      const activeRange = rangeDrag && {key:rangeDrag.key,value:Number(rangeDrag.input.value)};
      current = config.changes(current, changes);
      if (activeRange) current = config.sanitize({...current,...rangePatch(activeRange.key,activeRange.value)});
      // A slider that is still moving keeps its newest value; an echo of one of its own writes changes nothing here.
      const live = liveRangeKeys();
      for (const [key,state] of sliderWrites) if (state.busy || sliderTimers.has(key)) current = config.sanitize({...current,...rangePatch(key,state.value)});
      if (pendingWorkspaceMode !== null) current.compactMode = pendingWorkspaceMode;
      if (live.size && Object.keys(changes).every(name => live.has(name.replace(/^wmeStudio\./,'')))) return;
      render();
      if (changes[workspaces.key]) refreshProfiles();
    });

    // Scrolls one setting into view and outlines it briefly; used by the command palette's search results.
    function reveal(id) {
      const target = q(`[data-row="${id}"]`) || q(`[data-id="${id}"]`);if (!target) return;
      const row = target.closest('.srow,.saved,.group') || target;
      requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
        row.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});row.removeAttribute('data-flash');void row.offsetWidth;row.setAttribute('data-flash','');
        setTimeout(()=>row.removeAttribute('data-flash'),1400);
      });
    }
    studioUI = { host, shadow, open, close, reveal };
    return studioUI;
  }

  function openStudioUI(page,section) {
    const ui = buildStudioUI();
    ui?.open(page);
    if (ui && typeof section === 'string') ui.reveal(section);
  }

    function render() {
      const words = normalized(input.value).trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
      matches = commands.filter(command=>words.every(word=>normalized(command.label+' '+(command.keywords || '')).includes(word)));
      selected = matches.findIndex(command=>!command.disabled);

    function select(index,scroll = true) {

    function close(restore = true) {

    async function run(index) {
      const command = matches[index];if (!command || command.disabled || running) return;
      running = true;input.disabled = true;message.hidden = true;
      try {await command.run();close(!studioPanelOpen && !document.documentElement.hasAttribute('data-wme-studio-layout-editing'));}

      finally {running = false;input.disabled = false;if (!host.hidden) input.focus({preventScroll:true});}

    function keys(event) {
      if (host.hidden) return;
      // Leave browser/input defaults intact, but never let search typing reach editor shortcuts.
      event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      if (event.isComposing) return;
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();close();return;}
      if (event.key === 'Tab') {
        event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();(shadow.activeElement === input ? shadow.querySelector('.close') : input).focus();return;
      }
      if (event.target !== host || shadow.activeElement !== input) return;
      if (['ArrowDown','ArrowUp','Enter'].includes(event.key)) {event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();}
      if (event.key === 'Enter') {run(selected);return;}
      if (!['ArrowDown','ArrowUp'].includes(event.key)) return;
      const valid = matches.map((item,index)=>!item.disabled ? index : -1).filter(index=>index >= 0);if (!valid.length) return;
      const direction = event.key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : -1, index = valid.indexOf(selected);
      select(valid[(index + direction + valid.length) % valid.length]);
    }

  chrome.storage.onChanged.addListener(changes=>{

    commandShortcut = shortcut === null ? globalThis.WMEStudioSettings.defaults.commandShortcut : shortcut;

  function detectFixUI() {

  // The "WME Dark Mode" userscript (Greasy Fork 526924) recolors the editor through the same palette variables
  // Studio's themes set. It is recognised by the controls it adds to the profile menu and the Settings tab, and
  // by the opening comment of the stylesheet it injects, which is there from the moment it starts.
  const checkedForDarkMode = new WeakSet();
  function detectDarkModeScript() {
    if (document.querySelector('#wme-dark-mode_switch,.settings__form-group.dark-mode .theme-select,#button_dark_theme,#button_auto_theme')) return true;
    for (const style of document.head?.querySelectorAll('style:not([id])') || []) {
      if (checkedForDarkMode.has(style)) continue;
      if (style.textContent.includes('Dark mode palette found in the chat code')) return true;
      checkedForDarkMode.add(style);
    }
    return false;
  }
  function detectNativeCompact() {
    try {
      const prefs = setupPage.W?.prefs?.attributes;
      if (prefs) {
        const flags = Object.entries(prefs).filter(([key, value]) => /^(is)?compact/i.test(key) && typeof value === 'boolean');
        if (flags.length) return flags.some(([, value]) => value);
      }
    } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("detectNativeCompact",studioError);}
    return !!document.querySelector(':is(html,body,.app,#wz-app):is(.compact-density,.compact-mode,.is-compact,[data-density="compact"],[density="compact"])');
  }

    function focusedElement() {
      let element = document.activeElement;
      while (element?.shadowRoot?.activeElement) element = element.shadowRoot.activeElement;
      return element;
    }
    function detect() {
      const states = { fume: detectFixUI(), dark: detectDarkModeScript(), compact: detectNativeCompact() };
      const fume = q('[data-id="state-fume"]'), dark = q('[data-id="state-dark"]'), compact = q('[data-id="state-compact"]');
      const show = (pill, on, onText, offText) => {
        const kind = on ? 'warn' : 'ok';
        pill.hidden = false;
        if (pill.dataset.kind !== kind) { pill.dataset.kind = kind; pill.textContent = on ? onText : offText; }
      };
      show(fume, states.fume, 'Running now', 'Not running');
      show(dark, states.dark, 'Running now', 'Not running');
      show(compact, states.compact, 'Turned on', 'Turned off');
      const clear = !(states.fume || states.dark || states.compact), title = q('[data-id="compat-title"]');
      if (title.dataset.clear !== String(clear)) {
        title.dataset.clear = String(clear);
        title.textContent = clear ? 'Nothing to switch off.' : 'Three things to switch off.';
        q('[data-id="compat-text"]').textContent = clear ? 'Studio checked for the three things it cannot share the editor with. None is on.' : 'Studio lays out the editor itself, so it cannot share that job with these.';
      }
      q('[data-id="heads-up"]').hidden = clear;
    }
    function render() {
      dialog.dataset.step = String(step);
      dialog.dataset.mode = current.compactMode ? 'floating' : 'standard';
      dialog.dataset.motion = current.motion ? 'full' : 'reduced';
      qa('.step').forEach(element => { element.hidden = Number(element.dataset.step) !== step; });
      q('[data-id="count"]').textContent = `Step ${step + 1} of ${lastStep + 1}`;
      qa('.progress i').forEach((element, index) => { element.toggleAttribute('data-on', index <= step); });
      qa('input[name="setup-theme"]').forEach(input => { input.checked = input.value === current.theme; });
      qa('input[name="setup-mode"]').forEach(input => { input.checked = (input.value === 'floating') === current.compactMode; });
      qa('[data-accent]').forEach(button => button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(button.dataset.accent === current.accent)));
      q('[data-id="tip-arrange"]').hidden = !current.compactMode;
      q('[data-id="back"]').hidden = step === 0;
      q('[data-id="skip"]').hidden = step === lastStep;
      q('[data-id="settings"]').hidden = step !== lastStep;
      q('[data-id="next"]').textContent = nextLabels[step];
      if (step === 3) detect();
    }
    function go(next) {
      step = Math.max(0, Math.min(lastStep, next));
      render();
      q('[data-id="steps"]').scrollTop = 0;
    }
    function choose(patch) {
      current = config.sanitize({ ...current, ...patch });
      render();
      config.write(patch).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("choose",studioError);});
    }
    function onKeydown(event) {
      if (!opened) return;
      event.stopPropagation();
      if (event.key === 'Escape') { event.preventDefault(); close(); return; }
      if (event.key === 'Enter' && focusedElement() === dialog) { event.preventDefault(); q('[data-id="next"]').click(); return; }
      if (event.key !== 'Tab') return;
      const controls = qa('button,input').filter(element => !element.closest('[hidden]') && !element.disabled);
      const index = controls.indexOf(focusedElement());
      if (index === -1 || (event.shiftKey ? index === 0 : index === controls.length - 1)) {
        event.preventDefault();
        (event.shiftKey ? controls.at(-1) : controls[0])?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      }
    }
    function open(settings = null) {
      if (opened) return;
      opened = true; step = 0;
      returnFocus = focusedElement();
      if (settings) current = settings;
      render();
      dialog.classList.add('open'); scrim.classList.add('open');
      document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeydown, true);
      watcher = setInterval(() => { if (step === 3) detect(); }, 1500);
      dialog.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      if (!settings) config.read().then(value => { current = value; render(); }).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("open",studioError);});
    }
    function close() {
      if (!opened) return;
      opened = false;
      clearInterval(watcher); watcher = 0;
      dialog.classList.remove('open'); scrim.classList.remove('open');
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeydown, true);
      setupSeen = true;
      try { Promise.resolve(GM_setValue(SETUP_KEY, true)).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("close",studioError);}); } catch (studioError) { reportStudioError("close",studioError);}
      if (returnFocus?.isConnected) returnFocus.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      returnFocus = null;
    }
    qa('input[name="setup-theme"]').forEach(input => input.addEventListener('change', () => { if (input.checked) choose({ theme: input.value }); }));
    qa('input[name="setup-mode"]').forEach(input => input.addEventListener('change', () => { if (input.checked) choose({ compactMode: input.value === 'floating' }); }));
    qa('[data-accent]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => choose({ accent: button.dataset.accent })));
    q('[data-id="next"]').addEventListener('click', () => { if (step === lastStep) close(); else go(step + 1); });
    q('[data-id="back"]').addEventListener('click', () => go(step - 1));
    q('[data-id="skip"]').addEventListener('click', close);
    q('[data-id="settings"]').addEventListener('click', () => { close(); openStudioUI(); });
    chrome.storage.onChanged.addListener((changes, area) => {
      if (!opened || area !== 'local' || !Object.keys(changes).some(key => key.startsWith('wmeStudio.'))) return;
      current = config.changes(current, changes);
      render();
    });
    studioSetup = { host, open, close, isOpen: () => opened };
    return studioSetup;
  }

      const mark = kind => { if (kind) html.setAttribute('data-wme-studio-intro', kind); else html.removeAttribute('data-wme-studio-intro'); };
      const say = async (title, text = '') => {
        if (caption.classList.contains('in')) { caption.classList.add('out'); await pause(210); }
        const heading = $('[data-id="title"]');
        heading.textContent = '';
        words(title).split(' ').forEach((word, index) => {
          const span = document.createElement('span'); span.className = 'word'; span.textContent = word; span.style.transitionDelay = `${index * 60}ms`;
          heading.append(span, ' ');
        });
        $('[data-id="text"]').textContent = text ? words(text) : '';
        caption.classList.remove('in', 'out'); await frame(); caption.classList.add('in');
      };
      const shift = async (update, kind) => {
        if (typeof document.startViewTransition !== 'function') {
          curtain.classList.add('on'); await pause(280); update(); await pause(160); curtain.classList.remove('on'); await pause(300); return;
        }
        mark(kind);
        const transition = active = document.startViewTransition(async () => { update(); await new Promise(ok => setTimeout(ok, 80)); });
        if (kind === 'wipe') transition.ready.then(() => { const sweep = $('.sweep'); sweep.classList.remove('run'); void sweep.offsetWidth; sweep.classList.add('run'); }).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("shift",studioError);});
        try { await transition.finished; } catch (_) {}
        active = null;
        if (done) { mark(null); throw new Error('skip'); }
        mark('idle');
      };
      const ping = () => {
        ['#app-head', '#drawer', '#overlay-buttons'].forEach((selector, index) => {
          const element = document.querySelector(selector), rect = element?.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (!rect || rect.width < 8 || rect.height < 8) return;
          const ring = document.createElement('i');
          ring.className = 'ping';
          ring.style.cssText = `left:${rect.left}px;top:${rect.top}px;width:${rect.width}px;height:${rect.height}px;border-radius:${getComputedStyle(element).borderRadius};animation-delay:${index * 130}ms`;
          stage.append(ring); setTimeout(() => ring.remove(), 1700);
        });
      };
      const finish = () => {
        if (done) return;
        done = true;
        document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
        try { active?.skipTransition(); } catch (_) { reportStudioError("finish",_);}
        release?.();
        preview.clear(); mark(null);
        host.style.opacity = '0'; host.style.pointerEvents = 'none'; stage.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
        setTimeout(() => host.remove(), 500);
        resolve();
      };
      const onKey = event => {
        if (event.key === 'Escape') { event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation(); finish(); }
      };
      const floatingFits = matchMedia(globalThis.WMEStudioSafari.viewport).matches;
      const run = async () => {
        mark('idle');
        $('.progress').animate([{ transform: 'scaleX(0)' }, { transform: 'scaleX(1)' }], { duration: floatingFits ? 12400 : 10100, easing: 'linear', fill: 'forwards' });
        curtain.classList.add('on'); await pause(280);
        preview.set({ enabled: false }); await pause(240);
        stage.classList.add('live'); $('.shade').classList.add('on'); curtain.classList.remove('on');
        await pause(380);
        await say('You know this editor.', 'Header on top, sidebar on the left, panels where they have always been.');
        await pause(2100);
        await say('Not like this.');
        await pause(760);
        await shift(() => preview.set({ enabled: true, compactMode: false }), 'wipe');
        await pause(120);
        await say('This is WME Studio.', floatingFits ? 'The same editor, with its controls lifted off the map.' : 'The Waze Map Editor, your way.');
        await pause(floatingFits ? 620 : 1700);
        if (floatingFits) { await shift(() => preview.set({ enabled: true, compactMode: true }), 'morph'); ping(); await pause(1700); }
        caption.classList.add('out'); stage.classList.add('end'); $('.shade').classList.remove('on'); veil.classList.add('on');
        await pause(140);
        card.classList.add('in');
        await pause(2500);
        card.classList.add('out'); await pause(260);
      };
      $('[data-id="skip"]').addEventListener('click', finish);
      document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
      html.append(host);
      run().catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("playStudioIntro",studioError);}).finally(finish);
    });
  }
  function maybeStartSetup() {
    if (setupStarted || setupSeen !== false || !uiRouteAllowed() || window.top !== window.self) return;
    if (!document.getElementById('app-head') || !document.querySelector('.overlay-buttons-container,#overlay-buttons')) return;
    setupStarted = true;
    const settled = new Promise(ok => { const go = () => setTimeout(ok, 900); if (document.readyState === 'complete') go(); else window.addEventListener('load', go, { once: true }); });
    Promise.all([globalThis.WMEStudioSettings.read(), settled]).then(([value]) => {
      if (!value.enabled || setupSeen !== false) return;
      const visible = document.visibilityState === 'visible' ? Promise.resolve() : new Promise(ok => document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function shown() { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') { document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', shown); ok(); } }));
      visible.then(() => playStudioIntro(value)).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("maybeStartSetup",studioError);}).then(() => buildStudioSetup()?.open(value));
    }).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("maybeStartSetup",studioError);});
  }
  Promise.resolve(GM_getValue(SETUP_KEY, false)).then(value => { setupSeen = value === true; maybeStartSetup(); }).catch((studioError) => { reportStudioError("Studio initialization",studioError); setupSeen = true; });

  }

  // Command palette > "Inspect an element". The next click is not passed on to the editor; it is described instead:
  // what the element and its parents are, what is inside the component it belongs to, and the colours in use.
  let studioInspecting = false;
  function inspectStudioElement() {
    if (studioInspecting || window.top !== window.self) return;
    studioInspecting = true;
    const marker = document.createElement('div'), banner = document.createElement('div');
    marker.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;z-index:2147483646;pointer-events:none;border:2px solid #0099ff;background:#0099ff22;border-radius:4px;display:none';
    banner.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:50%;top:14px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:2147483647;pointer-events:none;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:10px;background:#1d2024;color:#fff;border:1px solid #4b5560;box-shadow:0 8px 30px #0008;font:600 13px/1.3 system-ui,sans-serif';
    banner.textContent = 'Click the element to describe. Esc cancels.';
    marker.setAttribute('data-ws-keep', ''); banner.setAttribute('data-ws-keep', '');
    (document.body || document.documentElement).append(marker, banner);
    const short = (value, limit) => { const text = String(value ?? '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); return text.length > limit ? text.slice(0, limit) + '…' : text; };
    const name = element => {
      let text = element.localName + (element.id ? '#' + element.id : '') + (element.classList?.length ? '.' + [...element.classList].slice(0, 6).join('.') : '');
      for (const attribute of ['type', 'role', 'for', 'name', 'checked', 'disabled', 'indeterminate', 'aria-checked', 'aria-disabled', 'value', 'color', 'size']) if (element.hasAttribute?.(attribute)) text += `[${attribute}="${short(element.getAttribute(attribute), 30)}"]`;
      return text;
    };
    const look = (element, pseudo) => {
      const style = getComputedStyle(element, pseudo || null);
      if (pseudo && (style.content === 'none' || style.content === 'normal')) return null;
      const out = { color: style.color, background: style.backgroundColor, border: `${style.borderTopWidth} ${style.borderTopStyle} ${style.borderTopColor}`, opacity: style.opacity, display: style.display };
      if (style.backgroundImage !== 'none') out.backgroundImage = short(style.backgroundImage, 110);
      if (pseudo) { out.content = short(style.content, 40); out.font = short(style.fontFamily, 50); out.size = `${style.width} x ${style.height}`; }
      if (element.localName === 'svg' || element.closest?.('svg')) { out.fill = style.fill; out.stroke = style.stroke; out.visibility = style.visibility; }
      return out;
    };
    const describe = target => {
      const chain = []; let node = target;
      while (node && chain.length < 10) {
        if (node.nodeType === 1) { chain.push((node.checked === true ? '(checked now) ' : node.checked === false && node.localName !== 'input' ? '' : node.localName === 'input' ? '(not checked now) ' : '') + name(node)); node = node.parentNode; }
        else if (node.nodeType === 11 && node.host) { chain.push('  #shadow-root of ↓'); node = node.host; }
        else break;
      }
      const root = target.getRootNode(), host = root?.host || null, parts = {};
      for (const [label, element] of [['element', target], ['parent', target.parentElement], ['grandparent', target.parentElement?.parentElement]]) {
        if (!element) continue;
        parts[label] = { is: name(element), look: look(element) };
        const before = look(element, '::before'), after = look(element, '::after');
        if (before) parts[label].before = before; if (after) parts[label].after = after;
      }
      const previous = target.previousElementSibling, next = target.nextElementSibling;
      return JSON.stringify({
        studio: USERSCRIPT_VERSION, theme: document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-theme'), floating: document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-compact') === 'on', addons: document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-addons'),
        path: chain, ...parts,
        siblings: { previous: previous ? name(previous) : null, next: next ? name(next) : null },
        html: short(target.outerHTML, 700),
        component: host ? { host: name(host), hostProperties: { checked: host.checked, disabled: host.disabled, indeterminate: host.indeterminate }, studioSheets: root.adoptedStyleSheets?.length || 0, inside: short(root.innerHTML.replace(/<style[\s\S]*?<\/style>/g, '<style>…</style>'), 1800) } : null,
        around: short(target.parentElement?.outerHTML, 900)
      }, null, 1);
    };
    const pick = event => event.composedPath().find(node => node.nodeType === 1) || event.target;
    const stop = event => { event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation(); };
    const move = event => { const rect = pick(event).getBoundingClientRect(); Object.assign(marker.style, { display: 'block', left: `${rect.left - 2}px`, top: `${rect.top - 2}px`, width: `${rect.width + 4}px`, height: `${rect.height + 4}px` }); };
    const events = ['pointerdown', 'mousedown', 'pointerup', 'mouseup'];
    const finish = () => {
      studioInspecting = false; marker.remove(); banner.remove();
      window.removeEventListener('pointermove', move, true); window.removeEventListener('click', click, true); window.removeEventListener('keydown', key, true);
      for (const type of events) window.removeEventListener(type, stop, true);
    };
    const click = event => {
      stop(event); const target = pick(event); finish();
      let text; try { text = describe(target); } catch (error) { text = `The element could not be described: ${error?.message || error}`; }
      showStudioTextReport('wme-studio-element-report', 'Element report', 'How the element you clicked is built and coloured. Copy this and send it along when something is not themed correctly.', text);
    };
    const key = event => { if (event.key === 'Escape') { stop(event); finish(); } };
    window.addEventListener('pointermove', move, true); window.addEventListener('click', click, true); window.addEventListener('keydown', key, true);
    for (const type of events) window.addEventListener(type, stop, true);
  }
  function recordStudioPerformance(seconds = 15) {
    if (performanceRecording || window.top !== window.self) return;
    performanceRecording = true;
    const scripts = new Map(), started = performance.now();
    let frames = 0, slow = 0, worst = 0, last = 0, tick = 0, longFrames = 0, blocked = 0, observer = null;
    const step = now => { if (last) { const gap = now - last; frames++; if (gap > 34) slow++; if (gap > worst) worst = gap; } last = now; tick = requestAnimationFrame(step); };
    tick = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    const nameOf = url => {
      const text = String(url || '');
      const named = /[?&]name=([^&#]+)/.exec(text);
      if (named) { try { return decodeURIComponent(named[1]); } catch (_) { return named[1]; } }
      return text.replace(/[?#].*$/, '').split('/').filter(Boolean).pop() || '(page)';
    };
    try {
      observer = new PerformanceObserver(list => {
        for (const entry of list.getEntries()) {
          longFrames++; blocked += entry.blockingDuration || 0;
          for (const script of entry.scripts || []) {
            const key = `${nameOf(script.sourceURL)} | ${script.sourceFunctionName || '-'} | ${script.invoker || script.invokerType || '-'}`.slice(0, 170);
            const item = scripts.get(key) || { ms: 0, calls: 0, layout: 0 };
            item.ms += script.duration || 0; item.calls++; item.layout += script.forcedStyleAndLayoutDuration || 0;
            scripts.set(key, item);
          }
        }
      });
      observer.observe({ type: 'long-animation-frame', buffered: false });
    } catch (_) { observer = null; }
    const host = document.createElement('div');
    host.id = 'wme-studio-performance-report'; host.setAttribute('data-ws-keep', '');
    host.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:36px;z-index:2147483646';
    const shadow = host.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' });
    shadow.innerHTML = `<style>
      .box{width:min(520px,calc(100vw - 32px));padding:14px;border-radius:14px;background:#1d2024;color:#edf1f4;border:1px solid #4b5560;box-shadow:0 12px 40px #0009;font:13px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif}
      b{display:block;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:4px}p{margin:0 0 10px;color:#c0c8d0}
      textarea{display:block;width:100%;height:210px;box-sizing:border-box;resize:vertical;background:#111418;color:#dfe5ea;border:1px solid #3d444b;border-radius:8px;padding:8px;font:11px/1.4 ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace}
      .row{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:10px}
      button{height:32px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #4b5560;background:#2a2f35;color:#fff;font:600 12px/1 system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
      button.primary{background:#0099ff;border-color:#0099ff;color:#08131d}
    </style><div class="box" role="dialog" aria-label="WME Studio performance report"><b>Recording performance…</b><p class="note">Keep using the editor as usual for ${seconds} seconds: move and zoom the map, select things, open panels.</p></div>`;
    (document.body || document.documentElement).append(host);
    setTimeout(async () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(tick); observer?.disconnect();
      const elapsed = (performance.now() - started) / 1000;
      let saved = {};
      try { saved = await globalThis.WMEStudioSettings.read(); } catch (_) { saved = {}; }
      const keep = ['enabled', 'theme', 'compactMode', 'compactIslandOpacity', 'motion', 'addons', 'eyeSaver', 'satelliteBrightness', 'viewportBrightness', 'gpsOpacity', 'gpsBelowRoads', 'fontScale', 'hudScale', 'compactRequests'];
      const top = [...scripts.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1].ms - a[1].ms).slice(0, 14)
        .map(([name, item]) => ({ script: name, ms: Math.round(item.ms), calls: item.calls, forcedLayoutMs: Math.round(item.layout) }));
      const report = {
        studio: USERSCRIPT_VERSION, seconds: Math.round(elapsed),
        frames: { perSecond: Math.round(frames / elapsed), slowerThan30fps: slow, worstMs: Math.round(worst) },
        longFrames: observer ? { count: longFrames, blockedMs: Math.round(blocked) } : 'not supported by this browser',
        busiestScripts: top,
        page: { elements: document.getElementsByTagName('*').length, mapVectors: document.querySelectorAll('.olMapViewport svg *').length, window: `${innerWidth}x${innerHeight}@${devicePixelRatio}`, cores: navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 0, memoryGB: navigator.deviceMemory || 0 },
        settings: Object.fromEntries(keep.filter(key => key in saved).map(key => [key, saved[key]])),
        browser: navigator.userAgent.replace(/^.*?(Chrome|Firefox|Version)\//, '$1/').slice(0, 60)
      };
      const box = shadow.querySelector('.box');
      box.innerHTML = '<b>Performance report</b><p>Copy this and send it along when you report a slowdown.</p><textarea readonly spellcheck="false"></textarea><div class="row"><button type="button" class="close">Close</button><button type="button" class="primary copy">Copy</button></div>';
      const area = box.querySelector('textarea'); area.value = JSON.stringify(report, null, 1);
      box.querySelector('.close').addEventListener('click', () => host.remove());
      box.querySelector('.copy').addEventListener('click', async event => {
        try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(area.value); } catch (_) { area.select(); try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (__) { /* the text stays selected for a manual copy */ } }
        event.currentTarget.textContent = 'Copied';
      });
      performanceRecording = false;
    }, seconds * 1000);
  }
  if (typeof GM_registerMenuCommand === 'function') {
    GM_registerMenuCommand(globalThis.WMEStudioI18n.t('WME Studio: Open settings'), openStudioUI);
    GM_registerMenuCommand('WME Studio: Command palette',openStudioCommands);
    GM_registerMenuCommand(globalThis.WMEStudioI18n.t('WME Studio: Toggle on/off'), async () => {
      const cfg = globalThis.WMEStudioSettings;
      const now = await cfg.read();
      await cfg.write({ enabled: !now.enabled });
    });
  }

  (() => {
    const LIST = '.problem-edit .comment-list';
    const settingsApi = globalThis.WMEStudioSettings;
    let visible = settingsApi?.defaults?.discussionVisible ?? 2;
    const fit = list => {
      try {
        const items = list.querySelectorAll(':scope > .comment');
        if (items.length <= visible) { if (list.style.getPropertyValue('--ws-ur-list-max')) list.style.removeProperty('--ws-ur-list-max'); return; }
        const height = Math.ceil(items[visible - 1].getBoundingClientRect().bottom - items[0].getBoundingClientRect().top);
        const value = Math.ceil(height / (list.currentCSSZoom || 1)) + 'px';
        if (height > 0 && list.style.getPropertyValue('--ws-ur-list-max') !== value) list.style.setProperty('--ws-ur-list-max', value);
      } catch (_) { reportStudioError("fit",_);}
    };
    const observedComments = new Set();
    const resize = typeof ResizeObserver === 'function'
      ? new ResizeObserver(entries => {
          const lists = new Set();
          for (const entry of entries) { const list = entry.target.closest?.('.comment-list'); if (list) lists.add(list); }
          lists.forEach(fit);
        })
      : null;
    let queued = false;
    const isCompact = () => document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-wme-studio-requests') === 'compact';
    const setShort = (el, value) => {
      if (!el) return;
      if (value) { if (el.getAttribute('data-ws-short') !== value) el.setAttribute('data-ws-short', value); }
      else if (el.hasAttribute('data-ws-short')) el.removeAttribute('data-ws-short');
    };
    const afterLabel = text => {
      const clean = String(text || '').replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ').trim();
      const at = clean.indexOf(': ');
      return at > 0 && at < 40 ? clean.slice(at + 2).trim() : '';
    };
    const shortDates = new Map();
    const shortDate = text => {
      const clean = String(text || '').trim();
      if (!clean) return '';
      const year = new Date().getFullYear(), key = `${year}|${document.documentElement.lang}|${clean}`;
      let short = shortDates.get(key);
      if (short === undefined) {
        const date = new Date(clean);
        if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) short = '';
        else {
          const options = { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' };
          if (date.getFullYear() !== year) options.year = 'numeric';
          try { short = date.toLocaleDateString(document.documentElement.lang || undefined, options); } catch (_) { reportStudioError("shortDate",_); short = ''; }
        }
        if (shortDates.size > 400) shortDates.clear();
        shortDates.set(key, short);
      }
      return short;
    };
    const shorten = panel => {
      try {
        const reported = panel.querySelector('[class*="reported--"]');
        setShort(reported, reported ? afterLabel(reported.textContent) : '');
        const source = panel.querySelector('[class*="sourceInfo--"]');
        setShort(source, source ? afterLabel(source.textContent) : '');
        for (const date of panel.querySelectorAll('.conversation-view .comment .date')) setShort(date, shortDate(date.textContent));
      } catch (_) { reportStudioError("shorten",_);}
    };
    const scan = () => {
      queued = false;
      if (isCompact()) for (const panel of document.querySelectorAll('.problem-edit, .place-update-edit')) shorten(panel);
      const nextComments = new Set();
      for (const list of document.querySelectorAll(LIST)) {
        fit(list);
        if (resize) for (const item of Array.from(list.querySelectorAll(':scope > .comment')).slice(0, visible)) nextComments.add(item);
      }
      for (const item of observedComments) if (!nextComments.has(item)) {
        resize.unobserve(item); observedComments.delete(item);
      }
      for (const item of nextComments) if (!observedComments.has(item)) {
        resize.observe(item); observedComments.add(item);
      }
    };
    const queue = () => { if (!queued) { queued = true; requestAnimationFrame(scan); } };
    const load = () => settingsApi?.read?.().then(value => { visible = value.discussionVisible; queue(); }).catch(() => {});
    try {
      chrome.storage.onChanged.addListener((changes, area) => {
        if (area === 'local' && changes['wmeStudio.discussionVisible']) load();
      });
    } catch (_) { reportStudioError("Studio initialization",_);}
    load();
    const PANEL = '.problem-edit, .place-update-edit';
    const SVG_NAMESPACE = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
    const relevant = records => {
      let inspected = 0;
      for (let index = 0; index < records.length; index++) {
        const record = records[index], target = record.target;
        if (target.namespaceURI === SVG_NAMESPACE) continue;
        if (++inspected > 256) return true;
        const element = target.nodeType === 1 ? target : target.parentElement;
        if (element?.closest(PANEL)) return true;
        for (const node of record.removedNodes) {
          if (node.nodeType === 1 && (node.matches(PANEL) || (node.firstElementChild && node.querySelector(PANEL)))) return true;
        }
        for (const node of record.addedNodes) {
          if (node.nodeType === 1 && (node.matches(PANEL) || (node.firstElementChild && node.querySelector(PANEL)))) return true;
        }
      }
      return false;
    };
    const observe = records => {
      if (queued) return;
      if (relevant(records)) queue();
    };
    const start = () => {
      if (globalThis.WMEStudioVectorWatch) globalThis.WMEStudioVectorWatch.watch(observe, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true });
      else new MutationObserver(observe).observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true });
      new MutationObserver(queue).observe(document.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-wme-studio-requests'] });
      queue();
    };
    if (document.documentElement) start();
    else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start, { once: true });
  })();

})();
